articles.title: The Superpile Cycle: the reorganisation of basal mantle structures coupled to the supercontinent cycle
articles.title_zh: 超级堆旋回：与超大陆旋回耦合的基底地幔结构的重组
articles.abstract: The coupling between the surface and deep Earth is fundamental to the dynamics of the planet, yet the nature of these interactions remain incompletely understood. These processes are elusive, in part, because of a lack of constraints on the nature and evolution large low shear-velocity provinces (LLSVPs) near the core-mantle boundary (CMB), and their role in mantle circulation. Here we use a suite of 24 3D mantle circulation models, spanning a wide parameter space of CMB temperature, plate velocity, viscosity structure, and basal layer properties, to assess the stability of LLSVP-like structures and their relationships to upwellings, downwellings, and plate tectonics. We propose the hypothesis of a `superpile cycle' (named after its close ties to the supercontinent cycle, and usage of the term `super-pile' to describe LLSVPs beneath Africa and Pacific Ocean) that depicts the evolution of the deep Earth in response to supercontinent dynamics. Supercontinents assemble with stable subduction girdles and antipodal basal mantle structures, then break apart. During dispersal, new subduction zones form, slabs induce more complex mantle flow and disrupt the stable degree 2 structure in the lowermost mantle during a brief `rearrangement event', in which mantle plumes become more numerous and widely distributed. As subduction zone locations stabilise, LLSVP-like structures tend back to antipodal piles, plume activity becomes more focussed, and a new supercontinent assembles. This cyclicity, and the relative ordering of events, is consistent across the model suite , suggesting a coupled relationship between supercontinent dynamics, basal mantle structures, and distribution of upwellings through time.
articles.abstract_zh: 地球表面和深层之间的耦合是地球动力学的基础，但这些相互作用的本质仍然不完全清楚。这些过程难以捉摸，部分原因是缺乏对核幔边界（CMB）附近大型低剪切速度区（LLSVP）的性质和演化及其在地幔循环中的作用的约束。在这里，我们使用一套 24 个 3D 地幔循环模型，涵盖 CMB 温度、板块速度、粘度结构和基底层特性的广泛参数空间，来评估类 LLSVP 结构的稳定性及其与上升流、下降流和板块构造的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 地球表面和深层之间的耦合是地球动力学的基础，但这些相互作用的本质仍然不完全清楚。这些过程难以捉摸，部分原因是缺乏对核幔边界（CMB）附近大型低剪切速度区（LLSVP）的性质和演化及其在地幔循环中的作用的约束。在这里，我们使用一套 24 个 3D 地幔循环模型，涵盖 CMB 温度、板块速度、粘度结构和基底层特性的广泛参数空间，来评估类 LLSVP 结构的稳定性及其与上升流、下降流和板块构造的关系。我们提出了“超级桩循环”的假设（以其与超大陆循环的密切联系而命名，并使用“超级桩”一词来描述非洲和太平洋下方的 LLSVP），该假设描述了地球深处响应超大陆动力学的演化。超大陆由稳定的俯冲带和对映的基底地幔结构聚集在一起，然后分裂。在扩散过程中，新的俯冲带形成，板片诱发更复杂的地幔流，并在短暂的“重排事件”期间破坏最低地幔中稳定的二级结构，其中地幔柱变得更多且分布更广泛。随着俯冲带位置的稳定，类 LLSVP 的结构趋向于回到反足堆，羽流活动变得更加集中，新的超大陆聚集在一起。这种周期性和事件的相对顺序在整个模型组中是一致的，表明超大陆动力学、基底地幔结构和上升流随时间的分布之间存在耦合关系。

articles.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Spatiotemporal Prediction of Urban Heat Dynamics: Insights from Chicago
articles.title_zh: 用于城市热动力学时空预测的可解释机器学习：来自芝加哥的见解
articles.abstract: Urbanization is intensifying Land Surface Temperature (LST) dynamics and Urban Heat Island (UHI) effects in rapidly expanding cities. Yet, the intricate interactions among land cover, carbon storage (CS), and socioeconomic factors remain inadequately understood at detailed spatial and temporal scales. Here we synthesize remote sensing, GIS, and census tract data with ensemble machine learning (ML) techniques to model the spatiotemporal variability of LST in Chicago from 2000 to 2022. Using Landsat and MODIS datasets, we apply a quantile mapping approach to reduce inter-sensor bias and align temperature distributions. Land-cover and CS assessments are derived from the National Land Cover Database (NLCD) and the Integrated Valuation of Ecosystem Services and Trade-Offs (InVEST) model. Long-term temperature records reveal a statistically significant warming trend over 52 years (P = 0.03), with the frequency of extreme temperature days increasing from 5 in 2000 to 28 in 2022. Adjusted LST maps show a 5–6°C rise in average surface temperature over two decades, with the most pronounced warming concentrated in industrial and high-density developed areas. Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) outperformed Random Forest (RF), achieving higher predictive performance (R² = 0.55 vs. 0.49) and marginally better classification of temperature extremes (Area under the Curve, AUC = 0.85 vs. 0.84). SHAP analysis identifies vegetation cover and carbon stock density as the strongest cooling factors, whereas built-up intensity and population density are associated with higher LST. Partial dependence analysis reveals nonlinear predictor–response relationships, including a diminishing marginal cooling effect of vegetation at high NDVI values. Total carbon storage across Chicago’s census tracts declined by 0.38% over the study period, with the spatial concordance between carbon depletion and thermal amplification providing evidence that carbon conservation serves dual climate mitigation and heat reduction objectives. These results demonstrate the utility of interpretable machine learning for understanding urban thermal dynamics and provide a scalable, transferable framework for climate-informed urban planning and heat mitigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 城市化正在加剧快速扩张的城市中的地表温度 (LST) 动态和城市热岛 (UHI) 效应。然而，在详细的时空尺度上，土地覆盖、碳储存（CS）和社会经济因素之间错综复杂的相互作用仍然没有得到充分的了解。在这里，我们利用集成机器学习 (ML) 技术综合遥感、GIS 和人口普查区数据，对 2000 年至 2022 年芝加哥地表温度的时空变化进行建模。使用 Landsat 和 MODIS 数据集，我们应用分位数映射方法来减少传感器间偏差并调整温度分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 城市化正在加剧快速扩张的城市中的地表温度 (LST) 动态和城市热岛 (UHI) 效应。然而，在详细的时空尺度上，土地覆盖、碳储存（CS）和社会经济因素之间错综复杂的相互作用仍然没有得到充分的了解。在这里，我们利用集成机器学习 (ML) 技术综合遥感、GIS 和人口普查区数据，对 2000 年至 2022 年芝加哥地表温度的时空变化进行建模。使用 Landsat 和 MODIS 数据集，我们应用分位数映射方法来减少传感器间偏差并调整温度分布。土地覆盖和 CS 评估源自国家土地覆盖数据库 (NLCD) 和生态系统服务和权衡综合估值 (InVEST) 模型。长期温度记录揭示了52年来统计上显着的变暖趋势（P = 0.03），极端温度日的频率从2000年的5天增加到2022年的28天。调整后的LST地图显示，二十年来平均地表温度上升了5-6°C，最明显的变暖集中在工业和高密度发达地区。极端梯度提升 (XGBoost) 优于随机森林 (RF)，实现了更高的预测性能（R² = 0.55 与 0.49），并且对极端温度的分类稍好（曲线下面积，AUC = 0.85 与 0.84）。 SHAP 分析确定植被覆盖和碳储量密度是最强的降温因素，而建筑强度和人口密度则与较高的地表温度相关。部分依赖性分析揭示了非线性预测-响应关系，包括植被在高 NDVI 值下边际冷却效应递减。在研究期间，芝加哥人口普查区的总碳储存量下降了 0.38%，碳消耗和热放大之间的空间一致性提供了证据，表明碳节约服务于减缓气候变化和减少热量的双重目标。这些结果证明了可解释的机器学习在理解城市热动力学方面的实用性，并为气候知情的城市规划和热量缓解提供了可扩展、可转移的框架。

articles.title: Analytical Modeling of an Outer-Rotor Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Machine with Dual Stator-Toothed Magnets Considering Magnetic Saturation
articles.title_zh: 考虑磁饱和的双定子齿磁体外转子磁通切换永磁电机的分析建模
articles.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive two-dimensional analytical model for a outer-rotor flux-switching permanent magnet (ORFSPM) machine, accounting for magnetic saturation effects in both radial and tangential flux density components. The ORFSPM topology is particularly attractive for applications requiring high torque density and compact design, such as in-wheel electric vehicle drives, direct-drive industrial systems, and high-performance servo applications. The model is developed using the subdomain method, where the machine geometry is divided into distinct regions (stator slots, permanent magnets, airgap, and rotor slots). Magnetic saturation is incorporated through an iterative local correction technique based on the actual B-H curve of the lamination steel, applied separately to the stator teeth and yoke. The analytical model predicts key electromagnetic performance indicators, including cogging torque, electromagnetic torque, and unbalanced magnetic force (UMF). These parameters are critical for assessing vibration and acoustic noise, which are major concerns in high-performance applications. The results are validated against finite element method (FEM) simulations, demonstrating excellent agreement. The proposed model offers a computationally efficient and accurate tool for early-stage design and optimization of ORFSPM machines, particularly for applications where torque smoothness, low vibration, and high power density are essential.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了外转子磁通切换永磁 (ORFSPM) 电机的综合二维分析模型，考虑了径向和切向磁通密度分量的磁饱和效应。 ORFSPM 拓扑对于需要高扭矩密度和紧凑设计的应用特别有吸引力，例如轮内电动汽车驱动、直接驱动工业系统和高性能伺服应用。该模型是使用子域方法开发的，其中机器几何形状被分为不同的区域（定子槽、永磁体、气隙和转子槽）。磁饱和是通过基于叠片钢的实际 B-H 曲线的迭代局部校正技术合并的，该技术分别应用于定子齿和磁轭。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了外转子磁通切换永磁 (ORFSPM) 电机的综合二维分析模型，考虑了径向和切向磁通密度分量的磁饱和效应。 ORFSPM 拓扑对于需要高扭矩密度和紧凑设计的应用特别有吸引力，例如轮内电动汽车驱动、直接驱动工业系统和高性能伺服应用。该模型是使用子域方法开发的，其中机器几何形状被分为不同的区域（定子槽、永磁体、气隙和转子槽）。磁饱和是通过基于叠片钢的实际 B-H 曲线的迭代局部校正技术合并的，该技术分别应用于定子齿和磁轭。分析模型预测了关键的电磁性能指标，包括齿槽转矩、电磁转矩和不平衡磁力 (UMF)。这些参数对于评估振动和噪声至关重要，而振动和噪声是高性能应用中的主要问题。结果通过有限元法 (FEM) 模拟进行验证，表现出极好的一致性。所提出的模型为 ORFSPM 机器的早期设计和优化提供了计算高效且准确的工具，特别是对于扭矩平滑、低振动和高功率密度至关重要的应用。

articles.title: Performance comparison of solar PV fed PI, MPC & AI controller for fast battery charging system in Electric Vehicles
articles.title_zh: 用于电动汽车电池快速充电系统的太阳能光伏馈电 PI、MPC 和 AI 控制器的性能比较
articles.abstract: The integration of solar photovoltaics (PV) for electric vehicle (EV) charging presents challenges due to the intermittent nature of solar energy and the stringent requirements of fast-charging lithium-ion batteries. This paper presents a comparative performance analysis of three control architectures: the traditional Proportional-Integral (PI) controller, the Model Predictive Control (MPC), and AI-based strategies (specifically Artificial Neural Networks). The study focuses on key metrics, including Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) efficiency, transient response, voltage overshoot, and battery State-of-Charge (SoC) stability. Results indicate that while PI controllers offer simplicity, they suffer from high overshoot and slow settling times. MPC provides superior constraint handling but is computationally intensive. In contrast, AI controllers exhibit the best real-time adaptability, reducing voltage overshoot by up to **80%** and improving settling time by over **50%** compared to conventional methods, making them the most robust solution for dynamic environmental conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于太阳能的间歇性和快速充电锂离子电池的严格要求，用于电动汽车（EV）充电的太阳能光伏（PV）集成提出了挑战。本文对三种控制架构进行了性能比较分析：传统比例积分 (PI) 控制器、模型预测控制 (MPC) 和基于人工智能的策略（特别是人工神经网络）。该研究重点关注关键指标，包括最大功率点跟踪 (MPPT) 效率、瞬态响应、电压过冲和电池充电状态 (SoC) 稳定性。结果表明，虽然 PI 控制器很简单，但它们存在高超调和缓慢的稳定时间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于太阳能的间歇性和快速充电锂离子电池的严格要求，用于电动汽车（EV）充电的太阳能光伏（PV）集成提出了挑战。本文对三种控制架构进行了性能比较分析：传统比例积分 (PI) 控制器、模型预测控制 (MPC) 和基于人工智能的策略（特别是人工神经网络）。该研究重点关注关键指标，包括最大功率点跟踪 (MPPT) 效率、瞬态响应、电压过冲和电池充电状态 (SoC) 稳定性。结果表明，虽然 PI 控制器很简单，但它们存在高超调和缓慢的稳定时间。 MPC 提供卓越的约束处理，但计算量较大。相比之下，人工智能控制器表现出最佳的实时适应性，与传统方法相比，电压过冲降低高达**80%**，稳定时间缩短**50%**以上，使其成为动态环境条件下最稳健的解决方案。

articles.title: Topological characteristics, formation mechanisms and risk propagation simulation of global unmanned aerial vehicle industrial chain trade network
articles.title_zh: 全球无人机产业链贸易网络拓扑特征、形成机制及风险传播模拟
articles.abstract: As a strategic high-tech product, the application of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has exerted a profound impact on military and civil domains, becoming a new focal point of major-power technological competition. Currently, global UAV trade is deeply embedded within intricate international geopolitical dynamics, rendering it vulnerable to multiple risk shocks. To address these challenges, an analytical framework of “pattern-mechanism-risk” is constructed. By employing complex network analysis, exponential random graph model (ERGM), and cascading failure model, this study dissects the topological characteristics and formation mechanisms of the global UAV industrial chain trade network in 2023. Furthermore, it simulates the propagation processes of risks triggered by upstream supply reduction. Results indicate that (1) The upstream, midstream, and downstream trade networks display structural characteristics spanning multipolarity, regionality, with the mainland of China playing a core exporting role across all segments. In the downstream segment, the trade community led by the mainland of China encompasses more than 85% of global economies and accounts for over 60% of the total trade value. (2) Endogenous structural and exogenous factors jointly shape the architecture of the trade network. Synergy effects across various industrial chain segments, particularly the midstream segment, play a prominent role in driving network formation. (3) Risk propagation within the industrial chain manifests a minority impact phenomenon. Basic material supply reduction in the mainland of China will impact over 90% of economies, including Germany and the United States, whereas the disruptive scope of the United States remains contained within the Americas. This study provides valuable references for the effective formulation of UAV industrial chain security policies and the scientific governance policies of dual-use technology products.
articles.abstract_zh: 无人机作为战略性高新技术产品，其应用对军事和民用领域产生了深刻影响，成为大国技术竞争的新焦点。当前，全球无人机贸易深深融入错综复杂的国际地缘政治动态，容易受到多重风险冲击。为了应对这些挑战，构建了“模式-机制-风险”的分析框架。本研究采用复杂网络分析、指数随机图模型（ERGM）和级联失效模型，剖析2023年全球无人机产业链贸易网络的拓扑特征和形成机制，并模拟上游供给减少引发的风险传播过程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无人机作为战略性高新技术产品，其应用对军事和民用领域产生了深刻影响，成为大国技术竞争的新焦点。当前，全球无人机贸易深深融入错综复杂的国际地缘政治动态，容易受到多重风险冲击。为了应对这些挑战，构建了“模式-机制-风险”的分析框架。本研究采用复杂网络分析、指数随机图模型（ERGM）和级联失效模型，剖析2023年全球无人机产业链贸易网络的拓扑特征和形成机制，并模拟上游供给减少引发的风险传播过程。研究结果表明：（1）上、中、下游贸易网络呈现出跨多极化、区域性的结构特征，中国内地在各个环节均发挥着出口核心作用。在下游环节，以中国内地为首的贸易群体涵盖了全球85%以上的经济体，占全球贸易总额的60%以上。 （2）内生结构性因素和外生性因素共同塑造贸易网络的架构。产业链各环节特别是中游环节的协同效应对网络形成的推动作用突出。 （三）产业链内风险传播呈现少数影响现象。中国大陆基础材料供应减少将影响90%以上的经济体，其中包括德国和美国，而美国的破坏范围仍局限于美洲。该研究为无人机产业链安全政策的有效制定和军民两用技术产品的科学治理政策提供了有价值的参考。

articles.title: Time-indexed FDS-derived Fire-risk Fields for Indoor UAV Emergency Routing in Building Fires
articles.title_zh: 建筑物火灾中室内无人机紧急路由的时间索引 FDS 火灾风险场
articles.abstract: Indoor building fires create rapidly changing heat, smoke, toxic-gas and visibility conditions, making emergency route selection difficult when only geometric accessibility is considered. Small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support pre-entry fire-response reconnaissance by inspecting smoke-affected corridors, potential access routes and hazardous rooms while reducing direct firefighter exposure. However, many routing studies still represent fire as a point source, a prescribed hazard zone or a single static risk map. This study proposes a fire-risk field enrichment framework that converts transient Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS)/PyroSim outputs into route-level risk information for indoor UAV emergency routing. Temperature, carbon monoxide (CO) concentration and visibility fields are sampled at UAV flight height, normalized into risk channels and fused into time-indexed fire-risk fields. These fields are combined with a hard obstacle occupancy map and embedded into a cost-augmented A^* planner. Robot Operating System 2 (ROS2)-Gazebo set-pose replay is used as an intermediate robotics-side check of spatial consistency and obstacle feasibility. For a fixed start--goal task, the proposed planner reduced cumulative sampled risk by 99.67% compared with Standard A^*. Across five late-stage start--goal cases, reductions ranged from 37.9% to 99.9%. Offline dynamic risk-map replanning further reduced sampled risk by 28.32%. The results show that transient fire simulation can provide actionable route-level support for indoor UAV fire-response reconnaissance.
articles.abstract_zh: 室内建筑火灾会产生快速变化的热量、烟雾、有毒气体和能见度条件，当仅考虑几何可达性时，使得紧急路线选择变得困难。小型无人机（UAV）可以通过检查受烟雾影响的走廊、潜在通道和危险房间来支持进入前的火灾响应侦察，同时减少消防员的直接暴露。然而，许多路径研究仍然将火灾表示为点源、规定的危险区域或单个静态风险地图。本研究提出了一种火灾风险现场丰富框架，可将瞬态火灾动力学模拟器（FDS）/PyroSim 输出转换为室内无人机紧急路由的路线级风险信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 室内建筑火灾会产生快速变化的热量、烟雾、有毒气体和能见度条件，当仅考虑几何可达性时，使得紧急路线选择变得困难。小型无人机（UAV）可以通过检查受烟雾影响的走廊、潜在通道和危险房间来支持进入前的火灾响应侦察，同时减少消防员的直接暴露。然而，许多路径研究仍然将火灾表示为点源、规定的危险区域或单个静态风险地图。本研究提出了一种火灾风险现场丰富框架，可将瞬态火灾动力学模拟器（FDS）/PyroSim 输出转换为室内无人机紧急路由的路线级风险信息。在无人机飞行高度对温度、一氧化碳 (CO) 浓度和能见度场进行采样，标准化为风险通道，并融合到时间索引的火灾风险场中。这些字段与硬障碍物占用图相结合，并嵌入到成本增强的 A^* 规划器中。机器人操作系统 2 (ROS2)-Gazebo 设置姿势重播用作空间一致性和障碍物可行性的中间机器人端检查。对于固定的起始目标任务，与标准 A^* 相比，所提出的规划器将累积采样风险降低了 99.67%。在 5 个后期启动目标案例中，减少幅度从 37.9% 到 99.9% 不等。离线动态风险地图重新规划进一步将抽样风险降低了 28.32%。结果表明，瞬态火灾模拟可为室内无人机火力侦察提供可操作的航线级支持。

articles.title: Immobilized PMA on a pyridine-based rigid polymer as a heterogeneous catalyst for the synthesis of 5-aminopyrazole-4-carbonitrile
articles.title_zh: 固定化 PMA 在吡啶基刚性聚合物上作为多相催化剂用于合成 5-氨基吡唑-4-甲腈
articles.abstract: Phosphomolybdic acid (PMA), characterized by strong Brønsted acidity, redox activity, and thermal stability, is a leading candidate in heterogeneous catalyst design. However, challenges such as leaching and activity loss across multiple cycles limit its practical applications. In this study, immobilizing PMA on a rigid pyridine-based polymeric framework enhances the stability of acidic sites and enables catalyst recyclability. The polymeric support, with appropriate surface area and well-defined porosity, facilitates substrate access to the active PMA sites, thereby improving catalytic efficiency. The resulting catalyst afforded high yields (65–95%) in the synthesis of 5-aminopyrazole-4-carbonitrile in short reaction times (10–90 min). Moreover, the catalyst maintained its activity over at least five consecutive cycles without significant loss. These findings indicate that integrating PMA with rigid polymeric frameworks offers a promising approach to developing heterogeneous catalysts that exhibit high efficiency, structural robustness, and recyclability with considerable potential for acid-catalyzed organic transformations.
articles.abstract_zh: 磷钼酸 (PMA) 具有强布朗斯台德酸性、氧化还原活性和热稳定性，是多相催化剂设计的主要候选者。然而，多个循环中的浸出和活性损失等挑战限制了其实际应用。在这项研究中，将 PMA 固定在刚性的吡啶基聚合物框架上可以增强酸性位点的稳定性并实现催化剂的可回收性。聚合物载体具有适当的表面积和明确的孔隙率，有利于底物进入活性 PMA 位点，从而提高催化效率。所得催化剂在短反应时间（10-90 分钟）内合成 5-氨基吡唑-4-甲腈时提供了高收率（65-95%）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磷钼酸 (PMA) 具有强布朗斯台德酸性、氧化还原活性和热稳定性，是多相催化剂设计的主要候选者。然而，多个循环中的浸出和活性损失等挑战限制了其实际应用。在这项研究中，将 PMA 固定在刚性的吡啶基聚合物框架上可以增强酸性位点的稳定性并实现催化剂的可回收性。聚合物载体具有适当的表面积和明确的孔隙率，有利于底物进入活性 PMA 位点，从而提高催化效率。所得催化剂在短反应时间（10-90 分钟）内合成 5-氨基吡唑-4-甲腈时提供了高收率（65-95%）。此外，催化剂在至少五个连续循环中保持其活性而没有显着损失。这些发现表明，将 PMA 与刚性聚合物框架相结合，为开发多相催化剂提供了一种有前途的方法，该催化剂表现出高效率、结构坚固性和可回收性，在酸催化有机转化方面具有相当大的潜力。

articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 02 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78224-2 Achieving photoswitchable luminescence across a broad wavelength range remains challenging. Here, the authors integrate diarylethene photoswitches with quantum dots, enabling visible-light on-off switching of photoluminescence from blue to near-infrared across nearly 500 nm range, with applications in data storage and anti-counterfeiting.

articles.title: Transferable Graph Neural Network Surrogates for Molecular Dynamics Across Crystal Symmetries
articles.title_zh: 跨晶体对称的分子动力学可转移图神经网络代理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a transferable graph neural network (GNN) surrogate framework for molecular dynamics (MD) that directly predicts atomic displacements and propagates atomistic configurations without explicit force evaluation or numerical time integration. The central objective of this work is to establish whether a common GNN formulation can represent atomic dynamics across materials with fundamentally different crystal symmetries and coordination environments. The same network architecture, feature representation, graph construction, and training protocol are applied without symmetry-specific modification to face-centered cubic (FCC) aluminum, body-centered cubic (BCC) iron, and hexagonal close-packed (HCP) magnesium. Across these distinct elemental and crystallographic systems, the framework achieves position-prediction errors on the order of 10⁻⁴ Angstrom² and supports stable autoregressive propagation to nanosecond time scales. The predicted trajectories preserve thermodynamic stability, characteristic coordination-shell structure in the radial distribution functions, and temperature-dependent mean-squared-displacement behavior. In particular, the framework captures the closely spaced coordination shells of BCC iron and the anisotropic coordination environment of HCP magnesium without introducing lattice-specific representations. These results demonstrate that direct GNN-based atomic propagation can be formulated as a transferable framework across different elements, lattice symmetries, and coordination geometries, providing a pathway toward generalizable surrogate models for accelerated molecular dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于分子动力学（ MD ）的可转移图神经网络（ GNN ）替代框架，该框架直接预测原子位移并传播原子构型，而无需显式力评估或数值时间积分。这项工作的中心目标是确定一个通用的GNN公式是否可以代表具有根本不同晶体对称性和配位环境的材料的原子动力学。将相同的网络架构、特征表示、图形构造和训练协议应用于面心立方体（ FCC ）铝、体心立方体（ BCC ）铁和六边形紧密堆积（ HCP ）镁，而无需进行特定于对称的修改。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种用于分子动力学（ MD ）的可转移图神经网络（ GNN ）替代框架，该框架直接预测原子位移并传播原子构型，而无需显式力评估或数值时间积分。这项工作的中心目标是确定一个通用的GNN公式是否可以代表具有根本不同晶体对称性和配位环境的材料的原子动力学。将相同的网络架构、特征表示、图形构造和训练协议应用于面心立方体（ FCC ）铝、体心立方体（ BCC ）铁和六边形紧密堆积（ HCP ）镁，而无需进行特定于对称的修改。在这些截然不同的元素和晶体系统中，该框架实现了约10埃的位置预测误差，并支持稳定的自回归传播到纳秒时间尺度。预测的轨迹保持了热力学稳定性、径向分布函数中的特征配位壳结构以及温度相关的均方位移行为。特别是，该框架捕获了BCC铁的紧密间隔的配位壳和HCP镁的各向异性配位环境，而没有引入晶格特异性表示。这些结果表明，基于GNN的直接原子传播可以被公式化为跨越不同元素、晶格对称性和配位几何形状的可转移框架，为加速分子动力学的可推广替代模型提供了途径。

articles.title: Emergence of electronic modes and triplet pairing from spin-1 antiferromagnetic insulators in the Kanamori-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: Kanamori-Hubbard模型中自旋-1反铁磁绝缘体的电子模式和三重配对的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic band structures of conventional band insulators generally remain unchanged under doping via chemical-potential shifts or increasing temperature. However, in Mott and Kondo insulators described by models such as the Hubbard and Kondo lattice models, distinct electronic modes with momentum-shifted magnetic dispersion relations have been shown to emerge from band edges into the gap. Here, by investigating the two-orbital Kanamori-Hubbard model, this study elucidates how and why the band structures of spin-1 antiferromagnetic insulators change with doping and temperature, revealing emergent spectral features characteristic of orbitally degenerate systems. The nature of the emergent electronic modes is clarified using weak-hopping effective theory, selection-rule analysis, and numerical calculations. In a typical parameter regime, the doping-induced modes in each orbital reflect distinct types of spin modes, while the temperature-induced modes primarily reflect the low-energy spin mode in both orbitals; in both cases, the emergent modes exhibit momentum-shifted spin-mode dispersion relations. The momentum regimes of these emergent modes can differ between orbitals if signs of the hopping parameters differ. For small inter-orbital repulsion, onsite spin-triplet pairs can form after doping, leading to a pair-breaking gap, while the temperature-induced electronic modes continue to reflect the low-energy spin mode without a pair-breaking gap. Moreover, the emergence and characteristics of electronic modes in nonequilibrium states by spin or charge perturbations are elucidated. These findings provide a comprehensive understanding of how the interplay among the spin, charge, and orbital degrees of freedom in large-spin antiferromagnetic insulators leads to emergent electronic modes, opening avenues for exploring unconventional quantum phenomena in strongly correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统带状绝缘体的电子带结构通常在掺杂下通过化学势位移或增加温度保持不变。然而，在Hubbard和Kondo晶格模型等模型描述的Mott和Kondo绝缘体中，已经显示出具有动量偏移磁色散关系的不同电子模式从带边缘出现到间隙中。在这里，通过研究双轨道Kanamori-Hubbard模型，本研究阐明了自旋-1反铁磁绝缘体的能带结构如何以及为何随掺杂和温度变化而变化，揭示了轨道退化系统的特征。使用弱跳有效理论、选择规则分析和数值计算来阐明新兴电子模式的性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统带状绝缘体的电子带结构通常在掺杂下通过化学势位移或增加温度保持不变。然而，在Hubbard和Kondo晶格模型等模型描述的Mott和Kondo绝缘体中，已经显示出具有动量偏移磁色散关系的不同电子模式从带边缘出现到间隙中。在这里，通过研究双轨道Kanamori-Hubbard模型，本研究阐明了自旋-1反铁磁绝缘体的能带结构如何以及为何随掺杂和温度变化而变化，揭示了轨道退化系统的特征。使用弱跳有效理论、选择规则分析和数值计算来阐明新兴电子模式的性质。在典型的参数模式下，每个轨道中的掺杂诱导模式反映了不同类型的自旋模式，而温度诱导模式主要反映了两个轨道中的低能量自旋模式；在这两种情况下，紧急模式都表现出动量偏移的自旋模式色散关系。如果跳跃参数的符号不同，这些紧急模式的动量机制可能在轨道之间有所不同。对于小的轨道间斥力，掺杂后可以形成现场自旋三重态对，导致配对断裂间隙，而温度诱导的电子模式继续反映低能量自旋模式而没有配对断裂间隙。此外，通过自旋或电荷扰动阐明了非平衡状态下电子模式的出现和特征。这些发现全面了解了大自旋反铁磁绝缘体中自旋、电荷和轨道自由度之间的相互作用如何导致出现电子模式，为探索强相关系统中的非常规量子现象开辟了途径。

articles.title: Loading history and window geometry bound compact-state slip ranking during granular shear startup
articles.title_zh: 粒状剪切启动过程中的加载历史记录和窗口几何约束紧凑状态滑移排名
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Granular slip forecasting can conflate material state, loading progress, and the geometry of event-centered sampling. We separated these contributions in slowly sheared two-dimensional frictional disks using a compact neural score of stress, pressure, coordination, non-affine motion, and force-network observables. The model was developed on 36 trajectories and frozen efore testing on 18 new trajectories under two nested stress-drop definitions. Inspection of held-out results revealed post-event sampling asymmetry; recovery-aware analyses are therefore descriptive. With trajectories weighted equally, the compact score ranked near-slip windows above both prevalence and within-trajectory circular-phase controls under both definitions (representative average precision 0.310 versus prevalence 0.173; phase-null upper bound 0.257). Loading-history coordinates ranked more strongly, reaching 0.534 for causal elapsed strain. The recovery-aware rule retained 78.4% of activity-gated events and preferentially selected longer preceding intervals; ranking by time since the previous catalogued event remained compatible with a count-conditioned geometry null. Compact observables thus contain temporally aligned slip information, but stronger loading-history baselines and window-geometry sensitivity bound that evidence. These startup data do not isolate a state-specific short-horizon precursor beyond loading history or support a renewal interpretation of elapsed-strain ranking.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 粒度滑移预测可以合并材料状态、加载进度和以事件为中心的采样的几何形状。我们使用应力、压力、协调、非仿射运动和力网络可观察性的紧凑神经评分，将这些贡献分解为慢速剪切的二维摩擦盘。该模型是在36个轨迹上开发的，并在两个嵌套应力下降定义下对18个新轨迹进行了冻结测试。对保留结果的检查显示事件后采样不对称；因此，回收感知分析是描述性的。在轨迹加权相等的情况下，紧凑分数将近滑动窗口排在两个定义下的流行率和轨迹内循环相位控制之上（代表性平均精度0.310 vs流行率0.173 ；相位零上限0.257 ）。加载历史坐标排名更强，因果应变达到0.534。恢复感知规则保留了78.4%的活动门控事件和优先选择的较长前期间隔；自上一个编目事件以来，按时间排名仍与计数条件几何空值兼容。因此，紧凑的可观测对象包含时间对齐的滑动信息，但更强的加载历史基线和窗口几何敏感性约束了这一证据。这些启动数据不会在加载历史记录之外隔离特定状态的短视前体，也不支持对已用应变排名的更新解释。

articles.title: Tunable flat bands and their signatures in electronic specific heat of an Aharonov-Bohm triangular quantum network
articles.title_zh: Aharonov-Bohm三角量子网络的电子比热下的可调谐平带及其特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00273v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum networks composed of loop-like structures provide a rich platform for exploring electronic transport phenomena and have been widely studied in various contexts. However, their thermal response remains relatively unexplored, motivating us to investigate it in the present work. We consider a tight-binding (TB) quantum network composed of a finite number of triangular plaquettes, where neighboring plaquettes are connected through single bonds and each triangular loop is threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm (AB) flux φ. The interplay of nonuniform site coordination, hopping asymmetry, and quantum interference gives rise to both dispersive and completely flat energy levels. We derive an analytical condition involving the TB parameters under which one of the energy branches becomes independent of the electronic momentum. We further show that the AB flux φ provides a direct means of tuning the position of the flat band. The characteristic features of the energy spectrum associated with this quantum geometry are reflected in the thermal response, which we investigate through the electronic specific heat (ESH). In particular, we demonstrate that the position of the flat band manifests itself as a distinct feature in the ESH, establishing a direct connection between the flat-band formation and the thermal response of the system. Thus, the ESH provides an alternative route for identifying the presence of a flat band, consistent with the analytical condition and the corresponding energy dispersion. Moreover, the AB flux allows the ESH to be selectively regulated through the tuning of the flat-band position. The proposed approach provides a simple complementary means of identifying momentum-independent energy levels and may be extended to other simple and complex quantum networks supporting flat bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 由环状结构组成的量子网络为探索电子传输现象提供了丰富的平台，并在各种环境中得到了广泛的研究。然而，它们的热响应仍然相对未被探索，这激励我们在当前的工作中对其进行研究。我们考虑一个由有限数量的三角形斑块组成的紧密结合（ TB ）量子网络，其中相邻的斑块通过单键连接，并且每个三角形环通过Aharonov-Bohm （ AB ）通量φ螺纹连接。非均匀位点协调、跳跃不对称和量子干扰的相互作用产生了色散和完全平坦的能级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由环状结构组成的量子网络为探索电子传输现象提供了丰富的平台，并在各种环境中得到了广泛的研究。然而，它们的热响应仍然相对未被探索，这激励我们在当前的工作中对其进行研究。我们考虑一个由有限数量的三角形斑块组成的紧密结合（ TB ）量子网络，其中相邻的斑块通过单键连接，并且每个三角形环通过Aharonov-Bohm （ AB ）通量φ螺纹连接。非均匀位点协调、跳跃不对称和量子干扰的相互作用产生了色散和完全平坦的能级。我们推导出涉及结核病参数的分析条件，其中一个能量分支独立于电子动量。我们进一步表明， AB通量φ提供了调节平带位置的直接手段。与这种量子几何相关的能谱的特征特征反映在热响应中，我们通过电子比热（ ESH ）进行研究。特别是，我们证明了平带的位置在ESH中表现为一个独特的特征，在平带的形成和系统的热响应之间建立了直接的联系。因此， ESH提供了一种替代路径，用于识别平坦带的存在，与分析条件和相应的能量分散一致。此外， AB通量允许通过调节平带位置来选择性地调节ESH。所提出的方法提供了一种简单的互补方法来识别动量无关的能级，并且可以扩展到支持平坦带的其他简单和复杂的量子网络。

articles.title: Interior contacts in a narrow quantum Hall bar: a two-dimensional self-consistent screening calculation of the current distribution
articles.title_zh: 窄量子霍尔棒中的内部触点：电流分布的二维自洽筛选计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present fully two-dimensional self-consistent calculations of the electron density, local filling factor and current distribution in a six-terminal GaAs/AlGaAs Hall bar of width W = 3 micrometers with two additional square contacts, A and B, placed on the channel axis and connected to the outside by air bridges, following the interior-contact experiment of Kendirlik et al. [Nat. Commun. 8, 14082 (2017)]. Within the screening theory of the integer quantized Hall effect, the Thomas-Fermi-Poisson equations are solved on the full device plane, including the probe arms and the depletion regions around the interior contacts, and the current is obtained from a local Ohm's law with a filling-factor dependent conductivity tensor, for source-drain and interior-contact excitation separately. Across the nu = 2 plateau the interior contacts pass through three regimes as the field is lowered: galvanically connected to the current path in a compressible bulk, floating in the Hall potential of a fully incompressible bulk, and isolated from both the bulk and the edge strips by closed incompressible rings encircling each contact. In the floating and isolated regimes the two-terminal resistance between the interior contacts rises by orders of magnitude. The isolation interval lies within the Hall plateau and ends before its low-field edge; its high-field end is sharply set by the disappearance of the incompressible bulk, while its low-field end shrinks with temperature and Landau-level broadening. The resistance between an interior contact and a perimeter probe approaches one half of the quantized Hall resistance across the plateau. The topology of the incompressible regions and the boundaries of the isolation interval are insensitive to the regularization of the local conductivity, to the grid and to moderate disorder, whereas the magnitude of the isolation resistance is not.
articles.abstract_zh: 在Kendirlik等人的内部接触实验之后，我们提出了宽度为W = 3微米的六端GaAs/AlGaAs霍尔棒中电子密度，局部填充因子和电流分布的完全二维自洽计算，其中两个额外的方形触点A和B放置在通道轴上并通过气桥连接到外部。[Nat. Commun. 8, 14082 (2017)]。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在Kendirlik等人的内部接触实验之后，我们提出了宽度为W = 3微米的六端GaAs/AlGaAs霍尔棒中电子密度，局部填充因子和电流分布的完全二维自洽计算，其中两个额外的方形触点A和B放置在通道轴上并通过气桥连接到外部。[Nat. Commun. 8, 14082 (2017)]。在整数量子化霍尔效应的筛选理论中， Thomas-Fermi-Poisson方程在整个器件平面上求解，包括探针臂和内部触点周围的耗尽区域，电流由具有填充因子相关电导率张量的局部欧姆定律获得，分别用于源漏和内部触点激发。在nu = 2的高原上，随着磁场的降低，内部触点通过三种方式：以可压缩的体积与电流路径电连接，漂浮在完全不可压缩的体积的霍尔电位中，并通过围绕每个触点的闭合不可压缩环与体积和边缘条隔离。在浮动和隔离状态下，内部触点之间的两端电阻增加了几个数量级。隔离区间位于霍尔高原内，在其低场边缘之前结束；其高场端因不可压缩体消失而急剧设定，而其低场端则随着温度和朗道水平变宽而收缩。内部触点和周边探头之间的电阻接近高原上量化霍尔电阻的一半。不可压缩区域和隔离区间边界的拓扑结构对局部电导率的正则化、对网格和中等无序不敏感，而隔离电阻的大小则不敏感。

articles.title: Strongly coupled ultracompressed self-cavity plasmon polaritons at millikelvin temperatures
articles.title_zh: 毫开尔文温度下的强耦合超压缩自腔等离子体激元极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Van der Waals heterostructures exhibit self-cavity resonances from sub-terahertz to terahertz frequencies and thus offer an attractive route toward realizing cavity-modified phases of matter. Spectroscopy of such systems calls for high frequency resolution at millikelvin temperatures, which is extremely challenging with existing methods. Here we demonstrate a new platform for realizing and probing such systems. Superconducting layers define self-cavity structures with electromagnetic volume compression of order 10⁷. With an integrated graphene layer, we observe underdamped cavity plasmon polaritons at frequencies as low as 0.04 THz and which exhibit avoided crossings with cavity modes. To measure such spectra, we deploy a millikelvin-compatible sub-THz spectrometer based on a superconducting circuit. This work paves the way for simultaneous spectroscopy and transport measurements of cavity-matter hybrid systems at millikelvin temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华异质结构在亚太赫兹到太赫兹频率范围内表现出自腔共振，因此为实现腔体修饰的物质相提供了一条极具吸引力的途径。对这类系统进行光谱学研究需要在毫开尔文温度下实现高分辨率，而现有方法难以做到这一点。本文展示了一种用于实现和探测此类系统的新平台。超导层定义了自腔结构，其电磁体积压缩量为10级。使用集成石墨烯层，我们观察到低阻尼空腔等离子体激元极化子，频率低至0.04 THz ，并表现出避免与空腔模式交叉。为了测量这种光谱，我们部署了一个基于超导电路的毫开尔文兼容亚赫兹光谱仪。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华异质结构在亚太赫兹到太赫兹频率范围内表现出自腔共振，因此为实现腔体修饰的物质相提供了一条极具吸引力的途径。对这类系统进行光谱学研究需要在毫开尔文温度下实现高分辨率，而现有方法难以做到这一点。本文展示了一种用于实现和探测此类系统的新平台。超导层定义了自腔结构，其电磁体积压缩量为10级。使用集成石墨烯层，我们观察到低阻尼空腔等离子体激元极化子，频率低至0.04 THz ，并表现出避免与空腔模式交叉。为了测量这种光谱，我们部署了一个基于超导电路的毫开尔文兼容亚赫兹光谱仪。这项工作为腔物质混合系统在毫开尔文温度下的同时光谱和传输测量铺平了道路。

articles.title: Stacking-Controlled Altermagnetism and Topological Magnons in Bilayer CrI₃
articles.title_zh: 双层CrI中堆叠控制的磁性与拓扑磁子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stacked van der Waals magnets provide a tunable route to altermagnetism, a compensated magnetic order characterized by momentum-dependent spin splitting, and to the topological magnetic excitations that such order can host. In bilayer CrI₃, first-principles calculations and linear spin-wave theory reveal stacking-controlled altermagnetic order and associated magnon band topology. Combining band-representation analysis with calculations of the dynamic structure factor relevant to inelastic neutron scattering, we further characterize the chirally split topological magnons and quantify their energy corrections and lifetimes using a many-body Green's-function approach. The interlayer magnetic ground state is highly sensitive to the stacking geometry, thereby controlling the magnon band topology and transport responses. We further show that magnon--magnon interactions renormalize the magnon dispersion and dynamic structure factor, with a particular focus on magnon decay. Using van der Waals bilayer CrI₃ as a representative platform, our results establish stacking engineering as a structural route for tuning altermagnetism and associated topological magnon excitations, opening avenues toward stacking-controlled spintronic and magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 堆叠的van der Waals磁体为改变磁性（一种以动量依赖的自旋分裂为特征的补偿磁序）以及这种磁序可以承载的拓扑磁激励提供了可调路径。在双层CrI *中，第一原理计算和线性自旋波理论揭示了堆叠控制的替代磁序和相关的磁子带拓扑。将带表示分析与与非弹性中子散射相关的动态结构因子的计算相结合，我们进一步表征手性分裂拓扑磁子，并使用多体格林函数方法量化其能量校正和寿命。层间磁性基态对堆叠几何形状高度敏感，从而控制磁子带拓扑和传输响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 堆叠的van der Waals磁体为改变磁性（一种以动量依赖的自旋分裂为特征的补偿磁序）以及这种磁序可以承载的拓扑磁激励提供了可调路径。在双层CrI *中，第一原理计算和线性自旋波理论揭示了堆叠控制的替代磁序和相关的磁子带拓扑。将带表示分析与与非弹性中子散射相关的动态结构因子的计算相结合，我们进一步表征手性分裂拓扑磁子，并使用多体格林函数方法量化其能量校正和寿命。层间磁性基态对堆叠几何形状高度敏感，从而控制磁子带拓扑和传输响应。我们进一步表明，磁子-磁子相互作用重整了磁子色散和动态结构因子，特别关注磁子衰变。我们的研究结果以van der Waals双层CrI ”为代表平台，将堆叠工程作为调谐改变磁性和相关拓扑磁子激发的结构路线，为堆叠控制的自旋电子和磁子器件开辟了道路。

articles.title: Orbital angular momentum in crystalline solids: non-equilibrium theory
articles.title_zh: 结晶固体中的轨道角动量：非平衡理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00496v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a general operator theory of orbital angular momentum (OAM) in periodic solids that applies equally to equilibrium and coherently driven states. Employing the crystal momentum representation of Adams and Blount, we construct a periodic-solid OAM operator exactly corresponding to the symmetrized hatmathbf r×hatmathbf v observable, and show that it separates into local circulation (LC) and itinerant circulation (IC) sectors that are Hermitian and U(1), and more generally U(N), gauge covariant. In equilibrium, the LC and IC sectors reduce to the established modern theory of orbital magnetism; out of equilibrium, the same operator structure exposes new contributions generated by laser-written momentum-space textures and interband coherence. Applied to gapped graphene, we uncover a rich phenomenology of ultrafast non-equilibrium orbital angular momentum, including a quasi-stationary light-induced OAM. This latter finding, underpinned by a close connection between band-manifold phase texture and nonequilibrium OAM, points towards new possibilities for light control over OAM in solids as well as a potentially rich role for topological band structures in designed OAM materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了周期性固体中轨道角动量（OAM）的一般算子理论，该理论同样适用于平衡态和相干驱动态。利用 Adams 和 Blount 的晶体动量表示，我们构造了一个与对称 hatmathbf r×hatmathbf v 可观测量完全对应的周期固体 OAM 算子，并表明它分为局域环流 (LC) 和流动环流 (IC) 扇区，它们是厄米和 U(1) 以及更一般的 U(N) 规范协变。在平衡状态下，LC 和 IC 部分简化为已建立的现代轨道磁性理论；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了周期性固体中轨道角动量（OAM）的一般算子理论，该理论同样适用于平衡态和相干驱动态。利用 Adams 和 Blount 的晶体动量表示，我们构造了一个与对称 hatmathbf r×hatmathbf v 可观测量完全对应的周期固体 OAM 算子，并表明它分为局域环流 (LC) 和流动环流 (IC) 扇区，它们是厄米和 U(1) 以及更一般的 U(N) 规范协变。在平衡状态下，LC 和 IC 部分简化为已建立的现代轨道磁性理论；失去平衡时，相同的算子结构揭示了激光写入动量空间纹理和带间相干性产生的新贡献。应用于有隙石墨烯，我们发现了超快非平衡轨道角动量的丰富现象，包括准稳态光诱导的 OAM。后一个发现以能带流形相结构与非平衡 OAM 之间的密切联系为基础，指出了固体中 OAM 光控制的新可能性，以及拓扑能带结构在设计的 OAM 材料中潜在的丰富作用。

articles.title: Near-infrared magnetic linear and non-reciprocal directional dichroism in the chiral antiferromagnet SmFe3(BO3)4
articles.title_zh: 手性反铁磁体 SmFe3(BO3)4 中的近红外磁线性和非互易方向二色性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00534v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the influence of antiferromagnetic (AFM) order on the near-infrared optical re- sponse of SmFe3(BO3)4 by polarization-resolved, magneto-optical spectroscopy. Below the Néel temperature, we observed pronounced magnetic linear dichroism at the 4f -4f transitions of Sm3+. By rotating the order parameter of the easy-plane AFM ground state using magnetic fields, we demonstrated the magnetic field control of linear dichroism, and deduced polarization selection rules. In addition, we detected non-reciprocal directional dichroism for several 4f -4f transitions. The non-reciprocal absorption appears in the symmetry-allowed toroidal geometry when the in- plane magnetic field is normal to one of the two-fold rotation axes. These results indicate a strong interference between electric- and magnetic-dipole excitations for transitions showing non-reciprocal absorption. The observed optical anisotropies provide a promising path to detect the in-plane orien- tation of the AFM order, enabling imaging and time-resolved studies of the AFM order parameter in rare-earth ferroborates.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过偏振分辨磁光光谱研究了反铁磁 (AFM) 级数对 SmFe3(BO3)4 近红外光学响应的影响。在尼尔温度以下，我们在 Sm3+ 的 4f -4f 跃迁处观察到明显的磁线性二色性。通过利用磁场旋转易平面AFM基态的序参数，我们演示了线性二向色性的磁场控制，并推导了偏振选择规则。此外，我们还检测到了几个 4f -4f 跃迁的非互易方向二色性。当面内磁场垂直于两倍旋转轴之一时，非互易吸收出现在允许对称的环形几何形状中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过偏振分辨磁光光谱研究了反铁磁 (AFM) 级数对 SmFe3(BO3)4 近红外光学响应的影响。在尼尔温度以下，我们在 Sm3+ 的 4f -4f 跃迁处观察到明显的磁线性二色性。通过利用磁场旋转易平面AFM基态的序参数，我们演示了线性二向色性的磁场控制，并推导了偏振选择规则。此外，我们还检测到了几个 4f -4f 跃迁的非互易方向二色性。当面内磁场垂直于两倍旋转轴之一时，非互易吸收出现在允许对称的环形几何形状中。这些结果表明电偶极子激发和磁偶极子激发之间对显示非互易吸收的跃迁存在强烈干扰。观察到的光学各向异性为检测 AFM 有序的面内方向提供了一条有前途的途径，从而能够对稀土硼铁酸盐中的 AFM 有序参数进行成像和时间分辨研究。

articles.title: Reference-free certification of machine-learning interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 机器学习原子间势的无参考认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials now reach held-out energy and force errors so small that they no longer predict how a model behaves in simulation. Here we show that a potential can be graded without any reference calculation, against properties the exact Born-Oppenheimer surface satisfies by mathematical or physical necessity. We organise these properties into four families, symmetry and invariance, self-consistency and integrability, statistical-mechanical equilibrium and regularity, and turn them into fourteen inexpensive probes, each certifying against a target that is exact and independent of chemistry and reference method. Every probe therefore returns an absolute, architecture-comparable score from the energies, forces and stresses a potential already exposes, and reveals failures a fixed test set cannot. Applied to 64 pretrained potentials, the suite resolves two orders of magnitude of certified quality at comparable reported accuracy, and flags a fine-tuned potential whose reference errors improve while its surface degrades until molecular dynamics fails. An interactive leaderboard of all 64 models is available at https://jhaens.github.io/pescert-bench.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势现在达到了非常小的保留能量和力误差，以至于它们不再预测模型在模拟中的行为。在这里，我们表明，可以根据数学或物理必要性精确的玻恩-奥本海默曲面满足的属性，在没有任何参考计算的情况下对势进行分级。我们将这些性质分为四个系列：对称性和不变性、自洽性和可积性、统计力学平衡和规律性，并将它们变成十四个廉价的探针，每个探针都针对一个精确且独立于化学和参考方法的目标进行认证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用机器学习原子间势现在达到了非常小的保留能量和力误差，以至于它们不再预测模型在模拟中的行为。在这里，我们表明，可以根据数学或物理必要性精确的玻恩-奥本海默曲面满足的属性，在没有任何参考计算的情况下对势进行分级。我们将这些性质分为四个系列：对称性和不变性、自洽性和可积性、统计力学平衡和规律性，并将它们变成十四个廉价的探针，每个探针都针对一个精确且独立于化学和参考方法的目标进行认证。因此，每个探测器都会从潜在已经暴露的能量、力和应力中返回一个绝对的、与架构可比的分数，并揭示固定测试集无法揭示的故障。该套件应用于 64 个预训练电位，以可比的报告精度解析了两个数量级的认证质量，并标记了一个微调电位，其参考误差得到改善，而其表面退化，直到分子动力学失效。所有 64 个模型的交互式排行榜可在 https://jhaens.github.io/pescert-bench 上找到。

articles.title: The Ericson Transition in Time-Reversal Invariant Systems: Symplectically Invariant Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 时间反演不变系统中的埃里克森转变：辛不变哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the distributions of off-diagonal scattering matrix elements and cross-sections in the Ericson regime for time-reversal invariant systems with odd spin. Within the universal Heidelberg approach we prove that Gaussian and exponential behavior is found as the leading-order term of an asymptotic expansion of the aforementioned distributions. Furthermore, the subleading-order term is derived and compared with numerical simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有奇自旋的时间反演不变系统的 Ericson 体系中非对角散射矩阵元素和横截面的分布。在通用海德堡方法中，我们证明高斯和指数行为被发现是上述分布的渐近展开的首项。此外，还推导了次导阶项并与数值模拟进行了比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有奇自旋的时间反演不变系统的 Ericson 体系中非对角散射矩阵元素和横截面的分布。在通用海德堡方法中，我们证明高斯和指数行为被发现是上述分布的渐近展开的首项。此外，还推导了次导阶项并与数值模拟进行了比较。

articles.title: Mechanism of Incommensurate Magnetic Order in BaCo₂(AsO₄)₂: Interplay of Frustrated Further-Neighbor Exchanges and Bond-Directional Anisotropy
articles.title_zh: BaCo2(AsO4)2 中不相称磁序的机制：受阻的更邻近交换和键方向各向异性的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic mechanism governing the zero-field incommensurate magnetic order in the honeycomb cobaltate BaCo₂(AsO₄)₂ remains a significant unresolved problem, particularly concerning the relative contributions of bond-directional Kitaev-type interactions and exchange frustration. This study investigates an extended J₁--K--Γ--Γ'--J₂--J₃ model, which incorporates XXZ-type exchange anisotropies on the honeycomb lattice. Nearest-neighbor parameters are constrained by ab initio electronic structure calculations. By integrating the analytical Luttinger-Tisza approach with exact diagonalization calculations under twisted boundary conditions, we delineate the classical and quantum phase diagrams across the (J₂, J₃) parameter space. We demonstrate that the stabilization of the experimentally observed incommensurate spiral phase, propagating along the Γ→ M direction, does not necessitate an anomalously dominant Kitaev coupling. Instead, this phase arises naturally from the synergistic interplay between exchange frustration, driven by further-neighbor couplings (J₂, J₃), and intermediate off-diagonal bond anisotropies (Γ, Γ'). In the quantum regime, we elucidate the competition between this incommensurate manifold and an out-of-plane ferromagnetic (FM_z) phase, which is selectively stabilized via a quantum order-by-disorder mechanism. Our findings reconcile conflicting interpretations of the magnetic interactions in BaCo₂(AsO₄)₂ and establish the microscopic origin and stability range of its incommensurate ground state.
articles.abstract_zh: 蜂窝状钴酸盐 BaCo2(AsO4)2 中控制零场不相称磁序的微观机制仍然是一个尚未解决的重大问题，特别是关于键向基塔耶夫型相互作用和交换挫败的相对贡献。本研究研究了扩展的 J₁--K--γ--γ'--J2--J₃ 模型，该模型在蜂窝晶格上结合了 XXZ 型交换各向异性。最近邻参数受到从头算电子结构计算的约束。通过将解析 Luttinger-Tisza 方法与扭曲边界条件下的精确对角化计算相结合，我们在 (J2, J₃) 参数空间上描绘了经典相图和量子相图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蜂窝状钴酸盐 BaCo2(AsO4)2 中控制零场不相称磁序的微观机制仍然是一个尚未解决的重大问题，特别是关于键向基塔耶夫型相互作用和交换挫败的相对贡献。本研究研究了扩展的 J₁--K--γ--γ'--J2--J₃ 模型，该模型在蜂窝晶格上结合了 XXZ 型交换各向异性。最近邻参数受到从头算电子结构计算的约束。通过将解析 Luttinger-Tisza 方法与扭曲边界条件下的精确对角化计算相结合，我们在 (J2, J₃) 参数空间上描绘了经典相图和量子相图。我们证明，实验观察到的不相称螺旋相的稳定，沿着 Γ→ M 方向传播，并不需要异常主导的 Kitaev 耦合。相反，这个阶段自然地产生于交换挫败之间的协同相互作用，由更邻近的耦合（J2，J₃）驱动，与中间的非对角键各向异性（Г，Г'）驱动。在量子体系中，我们阐明了这种不可通约流形与面外铁磁（FM_z）相之间的竞争，该相通过量子逐序无序机制选择性地稳定。我们的研究结果调和了 BaCo2(AsO4)2 中磁相互作用的相互矛盾的解释，并确定了其不相称基态的微观起源和稳定范围。

articles.title: CTMRG as a tensor-network message-passing algorithm
articles.title_zh: CTMRG 作为张量网络消息传递算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate the corner transfer matrix equations, and the corner transfer matrix renormalization group built on them, as a set of local equations on general planar graphs. These equations depend only on the local subgraphs of the planar graph and are glued together consistently to describe the whole graph. Solving them yields message tensors and corner matrices, which can be used to construct an MPS environment for any connected subgraph. We test the proposed equations on the ferromagnetic Ising model, on a variety of infinite lattices (including hyperbolic ones) and on finite graphs, and find systematic improvement over belief propagation.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将角传递矩阵方程和基于它们的角传递矩阵重整化群表示为一般平面图上的一组局部方程。这些方程仅取决于平面图的局部子图，并且一致地粘合在一起以描述整个图。求解它们会产生消息张量和角矩阵，可用于为任何连通子图构建 MPS 环境。我们在铁磁伊辛模型、各种无限晶格（包括双曲晶格）和有限图上测试了所提出的方程，并发现了对置信传播的系统改进。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将角传递矩阵方程和基于它们的角传递矩阵重整化群表示为一般平面图上的一组局部方程。这些方程仅取决于平面图的局部子图，并且一致地粘合在一起以描述整个图。求解它们会产生消息张量和角矩阵，可用于为任何连通子图构建 MPS 环境。我们在铁磁伊辛模型、各种无限晶格（包括双曲晶格）和有限图上测试了所提出的方程，并发现了对置信传播的系统改进。

articles.title: Enhanced Long-Wavelength Fluctuations and Interaction-Stress Correlations in Active Crystals
articles.title_zh: 活性晶体中增强的长波长波动和相互作用-应力相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Activity can enhance the long-wavelength density fluctuations of a solid beyond the equilibrium fluctuations predicted by the Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg theorem, but the microscopic origin of this enhancement remains unclear. We study a two-dimensional active Brownian crystal whose longitudinal and transverse displacement covariances scale as C^u_λ(q)sim q⁻³ as compared to the passive counterpart with q⁻² law. This spectrum predicts an MSD-plateau divergence proportional to L in two dimensions, logarithmic in three dimensions, and finite in four dimensions, in close correspondence with recent results reported in Dey et al. [Nat. Commun. 16, 5498 (2025)]. Inverse of the Covariance gives Hcov_λsim |q|³ with the corresponding dispersion ωcₒᵥ,λsim q³/², whereas direct mechanical response gives Kᵣₑₛₚ,λsim q² and acoustic modes with ω₀,λsim q. The nonlinear dispersion is therefore covariance-defined rather than mechanical. The mobility and integrated active-force correlations remain non-singular, although a finite-persistence crossover cannot be ruled out completely with the existing data. Microscopically, the longitudinal and transverse Irving-Kirkwood interaction-stress spectra scale as q⁻¹. The transverse stress-stress correlation connects well with the anomalous displacement field, indicating that activity anomalously populates ordinary acoustic modes, while the conservative interaction network transmits the resulting fluctuations as long-ranged stress. A three-dimensional active FCC crystal exhibits the same paired low-q trends.
articles.abstract_zh: 活动可以增强固体的长波长密度波动，超出 Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg 定理预测的平衡波动，但这种增强的微观起源仍不清楚。我们研究了一种二维主动布朗晶体，与具有 q⁻² 定律的被动对应物相比，其纵向和横向位移协方差尺度为 C^u_λ(q)sim q⁻3。该谱预测 MSD 平台散度在二维中与 L 成正比，在三维中与对数相关，在四个维度中与有限散度相关，与 Dey 等人最近报道的结果密切相关。 [纳特。交流。 16, 5498 (2025)]。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 活动可以增强固体的长波长密度波动，超出 Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg 定理预测的平衡波动，但这种增强的微观起源仍不清楚。我们研究了一种二维主动布朗晶体，与具有 q⁻² 定律的被动对应物相比，其纵向和横向位移协方差尺度为 C^u_λ(q)sim q⁻3。该谱预测 MSD 平台散度在二维中与 L 成正比，在三维中与对数相关，在四个维度中与有限散度相关，与 Dey 等人最近报道的结果密切相关。 [纳特。交流。 16, 5498 (2025)]。协方差的倒数给出 Hcov_λsim |q|³ 以及相应的色散 ωcₒᵥ,λsim q³/²，而直接机械响应给出 Kᵣₑₛₚ,λsim q² 和声学模式 ω₀,λsim q。因此，非线性色散是由协方差定义的，而不是机械的。尽管现有数据不能完全排除有限持续性交叉，但机动性和综合主力相关性仍然是非奇异的。在显微镜下，纵向和横向欧文-柯克伍德相互作用应力谱尺度为 q⁻1。横向应力-应力相关性与异常位移场密切相关，表明活动异常地填充普通声波模态，而保守的相互作用网络将由此产生的波动作为远程应力传递。三维活性 FCC 晶体表现出相同的成对低 q 值趋势。

articles.title: The half-filled optical Su-Schrieffer-Heeger-Hubbard model with uniaxial strain
articles.title_zh: 具有单轴应变的半填充光学 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger-Hubbard 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strain offers a direct route to control electronic phases by altering bond lengths, hopping amplitudes, and lattice symmetries. These aspects make electron-phonon (e-ph) coupled systems a natural setting to study strain-induced effects. The Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) Hamiltonian describes the coupling between itinerant electrons and lattice degrees of freedom that modulate hopping and is thus expected to be strongly affected by strain fields. At half-filling and on a bipartite lattice, the SSH interactions drive dominant bond-order-wave (BOW) correlations at low- temperature in which short bonds with high kinetic energy alternate with long bonds with low kinetic energy along four possible patterns. We model uniaxial strain through anisotropic hopping, which breaks the 90^circ rotational symmetry and reduces the BOW phase degeneracy to two. We also include an on-site Hubbard U that promotes antiferromagnetic correlations that are also (weakly) driven by the SSH interaction itself. We map out the half-filled phase diagram in the plane of the e-ph and Hubbard couplings, and determine the critical temperature of BOW formation. Using analytic continuation, we also evaluate the spectral function and demonstrate directionally dependent gap formation in the BOW phase
articles.abstract_zh: 应变提供了通过改变键长、跳跃幅度和晶格对称性来控制电子相位的直接途径。这些方面使电子声子 (e-ph) 耦合系统成为研究应变诱导效应的自然环境。 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 哈密顿量描述了流动电子与调制跳跃的晶格自由度之间的耦合，因此预计会受到应变场的强烈影响。在半填充和二分晶格上，SSH 相互作用在低温下驱动主要的键序波（BOW）相关性，其中高动能的短键与低动能的长键沿着四种可能的模式交替。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 应变提供了通过改变键长、跳跃幅度和晶格对称性来控制电子相位的直接途径。这些方面使电子声子 (e-ph) 耦合系统成为研究应变诱导效应的自然环境。 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 哈密顿量描述了流动电子与调制跳跃的晶格自由度之间的耦合，因此预计会受到应变场的强烈影响。在半填充和二分晶格上，SSH 相互作用在低温下驱动主要的键序波（BOW）相关性，其中高动能的短键与低动能的长键沿着四种可能的模式交替。我们通过各向异性跳跃对单轴应变进行建模，这打破了 90^circ 旋转对称性并将 BOW 相简并度降低到了 2。我们还包括一个现场 Hubbard U，它促进反铁磁相关性，这些相关性也由 SSH 交互本身（弱）驱动。我们在 e-ph 和 Hubbard 耦合平面上绘制了半填充相图，并确定了 BOW 形成的临界温度。使用解析延拓，我们还评估了谱函数并证明了 BOW 相中方向相关的间隙形成

articles.title: Tunable Electron Quantum Optics in Graphene Slit Junctions
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯狭缝结中的可调谐电子量子光学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A graphene slit junction is investigated as a compact geometry for directional electron-beam formation, coherent interference, and symmetry-controlled spin filtering. Atomistic tight-binding calculations combined with the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism show that trigonal warping in monolayer graphene produces strongly directional electron beams near E~2.7eV. Boundary reflections redirect these beams toward a common drain, where the transmission exhibits magnetic flux-dependent oscillations consistent with an h/e Aharonov-Bohm period, whose modulation is characterized by Fourier analysis and harmonic fitting. A local electrostatic gate provides additional control of the interference phase. In separate self-consistent mean-field Hubbard calculations, the pristine antiferromagnetic ground state is shown to have spin-degenerate transmission, whereas structural or electrostatic breaking of the left-right symmetry enables spin filtering. Complementary valley-resolved calculations using a four-band continuum model demonstrate analogous beam formation in bilayer graphene at E = 50meV. The results identify the slit junction as a common geometry for electron-optical and spin-dependent transport and motivate further investigation of low-energy bilayer implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究石墨烯狭缝结作为一种紧凑的几何结构，用于定向电子束形成、相干干涉和对称控制的自旋过滤。原子紧束缚计算结合非平衡格林函数形式表明单层石墨烯中的三角翘曲会产生E~2.7eV附近的强定向电子束。边界反射将这些光束重定向到公共漏极，其中传输表现出与 h/e 阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆周期一致的磁通量相关振荡，其调制通过傅里叶分析和谐波拟合来表征。局部静电门提供对干扰阶段的额外控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究石墨烯狭缝结作为一种紧凑的几何结构，用于定向电子束形成、相干干涉和对称控制的自旋过滤。原子紧束缚计算结合非平衡格林函数形式表明单层石墨烯中的三角翘曲会产生E~2.7eV附近的强定向电子束。边界反射将这些光束重定向到公共漏极，其中传输表现出与 h/e 阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆周期一致的磁通量相关振荡，其调制通过傅里叶分析和谐波拟合来表征。局部静电门提供对干扰阶段的额外控制。在单独的自洽平均场哈伯德计算中，原始反铁磁基态被证明具有自旋简并传输，而左右对称性的结构或静电破坏使得自旋过滤成为可能。使用四能带连续谱模型的互补谷分辨计算证明了双层石墨烯在 E = 50meV 时的类似光束形成。结果表明，狭缝结是电子光学和自旋相关传输的常见几何形状，并激发了对低能双层实现的进一步研究。

articles.title: Long-Range Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Defect Energetics in SrTiO₃
articles.title_zh: SrTiO₃ 缺陷能量学的长程机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have advanced rapidly in recent years, yet the majority of models remain semilocal in nature and neglect long-range electrostatic interactions. A growing number of long-range models have emerged to address this limitation, but systematic benchmarks comparing their performance on physically realistic systems remain scarce. In this work, we assess three long-range MLIPs -- MACE-POLAR, MACE-LES, and LOREM, against a short-range baseline MACE model, on their ability to capture long-range Coulombic interactions, progressing from idealised synthetic point-charge systems to first-principles data on realistic crystal structures. This progression allows us to isolate model's capability to learn electrostatic interactions from the many competing energy contributions, such as dielectric screening and exchange-correlation, that are present in DFT total energies. As a physically motivated benchmark system, we focus on strontium titanate SrTiO₃ with Sr--O Schottky vacancy pairs, a material in which long-range charge interactions play a central role and which serves as a natural stepping stone towards the study of charged polarons and other electronic and optical properties. Building on this benchmark, we further examine oxygen vacancy migration in the presence of the Sr--O Schottky pair, using climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations and molecular dynamics to obtain activation barriers as a function of the vacancy pair separation, providing further extrapolation test of each model's ability to capture the electrostatic effects that govern defect transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）近年来发展迅速，但大多数模型本质上仍然是半局域的，并且忽略了长程静电相互作用。为了解决这一限制，出现了越来越多的远程模型，但比较它们在物理现实系统上的性能的系统基准仍然很少。在这项工作中，我们根据短程基线 MACE 模型评估了三种远程 MLIP——MACE-POLAR、MACE-LES 和 LOREM，评估它们捕获长程库仑相互作用的能力，从理想化的合成点电荷系统发展到现实晶体结构的第一原理数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）近年来发展迅速，但大多数模型本质上仍然是半局域的，并且忽略了长程静电相互作用。为了解决这一限制，出现了越来越多的远程模型，但比较它们在物理现实系统上的性能的系统基准仍然很少。在这项工作中，我们根据短程基线 MACE 模型评估了三种远程 MLIP——MACE-POLAR、MACE-LES 和 LOREM，评估它们捕获长程库仑相互作用的能力，从理想化的合成点电荷系统发展到现实晶体结构的第一原理数据。这一进展使我们能够将模型学习静电相互作用的能力与 DFT 总能量中存在的许多竞争能量贡献（例如介电屏蔽和交换相关）隔离开来。作为物理驱动的基准系统，我们专注于具有 Sr--O 肖特基空位对的钛酸锶 SrTiO₃，这种材料中长程电荷相互作用起着核心作用，并且是研究带电极化子和其他电子和光学特性的天然垫脚石。在此基准的基础上，我们进一步检查了 Sr-O 肖特基对存在下的氧空位迁移，使用爬升图像微移弹性带计算和分子动力学来获得激活势垒作为空位对分离的函数，为每个模型捕获控制缺陷传输的静电效应的能力提供进一步的外推测试。

articles.title: Local geometry of the Fermi surface and its effect on the electronic characteristics of normal metals
articles.title_zh: 费米面的局部几何形状及其对普通金属电子特性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fine features in the Fermi surface geometry, such as nearly cylindrical or nearly paraboloidal strips or local flattenings, are examined as regards their effect on the electronic, mainly galvanomagnetic, properties of metals. It is shown that under certain conditions, these features may significantly change the way a conventional normal metal or a layered structure with metallic conductivity responds to high- frequency external disturbances. All of the effects considered appear to be very sensitive to the disturbance propagation direction and/or to that of the external magnetic field. Experimental possibilities of observing the described effects are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 费米表面几何结构中的精细特征，例如近圆柱形或近抛物面带或局部扁平化，都被检查了它们对金属电子（主要是电磁）性质的影响。结果表明，在某些条件下，这些特征可能会显着改变传统普通金属或具有金属导电性的层状结构对高频外部干扰的响应方式。所有考虑的效应似乎对扰动传播方向和/或外部磁场的传播方向非常敏感。讨论了观察所描述效果的实验可能性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 费米表面几何结构中的精细特征，例如近圆柱形或近抛物面带或局部扁平化，都被检查了它们对金属电子（主要是电磁）性质的影响。结果表明，在某些条件下，这些特征可能会显着改变传统普通金属或具有金属导电性的层状结构对高频外部干扰的响应方式。所有考虑的效应似乎对扰动传播方向和/或外部磁场的传播方向非常敏感。讨论了观察所描述效果的实验可能性。

articles.title: Thermal entanglement transitions from strong SU(2) symmetry
articles.title_zh: 强 SU(2) 对称性的热纠缠跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study mixed-state entanglement in Gibbs states with strong SU(2) symmetry, focusing on locally interacting spin systems with ferromagnetic interactions. Our main result is to show that finite-temperature ordering transitions are associated with entanglement transitions, and therefore the steady state of strongly symmetric Lindbladians can exhibit entanglement transitions. While in the paramagnetic phase it is known that the distillable entanglement and logarithmic entanglement negativity between two halves of a large system grow logarithmically with the square root of the number of spins, we show that in ferromagnetic phases these quantities grow parametrically faster with system size. To arrive at this result we first establish relations between these mixed-state entanglement measures and spin correlations in states that are singlets under global rmSU(2) symmetry transformations. We then introduce a semiclassical theory for rmSU(2) singlet thermal states. While the global singlet constraint generally enters this theory as a complicated function of the full semiclassical spin configuration, we show that in large S limit it simplifies drastically to a Gaussian suppression of total magnetization in disordered phases as well as in ordered phases in the vicinity of continuous thermal phase transitions. This leads us to a field theory describing spin correlations in the singlet sector. Using this we determine the behavior of various probes of mixed-state entanglement at low and at high temperatures, supporting our analytical results using numerical Monte Carlo simulations of a three-dimensional lattice realization of our semiclassical theory. We also use exact numerics in one-dimensional spin-1/2 systems to confirm our predictions for the scaling of mixed-state entanglement with correlation length and system size in the paramagnetic phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有强 SU(2) 对称性的吉布斯态混合态纠缠，重点关注具有铁磁相互作用的局部相互作用的自旋系统。我们的主要结果是证明有限温度有序跃迁与纠缠跃迁相关，因此强对称 Lindbladians 的稳态可以表现出纠缠跃迁。虽然在顺磁相中，已知大系统两半之间的可蒸馏纠缠和对数纠缠负性随着自旋数量的平方根呈对数增长，但我们表明，在铁磁相中，这些量随着系统尺寸的变化而参数增长得更快。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究具有强 SU(2) 对称性的吉布斯态混合态纠缠，重点关注具有铁磁相互作用的局部相互作用的自旋系统。我们的主要结果是证明有限温度有序跃迁与纠缠跃迁相关，因此强对称 Lindbladians 的稳态可以表现出纠缠跃迁。虽然在顺磁相中，已知大系统两半之间的可蒸馏纠缠和对数纠缠负性随着自旋数量的平方根呈对数增长，但我们表明，在铁磁相中，这些量随着系统尺寸的变化而参数增长得更快。为了得到这个结果，我们首先建立这些混合态纠缠测量与全局 rmSU(2) 对称变换下单态状态的自旋相关性之间的关系。然后我们介绍 rmSU(2) 单线态热态的半经典理论。虽然全局单重态约束通常作为完整半经典自旋构型的复杂函数进入该理论，但我们表明，在大 S 限制下，它大大简化为无序相以及连续热相变附近的有序相中总磁化强度的高斯抑制。这使我们得出描述单线态扇区中自旋相关性的场论。利用这一点，我们确定了混合态纠缠的各种探针在低温和高温下的行为，支持我们使用半经典理论的三维晶格实现的数值蒙特卡罗模拟的分析结果。我们还使用一维自旋 1/2 系统中的精确数值来证实我们对顺磁相中混合态纠缠与相关长度和系统尺寸的缩放比例的预测。

articles.title: Complex Magnetic Phases and Unconventional Skyrmion Thermodynamics in Magnetically Intercalated Cr₁₊ₓTe₂Compounds
articles.title_zh: 磁插层 Cr₁₊ₓTe₂ 化合物中的复杂磁相和非常规斯格明子热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical intercalation provides a powerful route for tuning the electronic and magnetic properties of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), enabling the emergence of magnetic phases and phenomena that are otherwise inaccessible in their pristine forms. Here, we investigate the structural, electronic, and magnetic properties of magnetically intercalated Cr₁₊ₓTe₂ through a combination of scanning tunneling microscopy, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, magnetization, electrical transport, and Lorentz transmission electron microscopy measurements. We uncover a rich magnetic phase diagram comprising paramagnetic, in-plane spin-fluctuation, out-of-plane ferromagnetic, and field-induced Néel-type skyrmion phases. In particular, Lorentz transmission electron microscopy directly reveals the formation of Néel-type skyrmion textures slightly below the Curie temperature, with their configurations evolving strongly with temperature and magnetic field. The skyrmions exhibit pronounced thermal hysteresis and coexist with stripe domains, indicative of a complex magnetic energy landscape arising from the competition among disorder-induced local Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, and dipolar interactions. Our results demonstrate that chemical intercalation can profoundly reshape the magnetic interactions and phase behavior of TMDs, establishing Cr₁₊ₓTe₂ as a versatile platform for exploring tunable magnetism, skyrmion physics, and unconventional thermodynamic phenomena in low-dimensional quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 化学插层为调节过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）的电子和磁性提供了一条强大的途径，从而能够出现原始形式无法实现的磁性相和现象。在这里，我们通过扫描隧道显微镜、角分辨光电子能谱、磁化、电输运和洛伦兹透射电子显微镜测量相结合，研究了磁插层 Cr1₊ₓTe2 的结构、电子和磁性特性。我们揭示了丰富的磁相图，包括顺磁相、面内自旋涨落、面外铁磁相和场诱导的尼尔型斯格明子相。特别是，洛伦兹透射电子显微镜直接揭示了略低于居里温度的尼尔型斯格明子织构的形成，其构型随着温度和磁场的变化而强烈变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 化学插层为调节过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）的电子和磁性提供了一条强大的途径，从而能够出现原始形式无法实现的磁性相和现象。在这里，我们通过扫描隧道显微镜、角分辨光电子能谱、磁化、电输运和洛伦兹透射电子显微镜测量相结合，研究了磁插层 Cr1₊ₓTe2 的结构、电子和磁性特性。我们揭示了丰富的磁相图，包括顺磁相、面内自旋涨落、面外铁磁相和场诱导的尼尔型斯格明子相。特别是，洛伦兹透射电子显微镜直接揭示了略低于居里温度的尼尔型斯格明子织构的形成，其构型随着温度和磁场的变化而强烈变化。斯格明子表现出明显的热滞现象并与条带域共存，表明由无序引起的局部 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用、垂直磁各向异性和偶极相互作用之间的竞争而产生的复杂磁能景观。我们的结果表明，化学插层可以深刻地重塑TMD的磁相互作用和相行为，将Cr₁₊ₓTe2建立为探索低维量子材料中可调磁性、斯格明子物理和非常规热力学现象的多功能平台。

articles.title: Highly anisotropic collective modes of altermagnetic superconductors with Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces
articles.title_zh: 具有 Bogoliubov 费米面的交磁超导体的高度各向异性集体模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate collective modes in charge-neutral altermagnetic superconductors with d-wave spin-split bands, focusing on the impact of emergent Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. In the absence of a magnetic field, the BCS state supports collective modes that inherit the underlying d-wave symmetry, resulting in pronounced momentum-space anisotropy. The broken time-reversal symmetry further couples these modes to spin-density fluctuations, allowing their signatures to emerge in the spin dynamical structure factor. Upon applying a magnetic field, Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces emerge and qualitatively reshape the collective-mode dynamics through gapless particle-hole excitations and strongly anisotropic Landau damping. The damping is strongest along the momentum-space diagonal, where it can suppress the low-energy phonon mode at small momenta. Remarkably, the suppressed phonon is accompanied by the emergence of an in-gap structure in the Higgs mode and an associated pronounced enhancement of the spin response. These results establish Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces as a mechanism for generating highly anisotropic collective-mode dynamics and identify spin response as a sensitive probe of in-gap Higgs excitations in altermagnetic superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有 d 波自旋分裂带的电荷中性交变磁超导体中的集体模式，重点关注新兴的博戈柳博夫费米面的影响。在没有磁场的情况下，BCS 状态支持继承底层 d 波对称性的集体模式，从而导致明显的动量空间各向异性。打破的时间反转对称性进一步将这些模式与自旋密度涨落耦合起来，使它们的特征出现在自旋动力学结构因子中。施加磁场后，Bogoliubov 费米面就会出现，并通过无间隙粒子孔激发和强各向异性朗道阻尼定性地重塑集体模式动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究具有 d 波自旋分裂带的电荷中性交变磁超导体中的集体模式，重点关注新兴的博戈柳博夫费米面的影响。在没有磁场的情况下，BCS 状态支持继承底层 d 波对称性的集体模式，从而导致明显的动量空间各向异性。打破的时间反转对称性进一步将这些模式与自旋密度涨落耦合起来，使它们的特征出现在自旋动力学结构因子中。施加磁场后，Bogoliubov 费米面就会出现，并通过无间隙粒子孔激发和强各向异性朗道阻尼定性地重塑集体模式动力学。沿动量空间对角线的阻尼最强，可以抑制小动量下的低能声子模式。值得注意的是，受抑制的声子伴随着希格斯模式中带隙内结构的出现以及相关的自旋响应的显着增强。这些结果确立了 Bogoliubov 费米面作为产生高度各向异性集体模式动力学的机制，并将自旋响应确定为交磁超导体中带隙内希格斯激发的敏感探针。

articles.title: Train for Accuracy, Execute at Scale: Architecture-Preserving Inference for Equivariant Atomistic Foundation Models
articles.title_zh: 训练准确性，大规模执行：等变原子基础模型的架构保留推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equivariant atomistic foundation models provide broadly transferable interatomic potentials trained against quantum-mechanical reference data, but their repeated execution at simulation scale remains computationally and memory intensive. We present Symmetrix-XL, an inference engine that scales pretrained MACE checkpoints without retraining, distillation, or modification of their learned weights. It combines streamed-edge execution to avoid graph-wide materialization of expanded edge intermediates, model-specialized code generation to compile checkpoint-specific operators, and tiled execution to reuse a bounded device-memory workspace. On complete LAMMPS-step benchmarks, Symmetrix-XL reduces inference time by 3.1-5.0 times relative to ML-IAP + cuEquivariance across tested A100 and RTX 5090 workloads. On a single A100 80 GB GPU, the tested MACE-OMAT-0 capacity boundary increases from 24,565 atoms to 11.24 million atoms. This substantially lowers the hardware threshold for simulations that would otherwise require spatial decomposition across many GPUs and compute nodes. The same backend weak-scales to 703 million atoms on 64 A800 GPUs at 93.8 percent efficiency. Energy, force, stress, molecular-dynamics stability, and Matbench Discovery evaluations reproduce reference MACE behavior within measured tolerances. Case studies spanning solid-state, interfacial, and reactive systems demonstrate the increased capacity in realistic workflows. These results establish post-training execution as a scaling axis complementary to model redesign, compression, and distributed scale-out, and show that the practical accuracy-cost frontier depends on both model architecture and inference execution.
articles.abstract_zh: 等变原子基础模型提供了针对量子力学参考数据训练的广泛可转移的原子间势，但它们在模拟规模上的重复执行仍然是计算和内存密集型的。我们推出了 Symmetrix-XL，这是一种推理引擎，可以扩展预训练的 MACE 检查点，而无需重新训练、蒸馏或修改其学习权重。它结合了流式边缘执行以避免扩展边缘中间体的图范围实现、模型专用代码生成以编译特定于检查点的运算符，以及平铺执行以重用有界设备内存工作空间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 等变原子基础模型提供了针对量子力学参考数据训练的广泛可转移的原子间势，但它们在模拟规模上的重复执行仍然是计算和内存密集型的。我们推出了 Symmetrix-XL，这是一种推理引擎，可以扩展预训练的 MACE 检查点，而无需重新训练、蒸馏或修改其学习权重。它结合了流式边缘执行以避免扩展边缘中间体的图范围实现、模型专用代码生成以编译特定于检查点的运算符，以及平铺执行以重用有界设备内存工作空间。在完整的 LAMMPS 步骤基准测试中，Symmetrix-XL 在测试的 A100 和 RTX 5090 工作负载中相对于 ML-IAP + cuEquivariance 将推理时间缩短了 3.1-5.0 倍。在单个 A100 80 GB GPU 上，测试的 MACE-OMAT-0 容量边界从 24,565 个原子增加到 1124 万个原子。这大大降低了模拟的硬件门槛，否则需要跨多个 GPU 和计算节点进行空间分解。相同的后端弱扩展至 64 个 A800 GPU 上的 7.03 亿个原子，效率为 93.8%。能量、力、应力、分子动力学稳定性和 Matbench Discovery 评估可在测量的公差范围内重现参考 MACE 行为。涵盖固态、界面和反应系统的案例研究证明了实际工作流程中容量的增加。这些结果将训练后执行建立为与模型重新设计、压缩和分布式横向扩展相补充的扩展轴，并表明实际的准确性成本边界取决于模型架构和推理执行。

articles.title: Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors for Mechanistic Ion Transport Pathways from Static Crystal Structures
articles.title_zh: 静态晶体结构机械离子传输路径的拓扑谱渗流描述符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ion transport controls the macroscopic performance of solid electrolytes, battery electrodes, ion-selective membranes, electrolysis ceramics, mixed conductors, porous sorbents, and biological channels. In each case, ion transport is determined by structural characteristics, namely the available diffusion pathways and the specific bottleneck atoms that limit the ionic jumps. These are intrinsic properties of the crystalline framework, whereas temperature, carrier concentration, and correlated motion govern the transport rate. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) resolves the mechanism directly but is too costly for materials screening, and most surrogate models give only a single transport number. Here we present a calibration-free method for determining the mechanism, based on Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors (TSPD). TSPD obtains the transport mechanism from a single static structure in seconds. It constructs a periodic migration network whose edge barriers are computed from physics-based energetics. We then analyze the barrier-threshold topology of this network and the spectrum of its barrier-weighted graph Laplacian. To establish its validity for computational solid-state ionics, we test TSPD against AIMD ion densities and neutron diffraction data for eight materials, including cathodes and solid electrolytes, whose transport ranges from one- to three-dimensional. TSPD reproduces the established mechanism in every case and correctly identifies structures in which geometric openness does not imply viable ion percolation. The method is most informative for pathway-limited, direction-dependent transport, and it complements full dynamical simulations for strongly cooperative or nearly isotropic transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 离子输运控制着固体电解质、电池电极、离子选择性膜、电解陶瓷、混合导体、多孔吸附剂和生物通道的宏观性能。在每种情况下，离子传输由结构特征决定，即可用的扩散路径和限制离子跳跃的特定瓶颈原子。这些是晶体框架的固有特性，而温度、载流子浓度和相关运动控制着传输速率。从头算分子动力学（AIMD）直接解决了该机制，但对于材料筛选来说成本太高，并且大多数替代模型仅给出单个传输数。在这里，我们提出了一种基于拓扑谱渗流描述符（TSPD）的免校准方法来确定机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离子输运控制着固体电解质、电池电极、离子选择性膜、电解陶瓷、混合导体、多孔吸附剂和生物通道的宏观性能。在每种情况下，离子传输由结构特征决定，即可用的扩散路径和限制离子跳跃的特定瓶颈原子。这些是晶体框架的固有特性，而温度、载流子浓度和相关运动控制着传输速率。从头算分子动力学（AIMD）直接解决了该机制，但对于材料筛选来说成本太高，并且大多数替代模型仅给出单个传输数。在这里，我们提出了一种基于拓扑谱渗流描述符（TSPD）的免校准方法来确定机制。 TSPD 在几秒钟内从单个静态结构中获取传输机制。它构建了一个周期性迁移网络，其边缘障碍是根据基于物理的能量学计算的。然后，我们分析该网络的障碍阈值拓扑及其障碍加权图拉普拉斯的频谱。为了确定其在计算固态离子学中的有效性，我们根据 AIMD 离子密度和八种材料的中子衍射数据测试了 TSPD，其中包括阴极和固体电解质，其输运范围从一维到三维。 TSPD 在每种情况下都重现了已建立的机制，并正确识别了几何开放性并不意味着可行的离子渗透的结构。该方法对于路径限制、方向依赖的运输来说信息量最大，并且它补充了强合作或近各向同性运输的完整动态模拟。

articles.title: Charge and spin dynamics in spintronic THz emitters from Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory
articles.title_zh: 来自瞬态密度泛函理论的自旋电子太赫兹发射器中的电荷和自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters based on ferromagnet/heavy-metal heterostructures provide efficient broadband sources of THz radiation, yet the microscopic relation between ultrafast spin transport and charge redistribution remains incompletely understood. Here, we employ time-dependent density functional theory to resolve the coupled charge, spin, and magnetization dynamics of Co/Pt and Co/W bilayers in real time and space. Despite qualitatively similar interlayer spin-current dynamics, the two heterostructures exhibit markedly different interlayer charge transfer: Co/Pt shows a relatively small and partially reversed transfer from Pt to Co, whereas Co/W exhibits a larger and persistent transfer from Co to W. We trace these differences to the material-dependent ground-state electronic structure and the spin- and orbital-resolved phase space accessible to photoexcited carriers. Spin-resolved dynamics further reveal coexisting spin-orbit-mediated redistribution and optically induced intersite spin transfer, including a delayed minority-spin transfer from the heavy metal to Co common to both systems. While net electronic spin angular momentum is transferred between the layers, we find no corresponding net transfer of electronic orbital angular momentum. In Co/W, the persistent redistribution of electronic density from interstitial to atom-centered states additionally provides strong evidence for light-induced electronic localization. These results demonstrate that ultrafast spin transport does not uniquely determine charge or angular-momentum redistribution in spintronic THz emitters, which instead depends critically on the material-specific electronic phase space.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于铁磁体/重金属异质结构的自旋电子太赫兹（THz）发射器提供了高效的宽带太赫兹辐射源，但超快自旋输运和电荷重新分布之间的微观关系仍未完全了解。在这里，我们采用瞬态密度泛函理论来实时和空间地解析 Co/Pt 和 Co/W 双层的耦合电荷、自旋和磁化动力学。尽管层间自旋电流动力学性质相似，但这两种异质结构表现出明显不同的层间电荷转移：Co/Pt 显示出从 Pt 到 Co 的相对较小且部分反向的转移，而 Co/W 表现出从 Co 到 W 的较大且持续的转移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于铁磁体/重金属异质结构的自旋电子太赫兹（THz）发射器提供了高效的宽带太赫兹辐射源，但超快自旋输运和电荷重新分布之间的微观关系仍未完全了解。在这里，我们采用瞬态密度泛函理论来实时和空间地解析 Co/Pt 和 Co/W 双层的耦合电荷、自旋和磁化动力学。尽管层间自旋电流动力学性质相似，但这两种异质结构表现出明显不同的层间电荷转移：Co/Pt 显示出从 Pt 到 Co 的相对较小且部分反向的转移，而 Co/W 表现出从 Co 到 W 的较大且持续的转移。我们将这些差异追溯到材料相关的基态电子结构以及光激发载流子可访问的自旋和轨道分辨相空间。自旋分辨动力学进一步揭示了共存的自旋轨道介导的重新分布和光诱导位点间自旋转移，包括两个系统共有的从重金属到Co的延迟少数自旋转移。虽然净电子自旋角动量在层之间转移，但我们没有发现相应的电子轨道角动量净转移。在Co/W中，电子密度从间隙态到原子中心态的持续重新分布还为光诱导电子局域化提供了强有力的证据。这些结果表明，超快自旋输运并不能唯一地决定自旋电子太赫兹发射器中的电荷或角动量重新分布，而是关键取决于材料特定的电子相空间。

articles.title: Effects of on-site Gaussian disorder in the ferromagnetic Blume Capel model
articles.title_zh: 铁磁 Blume Capel 模型中现场高斯无序的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We conduct a numerical study of a generalization of the Blume-Capel model in which the crystal field Dᵢ, which controls the local vacancy density, is site dependent rather than uniform. We employ Markov Chain Monte Carlo to compute the shifted phase transition line T_c as a function of the width σ of a gaussian distribution P(Dᵢ) sim exp( -(Dᵢ - barD)²/2 σ²) at fixed barD. We characterize how the presence of this on-site Gaussian disorder reduces T_c across the second order transition line, and discuss how our results suggest that T_c remains finite even at large values of σ. We also determine the effects of disorder on the tricritical point of the conventional, uniform, Blume-Capel model, finding that it significantly suppresses the first-order phase transition, eliminating it entirely at large values of σ.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对 Blume-Capel 模型的推广进行了数值研究，其中控制局部空位密度的晶体场 Dᵢ 是位置相关的而不是均匀的。我们采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗来计算平移相变线 T_c 作为固定 barD 处高斯分布 P(Dᵢ) sim exp( -(Dᵢ - barD)²/2 σ²) 的宽度 σ 的函数。我们描述了这种现场高斯无序的存在如何降低二阶过渡线的 T_c，并讨论我们的结果如何表明即使在较大的 σ 值下 T_c 仍然是有限的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对 Blume-Capel 模型的推广进行了数值研究，其中控制局部空位密度的晶体场 Dᵢ 是位置相关的而不是均匀的。我们采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗来计算平移相变线 T_c 作为固定 barD 处高斯分布 P(Dᵢ) sim exp( -(Dᵢ - barD)²/2 σ²) 的宽度 σ 的函数。我们描述了这种现场高斯无序的存在如何降低二阶过渡线的 T_c，并讨论我们的结果如何表明即使在较大的 σ 值下 T_c 仍然是有限的。我们还确定了无序对传统均匀 Blume-Capel 模型三临界点的影响，发现它显着抑制了一阶相变，在大 σ 值时完全消除它。

articles.title: Synthesis of Metal-Semiconductor Heterojunctions in Single Graphene Nanoribbons
articles.title_zh: 单石墨烯纳米带中金属-半导体异质结的合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) are a highly tunable class of one-dimensional (1D) quantum materials that can be fabricated through bottom-up synthesis. Precise control over GNR band gaps and band-edge alignments has established them as a promising nanoelectronics platform, but forming high-quality electronic interfaces remains challenging. Here we combine sequential on-surface synthesis and scanning tunneling microscopy (STM)-induced dehydrogenation to directly write metallic 7-iGNR segments into otherwise semiconducting H₂-7-iGNRs without changing the GNR width or carbon backbone connectivity. The resulting metallic segments exhibit nonzero spectral weight at the Fermi level (E_F) and spatially extended electronic states, consistent with two dispersive bands crossing E_F. The new metallic states are well described by an extended Su--Schrieffer--Heeger zigzag-ladder Hamiltonian. Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy (STS) and first-principles calculations show that the valence band edge of adjacent, connected semiconducting GNR segments lies close to E_F for the metallic segments. STS spectra recover bulk GNR properties within sim1 nm on either side of the metal-semiconductor GNR interface, with no discernible depletion region. The observed GNR band edge alignment is consistent with a small energy barrier for hole injection, thus suggesting a possible route towards atomically precise, low-barrier p-type contacts for future GNR-based electronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 石墨烯纳米带（GNR）是一类高度可调的一维（1D）量子材料，可以通过自下而上的合成来制造。对 GNR 带隙和带边排列的精确控制使其成为一个有前途的纳米电子平台，但形成高质量的电子界面仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将顺序表面合成和扫描隧道显微镜 (STM) 诱导的脱氢结合起来，将金属 7-iGNR 片段直接写入半导体 H2-7-iGNR，而不改变 GNR 宽度或碳主链连接性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 石墨烯纳米带（GNR）是一类高度可调的一维（1D）量子材料，可以通过自下而上的合成来制造。对 GNR 带隙和带边排列的精确控制使其成为一个有前途的纳米电子平台，但形成高质量的电子界面仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将顺序表面合成和扫描隧道显微镜 (STM) 诱导的脱氢结合起来，将金属 7-iGNR 片段直接写入半导体 H2-7-iGNR，而不改变 GNR 宽度或碳主链连接性。由此产生的金属片段在费米能级 (E_F) 和空间扩展的电子态上表现出非零光谱权重，与穿过 E_F 的两个色散带一致。新的金属态可以通过扩展的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger zigzag-ladder Hamiltonian 很好地描述。扫描隧道光谱 (STS) 和第一原理计算表明，相邻连接的半导体 GNR 段的价带边缘靠近金属段的 E_F。 STS 光谱恢复了金属-半导体 GNR 界面两侧 sim1 nm 内的体 GNR 特性，没有明显的耗尽区。观察到的 GNR 能带边缘排列与空穴注入的小能垒一致，从而为未来基于 GNR 的电子器件提供了一条实现原子级精确、低势垒 p 型接触的可能途径。

articles.title: Composite fermions in ideal Chern bands
articles.title_zh: 理想陈能带中的复合费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The composite-fermion framework maps the strongly correlated fractional quantum Hall state onto a weakly interacting integer quantum Hall state in a reduced effective magnetic field. We ask how this framework is modified for fractional Chern insulators, where the role of a uniform magnetic field is replaced by the nonuniform Berry curvature of a Chern band. Specifically, we construct composite-fermion wave functions for Jain states and their quasiparticles and quasiholes in Aharonov-Casher bands, a widely used model for ideal Chern bands. We find that these states overlap closely with exact eigenstates over a broad range of field modulation. Using these wave functions, we demonstrate that the emergent composite-fermion band structure goes beyond the conventional picture of effective Landau levels, correctly capturing the quasiparticle dispersion. Remarkably, we find that an isolated quasiparticle band carries a total Berry flux that is different from a Landau level. These results establish a composite-fermion description for mobile fractional Chern insulator anyons and provide a framework to understand their stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 复合费米子框架将强相关的分数量子霍尔态映射到减小的有效磁场中的弱相互作用的整数量子霍尔态。我们询问如何针对分数陈绝缘体修改该框架，其中均匀磁场的作用被陈带的不均匀贝里曲率取代。具体来说，我们为 Jain 态及其在 Aharonov-Casher 能带中的准粒子和准空穴构造了复合费米子波函数，Aharonov-Casher 能带是理想陈能带的广泛使用的模型。我们发现这些状态在广泛的场调制范围内与精确的本征态紧密重叠。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复合费米子框架将强相关的分数量子霍尔态映射到减小的有效磁场中的弱相互作用的整数量子霍尔态。我们询问如何针对分数陈绝缘体修改该框架，其中均匀磁场的作用被陈带的不均匀贝里曲率取代。具体来说，我们为 Jain 态及其在 Aharonov-Casher 能带中的准粒子和准空穴构造了复合费米子波函数，Aharonov-Casher 能带是理想陈能带的广泛使用的模型。我们发现这些状态在广泛的场调制范围内与精确的本征态紧密重叠。利用这些波函数，我们证明了新出现的复合费米子能带结构超越了有效朗道能级的传统图像，正确地捕获了准粒子色散。值得注意的是，我们发现孤立的准粒子带携带的总贝里通量不同于朗道能级。这些结果建立了移动分数陈绝缘体任意子的复合费米子描述，并提供了理解其稳定性的框架。

articles.title: Robustness of the Verwey transition against remanent strain-induced defects in magnetite
articles.title_zh: Verwey 转变对磁铁矿中残余应变引起的缺陷的鲁棒性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Verwey transition in magnetite is a benchmark electronically driven phase transition that is highly sensitive to lattice imperfections and external perturbations. Doping, deviations from oxygen stoichiometry, and irradiation-induced point defects are known to lower the Verwey transition temperature, Tᵣₘ V. By contrast, the role of remanent strain fields and extended defect structures generated by uniaxial stress has remained largely unexplored. Here we combine dark-field x-ray microscopy (DFXM) and ac magnetic susceptibility to determine how strain-induced defects affect the Verwey transition in stoichiometric single-crystalline magnetite after uniaxial compression and unloading. The DFXM measurements were performed on two samples compressed along the same [011] direction: loading to 200~MPa generated stable line-like defects and remanent strain fields, whereas loading beyond the fracture threshold produced denser defect networks and mechanical fracture. To test the effect of a different loading geometry, we also measured the ac susceptibility of a sample fractured by compression along [001]. Real-space DFXM imaging, lattice-orientation mapping, and residual strain mapping show substantial remanent structural disorder after compression. Nevertheless, neither the transition temperature Tᵣₘ V nor the sharpness of the transition changes measurably in any of the compressed or fractured samples.
