This behavior contrasts with the strong suppression of Tᵣₘ V by point-like disorder. Our results show that extended line-like defects and remanent strain fields produced by plastic deformation do not measurably perturb the macroscopic electronic ordering responsible for the Verwey transition, thereby distinguishing the effects of point defects from those of extended slip-related defects in magnetite.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁铁矿中的 Verwey 转变是一种基准电子驱动相变，对晶格缺陷和外部扰动高度敏感。众所周知，掺杂、氧化学计量偏差和辐照引起的点缺陷会降低 Verwey 转变温度 Tᵣₘ V。相比之下，单轴应力产生的残余应变场和扩展缺陷结构的作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们结合暗场 X 射线显微镜 (DFXM) 和交流磁化率来确定应变诱导缺陷如何影响单轴压缩和卸载后化学计量单晶磁铁矿的 Verwey 转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁铁矿中的 Verwey 转变是一种基准电子驱动相变，对晶格缺陷和外部扰动高度敏感。众所周知，掺杂、氧化学计量偏差和辐照引起的点缺陷会降低 Verwey 转变温度 Tᵣₘ V。相比之下，单轴应力产生的残余应变场和扩展缺陷结构的作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们结合暗场 X 射线显微镜 (DFXM) 和交流磁化率来确定应变诱导缺陷如何影响单轴压缩和卸载后化学计量单晶磁铁矿的 Verwey 转变。对沿相同[011]方向压缩的两个样品进行DFXM测量：加载至200MPa产生稳定的线状缺陷和残余应变场，而超过断裂阈值的加载产生更密集的缺陷网络和机械断裂。为了测试不同加载几何形状的效果，我们还测量了沿 [001] 压缩断裂的样品的交流磁化率。实空间 DFXM 成像、晶格取向映射和残余应变映射显示压缩后存在大量残余结构紊乱。然而，在任何压缩或断裂的样品中，转变温度 Tᵣₘ V 和转变的锐度都没有发生可测量的变化。这种行为与点状无序对 Tᵣₘ V 的强烈抑制形成鲜明对比。我们的结果表明，塑性变形产生的延伸线状缺陷和残余应变场不会明显扰乱负责韦尔威转变的宏观电子有序性，从而区分磁铁矿中点缺陷的影响与延伸滑移相关缺陷的影响。

articles.title: Inertial Dynamics of a Skymeron
articles.title_zh: Skymeron 的惯性动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological spin textures in antiferromagnets inherit the compensated magnetic order of the host material, resulting for skyrmions in the suppression of the skyrmion Hall effect and enabling ultrafast dynamics that make them attractive for low-power spintronic devices. In intrinsic antiferromagnets, the two sublattices are identical, but synthetic antiferromagnets offer additional control mechanisms by enabling independent tuning of the properties of two ferromagnetic layers. Analogous to a ferrimagnet, the total magnetic moment can be adjusted by compensating the two-layer moments. Here, we demonstrate that tuning the effective magnetic anisotropy difference between the two layers drives a spin-flop transition where one layer reorients and thus stabilizes an orthogonal configuration with one layer oriented along the out-of-plane direction and the other in-plane. In this transition, an antiferromagnetic skyrmion undergoes a homotopic reconfiguration into a complex spin texture comprising a skyrmion coupled to an in-plane bimeron. Element-specific X-ray microscopy resolves this texture layer by layer: one hosts an out-of-plane skyrmion coupled to an in-plane bimeron in the other. We refer to this previously unexplored three-dimensional spin texture as a skymeron. By using time-resolved pump-probe X-ray microscopy, we discover unique polarity ,dependent dynamics during current pulses: a short post-pulse inertia-like continuation of the motion, and a slower return towards the pinned initial state. Micromagnetic simulations reveal that the inertia-like propagation originates from the finite-time relaxation of reorientation of the skymeron. Our results establish layer-selective anisotropy engineering as a route to uncharted composite spin textures with internal dynamical degrees of freedom, not possible in conventional antiferromagnets with identical sublattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁体中的拓扑自旋纹理继承了主体材料的补偿磁序，从而导致斯格明子抑制斯格明子霍尔效应，并实现超快动力学，这使得它们对低功耗自旋电子器件具有吸引力。在本征反铁磁体中，两个子晶格是相同的，但合成反铁磁体通过实现两个铁磁层的属性的独立调节来提供额外的控制机制。与亚铁磁体类似，可以通过补偿两层磁矩来调整总磁矩。在这里，我们证明了调整两层之间的有效磁各向异性差异可驱动自旋翻转转变，其中一层重新取向，从而稳定正交配置，其中一层沿面外方向取向，另一层沿面内方向取向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体中的拓扑自旋纹理继承了主体材料的补偿磁序，从而导致斯格明子抑制斯格明子霍尔效应，并实现超快动力学，这使得它们对低功耗自旋电子器件具有吸引力。在本征反铁磁体中，两个子晶格是相同的，但合成反铁磁体通过实现两个铁磁层的属性的独立调节来提供额外的控制机制。与亚铁磁体类似，可以通过补偿两层磁矩来调整总磁矩。在这里，我们证明了调整两层之间的有效磁各向异性差异可驱动自旋翻转转变，其中一层重新取向，从而稳定正交配置，其中一层沿面外方向取向，另一层沿面内方向取向。在此转变中，反铁磁斯格明子经历同伦重构，形成复杂的自旋结构，该复杂自旋结构包括与面内双分子耦合的斯格明子。特定元素的 X 射线显微镜逐层解析了这种纹理：一个具有平面外斯格明子，另一个具有平面内双聚子。我们将这种以前未探索过的三维自旋纹理称为 skymeron。通过使用时间分辨泵浦探针 X 射线显微镜，我们发现了电流脉冲期间独特的极性相关动力学：脉冲后短暂的类似惯性的运动延续，以及向固定初始状态的较慢返回。微磁模拟表明，类惯性传播源于斯格默子重新定向的有限时间弛豫。我们的结果建立了层选择性各向异性工程作为获得具有内部动态自由度的未知复合自旋纹理的途径，这在具有相同子晶格的传统反铁磁体中是不可能的。

articles.title: Domain-engineered ferroelectric BiFeO₃ thin films for efficient bias-free THz emission
articles.title_zh: 域工程铁电 BiFeO₃ 薄膜可实现高效无偏压太赫兹发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrashort light pulses can drive transient photocurrents in solids, the basis of modern terahertz (THz) emitters. Ferroelectrics have recently emerged in this context as sources that require neither the bias voltage of photoconductive antennas nor the magnetic field of spintronic emitters, yet the ultrafast photocurrent generating the emission has remained debated. Here, we resolve this question in epitaxial BiFeO₃ thin films with engineered ferroelectric domain configurations, from single-domain to periodic stripe patterns. The stripe-domain film emits a THz field four times stronger than the single-domain configurations, reaching about half the output of a metallic spintronic reference emitter while remaining unsaturated at our highest excitation fluences. Resolving the emitted THz field in amplitude and phase as a function of the pump light polarization and the crystal orientation, we separate the coexisting photocurrents by their symmetry. This identifies the ultrafast screening of the ferroelectric polarization by photocarriers as the dominant emission mechanism in the in-plane-polarized films, enhanced in multidomain films by the strong built-in fields at the domain walls, while an out-of-plane polarization favors the bulk photovoltaic current. Our results establish the ferroelectric domain configuration as a design parameter setting both the strength and the microscopic origin of light-driven THz emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 超短光脉冲可以驱动固体中的瞬态光电流，这是现代太赫兹（THz）发射器的基础。铁电体最近在这种背景下出现，作为既不需要光电导天线的偏置电压也不需要自旋电子发射器的磁场的源，但产生发射的超快光电流仍然存在争议。在这里，我们通过具有工程铁电域配置（从单域到周期性条纹图案）的外延 BiFeO₃ 薄膜解决了这个问题。条带域薄膜发射的太赫兹场比单域配置强四倍，达到金属自旋电子参考发射器输出的大约一半，同时在最高激发通量下保持不饱和。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超短光脉冲可以驱动固体中的瞬态光电流，这是现代太赫兹（THz）发射器的基础。铁电体最近在这种背景下出现，作为既不需要光电导天线的偏置电压也不需要自旋电子发射器的磁场的源，但产生发射的超快光电流仍然存在争议。在这里，我们通过具有工程铁电域配置（从单域到周期性条纹图案）的外延 BiFeO₃ 薄膜解决了这个问题。条带域薄膜发射的太赫兹场比单域配置强四倍，达到金属自旋电子参考发射器输出的大约一半，同时在最高激发通量下保持不饱和。将发射的太赫兹场的振幅和相位解析为泵浦光偏振和晶体方向的函数，我们通过共存的光电流的对称性来分离它们。这表明光载流子对铁电极化的超快屏蔽是面内偏振薄膜中的主要发射机制，在多域薄膜中通过畴壁处的强内置场得到增强，而面外偏振则有利于体光伏电流。我们的结果将铁电域配置确立为设计参数，设定光驱动太赫兹发射的强度和微观起源。

articles.title: Benchmarking average atom potentials derived from atomic cluster expansions
articles.title_zh: 对原子团簇扩展得出的平均原子势进行基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Average atom (A-atom) potentials provide a mean-field description of a chemically disordered alloy and are used to predict the properties of solid solutions without short-range order. Such potentials are usually averaged from an existing interatomic potential and are therefore only as accurate as the parent model. Accurate interatomic potentials are themselves difficult to parameterize and can require large training datasets. Here we benchmark a recently developed formalism that computes an exact A-atom potential directly from a linear atomic cluster expansion (ACE). We first fit a linear ACE to Fe-W data generated with an embedded atom method (EAM) potential. The resulting A-atom potential reproduces the properties of the disordered phase computed from an explicit random supercell and from a conventional A-atom potential averaged from the same EAM potential. We then fit a linear ACE to energies and forces computed from electronic structure calculations for about 1500 small Mo-Nb structures with an average of 7 atoms per structure. The A-atom potential derived from this ACE reproduces the DFT elastic constants, lattice parameter, mixing enthalpy, and Bain path of special quasirandom structures. Of the three chemical site bases, only the occupation basis also reproduces the DFT surface energies of the alloy. For Mo-Nb, the A-atom potential also predicts that the ideal solution entropy outweighs the destabilizing vibrational contribution to the finite-temperature free energy of the disordered phase. These benchmarks show that the properties of disordered alloys can be recovered from small training datasets when the chemical site basis is chosen carefully.
articles.abstract_zh: 平均原子（A 原子）势提供了化学无序合金的平均场描述，并用于预测没有短程有序的固溶体的特性。此类势通常是现有原子间势的平均值，因此仅与父模型一样准确。准确的原子间势本身很难参数化，并且可能需要大量的训练数据集。在这里，我们对最近开发的形式主义进行了基准测试，该形式主义直接从线性原子簇展开（ACE）计算精确的原子势。我们首先将线性 ACE 拟合到使用嵌入式原子方法 (EAM) 势生成的 Fe-W 数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平均原子（A 原子）势提供了化学无序合金的平均场描述，并用于预测没有短程有序的固溶体的特性。此类势通常是现有原子间势的平均值，因此仅与父模型一样准确。准确的原子间势本身很难参数化，并且可能需要大量的训练数据集。在这里，我们对最近开发的形式主义进行了基准测试，该形式主义直接从线性原子簇展开（ACE）计算精确的原子势。我们首先将线性 ACE 拟合到使用嵌入式原子方法 (EAM) 势生成的 Fe-W 数据。所得的 A 原子势再现了从显式随机超晶胞和从相同 EAM 势平均得到的常规 A 原子势计算得出的无序相的特性。然后，我们将线性 ACE 拟合到通过电子结构计算计算出的能量和力，这些能量和力针对大约 1500 个小型 Mo-Nb 结构（每个结构平均有 7 个原子）进行计算。从此 ACE 导出的 A 原子势再现了特殊准随机结构的 DFT 弹性常数、晶格参数、混合焓和贝恩路径。在三个化学位点基础中，只有占据基础也再现了合金的 DFT 表面能。对于 Mo-Nb，A 原子势还预测理想溶液熵超过对无序相的有限温度自由能的不稳定振动贡献。这些基准表明，当仔细选择化学位点基础时，可以从小型训练数据集中恢复无序合金的性能。

articles.title: Na₂Ir^IVCl₆: The Missing Member of the Perfectly Cubic Vacancy Ordered A₂IrCl₆ Family, Another Potential Jₑff = frac12 Ground State Candidate
articles.title_zh: Na2Ir^IVCl₆：完美立方空位有序 A2IrCl₆ 族中缺失的成员，另一个潜在的 Jₑff = frac12 基态候选者
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vacancy ordered double perovskites (VODPs) have been known for more than 100 years, but their exact crystal structures and magnetic ground state remained controversial till date. Anhydrous VODP iridates (A₂IrX₆; A = K⁺, (NH₄)⁺, Cs⁺, Rb⁺, and X = F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻), having face-centered~cubic (fcc) antiferromagnetic ground state, offer a chemically well-defined platform to investigate the influence of on-site Coulomb repulsion, crystal field, spin-orbit coupling, and competing Heisenberg and Kitaev interactions. Interestingly, among these, the Na-based VODP iridates seem to possess an unusual hydration dependent structural and magnetic uncertainty. As a result, a cubic Na₂IrCl₆ system having fcc antiferromagnetism could not be stabilized ever. Here, for the first time, we report the synthesis and comprehensive characterization of anhydrous Na₂IrCl₆ single crystals having fcc structure with antiferromagnetic transition temperature of 1.91 K. Thermogravimetric analysis establishes the absence of lattice water and also demonstrates thermal stability of the crystals up to 453 K. The cubic phase reported here contrasts with previously described 'anhydrous' monoclinic Na₂IrCl₆ and highlights the strong structural and physical property relationship in Na-based VODP iridates. This new material offers an exciting playing ground for exploring another potential perfect Jₑff = frac12 octahedra and the consequent strong Kitaev interaction within the nearest-neighbor (nn) pairs of Ir ions.
articles.abstract_zh: 空位有序双钙钛矿 (VODP) 已知已有 100 多年的历史，但迄今为止，其确切的晶体结构和磁性基态仍存在争议。无水 VODP 铱酸盐 (A2IrX₆; A = K⁺, (NH₄)⁺, Cs⁺, Rb⁺, 和 X = F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻) 具有面心立方 (fcc) 反铁磁基态，提供了一个化学上明确的平台来研究现场库仑斥力、晶体场、自旋轨道耦合，以及竞争的海森堡和基塔耶夫相互作用。有趣的是，其中，Na 基 VODP 铱酸盐似乎具有不寻常的水合依赖性结构和磁性不确定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空位有序双钙钛矿 (VODP) 已知已有 100 多年的历史，但迄今为止，其确切的晶体结构和磁性基态仍存在争议。无水 VODP 铱酸盐 (A2IrX₆; A = K⁺, (NH₄)⁺, Cs⁺, Rb⁺, 和 X = F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻) 具有面心立方 (fcc) 反铁磁基态，提供了一个化学上明确的平台来研究现场库仑斥力、晶体场、自旋轨道耦合，以及竞争的海森堡和基塔耶夫相互作用。有趣的是，其中，Na 基 VODP 铱酸盐似乎具有不寻常的水合依赖性结构和磁性不确定性。结果，具有面心立方反铁磁性的立方Na 2 IrCl 6 体系永远无法稳定。在这里，我们首次报道了具有面心立方结构、反铁磁转变温度为 1.91 K 的无水 Na2IrCl6 单晶的合成和综合表征。热重分析确定了不存在晶格水，并且还证明了晶体在高达 453 K 的热稳定性。这里报道的立方相与之前描述的“无水”单斜 Na2IrCl6 形成鲜明对比，并强调了结构和物理性质之间的强烈关系。 Na 基 VODP 铱酸盐。这种新材料为探索另一种潜在的完美 Jₑff = frac12 八面体以及随之而来的最近邻 (nn) Ir 离子对内的强 Kitaev 相互作用提供了一个令人兴奋的平台。

articles.title: Sector-Resolved Winding Selection Rules for Structured-Light-Driven dc Currents
articles.title_zh: 结构光驱动直流电流的扇区解析绕组选择规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured light can generate electronic dc currents with azimuthal winding, yet the rules governing their winding order m remain unclear. Here we identify sector-resolved winding selection rules using graphene as a clean two-dimensional platform. By decomposing the current response into local and gradient sectors at the current-operator level, we show that the winding order is determined not by the optical orbital angular momentum ell alone, but by the angular structure of the corresponding current operators together with projection onto the azimuthal direction. For scalar Laguerre-Gaussian beams, linear polarization yields m=|ell±1| in the local sector and m=|ell|,|ell±2| in the gradient sector, whereas circular polarization with helicity σ=±1 selects m=|ell-σ| in the local sector and m=|ell+2σ| in the gradient sector. Numerical time-evolution calculations verify these rules and further show that helicity can select an m=0 branch, producing an azimuthally uniform circulating current whose radial profile determines the axial magnetic field B_z(z). Our results provide a sector-resolved organizing principle for classifying and controlling structured-light-driven dc currents with tailored winding structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构光可以通过方位角缠绕产生电子直流电流，但控制其缠绕顺序 m 的规则仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用石墨烯作为干净的二维平台来确定扇区解析的绕组选择规则。通过将电流响应分解为电流算子水平上的局部和梯度扇区，我们表明缠绕顺序不仅仅由光轨道角动量 ell 决定，而是由相应电流算子的角度结构以及方位角方向上的投影决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构光可以通过方位角缠绕产生电子直流电流，但控制其缠绕顺序 m 的规则仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用石墨烯作为干净的二维平台来确定扇区解析的绕组选择规则。通过将电流响应分解为电流算子水平上的局部和梯度扇区，我们表明缠绕顺序不仅仅由光轨道角动量 ell 决定，而是由相应电流算子的角度结构以及方位角方向上的投影决定。对于标量拉盖尔高斯光束，线性偏振产生 m=|ell±1|在本地部门，m=|ell|,|ell±2|在梯度扇区中，而螺旋度 σ=±1 的圆偏振选择 m=|ell-σ|在本地部门并且 m=|ell+2σ|在梯度领域。数值时间演化计算验证了这些规则，并进一步表明螺旋度可以选择 m=0 分支，产生方位均匀的循环电流，其径向轮廓决定轴向磁场 B_z(z)。我们的结果提供了一个部门解决的组织原则，用于通过定制的绕组结构对结构光驱动的直流电流进行分类和控制。

articles.title: Learning ab initio phase-field models
articles.title_zh: 从头开始学习相场模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01432v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating microstructure evolution requires quantum-mechanical accuracy and mesoscopic reach in length and time scales, a combination that no current method achieves. Classical phase-field models provide this reach, but their accuracy is limited by phenomenological free energies and mobilities. Here we develop a framework for learning ab initio phase-field models, where the mesoscopic equation is not postulated but derived from a Mori-Zwanzig projection of molecular dynamics onto species-density fields under explicit assumptions. The nonlocal free energy and mobility left unspecified by this equation are parametrized by neural networks and learned from short molecular dynamics trajectories generated with machine-learning interatomic potentials of ab initio accuracy. We demonstrate the framework on an iron-boron melt and on hydrogen-helium mixtures under planetary conditions. For iron-boron, the model shows that the melt at the FeB₄ composition is spinodally unstable at ambient pressure but stabilized at 10 GPa, offering a thermodynamic rationale for why FeB₄ has been synthesized only under high pressure. For hydrogen-helium, the model predicts the immiscibility boundary and captures droplet nucleation and growth in helium-rain simulations of a column corresponding to 2.2 million atoms, far beyond the scale of atomistic modeling at comparable accuracy. Trained across compositions and conditions, such models could provide a mesoscopic counterpart to ab initio molecular dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟微观结构演化需要量子力学精度以及长度和时间尺度的介观范围，这是当前方法无法实现的组合。经典相场模型提供了这种范围，但其准确性受到唯象自由能和迁移率的限制。在这里，我们开发了一个从头开始学习相场模型的框架，其中介观方程不是假设的，而是在明确的假设下从分子动力学到物种密度场的 Mori-Zwanzig 投影导出的。该方程未指定的非局域自由能和迁移率由神经网络参数化，并从从头精度的机器学习原子间势生成的短分子动力学轨迹中学习。我们展示了行星条件下铁硼熔体和氢氦混合物的框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 模拟微观结构演化需要量子力学精度以及长度和时间尺度的介观范围，这是当前方法无法实现的组合。经典相场模型提供了这种范围，但其准确性受到唯象自由能和迁移率的限制。在这里，我们开发了一个从头开始学习相场模型的框架，其中介观方程不是假设的，而是在明确的假设下从分子动力学到物种密度场的 Mori-Zwanzig 投影导出的。该方程未指定的非局域自由能和迁移率由神经网络参数化，并从从头精度的机器学习原子间势生成的短分子动力学轨迹中学习。我们展示了行星条件下铁硼熔体和氢氦混合物的框架。对于铁硼，该模型显示 FeB₄ 成分的熔体在环境压力下是旋节线不稳定的，但在 10 GPa 下稳定，这为为什么 FeB₄ 只能在高压下合成提供了热力学原理。对于氢-氦，该模型预测了不混溶边界，并在对应于 220 万个原子的柱的氦雨模拟中捕获了液滴成核和生长，远远超出了原子模型在相当精度下的规模。经过不同成分和条件的训练，这些模型可以提供从头算分子动力学的介观对应物。

articles.title: Room-temperature Magnetoelastic Coupling in UIr₄Al₁₅
articles.title_zh: UIr₄Al₁₅中的室温磁弹性耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between electronic and structural degrees of freedom underpins many emergent phenomena in quantum materials, yet magnetoelastic coupling in metallic systems is typically weak and confined to low temperatures or microscopic length scales. Here, we report giant magnetoelastic coupling slightly above room temperature in the uranium-based intermetallic compound UIr₄Al₁₅. Using temperature-dependent single-crystal X-ray diffraction together with anisotropic magnetic susceptibility measurements, we directly resolve subtle but reproducible structural distortions coupled to magnetic alignment. Despite the absence of crystallographic symmetry breaking, pronounced anomalies emerge in lattice parameters and selected chemical bond distances near the magnetic transition region, revealing an unusual sensitivity of the crystal structure to magnetic orientation. The coupling enables direct probing of how atomic distances and local chemical bonding govern the electronic and magnetic states in a bulk intermetallic material. Our results establish UIr₄Al₁₅ as a rare platform in which magnetism and lattice distortions are strongly intertwined near room temperature, opening new opportunities for magnetically responsive quantum materials and functional magnetic sensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子自由度和结构自由度之间的相互作用是量子材料中许多新兴现象的基础，但金属系统中的磁弹性耦合通常很弱，并且仅限于低温或微观长度尺度。在这里，我们报道了铀基金属间化合物 UIr4Al15 中略高于室温的巨磁弹性耦合。利用温度依赖性单晶 X 射线衍射和各向异性磁化率测量，我们直接解决了与磁对准耦合的微妙但可重复的结构畸变。尽管没有晶体对称性破缺，但在磁转变区域附近的晶格参数和选定的化学键距离中出现了明显的异常，揭示了晶体结构对磁取向的异常敏感性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子自由度和结构自由度之间的相互作用是量子材料中许多新兴现象的基础，但金属系统中的磁弹性耦合通常很弱，并且仅限于低温或微观长度尺度。在这里，我们报道了铀基金属间化合物 UIr4Al15 中略高于室温的巨磁弹性耦合。利用温度依赖性单晶 X 射线衍射和各向异性磁化率测量，我们直接解决了与磁对准耦合的微妙但可重复的结构畸变。尽管没有晶体对称性破缺，但在磁转变区域附近的晶格参数和选定的化学键距离中出现了明显的异常，揭示了晶体结构对磁取向的异常敏感性。这种耦合可以直接探测原子距离和局部化学键如何控制块状金属间材料中的电子和磁性状态。我们的研究结果将 UIr₄Al₁₅ 确立为一个罕见的平台，其中磁性和晶格畸变在室温附近强烈交织在一起，为磁响应量子材料和功能磁传感应用开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Single-Pulse Optical Switching combined with Current-Induced Motion of Skyrmionic Spin Textures
articles.title_zh: 单脉冲光开关与斯格明子自旋纹理的电流感应运动相结合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are promising nanoscale information carriers because their position can be manipulated by electrical currents. The additional ability of deterministic control of the spin structure would allow the use of magnetic skyrmions as multi-state bits, expanding the capabilities of skyrmion devices further. Such control could be realized by coupling all-optical helicity independent switching of magnetization (AO-HIS) to magnetic skyrmions. This is realized in a Pt/Ir/CoB/Gd/Pt multilayer that is engineered to stabilize magnetic skyrmions and, at the same time, enable AO-HIS by single ultrafast laser pulse. Laser excitation is used to write skyrmionic textures, whose polarity is selected by a small applied out-of-plane field. A single 30 fs laser pulse is then used to toggle the magnetization of an illuminated region containing skyrmionic textures, reversing their polarities without requiring any magnetic field or current pulses. This establishes deterministic optical switching of the skyrmion spin structure as a new manipulation channel, distinct from previously reported optical nucleation and annihilation. The material is then patterned into a wire, to combine the optical manipulation with current-induced skyrmion motion. These results establish a route toward opto-spintronic skyrmion devices in which light programs the internal state of a skyrmion and electrical currents control its position.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性斯格明子是有前途的纳米级信息载体，因为它们的位置可以通过电流操纵。自旋结构的确定性控制的额外能力将允许使用磁性斯格明子作为多态位，进一步扩展斯格明子器件的能力。这种控制可以通过将全光螺旋性独立磁化强度切换（AO-HIS）与磁性斯格明子耦合来实现。这是在 Pt/Ir/CoB/Gd/Pt 多层中实现的，该多层被设计用于稳定磁性斯格明子，同时通过单个超快激光脉冲实现 AO-HIS。激光激发用于写入斯格明子纹理，其极性由施加的小面外场选择。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性斯格明子是有前途的纳米级信息载体，因为它们的位置可以通过电流操纵。自旋结构的确定性控制的额外能力将允许使用磁性斯格明子作为多态位，进一步扩展斯格明子器件的能力。这种控制可以通过将全光螺旋性独立磁化强度切换（AO-HIS）与磁性斯格明子耦合来实现。这是在 Pt/Ir/CoB/Gd/Pt 多层中实现的，该多层被设计用于稳定磁性斯格明子，同时通过单个超快激光脉冲实现 AO-HIS。激光激发用于写入斯格明子纹理，其极性由施加的小面外场选择。然后使用单个 30 fs 激光脉冲来切换包含斯格明子纹理的照明区域的磁化强度，无需任何磁场或电流脉冲即可反转其极性。这将斯格明子自旋结构的确定性光学开关建立为新的操纵通道，与之前报道的光学成核和湮灭不同。然后将材料图案化为金属丝，将光学操纵与电流引起的斯格明子运动结合起来。这些结果为光自旋电子斯格明子器件开辟了一条道路，其中光对斯格明子的内部状态进行编程，电流控制其位置。

articles.title: Mass-asymmetry-controlled exciton dressing and dissociation in a quantum lattice model
articles.title_zh: 量子晶格模型中质量不对称控制的激子修整和解离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01594v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a polar material, a neutral exciton couples to phonons through the sum of the electron and hole deformation potentials. Because the total source vanishes by charge neutrality, the elastic exciton-phonon vertex is regularized by electron-hole interference. Here we determine the non-perturbative fate of this interference by exact diagonalization of a Holstein-exciton model. By parameterizing the mass asymmetry to decouple it from the small-polaron atomic limit, we map a regime map comprising an internal dressing crossover and a dissociation boundary. We prove analytically and verify numerically that for equal masses, the symmetric exciton ground state is protected from phonon dressing by an exact exchange selection rule, provided the phonon source is odd under electron-hole exchange (the neutral case). As mass asymmetry increases, this selection rule is broken and the exciton acquires a strong local polaronic cloud. We show that the dissociation boundary, conversely, is set by a global energy balance between Coulomb binding and polaronic stabilization, and is nearly independent of the internal dressing. Paradoxically, the very symmetry that protects the exciton from dressing denies it polaronic stabilization, driving it toward dissociation at strong coupling. We discuss these results in the context of lattice exciton-polaron models and their implications for sharp versus broad excitonic lines in mass-symmetric versus mass-asymmetric polar semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 在极性材料中，中性激子通过电子和空穴变形电势之和与声子耦合。由于总源因电荷中性而消失，因此弹性激子-声子顶点通过电子-空穴干涉而规则化。在这里，我们通过荷斯坦激子模型的精确对角化来确定这种干扰的非微扰命运。通过参数化质量不对称性以将其与小极化子原子极限解耦，我们绘制了包含内部敷料交叉和解离边界的状态图。我们通过分析证明并通过数值验证，对于相同的质量，只要声子源在电子-空穴交换（中性情况）下为奇数，对称激子基态就可以通过精确的交换选择规则来防止声子修饰。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在极性材料中，中性激子通过电子和空穴变形电势之和与声子耦合。由于总源因电荷中性而消失，因此弹性激子-声子顶点通过电子-空穴干涉而规则化。在这里，我们通过荷斯坦激子模型的精确对角化来确定这种干扰的非微扰命运。通过参数化质量不对称性以将其与小极化子原子极限解耦，我们绘制了包含内部敷料交叉和解离边界的状态图。我们通过分析证明并通过数值验证，对于相同的质量，只要声子源在电子-空穴交换（中性情况）下为奇数，对称激子基态就可以通过精确的交换选择规则来防止声子修饰。随着质量不对称性的增加，这种选择规则被打破，激子获得强大的局部极化云。相反，我们表明解离边界是由库仑结合和极化稳定之间的全局能量平衡决定的，并且几乎独立于内部敷料。矛盾的是，保护激子免于磨损的对称性却否认了它的极化稳定性，驱使它在强耦合下解离。我们在晶格激子极化子模型的背景下讨论这些结果及其对质量对称与质量不对称极性半导体中尖锐与宽激子线的影响。

articles.title: Learning to Classify Threading in Melts of Rings
articles.title_zh: 学习对环熔体中的螺纹进行分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dense melts of nonconcatenated ring polymers exhibit anomalous dynamics and nonlinear rheology, in some cases linked to long-lived inter-ring threading entanglement. Detecting these geometric constraints remains computationally demanding, with different methods being based on different geometric features tuned to specific models. Here, we introduce a machine-learning framework that detects threading directly from the writhe of ring conformations and we demonstrate its broad generalisability. Trained on simulations of isolated, distance-constrained pairs of short rings, a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN1D) operating on the writhe profile classifies threading states with over 98% accuracy on held-out ring pairs. Remarkably, this model generalises without retraining to equilibrium dense melts spanning a wide range of densities and chain lengths (N = 100 to 1600), maintaining true-positive rates above 91% with false-positive rates near zero. Misclassified conformations are limited to physically ambiguous, shallow threading events which are arguably not impacting the dynamics of the rings. Effectively, writhe captures the interaction between the two rings, allowing writhe-based classifiers to improve the topological analysis of large ring-polymer systems with a 3-fold speed-up over the state-of-the-art minimal-surface detection. These results establish the writhe-trained neural networks as an accurate, scalable tool for characterising entanglement in ring polymer melts.
articles.abstract_zh: 非串联环聚合物的致密熔体表现出异常动力学和非线性流变学，在某些情况下与长寿命的环间螺纹缠结有关。检测这些几何约束仍然需要大量的计算，不同的方法基于针对特定模型调整的不同几何特征。在这里，我们介绍了一种机器学习框架，可以直接从环构象的扭曲中检测线程，并证明其广泛的通用性。经过对孤立的、距离受限的短环对的模拟训练，在扭动轮廓上运行的一维卷积神经网络 (CNN1D) 对保持环对的线程状态进行分类，准确率超过 98%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非串联环聚合物的致密熔体表现出异常动力学和非线性流变学，在某些情况下与长寿命的环间螺纹缠结有关。检测这些几何约束仍然需要大量的计算，不同的方法基于针对特定模型调整的不同几何特征。在这里，我们介绍了一种机器学习框架，可以直接从环构象的扭曲中检测线程，并证明其广泛的通用性。经过对孤立的、距离受限的短环对的模拟训练，在扭动轮廓上运行的一维卷积神经网络 (CNN1D) 对保持环对的线程状态进行分类，准确率超过 98%。值得注意的是，该模型无需重新训练即可在广泛的密度和链长度（N = 100 至 1600）范围内达到平衡致密熔体，从而将真阳性率保持在 91% 以上，假阳性率接近于零。错误分类的构象仅限于物理上不明确的浅螺纹事件，这些事件可以说不会影响环的动力学。扭动有效地捕获了两个环之间的相互作用，使基于扭动的分类器能够改进大型环聚合物系统的拓扑分析，其速度比最先进的最小表面检测提高了 3 倍。这些结果将扭曲训练的神经网络确立为一种准确、可扩展的工具，用于表征环形聚合物熔体中的缠结。

articles.title: Optimal sampling strategies in event-chain Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 事件链蒙特卡罗中的最优采样策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Event-chain Monte Carlo (ECMC) has revolutionised computational sampling over recent years, providing a powerful alternative to the molecular-dynamics (MD) and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithms. Each method outperforms the ubiquitous random-walk Metropolis algorithm by advancing particles along deterministic trajectories, but ECMC achieves this without being constrained by Newtonian dynamics. Recent advances exploited this dynamical freedom to induce a collective particle dynamics that relax local density variations on fast timescales. In a foundational model of N pairwise-interacting particles on the 1D torus, this led to an O(N³/⁴) improvement on the industry-leading computational efficiency of MD and HMC - but with an impractically small prefactor at low/high mean particle density for general attractive/repulsive interactions. Here we present a universal framework that generalises this high-efficiency sampling strategy to all translationally symmetric pairwise models on the torus - creating the potential to surpass MD and HMC as the state of the art. We also numerically elucidate the collective particle dynamics and discuss broad impact across the physical sciences and computational statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，事件链蒙特卡罗 (ECMC) 彻底改变了计算采样，为分子动力学 (MD) 和哈密顿蒙特卡罗 (HMC) 算法提供了强大的替代方案。每种方法都通过沿着确定性轨迹推进粒子来优于普遍存在的随机游走 Metropolis 算法，但 ECMC 实现了这一目标，而不受牛顿动力学的约束。最近的进展利用这种动态自由度来诱导集体粒子动力学，从而在快速时间尺度上放松局部密度变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，事件链蒙特卡罗 (ECMC) 彻底改变了计算采样，为分子动力学 (MD) 和哈密顿蒙特卡罗 (HMC) 算法提供了强大的替代方案。每种方法都通过沿着确定性轨迹推进粒子来优于普遍存在的随机游走 Metropolis 算法，但 ECMC 实现了这一目标，而不受牛顿动力学的约束。最近的进展利用这种动态自由度来诱导集体粒子动力学，从而在快速时间尺度上放松局部密度变化。在 1D 环面上 N 个成对相互作用粒子的基础模型中，这导致业界领先的 MD 和 HMC 计算效率提高了 O(N3/⁴)，但在低/高平均粒子密度下，对于一般的吸引/排斥相互作用，前置因子小得不切实际。在这里，我们提出了一个通用框架，将这种高效采样策略推广到环面上的所有平移对称成对模型 - 创造了超越 MD 和 HMC 的潜力，成为最先进的技术。我们还从数字上阐明了集体粒子动力学，并讨论了物理科学和计算统计学的广泛影响。

articles.title: Decoding Thermal Stability: In situ Insights into Phase Controlled Phosphine-free Colloidal Bi-Te Nanosheets
articles.title_zh: 解码热稳定性：原位洞察相控无磷胶体 Bi-Te 纳米片
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bismuth telluride (Bi2Te3) is a prototypical V-VI semiconductor of interest for both thermoelectric and topological applications; however, phase-selective synthesis and thermal stability across the bismuth-telluride homologous series remain poorly understood. We report a facile and phosphine-free colloidal synthesis approach for a phase-selective synthesis of Bi2Te3, BiTe, and Bi4Te5 nanosheets with well-defined hexagonal morphology. By controlling precursor chemistry and reaction temperature, we achieved the selective formation of different phases within the (Bi2)m(Bi2Te3)n homologous series. Based on in situ heating studies, BiTe and Bi4Te5 nanosheets transform into Bi2Te3 at about 340 degree C, followed by preferential Te sublimation under vacuum or oxidation in air at higher temperatures. We discuss plausible mechanisms for these phase transformations. EDS analysis and FFT analysis of STEM images provide direct evidence for the temperature-dependent compositional and structural changes and highlight the close thermal relationship among these phases. These results not only advance fundamental understanding of phase stability and thermal behavior in bismuth-tellurides at the nanoscale but also establish a framework for understanding structural evolution in related homologous series, providing insights into their potential future applications in thermoelectric, spintronic, and topological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 碲化铋 (Bi2Te3) 是一种典型的 V-VI 半导体，可用于热电和拓扑应用；然而，碲化铋同系物的相选择性合成和热稳定性仍然知之甚少。我们报告了一种简便且无磷的胶体合成方法，用于相选择性合成具有明确六边形形态的 Bi2Te3、BiTe 和 Bi4Te5 纳米片。通过控制前驱体化学和反应温度，我们实现了(Bi2)m(Bi2Te3)n同系物中不同相的选择性形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碲化铋 (Bi2Te3) 是一种典型的 V-VI 半导体，可用于热电和拓扑应用；然而，碲化铋同系物的相选择性合成和热稳定性仍然知之甚少。我们报告了一种简便且无磷的胶体合成方法，用于相选择性合成具有明确六边形形态的 Bi2Te3、BiTe 和 Bi4Te5 纳米片。通过控制前驱体化学和反应温度，我们实现了(Bi2)m(Bi2Te3)n同系物中不同相的选择性形成。基于原位加热研究，BiTe 和 Bi4Te5 纳米片在约 340 摄氏度时转变为 Bi2Te3，然后在真空下优先升华或在更高温度下在空气中氧化。我们讨论这些相变的合理机制。 STEM 图像的 EDS 分析和 FFT 分析为温度依赖性成分和结构变化提供了直接证据，并强调了这些相之间密切的热关系。这些结果不仅促进了对纳米尺度碲化铋相稳定性和热行为的基本理解，而且还建立了理解相关同系系列结构演化的框架，为它们在热电、自旋电子和拓扑系统中的潜在未来应用提供了见解。

articles.title: Theory of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity in Trefoil-knot Molecules
articles.title_zh: 三叶结分子手性诱导自旋选择性理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) remains elusive, and ultrahigh spin polarization (SP) in topologically knotted molecules is unexplained. We develop a discrete geometric spin-orbit coupling (SOC) framework for molecular junctions, resolving site-specific curvature and current-partition effects beyond continuous models. For trefoil-knot molecules, it quantifies site-resolved geometric SOC, reaching sim120 meV, nearly two orders of magnitude larger than intrinsic SOC of light atoms. The substrate-coupled benzene unit, carrying the largest current and remarkable geometric SOC, dominates the CISS effect. The framework quantitatively reproduces measured SP, temperature-dependent magnetoresistance (MR) and ΔMR trends, establishing discrete geometric SOC as a predictive tool for CISS in topologically knotted molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性诱导的自旋选择性（CISS）的起源仍然难以捉摸，拓扑结分子中的超高自旋极化（SP）也无法解释。我们开发了一种用于分子连接的离散几何自旋轨道耦合（SOC）框架，解决了连续模型之外的特定位点曲率和电流分配效应。对于三叶结分子，它量化了位点分辨的几何 SOC，达到 sim120 meV，比轻原子的固有 SOC 大近两个数量级。底物耦合苯单元具有最大的电流和显着的几何 SOC，在 CISS 效应中占主导地位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性诱导的自旋选择性（CISS）的起源仍然难以捉摸，拓扑结分子中的超高自旋极化（SP）也无法解释。我们开发了一种用于分子连接的离散几何自旋轨道耦合（SOC）框架，解决了连续模型之外的特定位点曲率和电流分配效应。对于三叶结分子，它量化了位点分辨的几何 SOC，达到 sim120 meV，比轻原子的固有 SOC 大近两个数量级。底物耦合苯单元具有最大的电流和显着的几何 SOC，在 CISS 效应中占主导地位。该框架定量再现了测量的 SP、温度依赖性磁阻 (MR) 和 ΔMR 趋势，建立离散几何 SOC 作为拓扑结分子中 CISS 的预测工具。

articles.title: Structured-Light Control of Goniopolar Thermoelectricity in NaSntexorpdfstring₂2Astexorpdfstring₂2
articles.title_zh: NaSntexorpdfstring22Astexorpdfstring22 中角极热电的结构光控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Goniopolar metals exhibit opposite thermoelectric polarities along different crystallographic directions, enabling zero-field transverse thermoelectricity but offering few means for external control. Here we show that a spatially structured Laguerre--Gaussian vector potential can programmably reconstruct the goniopolar phase space of NaSn₂As₂. First-principles-derived Wannier transport with bond-dependent Peierls coupling reveals two OAM-dependent spatial scaling laws: the radial response follows the Laguerre--Gaussian radius rₘₐₓproptosqrt|ell|, while calculations for |ell|=2--5 yield a dominant angular harmonic mdₒₘ=2|ell|, encoding the optical winding in a frequency-doubled thermoelectric response. Increasing |ell| simultaneously reconstructs pre-existing goniopolar windows, enhancing a representative window by approximately 17% at |ell|=5. By contrast, reversing ell at fixed polarization produces only a small correction that approximately interchanges upon polarization reversal. Energy-resolved transport reveals that the structured field redistributes in-plane and cross-plane electronic velocities, shifting the directional Seebeck-zero boundaries that define the goniopolar state. These results establish vortex position and OAM magnitude as programmable control coordinates for goniopolar thermoelectricity.
articles.abstract_zh: 角极性金属沿着不同的晶体方向表现出相反的热电极性，从而实现零场横向热电，但提供的外部控制手段很少。在这里，我们证明了空间结构的拉盖尔-高斯矢量势可以可编程地重建 NaSn2As2 的角极相空间。基于第一原理的 Wannier 输运与键相关 Peierls 耦合揭示了两个 OAM 相关空间尺度定律：径向响应遵循拉盖尔高斯半径 rₘₐₓproptosqrt|ell|，而 |ell|=2--5 的计算产生主要角谐波 mdₒₘ=2|ell|，以倍频热电响应编码光学绕组。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 角极性金属沿着不同的晶体方向表现出相反的热电极性，从而实现零场横向热电，但提供的外部控制手段很少。在这里，我们证明了空间结构的拉盖尔-高斯矢量势可以可编程地重建 NaSn2As2 的角极相空间。基于第一原理的 Wannier 输运与键相关 Peierls 耦合揭示了两个 OAM 相关空间尺度定律：径向响应遵循拉盖尔高斯半径 rₘₐₓproptosqrt|ell|，而 |ell|=2--5 的计算产生主要角谐波 mdₒₘ=2|ell|，以倍频热电响应编码光学绕组。增加|ell|同时重建预先存在的角极窗口，在 |ell|=5 时将代表性窗口增强约 17%。相比之下，以固定偏振反转 ell 仅产生很小的校正，该校正在偏振反转时近似互换。能量分辨输运揭示了结构化场重新分布面内和跨面电子速度，从而改变了定义角极态的定向塞贝克零边界。这些结果将涡旋位置和 OAM 幅度建立为角极热电的可编程控制坐标。

articles.title: Weak non-Landau-type contributions to the diamagnetism of graphite
articles.title_zh: 对石墨抗磁性的弱非朗道型贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The exceptionally large diamagnetic susceptibility of a single-crystal graphite in the direction perpendicular to the graphene layers is caused by the Landau levels. However, there are also other contributions to the magnetic susceptibility. In particular, in metals the Pauli paramagnetism is leading, whereas in dielectrics the diamagnetic Langevin and paramagnetic Van Vleck terms are essential. These components of magnetic susceptibility are also present in graphite. In this work, we calculate the magnitudes of all these small contributions from first principles. It is found that the Pauli paramagnetism is negligible (2.3 x 10⁻⁹ emu/g), whereas the other diamagnetic contribution - arising from the Langevin and Van Vleck mechanisms - is comparable to the in-plane experimental diamagnetism of graphite and to the diamagnetic response of C60 and C70} fullerenes. This diamagnetic contribution proves to be slightly anisotropic (-2.93 x 10⁻⁷ emu/g along the x- or y-axes and -2.24 x 10⁻⁷ emu/g along the z-axis), with the averaged value -2.7 x 10⁻⁷ emu/g.
articles.abstract_zh: 单晶石墨在垂直于石墨烯层的方向上异常大的抗磁化率是由朗道能级引起的。然而，磁化率还有其他贡献。特别是，在金属中，泡利顺磁性占主导地位，而在电介质中，反磁性朗之万项和顺磁性范弗莱克项至关重要。这些磁化率成分也存在于石墨中。在这项工作中，我们根据第一原理计算所有这些小贡献的大小。研究发现泡利顺磁性可以忽略不计（2.3 x 10⁻⁹ emu/g），而朗之万和范弗莱克机制产生的其他抗磁性贡献与石墨的面内实验抗磁性以及 C60 和 C70} 富勒烯的抗磁性响应相当。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单晶石墨在垂直于石墨烯层的方向上异常大的抗磁化率是由朗道能级引起的。然而，磁化率还有其他贡献。特别是，在金属中，泡利顺磁性占主导地位，而在电介质中，反磁性朗之万项和顺磁性范弗莱克项至关重要。这些磁化率成分也存在于石墨中。在这项工作中，我们根据第一原理计算所有这些小贡献的大小。研究发现泡利顺磁性可以忽略不计（2.3 x 10⁻⁹ emu/g），而朗之万和范弗莱克机制产生的其他抗磁性贡献与石墨的面内实验抗磁性以及 C60 和 C70} 富勒烯的抗磁性响应相当。这种抗磁贡献被证明具有轻微的各向异性（沿 x 或 y 轴为 -2.93 x 10⁻⁷ emu/g，沿 z 轴为 -2.24 x 10⁻⁷ emu/g），平均值为 -2.7 x 10⁻⁷ emu/g。

articles.title: Flux- and tunnel-parity-controlled Josephson nonreciprocity from singlet-triplet competition in a parallel double quantum dot
articles.title_zh: 平行双量子点中单线态-三线态竞争的通量和隧道奇偶校验控制的约瑟夫森非互易性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01830v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal supercurrents in interacting nanostructures can arise when the positive and negative critical currents probe inequivalent portions of a phase-dependent many-body spectrum. We study this mechanism in a parallel double-quantum-dot Josephson junction with strong intradot Coulomb repulsion, where local and non-local Cooper-pair transfer coexist. Using exact diagonalization of a zero-bandwidth Hamiltonian with explicit superconducting orbitals, we show that orbital flux and the gauge-invariant tunnel-sign parity control the interference between local Josephson processes and non-local exchange. For detuned dots, this produces flux-tunable singlet, triplet, and doublet ground-state spectral branches and two rectification regimes. Near the boundaries of the charge sector with singly occupied dots [(1,1) sector], doublet branches compete with singlet or triplet branches, yielding diode efficiencies approaching 40%. Within the triplet-dominated (1,1) sector, nearby singlet crossings asymmetrically reshape the ground-state envelope even when both critical-current extrema lie on the triplet-like branch, producing a broader response of order 10-15%. Finite temperature generally suppresses charge-crossover rectification, however, for intermediate temperatures we find an enhancement of both the normalized efficiency and the absolute critical-current asymmetry in the triplet regime. These results establish phase-dependent many-body branch competition as a gate-, flux-, and tunnel-parity-sensitive source of Josephson nonreciprocity.
articles.abstract_zh: 当正和负临界电流探测相位相关多体光谱的不等部分时，相互作用的纳米结构中会出现不可逆超电流。我们在具有强点内库仑斥力的平行双量子点约瑟夫森结中研究了这种机制，其中局部和非局部库珀对转移共存。使用具有显式超导轨道的零带宽哈密顿量的精确对角化，我们证明轨道通量和规范不变隧道符号宇称控制局部约瑟夫森过程和非局部交换之间的干扰。对于失谐点，这会产生通量可调的单线态、三线态和双线基态光谱分支和两个整流机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当正和负临界电流探测相位相关多体光谱的不等部分时，相互作用的纳米结构中会出现不可逆超电流。我们在具有强点内库仑斥力的平行双量子点约瑟夫森结中研究了这种机制，其中局部和非局部库珀对转移共存。使用具有显式超导轨道的零带宽哈密顿量的精确对角化，我们证明轨道通量和规范不变隧道符号宇称控制局部约瑟夫森过程和非局部交换之间的干扰。对于失谐点，这会产生通量可调的单线态、三线态和双线基态光谱分支和两个整流机制。在具有单占据点 [(1,1) 扇区] 的电荷扇区边界附近，双态分支与单态或三态分支竞争，产生接近 40% 的二极管效率。在三重态主导的 (1,1) 扇区内，即使两个临界电流极值都位于类三重态分支上，附近的单重态交叉也会不对称地重塑基态包络，从而产生 10-15% 量级的更广泛响应。有限温度通常会抑制电荷交叉整流，然而，对于中间温度，我们发现三线态中归一化效率和绝对临界电流不对称性都有所增强。这些结果将相位相关的多体分支竞争确立为约瑟夫森非互易性的门、通量和隧道奇偶校验敏感源。

articles.title: Frustration-induced multiferroicity in hauerite MnS2
articles.title_zh: 铁锰矿 MnS2 中挫败诱导的多铁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pyrite-type mineral hauerite MnS₂ is a magnetic insulator with localized S=frac52 moments. Below 48 K, it develops a collinear antiferromagnetic order, accompanied by unit-cell doubling and breaking the inversion symmetry. We demonstrate that the latter gives rise to a ferroelectric polarization of up to 360 μC/m² rendering MnS₂ a type-II multiferroic. Microscopically, the electronic polarization originates from S₂ dimers that acquire a dipole moment induced by the frustrated magnetic ordering of neighboring Mn sites. We show that time-reversal symmetry leaves ferroelectric domains intact, and that domain switching necessitates overcoming a high energy barrier set by the magnetic exchange energy scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 黄铁矿型矿物金铁矿 MnS2 是一种具有局域 S=frac52 矩的磁绝缘体。低于 48 K，它会形成共线反铁磁序，伴随着晶胞倍增并打破反演对称性。我们证明，后者产生高达 360 μC/m2 的铁电极化，使 MnS2 成为 II 型多铁性。从微观上看，电子极化源于 S2 二聚体，该二聚体获得了由相邻 Mn 位点的受挫磁序引起的偶极矩。我们表明，时间反转对称性使铁电域保持完整，并且域切换需要克服由磁交换能量尺度设置的高能垒。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 黄铁矿型矿物金铁矿 MnS2 是一种具有局域 S=frac52 矩的磁绝缘体。低于 48 K，它会形成共线反铁磁序，伴随着晶胞倍增并打破反演对称性。我们证明，后者产生高达 360 μC/m2 的铁电极化，使 MnS2 成为 II 型多铁性。从微观上看，电子极化源于 S2 二聚体，该二聚体获得了由相邻 Mn 位点的受挫磁序引起的偶极矩。我们表明，时间反转对称性使铁电域保持完整，并且域切换需要克服由磁交换能量尺度设置的高能垒。

articles.title: Magnetic Phase Diagrams and Spin Hamiltonian of Monoclinic α-RuCl₃ from Angle-Dependent Torque Studies
articles.title_zh: 来自角度相关扭矩研究的单斜晶系 α-RuCl₃ 的磁相图和自旋哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The layered honeycomb α-RuCl₃ has been much explored as a candidate to display unconventional cooperative magnetism between spin-orbit entangled jᵣₘ ₑff=1/2 Ru³⁺ magnetic moments stabilized by strongly-frustrated, Kitaev and other bond-dependent anisotropic interactions. Most studies so far have focused on relatively large single crystals that undergo a structural phase transition from monoclinic to rhombohedral upon cooling below 150 K and a magnetic transition to zigzag order around 7 K. Here we study the magnetism of high-quality, very small (sub 100 μm diameter) single crystals, which remain monoclinic upon cooling to low temperatures and display a sharp magnetic transition at 14 K. Using highly-sensitive piezo-cantilever magnetic torque measurements in fields up to 16 T, we report a comprehensive study of the magnetic phase diagrams for magnetic field rotated in three orthogonal crystallographic planes. Our extensive torque data collected upon varying almost continuously the angular orientation of the field as well as the field magnitude, allows clear detection of phase transitions via anomalies in the raw torque data and its higher order derivatives with respect to both angle and field magnitude. The obtained magnetic phase diagrams show many differences compared to rhombohedral samples, displaying reduced rotational symmetry, substantially higher fields required to suppress the spontaneous magnetic order, and distinct field-induced phases. We provide a direct comparison of the torque data with mean-field calculations for magnetic Hamiltonians appropriate for α-RuCl₃ allowing for the monoclinic lattice symmetry and propose minimal magnetic structure models for all explored regions of the magnetic phase diagrams.
articles.abstract_zh: 层状蜂窝状 α-RuCl₃ 作为显示自旋轨道纠缠 jᵣₘ ₑff=1/2 Ru³⁺ 磁矩之间非常规协同磁性的候选材料已被广泛探索，该磁矩由强受挫、Kitaev 和其他依赖于键的各向异性相互作用稳定。迄今为止，大多数研究都集中在相对较大的单晶上，这些单晶在冷却到 150 K 以下时经历从单斜晶相到菱面体的结构相变，并在 7 K 左右磁转变到锯齿状有序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层状蜂窝状 α-RuCl₃ 作为显示自旋轨道纠缠 jᵣₘ ₑff=1/2 Ru³⁺ 磁矩之间非常规协同磁性的候选材料已被广泛探索，该磁矩由强受挫、Kitaev 和其他依赖于键的各向异性相互作用稳定。迄今为止，大多数研究都集中在相对较大的单晶上，这些单晶在冷却到 150 K 以下时经历从单斜晶相到菱面体的结构相变，并在 7 K 左右磁转变到锯齿状有序。在这里，我们研究高质量、非常小的（直径低于 100 μm）单晶的磁性，这些单晶在冷却到低温时保持单斜相，并在 14 K 时表现出急剧的磁转变。在高达16 T，我们报告了对在三个正交晶面旋转的磁场的磁相图的全面研究。我们在几乎连续改变磁场的角度方向和磁场强度时收集了大量的扭矩数据，可以通过原始扭矩数据及其相对于角度和磁场强度的高阶导数中的异常来清晰地检测相变。获得的磁相图与菱面体样品相比显示出许多差异，显示出旋转对称性降低、抑制自发磁序所需的明显更高的场以及不同的场感应相。我们提供了扭矩数据与适用于 α-RuCl₃ 的磁哈密顿量的平均场计算的直接比较，考虑到单斜晶格对称性，并为磁相图的所有探索区域提出了最小磁结构模型。

articles.title: Hyperbolic lattices with mass disorder: Phases and phase transitions
articles.title_zh: 具有质量无序的双曲晶格：相和相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nearest-neighbor (NN) tight-binding models (TBMs) on plaquette-centered  10,3 (Schläfli symbol),  8,3, and  8,4 hyperbolic lattices on a Poincaré disk with open boundary conditions display a vanishing, a finite, and a diverging density of states (DOS) near zero energy (band center), respectively, yielding a Dirac liquid, a Fermi liquid, and a flat band. Emergent bipartite nature of these lattices within the framework of NN-TBMs, allows us to scrutinize the impact of mass disorder on the electronic states and DOS therein. From extensive numerical calculations of the average and typical DOS using the kernel polynomial method, we show that hyperbolic Dirac liquid remains stable against weak mass disorder, undergoing a semimetal-to-metal quantum phase transition at moderate disorder, followed by an Anderson metal-to-insulator transition at even stronger disorder. The remaining two systems display only the latter transition. Critical exponents near all these transitions are found to be close to the ones mediated by on-site potential disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有开放边界条件的庞加莱圆盘上以斑块为中心的 10,3（Schläfli 符号）、8,3 和 8,4 双曲晶格上的最近邻 (NN) 紧束缚模型 (TBM) 分别显示接近零能量（能带中心）的消失态密度 (DOS)、有限态密度和发散态密度 (DOS)，从而产生狄拉克液体、费米液体和平能带。 NN-TBM 框架内这些晶格的新兴二分性质使我们能够仔细研究质量无序对其中电子态和 DOS 的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有开放边界条件的庞加莱圆盘上以斑块为中心的 10,3（Schläfli 符号）、8,3 和 8,4 双曲晶格上的最近邻 (NN) 紧束缚模型 (TBM) 分别显示接近零能量（能带中心）的消失态密度 (DOS)、有限态密度和发散态密度 (DOS)，从而产生狄拉克液体、费米液体和平能带。 NN-TBM 框架内这些晶格的新兴二分性质使我们能够仔细研究质量无序对其中电子态和 DOS 的影响。通过使用核多项式方法对平均和典型 DOS 进行广泛的数值计算，我们表明双曲狄拉克液体在弱质量无序下保持稳定，在中度无序下经历半金属到金属的量子相变，然后在更强的无序下经历安德森金属到绝缘体的转变。其余两个系统仅显示后一种转换。发现所有这些转变附近的临界指数都接近由现场潜在紊乱介导的指数。

articles.title: Walshness: an intrinsic neural-network representability metric for quantum states
articles.title_zh: Walshness：量子态的内在神经网络可表示性度量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00505v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural quantum states (NQS) have emerged as powerful representations of quantum states with rapidly expanding applications across quantum many-body physics. Yet our understanding of when neural networks can efficiently represent physical quantum states remains limited, in part due to the nonlinear parameterization of NQS, the intricate sign structure of quantum states, and the sensitive dependence on basis choice. We introduce Walshness, a complexity metric of a quantum state which quantifies whether it admits a compact neural-network representation. We rigorously prove that a general quantum many-body state admits an efficient NQS representation if and only if it has bounded Walshness for various NQS architectures. We provide an algorithm for finding the optimal basis by minimizing the energy of a corresponding classical spin model. This allows us to empirically improve the learnability of various physical quantum states, including ground states of the transverse-field Ising model and mixed-field toric code, often reducing infidelity by orders of magnitude, and recovers and generalizes the basis choice given by the well-known Marshall sign rule in frustrated antiferromagnets. Our results provide an intrinsic complexity metric for quantum states with provable connections to their neural-network representability.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经量子态（NQS）已经成为量子态的强大表示，在量子多体物理领域的应用迅速扩展。然而，我们对神经网络何时能够有效表示物理量子态的理解仍然有限，部分原因是 NQS 的非线性参数化、量子态复杂的符号结构以及对基选择的敏感依赖性。我们引入了 Walshness，一种量子态的复杂性度量，用于量化它是否接受紧凑的神经网络表示。我们严格证明，当且仅当通用量子多体态对于各种 NQS 架构具有限制 Walshness 时，它才允许有效的 NQS 表示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经量子态（NQS）已经成为量子态的强大表示，在量子多体物理领域的应用迅速扩展。然而，我们对神经网络何时能够有效表示物理量子态的理解仍然有限，部分原因是 NQS 的非线性参数化、量子态复杂的符号结构以及对基选择的敏感依赖性。我们引入了 Walshness，一种量子态的复杂性度量，用于量化它是否接受紧凑的神经网络表示。我们严格证明，当且仅当通用量子多体态对于各种 NQS 架构具有限制 Walshness 时，它才允许有效的 NQS 表示。我们提供了一种通过最小化相应经典自旋模型的能量来找到最佳基础的算法。这使我们能够凭经验提高各种物理量子态的可学习性，包括横向场伊辛模型和混合场环面码的基态，通常可以将不忠实性减少几个数量级，并恢复和推广受挫反铁磁体中著名的马歇尔符号规则给出的基础选择。我们的结果提供了量子态的内在复杂性度量，并与其神经网络可表示性有可证明的联系。

articles.title: Quantum Krylov Learning
articles.title_zh: 量子克雷洛夫学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00537v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Hamiltonian of a natural quantum system is usually determined indirectly, by proposing microscopic models and comparing their predicted observables with experiment. A more direct approach is to extract information about the Hamiltonian from measurements on the system itself. In many settings, however, direct access to the full system is unavailable and measurements can be performed only through controllable probes, as in quantum sensing and boundary spectroscopy. Existing Hamiltonian learning protocols under such restricted access typically require a special symmetry, a known parametric form, or controlled operations beyond free evolution. We introduce Quantum Krylov Learning (QKL), a restricted-access framework that avoids these requirements. QKL uses single temperature probe autocorrelators and their operator Krylov structure to extract model-independent spectral information about the unknown system. Rather than fitting a parametrized Hamiltonian, it reconstructs the operator Krylov Jacobi matrix representing the dynamical modes accessible to the probe. The method assumes that the unobserved system is at, or near, infinite temperature. Under this condition, the Jacobi matrix can be reconstructed directly from the autocorrelation of a probe observable, without oracle access to the Hamiltonian. The required operations are free evolution under the unknown H, together with probe state preparation and measurement. The learning core therefore requires no symmetry, no parametric model, and no controlled-unitary gates. We show a Lieb--Robinson bound for the operator Krylov chain and derive a data-driven criterion for the required observation window. We also establish an end-to-end sample complexity guarantee: under generic conditions on the spectral gaps and weights, the number of measurement shots required to achieve spectral precision ε is polynomial in 1/ε.
articles.abstract_zh: 自然量子系统的哈密顿量通常是通过提出微观模型并将其预测的可观测值与实验进行比较来间接确定的。更直接的方法是从系统本身的测量中提取有关哈密顿量的信息。然而，在许多设置中，无法直接访问整个系统，只能通过可控探针进行测量，例如在量子传感和边界光谱中。在这种受限访问下，现有的哈密顿学习协议通常需要特殊的对称性、已知的参数形式或超出自由进化的受控操作。我们引入了量子克雷洛夫学习（QKL），这是一种避免这些要求的限制访问框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自然量子系统的哈密顿量通常是通过提出微观模型并将其预测的可观测值与实验进行比较来间接确定的。更直接的方法是从系统本身的测量中提取有关哈密顿量的信息。然而，在许多设置中，无法直接访问整个系统，只能通过可控探针进行测量，例如在量子传感和边界光谱中。在这种受限访问下，现有的哈密顿学习协议通常需要特殊的对称性、已知的参数形式或超出自由进化的受控操作。我们引入了量子克雷洛夫学习（QKL），这是一种避免这些要求的限制访问框架。 QKL 使用单温度探针自相关器及其算子 Krylov 结构来提取有关未知系统的与模型无关的光谱信息。它不是拟合参数化哈密顿量，而是重建代表探测器可访问的动态模式的算子 Krylov Jacobi 矩阵。该方法假设未观察到的系统处于或接近无限温度。在这种情况下，雅可比矩阵可以直接从探测可观测量的自相关重建，而不需要预言机访问哈密顿量。所需的操作是未知 H 下的自由演化，以及探针状态准备和测量。因此，学习核心不需要对称性，不需要参数模型，也不需要受控单一门。我们展示了算子 Krylov 链的 Lieb-Robinson 边界，并导出了所需观察窗口的数据驱动标准。我们还建立了端到端样本复杂性保证：在光谱间隙和权重的通用条件下，实现光谱精度ε所需的测量镜头数量是1/ε的多项式。

articles.title: Engineering non-ergodic properties in two dimensional quantum many-body systems
articles.title_zh: 二维量子多体系统中的工程非遍历特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00635v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-ergodic quantum many-body dynamics offers a route to persistent quantum coherence far from equilibrium, beyond the conventional expectations of thermalizing statistical mechanics. Most known examples have been identified through intuition, analogy, or numerical search, rather than by systematic Hamiltonian design. This leaves few general methods for engineering robust non-ergodic dynamics in disorder-free interacting quantum many-body systems, especially in higher dimensions where enhanced connectivity generally disfavors ergodicity breaking. Here, we use an eigenstate-to-Hamiltonian construction approach to systematically engineer two-dimensional quantum spin Hamiltonians with tunable non-ergodic properties. Starting from a common parent model and input eigenstate, we construct two target Hamiltonians on the square lattice that differ in their interaction geometry: axial versus diagonal. We show that the resulting interaction geometry and coupling pattern control the Hilbert-space structure and dynamics. The axial model forms a connected Hilbert-space network and exhibits an anisotropy-driven crossover from ergodic to non-ergodic behavior through the suppression of resonances. In contrast, the diagonal model exhibits Hilbert-space fragmentation and, within its largest irreducible sector, signatures of quantum many-body scar dynamics including towers of highly localized, low-entanglement eigenstates, and long-lived coherent revivals. These results establish a direct link between Hamiltonian design, Hilbert-space network structure, and emergent non-ergodic dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 非遍历量子多体动力学提供了一条远离平衡态的持久量子相干性的途径，超出了热化统计力学的传统预期。大多数已知的例子都是通过直觉、类比或数值搜索来识别的，而不是通过系统的哈密顿设计。这使得在无序相互作用的量子多体系统中设计鲁棒的非遍历动力学的通用方法很少，特别是在更高的维度中，增强的连通性通常不利于遍历性破坏。在这里，我们使用本征态到哈密尔顿构造方法来系统地设计具有可调非遍历特性的二维量子自旋哈密顿量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非遍历量子多体动力学提供了一条远离平衡态的持久量子相干性的途径，超出了热化统计力学的传统预期。大多数已知的例子都是通过直觉、类比或数值搜索来识别的，而不是通过系统的哈密顿设计。这使得在无序相互作用的量子多体系统中设计鲁棒的非遍历动力学的通用方法很少，特别是在更高的维度中，增强的连通性通常不利于遍历性破坏。在这里，我们使用本征态到哈密尔顿构造方法来系统地设计具有可调非遍历特性的二维量子自旋哈密顿量。从共同的父模型和输入本征态开始，我们在方晶格上构建了两个目标哈密顿量，它们的相互作用几何形状不同：轴向与对角线。我们表明，由此产生的相互作用几何和耦合模式控制希尔伯特空间结构和动力学。轴向模型形成一个连接的希尔伯特空间网络，并通过抑制共振表现出各向异性驱动的从遍历行为到非遍历行为的交叉。相比之下，对角线模型表现出希尔伯特空间碎片，并且在其最大的不可约扇区中表现出量子多体疤痕动力学的特征，包括高度局域化、低纠缠本征态塔和长寿命相干复兴。这些结果在哈密顿设计、希尔伯特空间网络结构和新兴非遍历动力学之间建立了直接联系。

articles.title: From Energy-Force Weighting to Primal-Dual Optimization of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 从能量-力加权到机器学习原子间势的原始对偶优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00876v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials are commonly fitted by weighted-sum scalarization, which combines energy and force errors in a single loss. A nominal weight, however, identifies a potential only relative to the complete fitting protocol. We therefore treat energy--force balancing as a protocol-dependent problem of physical model selection. For fixed-basis atomic cluster expansion models of molten LiCl, liquid H₂O, and Si, the resulting scalarization paths contain dominated states at extreme weights. Their nondominated subsets depend on the solver, and the out-of-distribution Si path is nonmonotone. We replace direct weight selection by minimizing the regularized energy objective subject to an upper bound on the normalized force loss. Projected dual ascent adjusts the Lagrange multiplier from the force-constraint residual. A frozen-multiplier limited-memory quasi-Newton refinement then returns the final model. Across the three systems, the constrained procedure reaches the solver-matched low-error region and gives measured speedups of 6.7--8.9 over completed scalarization scans under the stated timing convention. Physical-property calculations show that first-shell geometry is comparatively insensitive to the selected balance, whereas transport and solid-state observables vary more strongly. These results identify the fitted model--protocol pair as the relevant object of energy--force model selection and support force-constrained fitting as an explicit selection rule.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习的原子间势通常通过加权和标量化来拟合，它将能量和力误差结合在一个损失中。然而，标称重量只能识别相对于完整验配协议的潜力。因此，我们将能量-力平衡视为物理模型选择的协议相关问题。对于熔融 LiCl、液态 H2O 和 Si 的固定基原子团簇膨胀模型，所得标量化路径包含极端重量下的主导态。它们的非支配子集取决于求解器，并且分布外 Si 路径是非单调的。我们通过最小化受归一化力损失上限影响的正则化能量目标来取代直接权重选择。预计双上升根据力约束残差调整拉格朗日乘数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习的原子间势通常通过加权和标量化来拟合，它将能量和力误差结合在一个损失中。然而，标称重量只能识别相对于完整验配协议的潜力。因此，我们将能量-力平衡视为物理模型选择的协议相关问题。对于熔融 LiCl、液态 H2O 和 Si 的固定基原子团簇膨胀模型，所得标量化路径包含极端重量下的主导态。它们的非支配子集取决于求解器，并且分布外 Si 路径是非单调的。我们通过最小化受归一化力损失上限影响的正则化能量目标来取代直接权重选择。预计双上升根据力约束残差调整拉格朗日乘数。然后，冻结乘数有限内存拟牛顿细化返回最终模型。在这三个系统中，约束程序达到了与求解器匹配的低误差区域，并在规定的计时约定下比完成的标量化扫描提供了 6.7--8.9 的测量加速。物理性质计算表明，第一层几何形状对所选平衡相对不敏感，而输运和固态可观测量变化更大。这些结果将拟合模型-协议对识别为能量-力模型选择的相关对象，并支持力约束拟合作为显式选择规则。

articles.title: Vector chiral order and dynamical quantum phase transitions in an Ising chain with dimerized anisotropic Gamma interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有二聚各向异性伽玛相互作用的伊辛链中的矢量手性序和动态量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01167v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate a transverse-field Ising chain with dimerized anisotropic Gamma interactions and demonstrate that, both in the absence and presence of Ising interactions, the competition between Gamma anisotropy and the transverse field gives rise to vector chiral order and dynamical quantum phase transitions. The phase diagram comprises positive and negative vector chiral phases and a paramagnetic phase, characterized by the vector spin chirality and the vector chiral order parameter. In the absence of Ising interactions, we identify a gapless critical line that exhibits no finite-size drift, along which the spin-spin correlations and subsystem entanglement entropy display behavior distinct from that of Ising criticality. Furthermore, we find that the critical times of dynamical quantum phase transitions form periodic or aperiodic sequences, depending on the quench path. Our findings highlight how dimerized off-diagonal exchange enriches both equilibrium ordering and dynamical critical behavior in a quantum Ising chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有二聚化各向异性伽马相互作用的横向场伊辛链，并证明，无论是否存在伊辛相互作用，伽马各向异性和横向场之间的竞争都会引起矢量手性有序和动态量子相变。该相图包括正、负矢量手性相和顺磁相，其特征在于矢量自旋手性和矢量手性序参数。在没有伊辛相互作用的情况下，我们确定了一条无间隙临界线，它不表现出有限尺寸的漂移，沿着这条线，自旋-自旋相关性和子系统纠缠熵表现出与伊辛临界性不同的行为。此外，我们发现动态量子相变的临界时间形成周期性或非周期性序列，具体取决于淬灭路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有二聚化各向异性伽马相互作用的横向场伊辛链，并证明，无论是否存在伊辛相互作用，伽马各向异性和横向场之间的竞争都会引起矢量手性有序和动态量子相变。该相图包括正、负矢量手性相和顺磁相，其特征在于矢量自旋手性和矢量手性序参数。在没有伊辛相互作用的情况下，我们确定了一条无间隙临界线，它不表现出有限尺寸的漂移，沿着这条线，自旋-自旋相关性和子系统纠缠熵表现出与伊辛临界性不同的行为。此外，我们发现动态量子相变的临界时间形成周期性或非周期性序列，具体取决于淬灭路径。我们的研究结果强调了二聚化非对角交换如何丰富量子伊辛链中的平衡有序和动态临界行为。

articles.title: Rapid mixing of quantum spin chains at any finite temperature
articles.title_zh: 在任何有限温度下快速混合量子自旋链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01190v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that a quasi-local quantum Gibbs sampler rapidly mixes to the Gibbs state of any 1D finite-range Hamiltonian at all finite temperatures in Oleft(log (n/ε)right) time. Each update traces out a contiguous block of constant length and reconstructs it using the Petz recovery map, following early proposals for quantum heat-bath Gibbs samplers by Kastoryano and Brandão~citekastoryano2016quantum. Our proof directly bounds the distance between the updated state and the target Gibbs state using quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1. We further provide O(polylog(n/ε)) depth of quantum circuits to prepare these Gibbs states. We hope these techniques will facilitate the analysis and design of other Gibbs samplers.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了准局部量子吉布斯采样器在 Oleft(log (n/ε)right) 时间内在所有有限温度下快速混合到任何一维有限范围哈密顿量的吉布斯状态。每次更新都会追踪出一个恒定长度的连续块，并使用 Petz 恢复图重建它，遵循 Kastoryano 和 Brandão~citekastoryano2016quantum 提出的量子热浴吉布斯采样器的早期建议。我们的证明使用 1 阶量子 Wasserstein 距离直接限制更新状态和目标吉布斯状态之间的距离。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了准局部量子吉布斯采样器在 Oleft(log (n/ε)right) 时间内在所有有限温度下快速混合到任何一维有限范围哈密顿量的吉布斯状态。每次更新都会追踪出一个恒定长度的连续块，并使用 Petz 恢复图重建它，遵循 Kastoryano 和 Brandão~citekastoryano2016quantum 提出的量子热浴吉布斯采样器的早期建议。我们的证明使用 1 阶量子 Wasserstein 距离直接限制更新状态和目标吉布斯状态之间的距离。我们进一步提供 O(polylog(n/ε)) 深度的量子电路来准备这些吉布斯状态。我们希望这些技术能够促进其他吉布斯采样器的分析和设计。

articles.title: EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations
articles.title_zh: EP-Flow：无位点级注释的无序晶体结构预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01315v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成模型在有序晶体结构预测方面取得了快速进展，但许多功能材料本质上是无序的，置换混合、空位或间隙物质控制着它们的性能。现有的晶体生成器要么假设确定的位点占用，要么需要位点级无序注释，当化学式是主要输入时，这些注释通常不可用。我们通过占据分布矩阵（ODM）制定无序晶体结构预测，这是一种连续的按物种表示，统一了有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序和间隙占据。有效的 ODM 必须满足耦合的位点占用、质量守恒和非负约束，将每个样本放置在依赖于公式的传输多胞体上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生成模型在有序晶体结构预测方面取得了快速进展，但许多功能材料本质上是无序的，置换混合、空位或间隙物质控制着它们的性能。现有的晶体生成器要么假设确定的位点占用，要么需要位点级无序注释，当化学式是主要输入时，这些注释通常不可用。我们通过占据分布矩阵（ODM）制定无序晶体结构预测，这是一种连续的按物种表示，统一了有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序和间隙占据。有效的 ODM 必须满足耦合的位点占用、质量守恒和非负约束，将每个样本放置在依赖于公式的传输多胞体上。我们提出了熵多面体流（EP-Flow），这是一种边缘约束流匹配框架，它将异构多面体规范化为共享双中心空间，学习边缘保持流，并通过 Sinkhorn 逆映射恢复可行占用。通过联合生成占据、分数坐标和晶格参数，EP-Flow 在源自 COD 和 MPDS 的公式条件无序 CSP 基准上实现了最先进的性能，大大优于自适应的有序晶体生成器。分析进一步表明，EP-Flow 恢复了稀疏且具有化学意义的局部无序模式，而不仅仅是匹配全局成分统计数据。

articles.title: SupraTITO: Transferable Generative Molecular Dynamics for Supramolecular Systems
articles.title_zh: SupraTITO：超分子系统的可转移生成分子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01381v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Peptide sequence governs both the structures formed through supramolecular assembly and the dynamics by which they emerge, but predicting either requires resolving slow collective processes among many interacting molecules. Molecular dynamics (MD) provides microscopic insight into these processes, yet the long timescales of assembly and the vast peptide sequence space make systematic exploration computationally demanding. We introduce SupraTITO, a transferable generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) framework for supramolecular systems, demonstrated through peptide self-assembly. SupraTITO learns transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) conditioned on peptide sequence, molecular topology, and periodic geometry, allowing configurations to be propagated over physical intervals much longer than an MD integration step. On a comprehensive dipeptide benchmark, SupraTITO generalizes to held-out sequences and reproduces sequence-dependent structures and dynamics while maintaining molecular integrity over long rollouts. Compared with direct ensemble prediction trained on the same trajectory data, SupraTITO more accurately reproduces assembly structures while also resolving their temporal evolution. The learned dynamics generalize across peptide concentrations, including dilute conditions not represented during training. These results extend transferable GenMD to collective dynamics in periodic supramolecular systems and provide a foundation for modeling related processes beyond peptide assembly.
articles.abstract_zh: 肽序列控制着通过超分子组装形成的结构以及它们出现的动力学，但预测其中任何一个都需要解决许多相互作用分子之间缓慢的集体过程。分子动力学（MD）提供了对这些过程的微观洞察，但组装的长时间尺度和巨大的肽序列空间使得系统探索的计算要求很高。我们介绍了 SupraTITO，这是一种用于超分子系统的可转移生成分子动力学 (GenMD) 框架，通过肽自组装进行了演示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 肽序列控制着通过超分子组装形成的结构以及它们出现的动力学，但预测其中任何一个都需要解决许多相互作用分子之间缓慢的集体过程。分子动力学（MD）提供了对这些过程的微观洞察，但组装的长时间尺度和巨大的肽序列空间使得系统探索的计算要求很高。我们介绍了 SupraTITO，这是一种用于超分子系统的可转移生成分子动力学 (GenMD) 框架，通过肽自组装进行了演示。 SupraTITO 学习以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期性几何为条件的可转移隐式转移算子 (TITO)，从而允许配置在比 MD 积分步骤长得多的物理间隔上传播。在全面的二肽基准上，SupraTITO 可以推广到保留序列并重现序列依赖性结构和动力学，同时在长期部署中保持分子完整性。与在相同轨迹数据上训练的直接集成预测相比，SupraTITO 更准确地再现装配结构，同时还解决了它们的时间演化问题。学到的动力学概括了肽浓度，包括训练期间未表示的稀释条件。这些结果将可转移的 GenMD 扩展到周期性超分子系统中的集体动力学，并为模拟肽组装之外的相关过程提供了基础。

articles.title: DSSYK, open ASEP/TASEP and 2d dilaton gravity at strong coupling
articles.title_zh: DSSYK、开放 ASEP/TASEP 和强耦合下的二维膨胀重力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01790v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We discuss the triality between stochastic growth models in the KPZ universality class, the DSSYK model, and low dimensional dilaton gravity. The TASEP model, which will be our primary focus, is identified with the strong-coupling limit of two-dimensional quantum gravity. The Hamiltonian of DSSYK and the transfer matrix of ASEP coincide up to an additive constant, and we derive the exact expression for the resolvent of the corresponding transfer matrix in ASEP on a finite interval. We also mention the relation of cumulants with the Tutte polynomial T(1,q) of the crossing graph dual to the chord diagram, which implies the relationship of the models considered with the Q=0 Potts model coupled with gravity. We further exploit the realization of all these models in terms of different versions of discrete and continuous random walks on two-dimensional manifolds, which parameterize the Hilbert spaces of the respective theories. The representation of TASEP as the growth model of heaps provides new insight into strong-coupling gravity, suggesting its interpretation as an emerging phenomenon. The new dualities between ASEP and q-TASEP models and heap models providing a useful growth interpretation have been developed.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了 KPZ 普适类中的随机增长模型、DSSYK 模型和低维膨胀引力模型之间的试验。 TASEP 模型将成为我们的主要关注点，它被认为具有二维量子引力的强耦合极限。 DSSYK 的哈密顿量与 ASEP 的传递矩阵在加性常数范围内重合，并推导了 ASEP 中相应传递矩阵在有限区间上求解的精确表达式。我们还提到了累积量与对偶弦图交叉图的 Tutte 多项式 T(1,q) 的关系，这暗示了用 Q=0 Potts 模型与重力耦合考虑的模型的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们讨论了 KPZ 普适类中的随机增长模型、DSSYK 模型和低维膨胀引力模型之间的试验。 TASEP 模型将成为我们的主要关注点，它被认为具有二维量子引力的强耦合极限。 DSSYK 的哈密顿量与 ASEP 的传递矩阵在加性常数范围内重合，并推导了 ASEP 中相应传递矩阵在有限区间上求解的精确表达式。我们还提到了累积量与对偶弦图交叉图的 Tutte 多项式 T(1,q) 的关系，这暗示了用 Q=0 Potts 模型与重力耦合考虑的模型的关系。我们进一步利用二维流形上离散和连续随机游走的不同版本来实现所有这些模型，这些模型参数化了各自理论的希尔伯特空间。 TASEP 作为堆增长模型的表示提供了对强耦合引力的新见解，表明它是一种新兴现象的解释。 ASEP 和 q-TASEP 模型以及提供有用增长解释的堆模型之间的新对偶性已经开发出来。

articles.title: Stationarity and angular momentum conservation in pulsar spin noise
articles.title_zh: 脉冲星自旋噪声中的平稳性和角动量守恒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01929v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present an analysis of pulsar spin noise based on physically-motivated two-component models of spin wandering. We focus on two models, distinguished by their total angular momentum dynamics: a singular, nonstationary model with a diffusive total angular momentum, and a minimal, stationary model anchored on a conserved total angular momentum. We develop scalable Gaussian process methods and, using mock data, show that the two models are fully testable and distinguishable with full-state observations, i.e., simultaneous independent data on the crust and the superfluid rotational states. This paves a path to testing stationarity in pulsar spin noise, potentially achievable with joint continuous gravitational wave observations and radio timing of pulsars. However, robust inferences and predictions are harder to achieve, and depend on the priors and data quality, when only one component is observationally accessible.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了基于物理驱动的自旋漂移二分量模型的脉冲星自旋噪声分析。我们重点关注两个模型，它们的总角动量动力学有所不同：一个是具有扩散总角动量的奇异非平稳模型，另一个是基于守恒总角动量的最小平稳模型。我们开发了可扩展的高斯过程方法，并使用模拟数据表明，这两个模型是完全可测试的，并且可以通过全状态观测来区分，即关于地壳和超流体旋转状态的同时独立数据。这为测试脉冲星自旋噪声的平稳性铺平了道路，这有可能通过联合连续引力波观测和脉冲星射电授时来实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了基于物理驱动的自旋漂移二分量模型的脉冲星自旋噪声分析。我们重点关注两个模型，它们的总角动量动力学有所不同：一个是具有扩散总角动量的奇异非平稳模型，另一个是基于守恒总角动量的最小平稳模型。我们开发了可扩展的高斯过程方法，并使用模拟数据表明，这两个模型是完全可测试的，并且可以通过全状态观测来区分，即关于地壳和超流体旋转状态的同时独立数据。这为测试脉冲星自旋噪声的平稳性铺平了道路，这有可能通过联合连续引力波观测和脉冲星射电授时来实现。然而，当只有一个组件可观察到时，稳健的推论和预测更难以实现，并且取决于先验和数据质量。

articles.title: Thin-capping layer epitaxial quantum dots for near-field quantum photonics
articles.title_zh: 用于近场量子光子学的薄覆盖层外延量子点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02080v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Epitaxial quantum dots (QDs) are widely recognised as one of the best quantum light sources, given their good stability, brightness, quantum efficiency and coherence. To reach such properties, QDs are protected from potentially detrimental surface states by a relatively thick capping layer, typically exceeding 50nm. This prevents the implementation of near-field effects, like plasmonic-based ones, that can dramatically increase the light-matter interaction, since the control of the spontaneous emission dynamics and directionality of the emission can only occur if the emitter is in close proximity (typically tens of nanometers or less) from the metallic structures. In this work, we report the growth and optical characterisation of InAs/GaAs QDs with GaAs capping layer thickness of 10nm, 20nm, and a more standard 95nm. Remarkably, we observe emission linewidths up to 5 times smaller than previously reported, with unperturbed excitonic lifetimes. These results demonstrate that the epitaxial QD's high optical quality can be maintained even when the emitters are at reduced distances from the surface, opening the path for the exploration of near-field light-matter interactions with coherent and stable emitters, suitable for quantum technology applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 外延量子点（QD）因其良好的稳定性、亮度、量子效率和相干性而被广泛认为是最好的量子光源之一。为了达到这样的特性，量子点通过相对较厚的覆盖层（通常超过 50 nm）来保护免受潜在有害的表面态的影响。这阻止了近场效应的实现，例如基于等离激元的近场效应，这种效应可以显着增加光与物质的相互作用，因为只有当发射器距离金属结构很近（通常是数十纳米或更小）时，才能控制自发发射动力学和发射方向性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 外延量子点（QD）因其良好的稳定性、亮度、量子效率和相干性而被广泛认为是最好的量子光源之一。为了达到这样的特性，量子点通过相对较厚的覆盖层（通常超过 50 nm）来保护免受潜在有害的表面态的影响。这阻止了近场效应的实现，例如基于等离激元的近场效应，这种效应可以显着增加光与物质的相互作用，因为只有当发射器距离金属结构很近（通常是数十纳米或更小）时，才能控制自发发射动力学和发射方向性。在这项工作中，我们报告了 GaAs 覆盖层厚度为 10 nm、20 nm 和更标准的 95 nm 的 InAs/GaAs QD 的生长和光学表征。值得注意的是，我们观察到发射线宽比之前报道的小 5 倍，并且激子寿命不受干扰。这些结果表明，即使发射器与表面的距离减小，外延量子点也可以保持高光学质量，从而为探索相干且稳定的发射器的近场光与物质相互作用开辟了道路，适合量子技术应用。

articles.title: Strong Simulation of 1D Quantum Circuits via Reduced Transition Matrices
articles.title_zh: 通过简化的跃迁矩阵对一维量子电路进行强模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02082v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tensor networks are powerful tools for simulating quantum many-body systems, but the growth of spatial entanglement severely limits the direct evolution of pure states under chaotic unitary circuits. Here we consider a more targeted task: the approximate strong simulation of a specified output probability of a 1D chaotic brick-wall circuit at finite relative precision. Given input and output bit strings by and bx, we evaluate p(bx|by)=|brabxU(T)ketby|² using the Sweeping RTM algorithm, a transverse tensor-network contraction based on reduced transition matrices (RTMs). The algorithm compresses the left and right temporal boundary states jointly, seeking an output probability that converges across spatial cuts and as the bond dimension is increased. For chaotic one-dimensional brick-wall circuits at a fixed relative target precision, we find numerical evidence that the bond dimension required to obtain stable estimates grows subexponentially over the accessible time window. Our findings open a direct route to classical probability queries for chaotic quantum circuits, with potential applications to benchmarking and learning tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络是模拟量子多体系统的强大工具，但空间纠缠的增长严重限制了混沌酉电路下纯态的直接演化。在这里，我们考虑一个更有针对性的任务：以有限相对精度对一维混沌砖墙电路的指定输出概率进行近似强模拟。给定输入和输出位串 by 和 bx，我们使用 Sweeping RTM 算法评估 p(bx|by)=|brabxU(T)ketby|²，这是一种基于简化转移矩阵 (RTM) 的横向张量网络收缩。该算法联合压缩左右时间边界状态，寻求在空间切割上以及随着键维数增加而收敛的输出概率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络是模拟量子多体系统的强大工具，但空间纠缠的增长严重限制了混沌酉电路下纯态的直接演化。在这里，我们考虑一个更有针对性的任务：以有限相对精度对一维混沌砖墙电路的指定输出概率进行近似强模拟。给定输入和输出位串 by 和 bx，我们使用 Sweeping RTM 算法评估 p(bx|by)=|brabxU(T)ketby|²，这是一种基于简化转移矩阵 (RTM) 的横向张量网络收缩。该算法联合压缩左右时间边界状态，寻求在空间切割上以及随着键维数增加而收敛的输出概率。对于固定相对目标精度的混沌一维砖墙电路，我们发现了数值证据，表明获得稳定估计所需的键维数在可访问的时间窗口内呈次指数增长。我们的研究结果为混沌量子电路的经典概率查询开辟了一条直接途径，并具有在基准测试和学习任务中的潜在应用。

articles.title: A No-Go Theorem for Order-Two Clifford Electric-Magnetic Duality
articles.title_zh: 二阶克利福德电磁对偶性的不可行定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02097v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electromagnetic duality in the toric code has order two at the level of anyon types and acts as a Hadamard-type logical transformation on the encoded quantum information. Here, we ask whether it can likewise be realized microscopically as an order-two Clifford operation. For the Z₂ toric code, we prove that any locality-preserving Clifford realization of electric-magnetic exchange cannot have order two. Our proof is fully general and requires neither translation symmetry with restricted families of system sizes nor a fixed pairing between vertex and plaquette stabilizers. Geometrically, the proof locally emulates the unavoidable crossing between electric and magnetic strings, similar to a cross-cap in a non-orientable manifold. Extending the problem to the Z_N toric code, we find that an order-two Clifford realization exists for odd N, whereas it is impossible for even N. Our results show that the group law of an emergent electromagnetic duality need not lift faithfully to its microscopic Clifford realization.
articles.abstract_zh: 环面码中的电磁对偶性在任意子类型级别具有二阶，并且充当编码量子信息的哈达玛型逻辑变换。在这里，我们询问是否可以同样在微观上将其实现为二阶 Clifford 运算。对于 Z2 复曲面码，我们证明了电磁交换的任何保局性 Clifford 实现都不可能具有二阶。我们的证明是完全通用的，既不需要系统尺寸受限系列的平移对称性，也不需要顶点稳定器和斑块稳定器之间的固定配对。从几何角度来看，证明局部模拟了电弦和磁弦之间不可避免的交叉，类似于不可定向流形中的交叉帽。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 环面码中的电磁对偶性在任意子类型级别具有二阶，并且充当编码量子信息的哈达玛型逻辑变换。在这里，我们询问是否可以同样在微观上将其实现为二阶 Clifford 运算。对于 Z2 复曲面码，我们证明了电磁交换的任何保局性 Clifford 实现都不可能具有二阶。我们的证明是完全通用的，既不需要系统尺寸受限系列的平移对称性，也不需要顶点稳定器和斑块稳定器之间的固定配对。从几何角度来看，证明局部模拟了电弦和磁弦之间不可避免的交叉，类似于不可定向流形中的交叉帽。将问题扩展到 Z_N 环面码，我们发现奇数 N 存在二阶 Clifford 实现，而偶数 N 则不可能。我们的结果表明，新兴电磁二象性的群定律不需要忠实地提升到其微观 Clifford 实现。

articles.title: Beyond Light Cones: State Preparation Complexity in Quantum Spin Glasses
articles.title_zh: 超越光锥：量子自旋玻璃的状态制备复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02166v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a method for studying state preparation complexity in dense quantum p-spin Hamiltonians on n qubits, going beyond bounds based only on circuit lightcones. The key input is the class's effective profile complexity, which is derived from the metric entropy of its Pauli profiles. These profiles record expectations of all Pauli operators supported on exactly p qubits. Classes with uniformly bounded quadratic effective profile complexity remain separated from the ground-state energy by a positive multiple of sqrt n for sufficiently large fixed p. At subquadratic effective profile complexity, the class cannot outperform a suitable benchmark class at leading order, with product states providing a universal benchmark. The proof combines an adaptation of a nonsymmetric quantum de Finetti theorem of Berta et al. (arXiv:1810.12197) with Gaussian process entropy bounds. Applying this framework, we show that attaining near-ground-state energy requires Ω(n²/log n) one- and two-qubit gates, even with arbitrary discardable ancillas. We also obtain depth-width tradeoffs, entanglement-depth and matrix product state bond-dimension lower bounds, and obstructions for both orientations at every fixed level of Parham's magic hierarchy (arXiv:2504.19966), with total circuit width O(n). In first-level reverse magic, a shallow circuit is followed by an unrestricted Clifford circuit. The latter can spread local observables across the system, preventing a direct application of small-lightcone bounds. For this first-level class, our bounds also allow arbitrarily many clean ancillas at fixed shallow-circuit depth. A sharper benchmark shows that Clifford+T circuits with o(n) T-gates have no leading-order energy advantage over product stabilizer states, even with unrestricted Clifford operations and arbitrary discardable ancillas.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种研究 n 个量子位上密集量子 p-自旋哈密顿量的状态准备复杂性的方法，超越了仅基于电路光锥的界限。关键输入是类的有效轮廓复杂度，它源自其泡利轮廓的度量熵。这些配置文件记录了在 p 个量子位上支持的所有泡利算子的期望。对于足够大的固定 p，具有统一有界二次有效轮廓复杂度的类仍然与基态能量分开 sqrt n 的正倍数。在次二次有效轮廓复杂度下，该类无法超越领先顺序的合适基准类，而产品状态提供了通用基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了一种研究 n 个量子位上密集量子 p-自旋哈密顿量的状态准备复杂性的方法，超越了仅基于电路光锥的界限。关键输入是类的有效轮廓复杂度，它源自其泡利轮廓的度量熵。这些配置文件记录了在 p 个量子位上支持的所有泡利算子的期望。对于足够大的固定 p，具有统一有界二次有效轮廓复杂度的类仍然与基态能量分开 sqrt n 的正倍数。在次二次有效轮廓复杂度下，该类无法超越领先顺序的合适基准类，而产品状态提供了通用基准。该证明结合了 Berta 等人的非对称量子 de Finetti 定理的改编。 (arXiv:1810.12197) 具有高斯过程熵界限。应用这个框架，我们表明，获得接近基态的能量需要 Ω(n²/log n) 一和两个量子位门，即使有任意可丢弃的辅助装置。我们还获得了深度-宽度权衡、纠缠深度和矩阵积态键维下界，以及 Parham 魔法层次结构 (arXiv:2504.19966) 的每个固定级别的两个方向的障碍物，总电路宽度为 O(n)。在第一级反向魔术中，浅层电路后面是无限制的克利福德电路。后者可以将局部可观测值传播到整个系统，从而防止直接应用小光锥边界。对于这个第一级类，我们的边界还允许在固定的浅电路深度上任意许多干净的辅助设备。更清晰的基准表明，即使具有不受限制的 Clifford 操作和任意可丢弃的辅助设备，具有 o(n) T 门的 Clifford+T 电路相对于乘积稳定器状态也没有前序能量优势。

articles.title: Investigation of Fe-Ag and Ag-Fe Interfaces in Ag-57Fe-Ag trilayer Using Nuclear Resonance Scattering under X-ray Standing Wave Conditions
articles.title_zh: X 射线驻波条件下利用核磁共振散射研究 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层中的 Fe-Ag 和 Ag-Fe 界面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.06223v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding the interfaces of layered nanostructures is key to optimizing their structural and magnetic properties for the desired functionality. In the present work, the two interfaces of a few nm thick Fe layer in Ag-57Fe-Ag trilayers are studied with a depth resolution of a fraction of a nanometer using x-ray standing waves (XSWs) generated by an underlying [W-Si]x10 multilayer (MLT) at an x-ray incident angle around the Bragg peak of the MLT. Interface selectivity in Ag-57Fe-Ag trilayers was achieved by moving XSW antinodes across the interfaces by optimizing suitable incident angles and performing depth-resolved nuclear resonance scattering (NRS) and X-ray fluorescence (XRF) measurements for magnetic and structural properties. The combined analysis revealed that the rms roughness of 57Fe-on-Ag and Ag-on-57Fe interfaces are not equal. The roughness of the 57Fe-on-Ag interface is 9.7 Angstrom, while that of the Ag-on-57Fe interface is 6.4 Angstrom. 57Fe isotope sensitive NRS revealed that hyperfine field (HFF) at both interfaces of 57Fe-on-Ag and Ag-on-57Fe interfaces are distinct, which is consistent with the difference in interface roughnesses measured as root mean square (RMS) roughness. Thermal annealing induces 57Fe diffusion into the Ag layer, and annealing at 325 C transforms the sample into a paramagnetic state. This behavior is attributed to forming 57Fe nanoparticles within the Ag matrix, exhibiting a paramagnetic nature. These findings provide deep insights into interface properties crucial for developing advanced nanostructures and spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解层状纳米结构的界面是优化其结构和磁性以获得所需功能的关键。在目前的工作中，使用底层 [W-Si]x10 多层 (MLT) 产生的 X 射线驻波 (XSW) 以围绕 MLT 布拉格峰的 X 射线入射角，以几分之一纳米的深度分辨率研究了 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层中几纳米厚的 Fe 层的两个界面。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解层状纳米结构的界面是优化其结构和磁性以获得所需功能的关键。在目前的工作中，使用底层 [W-Si]x10 多层 (MLT) 产生的 X 射线驻波 (XSW) 以围绕 MLT 布拉格峰的 X 射线入射角，以几分之一纳米的深度分辨率研究了 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层中几纳米厚的 Fe 层的两个界面。 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层膜中的界面选择性是通过优化合适的入射角并在界面上移动 XSW 波腹来实现的，并对磁性和结构特性进行深度分辨核磁共振散射 (NRS) 和 X 射线荧光 (XRF) 测量。综合分析表明，57Fe-on-Ag 和 Ag-on-57Fe 界面的均方根粗糙度不相等。 57Fe-on-Ag界面的粗糙度为9.7埃，而Ag-on-57Fe界面的粗糙度为6.4埃。 57Fe同位素敏感的NRS显示，57Fe-on-Ag和Ag-on-57Fe界面的超精细场（HFF）是明显的，这与以均方根（RMS）粗糙度测量的界面粗糙度的差异一致。热退火导致 57Fe 扩散到 Ag 层中，325°C 的退火将样品转变为顺磁性状态。这种行为归因于在 Ag 基质内形成 57Fe 纳米颗粒，表现出顺磁性。这些发现提供了对开发先进纳米结构和自旋电子器件至关重要的界面特性的深入见解。

articles.title: Sequential Circuits as Generalized Symmetry on the Lattice
articles.title_zh: 晶格上广义对称性的时序电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.22394v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generalized symmetry extends the usual notion of symmetry to ones that are of higher-form, acting on subsystems, non-invertible, etc. The concept was defined in the field theory context using the idea of topological defects. On the lattice, an immediate consequence is that a symmetry twist is moved across the system by a sequential quantum circuit. In this paper, we ask how to deduce the full, potentially non-invertible symmetry action from the unitary sequential circuit and how the connection to sequential circuit constrains the properties of the generalized symmetries. We find that for symmetries that contain the trivial symmetry operator as a fusion outcome, which we call annihilable symmetries, the sequential circuit fully determines the symmetry action and puts various constraints on their fusion. In contrast, for unannihilable symmetries, like those whose corresponding twist is the Cheshire string, a further one-dimensional sequential circuit is needed for the full description. Matrix product operator and tensor network operator representations play an important role in our discussion.
articles.abstract_zh: 广义对称将通常的对称概念扩展到更高形式的对称、作用于子系统的对称、不可逆的对称等。该概念是使用拓扑缺陷的思想在场论背景下定义的。在晶格上，直接的结果是对称性扭曲通过顺序量子电路在系统中移动。在本文中，我们询问如何从酉时序电路中推导出完整的、潜在不可逆的对称作用，以及与时序电路的连接如何限制广义对称性的属性。我们发现，对于包含平凡对称算子作为融合结果的对称性（我们称之为可湮灭对称性），时序电路完全决定了对称性行为，并对它们的融合施加了各种约束。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 广义对称将通常的对称概念扩展到更高形式的对称、作用于子系统的对称、不可逆的对称等。该概念是使用拓扑缺陷的思想在场论背景下定义的。在晶格上，直接的结果是对称性扭曲通过顺序量子电路在系统中移动。在本文中，我们询问如何从酉时序电路中推导出完整的、潜在不可逆的对称作用，以及与时序电路的连接如何限制广义对称性的属性。我们发现，对于包含平凡对称算子作为融合结果的对称性（我们称之为可湮灭对称性），时序电路完全决定了对称性行为，并对它们的融合施加了各种约束。相反，对于不可湮灭的对称性，比如那些相应的扭曲是柴郡弦的对称性，需要进一步的一维时序电路来进行完整的描述。矩阵乘积算子和张量网络算子表示在我们的讨论中发挥着重要作用。

articles.title: A Machine Learning Closure for Polymer Integral Equation Theory
articles.title_zh: 聚合物积分方程理论的机器学习闭包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11030v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Polymer reference interaction site model (PRISM) theory, a descendant of Ornstein-Zernike liquid state theory, is a powerful tool to predict the structure and thermodynamics of equilibrium polymer systems, but its accuracy and applicability can be limited in some important cases. Typically, these shortcomings are traced to the analytical closure relationships used to solve the integral equations. Here, we propose a machine learning (ML)-based closure relation trained on a dataset of coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of homopolymer melts and solutions. PRISM theory with the ML closure outperforms traditional atomic closures (e.g., Percus-Yevick) in predicting the structure of typical coarse-grained model systems. We also use the ML closure to accurately model the results of small-angle neutron scattering experiments. This ML-enhanced PRISM theory can therefore enable rapid soft materials discovery and design efforts.
