articles.abstract_zh_full: 针对分选条件差、目标形状多样造成的特征提取困难、信息单维等问题，提出了一种基于DRD-YOLOv11n的煤矸石检测和位姿估计方法。首先，为了避免棋盘效应，我们将用于动态上采样的DySample运算符添加到特征融合网络中。它取代了常见的插值，以较低的计算成本进行动态特征重采样。其次，为了减少灰尘和光线的噪音并增强细节功能，我们在检测头之前放置了一个残留增强模块。它使用深度可分离卷积和SE注意模块来完成有效的特征提取。此外，为实现不同尺寸物体的精确定位，结合多维关注，利用DCNv3算子的几何变形，重建基于DCNv3的动态检测头。最后，为了提供机械爪的精确抓取位置，设置了一个用于姿态估计的后处理模块。我们使用最小面积边界矩形（ MABR ）拟合和指数移动平均（ EMA ）时间滤波。利用分离轴定理，建立动态安全区，计算稳定的旋转角，确保安全抓取。测试结果表明，在煤和矸石数据集上，与原始YOLOv11n相比，改进的DRD-YOLOv11n仅具有5.1 MB的模型权重。其mAP50-95达到85.6% ，比基线高出0.6%。F1得分为95.1% ，也上升了0.6%。参数数量减少6% ，检测速度达到每秒114帧，加上位姿估计后，机械爪对长条形物体的抓取成功率从60%提高到90% ，即使在拥挤的工作条件下也能保证整体安全抓取率，在保持模型轻量的同时，该方法平衡了检测精度和速度。此外，新增模块解决了定位精度低的问题。为分拣机器人的实际工程应用提供关键支撑和理论参考。

articles.title: Study on the Oil Film Flow Field in Hydrostatic Bearings of Friction Welding Spindles
articles.title_zh: 摩擦焊主轴静压轴承油膜流场研究
articles.abstract: Addressing the issue of thermal failure in closed hydrostatic bearings of the spindle in heavy-duty inertial friction welding machines under extreme operating conditions, this paper takes a 1,000-tonne machine as its subject and employs the equivalent rectangularisation method for sector-shaped oil chambers, combined with CFD simulation, to analyse the oil film temperature and pressure fields under full-load upsetting force and at rotational speeds of 100–500 r/min. The results indicate that the high-temperature zones are located at the outlet of the oil seal and at the corners; temperatures on both the pressure side and the back-pressure side rise significantly with rotational speed, with the corners identified as the primary risk points for thermal failure. Under constant-flow oil supply, the pressures on both sides stabilise at 33–34 MPa and 7.8–8.2 MPa, respectively; the load-bearing capacity is insensitive to rotational speed, whilst the thermal load on the pressure side is significantly higher than that on the back-pressure side. Experimental validation confirms the reliability of the simulation method. This study provides a basis for optimising bearing design and implementing thermal prevention measures.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对重型惯性摩擦焊机主轴闭式静压轴承在极端工况下的热失效问题，以千吨级机床为对象，采用扇形油室等效矩形化方法，结合CFD仿真，对满载镦粗力、转速100~500 r/min下的油膜温度和压力场进行分析。结果表明，高温区位于油封出口处和拐角处；压力侧和背压侧的温度随着转速的增加而显着升高，角落被确定为热故障的主要风险点。恒流量供油时，两侧压力分别稳定在33~34 MPa和7.8~8.2 MPa；承载能力对转速不敏感，而压力侧的热负荷明显高于背压侧的热负荷。

articles.title_zh: 重新评估对极端环境下的难熔高熵合金的追求
articles.abstract: Nature Reviews Materials, Published online: 01 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41578-026-00969-5 The recent report of an oxide-dispersion-strengthened Ta alloy retaining appreciable tensile strength above 2,000 °C raises a provocative question: do we still need refractory high-entropy alloys? This Comment argues that their value lies in enabling multiple tolerance mechanisms for extreme environments and proposes shifting the design focus from maximizing compositional complexity to deploying the right complexity, in the right form, for the right mechanism.

articles.title: Hidden Angular Momentum Loop Currents in Symmetric Crystals
articles.title_zh: 对称晶体中隐藏的角动量环路电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Loop-current order has been invoked to explain unconventional electronic phases, with the crystal lattice usually regarded as a passive host for the underlying collective dynamics. Here we show that circulating currents can originate in the lattice itself, sustained by quantum and thermal fluctuations. We develop a microscopic description of angular momentum exchange that separates transfer between sites from crystalline restoring torques and reveals how circulation can emerge in a symmetry-preserving equilibrium state. In a two-dimensional elastic lattice preserving time-reversal, inversion, and fourfold rotational symmetries, we uncover opposite current loops on neighboring plaquettes while the mean angular momentum vanishes at every site. These currents are sustained by zero-point fluctuations in the phonon vacuum and persist at finite temperature. We trace their origin to directional elastic interactions in locally symmetry-lowered environments, with the higher crystal symmetry organizing the resulting currents into a compensated pattern of circulation. Our results extend the physics of equilibrium loop currents to lattice dynamics, revealing that elastic geometry can organize fluctuations into persistent angular momentum circulation without electronic or magnetic order, external driving, or spontaneous symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 环流顺序已被用来解释非常规电子相，晶格通常被视为潜在集体动力学的被动主体。在这里，我们证明循环电流可以起源于晶格本身，由量子和热波动维持。我们开发了角动量交换的微观描述，将位点之间的传递与晶体恢复扭矩分开，并揭示了循环如何出现在保持对称的平衡状态。在保持时间反转、反转和四重旋转对称性的二维弹性晶格中，我们发现相邻斑块上存在相反的电流环，而平均角动量在每个位置都消失。这些电流由声子真空中的零点涨落维持，并在有限温度下持续存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 环流顺序已被用来解释非常规电子相，晶格通常被视为潜在集体动力学的被动主体。在这里，我们证明循环电流可以起源于晶格本身，由量子和热波动维持。我们开发了角动量交换的微观描述，将位点之间的传递与晶体恢复扭矩分开，并揭示了循环如何出现在保持对称的平衡状态。在保持时间反转、反转和四重旋转对称性的二维弹性晶格中，我们发现相邻斑块上存在相反的电流环，而平均角动量在每个位置都消失。这些电流由声子真空中的零点涨落维持，并在有限温度下持续存在。我们将其起源追溯到局部对称性降低的环境中的定向弹性相互作用，较高的晶体对称性将产生的电流组织成补偿的循环模式。我们的研究结果将平衡环电流的物理学扩展到晶格动力学，揭示了弹性几何结构可以将涨落组织成持续的角动量循环，而无需电子或磁序、外部驱动或自发对称性破缺。

articles.title: Ab initio calculated diamagnetic and paramagnetic susceptibility of carbonate minerals
articles.title_zh: 从头计算碳酸盐矿物的抗磁和顺磁磁化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) is a widely used tool to infer rock fabrics, yet quantitative interpretation is limited by sparse single-crystal magnetic properties for rock-forming minerals and by the difficulty of separating intrinsic diamagnetism from impurity-related magnetism. Here we use density-functional theory (DFT) combined with perturbation theory to compute the diamagnetic susceptibility and AMS of calcite-group carbonates (calcite, magnesite, and dolomite) and to quantify the additional paramagnetic contribution from transition-metal doping. For pure calcite, the calculated susceptibility and its anisotropy are in good agreement with published single-crystal measurements, validating the ab initio approach for diamagnetic phases. We provide improved intrinsic diamagnetic reference values for magnesite and dolomite, for which experimental susceptibilities are commonly affected by magnetic impurities. To address impurity effects explicitly, we model Fe and Mn substitution in calcite using supercells. The computed spin moments reproduce expected high-spin states (Fe²⁺, S=2; Mn²⁺, S=5/2) and yield a susceptibility anisotropy per Fe concentration that matches the experimental slope. The strong anisotropy is primarily governed by an orbital contribution tied to the crystallographic c-axis rather than by spin-orbit coupling, highlighting orbital magnetisation as a key but numerically challenging ingredient for modelling of paramagnetic AMS in carbonates.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁化率各向异性（AMS）是一种广泛使用的推断岩石结构的工具，但定量解释受到造岩矿物稀疏的单晶磁性以及难以将固有抗磁性与杂质相关磁性分开的限制。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 与微扰理论相结合来计算方解石族碳酸盐（方解石、菱镁矿和白云石）的抗磁化率和 AMS，并量化过渡金属掺杂的额外顺磁贡献。对于纯方解石，计算的磁化率及其各向异性与已发表的单晶测量结果非常一致，验证了抗磁相的从头计算方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁化率各向异性（AMS）是一种广泛使用的推断岩石结构的工具，但定量解释受到造岩矿物稀疏的单晶磁性以及难以将固有抗磁性与杂质相关磁性分开的限制。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 与微扰理论相结合来计算方解石族碳酸盐（方解石、菱镁矿和白云石）的抗磁化率和 AMS，并量化过渡金属掺杂的额外顺磁贡献。对于纯方解石，计算的磁化率及其各向异性与已发表的单晶测量结果非常一致，验证了抗磁相的从头计算方法。我们为菱镁矿和白云石提供了改进的固有抗磁性参考值，这些材料的实验磁化率通常受到磁性杂质的影响。为了明确解决杂质影响，我们使用超级电池对方解石中的 Fe 和 Mn 替代进行建模。计算出的自旋矩再现了预期的高自旋态（Fe²⁺，S=2；Mn²⁺，S=5/2），并产生与实验斜率相匹配的每 Fe 浓度的磁化率各向异性。强各向异性主要由与晶体 c 轴相关的轨道贡献决定，而不是由自旋轨道耦合决定，这凸显了轨道磁化强度是碳酸盐中顺磁性 AMS 建模的关键但在数值上具有挑战性的因素。

articles.title: Stress-based structure optimization for a range-separated hybrid van der Waals density functional
articles.title_zh: 范围分离混合范德华密度泛函的基于应力的结构优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Complex matter, often partly soft and pliable, is the generic form of material systems. We must therefore generally call on density functional theory (DFT) to first predict the atomic structure before we can use it to also characterize (expected) properties. A recent range-separated hybrid (RSH) van Waals density functional (vdW-DF), `vdW-DF2-ahbr' (abbreviated AHBR) [PRX 12, 041003 (2022)], shows promise as a high-accuracy predictor of both binding energies and structure, from molecules to solids. However, the present implementation in Quantum Espresso (QE) does not, in our experience, support robust stress-based unit-cell optimization of RSHs. Here we document and illustrate work enabling practical AHBR-based complex-matter discovery: We port the AHBR XC functional to the Vienna Ab Initio Simulation Package (VASP) where use of stress-based DFT optimization is already stable also for RSHs. We test the implementation by comparing high-accuracy AHBR-QE and AHBR-VASP predictions of non-covalent molecular interactions and for structure and cohesion of simple bulk structures. We also illustrate and test the use of the new AHBR-VASP implementation to predict and understand (atomic and anti-ferromagnetic) structure in distorted-rocksalt metal monoxides. Finally, we illustrate use for complex-soft-matter discovery by predicting motifs for layer stacking in the C2N covalent-organic framework (COF) system [Nat. Commun. 6, 6486 (2015)].
articles.abstract_zh: 复杂物质，通常部分柔软且柔韧，是材料系统的通用形式。因此，我们通常必须首先利用密度泛函理论（DFT）来预测原子结构，然后才能使用它来表征（预期）属性。最近的范围分离杂化 (RSH) 范瓦尔斯密度泛函 (vdW-DF)“vdW-DF2-ahbr”（缩写 AHBR）[PRX 12, 041003 (2022)] 显示出作为从分子到固体的结合能和结构的高精度预测器的前景。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复杂物质，通常部分柔软且柔韧，是材料系统的通用形式。因此，我们通常必须首先利用密度泛函理论（DFT）来预测原子结构，然后才能使用它来表征（预期）属性。最近的范围分离杂化 (RSH) 范瓦尔斯密度泛函 (vdW-DF)“vdW-DF2-ahbr”（缩写 AHBR）[PRX 12, 041003 (2022)] 显示出作为从分子到固体的结合能和结构的高精度预测器的前景。然而，根据我们的经验，目前 Quantum Espresso (QE) 中的实现并不支持 RSH 的稳健的基于应力的单位单元优化。在这里，我们记录并说明了实现基于 AHBR 的实用复杂物质发现的工作：我们将 AHBR XC 功能移植到维也纳从头算仿真包 (VASP)，其中基于应力的 DFT 优化的使用对于 RSH 来说也已经稳定。我们通过比较非共价分子相互作用以及简单本体结构的结构和内聚力的高精度 AHBR-QE 和 AHBR-VASP 预测来测试实施情况。我们还说明和测试了如何使用新的 AHBR-VASP 实现来预测和理解扭曲岩盐金属一氧化物中的（原子和反铁磁）结构。最后，我们通过预测 C2N 共价有机框架 (COF) 系统中的层堆叠图案来说明复杂软物质发现的用途 [Nat.交流。 6、6486（2015）]。

articles.title_zh: 钛酸钡有序转变成核的经典和非经典理论结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38481v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Results of classical and nonclassical approach to nucleation at the ordering phase transition in barium titanate are presented. A nonclassical nucleation model is applied to the first-order paraelectric cubic phase to ferroelectric tetragonal phase transition in barium titanate is considered.

articles.title: Single-particle detection of the Néel transition in LaCrO₃ microcrystals via widefield nitrogen-vacancy center magnetic imaging
articles.title_zh: 通过宽场氮空位中心磁成像单粒子检测 LaCrO₃ 微晶中的尼尔跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth orthochromites exhibit rich, chemically tunable magnetic behavior, making them attractive for temperature sensing and temperature-dependent switching applications. Realizing this potential requires understanding how synthesis conditions and particle morphology influence the underlying Cr³⁺ magnetic ordering. Orthochromite magnetism has traditionally been characterized by ensemble techniques such as neutron diffraction and SQUID magnetometry, which report only averaged magnetic properties and cannot access particle-level information. Here we use widefield nitrogen-vacancy (NV) magnetometry to image the stray magnetic fields of individual LaCrO₃ microcrystals produced via molten salt synthesis, resolving the antiferromagnetic Néel transition in single particles. Of the 18 particles measured between 278 and 298 K, five show a clear onset of magnetization near the ensemble Néel temperature, four show no measurable magnetic signal, and nine display temperature-independent signatures consistent with localized magnetic impurities undetected by ensemble measurements. Below the Néel temperature, particle magnetization remains fixed under a rotating in-plane field, consistent with canted antiferromagnetic ordering rather than paramagnetism, while repeated thermal cycling shows that the magnetic field pattern varies between cooldowns with certain features recurring at the same locations, consistent with micron-scale structurally pinned antiferromagnetic domains in which the sign of the weak ferromagnetic moment is set independently each time they pass through the Néel transition. These results establish single-particle NV magnetometry as a sensitive probe of magnetic ordering and domain structure in individual microcrystals, a key step toward correlating individual particle morphology and defect structure with magnetic ordering in orthochromites.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土正铬铁矿表现出丰富的、化学可调的磁性行为，使其对温度传感和温度相关开关应用具有吸引力。实现这一潜力需要了解合成条件和颗粒形态如何影响潜在的 Cr3⁺ 磁有序。传统上，正铬铁矿的磁性是通过中子衍射和 SQUID 磁力测量等系综技术来表征的，这些技术仅报告平均磁特性，无法获取颗粒级信息。在这里，我们使用宽场氮空位（NV）磁力测量仪对通过熔盐合成产生的单个 LaCrO₃ 微晶的杂散磁场进行成像，解决了单个颗粒中的反铁磁尼尔转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土正铬铁矿表现出丰富的、化学可调的磁性行为，使其对温度传感和温度相关开关应用具有吸引力。实现这一潜力需要了解合成条件和颗粒形态如何影响潜在的 Cr3⁺ 磁有序。传统上，正铬铁矿的磁性是通过中子衍射和 SQUID 磁力测量等系综技术来表征的，这些技术仅报告平均磁特性，无法获取颗粒级信息。在这里，我们使用宽场氮空位（NV）磁力测量仪对通过熔盐合成产生的单个 LaCrO₃ 微晶的杂散磁场进行成像，解决了单个颗粒中的反铁磁尼尔转变。在 278 至 298 K 之间测量的 18 个粒子中，有 5 个在系综尼尔温度附近显示出明显的磁化起始，4 个显示没有可测量的磁信号，9 个显示与系综测量未检测到的局部磁性杂质一致的与温度无关的特征。在尼尔温度以下，粒子磁化强度在旋转面内场下保持固定，与倾斜的反铁磁有序而不是顺磁性一致，而重复的热循环表明，磁场模式在冷却之间变化，并且在相同位置重复出现某些特征，与微米级结构钉扎反铁磁域一致，其中弱铁磁矩的符号在每次通过尼尔跃迁时独立设置。这些结果确立了单颗粒 NV 磁力测量作为单个微晶中磁有序和磁域结构的敏感探针，这是将单个颗粒形态和缺陷结构与正铬矿中磁有序相关联的关键一步。

articles.title: Enabling Domain-Specific Atomistic Models: A Machine Learning Potential for the Solid Acid Family
articles.title_zh: 实现特定领域的原子模型：固体酸系列的机器学习潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials trained across the periodic table have made atomistic simulation broadly accessible, and specializing them to a single compound class is widely expected to improve accuracy. Yet examples remain scarce, and fewer still surpass universal models in speed or reach a higher level of electronic-structure theory. Here we present a potential that is universal within the class of water-free solid-state hydrogen-bond network mediated proton conductors rather than across chemistry and a database of 4.4 million first-principles configurations spanning 55 materials. It surpasses leading general-purpose potentials across this domain, recovering measured activation energies and the ordering of anion rotational dynamics that those models miss; agreement on static structure does not imply agreement on transport. Accuracy falls for compositions far from the training set but stays competitive for close structural relatives, and a higher level of electronic-structure theory is reached with a few hundred additional configurations per material. We further introduce a compact variant carrying a fifth of the parameters, faster still and yet more accurate than every general-purpose model tested. It sustains more than a quarter of a million atoms on a single graphics processor, placing grain boundaries and the transition into the highly conducting phase within reach, and making a quantum treatment of the protons affordable. Reference accuracy and accessible system size thus become largely independent, offering a template for other compound classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 在整个元素周期表中训练的机器学习原子间势使得原子模拟变得更加容易实现，并且人们普遍期望将它们专门针对单个化合物类别以提高准确性。然而例子仍然很少，而且在速度上超越通用模型或达到电子结构理论更高水平的例子仍然很少。在这里，我们提出了一种在无水固态氢键网络介导的质子导体类中普遍存在的潜力，而不是在化学领域中普遍存在的潜力，以及涵盖 55 种材料的 440 万个第一原理配置的数据库。它超越了该领域领先的通用潜力，恢复了这些模型遗漏的测量活化能和阴离子旋转动力学的顺序；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在整个元素周期表中训练的机器学习原子间势使得原子模拟变得更加容易实现，并且人们普遍期望将它们专门针对单个化合物类别以提高准确性。然而例子仍然很少，而且在速度上超越通用模型或达到电子结构理论更高水平的例子仍然很少。在这里，我们提出了一种在无水固态氢键网络介导的质子导体类中普遍存在的潜力，而不是在化学领域中普遍存在的潜力，以及涵盖 55 种材料的 440 万个第一原理配置的数据库。它超越了该领域领先的通用潜力，恢复了这些模型遗漏的测量活化能和阴离子旋转动力学的顺序；对静态结构的一致并不意味着对传输的一致。远离训练集的成分的准确性会下降，但对于结构密切的亲戚来说仍然具有竞争力，并且通过每种材料的数百个附加配置可以达到更高水平的电子结构理论。我们进一步引入了一个紧凑的变体，它携带五分之一的参数，比测试的每个通用模型更快、更准确。它在单个图形处理器上支持超过 25 万个原子，使晶界和向高导电相的转变触手可及，并使质子的量子处理变得经济实惠。因此，参考精度和可访问的系统尺寸在很大程度上变得独立，为其他复合类别提供了模板。

articles.title: Theory of criticality-enabled U(1) symmetry breaking in a class of 1+1D systems
articles.title_zh: 一类 1+1D 系统中临界性 U(1) 对称性破缺理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38581v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an analytic theory of the recently proposed phenomenon of spontaneous U(1) symmetry breaking at 1+1D Lifshitz quantum critical points. The low-energy field theory contains two periodic scalars θ and φ, with a Berry phase coupling that makes θ canonically conjugate to the U(1) charge density partialₓ φ. Within a controlled large-N limit, we demonstrate that the U(1)-charged phase vertex eⁱβθ develops long-range order, while the conjugate vertex eⁱβφ decays as a stretched exponential, loglangle eⁱβφ⁽x⁾ e⁻ⁱβφ⁽⁰⁾ranglepropto-|β|⁴/³|x|²/³. Going beyond the large-N limit, we give an analytic argument that the Lifshitz field theory supports U(1) long-range order provided its dynamical exponent satisfies z≠1, a condition strongly supported by existing calculations. We test these predictions using finite-size and infinite-system DMRG in an itinerant-fermion chain with U(1) rtimes Z₂ symmetry. At the Z₂ ferromagnetic transition, the spin sector of the chain maps to the Lifshitz field theory. Consistent with analytic predictions, the U(1)-charged spin-nematic bond operator Sᵢ⁺Sᵢ₊₁⁺ exhibits long-range order, while the electron Green's function shows stretched-exponential decay. Together, these results elucidate the mechanism and consequences of criticality-enabled U(1) symmetry breaking in 1+1D.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了最近提出的 1+1D Lifshitz 量子临界点自发 U(1) 对称破缺现象的解析理论。低能场理论包含两个周期标量 θ 和 φ，以及 Berry 相耦合，使 θ 与 U(1) 电荷密度偏ₓ φ 正则共轭。在受控的大 N 限制内，我们证明了 U(1) 带电相顶点 eⁱβθ 发展出长程有序，而共轭顶点 eⁱβφ 以拉伸指数、对数角度 eⁱβφ⁽x⁾ e⁻ⁱβφ⁽⁰⁾ranglepropto-|β|⁴/3|x|²/3 的形式衰减。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了最近提出的 1+1D Lifshitz 量子临界点自发 U(1) 对称破缺现象的解析理论。低能场理论包含两个周期标量 θ 和 φ，以及 Berry 相耦合，使 θ 与 U(1) 电荷密度偏ₓ φ 正则共轭。在受控的大 N 限制内，我们证明了 U(1) 带电相顶点 eⁱβθ 发展出长程有序，而共轭顶点 eⁱβφ 以拉伸指数、对数角度 eⁱβφ⁽x⁾ e⁻ⁱβφ⁽⁰⁾ranglepropto-|β|⁴/3|x|²/3 的形式衰减。超越大 N 限制，我们给出了一个解析论证，即 Lifshitz 场论支持 U(1) 长程序，前提是其动态指数满足 z≠1，这是现有计算强烈支持的条件。我们在具有 U(1) rtimes Z2 对称性的巡回费米子链中使用有限尺寸和无限系统 DMRG 来测试这些预测。在 Z2 铁磁转变处，链的自旋扇区映射到 Lifshitz 场论。与分析预测一致，U(1)带电的自旋向列键算子 Sᵢ⁺Sᵢ₊₁⁺ 表现出长程有序，而电子格林函数表现出拉伸指数衰减。总之，这些结果阐明了 1+1D 中临界性 U(1) 对称性破缺的机制和后果。

articles.title: Three-Dimensional Shankar Skyrmions in Frustrated Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 受挫反铁磁体中的三维香卡斯格明子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a continuum theory for three-dimensional (3D) Shankar skyrmions in frustrated chiral antiferromagnets (AFs) and derive the conditions for metastable finite-size π₃(SO(3)) solitons. A Derrick--Hobart scaling analysis shows that exchange, Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI), anisotropy, and frustration can balance to set a finite equilibrium size. We identify two microscopic routes to this common topological and stabilization framework: intrinsic rotation-frame order in noncollinear AFs and an S³ extension of an amplitude-softened Néel field. In the latter, the smooth four-component texture projects onto a Néel field containing a spatially separated pair of oppositely charged Bloch points. Numerical minimization yields metastable monopole textures, while the effective dynamics identifies coherent breathing oscillations as their characteristic finite-frequency collective mode. Our results provide a microscopic framework for the statics and dynamics of Shankar skyrmions and identify frustrated chiral AFs as promising hosts of 3D non-Abelian topological textures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们制定了受抑手性反铁磁体 (AF) 中三维 (3D) 香卡斯格明子的连续介质理论，并推导了亚稳态有限尺寸 π₃(SO(3)) 孤子的条件。 Derrick-Hobart 尺度分析表明，交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI)、各向异性和挫折可以平衡以设定有限的平衡大小。我们确定了通往这种常见拓扑和稳定框架的两条微观途径：非共线 AF 中的固有旋转框架顺序和幅度软化尼尔场的 S3 扩展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们制定了受抑手性反铁磁体 (AF) 中三维 (3D) 香卡斯格明子的连续介质理论，并推导了亚稳态有限尺寸 π₃(SO(3)) 孤子的条件。 Derrick-Hobart 尺度分析表明，交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI)、各向异性和挫折可以平衡以设定有限的平衡大小。我们确定了通往这种常见拓扑和稳定框架的两条微观途径：非共线 AF 中的固有旋转框架顺序和幅度软化尼尔场的 S3 扩展。在后者中，平滑的四分量纹理投影到包含一对空间上分离的带相反电荷的布洛赫点的尼尔场上。数值最小化产生亚稳态单极纹理，而有效动力学将相干呼吸振荡识别为其特征有限频率集体模式。我们的结果为香卡斯格明子的静力学和动力学提供了微观框架，并将受挫的手性 AF 识别为 3D 非阿贝尔拓扑纹理的有希望的宿主。

articles.title: Optical observation of interlayer spin correlation
articles.title_zh: 层间自旋相关性的光学观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38825v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin correlations govern numerous collective behaviors of quantum materials, underpinning exotic phenomena such as unconventional superconductivity and topological magnetism. In layered materials, the interlayer spin correlation is important because it characterizes the magnetic ground state and determines spin transport across the interface. Yet interlayer spin correlations have remained hard to measure directly, leaving one of the most basic quantities of two-dimensional magnetism out of experimental reach. Here we provide the first direct optical probe of interlayer spin correlations, using two-magnon Raman scattering in the van der Waals antiferromagnet (AFM) CrSBr, in remarkable agreement with a microscopic spin-wave model without any fitting parameter. Moreover, the two-magnon channel switches on only in the AFM state and vanishes when a magnetic field takes the crystal to a ferromagnetic state. We furthermore establish an exciton-mediated variant of the technique, where tuning the laser near the exciton resonance enhances the signal roughly tenfold due to the exciton's large oscillator strength. Magnon-pair Raman spectroscopy thus opens a direct optical window into interlayer spin correlations in van der Waals magnets, extendable to twisted bilayers and proximity-coupled heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋相关性控制着量子材料的众多集体行为，支撑着非常规超导和拓扑磁性等奇异现象。在层状材料中，层间自旋相关性很重要，因为它表征磁性基态并决定跨界面的自旋输运。然而，层间自旋相关性仍然难以直接测量，使得二维磁性的最基本量之一超出了实验范围。在这里，我们使用范德华反铁磁体 (AFM) CrSBr 中的双磁振子拉曼散射，提供了第一个层间自旋相关性的直接光学探针，与没有任何拟合参数的微观自旋波模型非常一致。此外，双磁振子通道仅在 AFM 状态下开启，并在磁场将晶体带入铁磁状态时消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋相关性控制着量子材料的众多集体行为，支撑着非常规超导和拓扑磁性等奇异现象。在层状材料中，层间自旋相关性很重要，因为它表征磁性基态并决定跨界面的自旋输运。然而，层间自旋相关性仍然难以直接测量，使得二维磁性的最基本量之一超出了实验范围。在这里，我们使用范德华反铁磁体 (AFM) CrSBr 中的双磁振子拉曼散射，提供了第一个层间自旋相关性的直接光学探针，与没有任何拟合参数的微观自旋波模型非常一致。此外，双磁振子通道仅在 AFM 状态下开启，并在磁场将晶体带入铁磁状态时消失。我们还建立了该技术的激子介导的变体，其中在激子共振附近调谐激光，由于激子的大振荡器强度而将信号增强了大约十倍。因此，磁振子对拉曼光谱为范德华磁体中的层间自旋相关性打开了一个直接光学窗口，可扩展到扭曲双层和邻近耦合异质结构。

articles.title: Quantum quenches of scar states in the Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki model via Clifford augmented tensor network simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过 Clifford 增强张量网络模拟 Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki 模型中疤痕态的量子淬灭
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clifford augmented methods have emerged as a powerful technique to simulate quantum circuits and many-body systems by exploiting the stabiliser structure found in said systems, whilst additionally enabling one to readily quantify the non-stabilizerness (i.e. magic) present. In this work, we utilise a qudit Clifford augmented simulation method to probe the presence of magic in the Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) model, finding that its ground state and scar states are highly magical as quantified by their Stabiliser Rényi Entropy (SRE). Nevertheless, owing to its low entanglement structure, these states are still readily expressible as a Clifford augmented Matrix Product State with low bond-dimension and moreover may be time-evolved using the Clifford augmented time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) algorithm. We utilise Clifford augmented TDVP to study the string order dynamics in the scar states of the AKLT model after a quench within the Haldane phase to the anti-ferromagnetic Heisenberg Hamiltonian. We observe that there is a decay of string order following the quench, which is more pronounced with increasing bimagnon number. This finding highlights the sensitivity of string order in the AKLT scar states to symmetry-preserving quenches, even when the initial and final Hamiltonians belong to the same topological phase.
articles.abstract_zh: Clifford 增强方法已成为一种强大的技术，通过利用系统中发现的稳定器结构来模拟量子电路和多体系统，同时还使人们能够轻松量化存在的非稳定器（即魔法）。在这项工作中，我们利用 Qudit Clifford 增强模拟方法来探测 Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) 模型中魔法的存在，发现其基态和疤痕状态非常神奇，正如其稳定器 Rényi 熵 (SRE) 所量化的那样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Clifford 增强方法已成为一种强大的技术，通过利用系统中发现的稳定器结构来模拟量子电路和多体系统，同时还使人们能够轻松量化存在的非稳定器（即魔法）。在这项工作中，我们利用 Qudit Clifford 增强模拟方法来探测 Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) 模型中魔法的存在，发现其基态和疤痕状态非常神奇，正如其稳定器 Rényi 熵 (SRE) 所量化的那样。然而，由于其低纠缠结构，这些状态仍然很容易表示为具有低键维数的克利福德增广矩阵积状态，而且可以使用克利福德增广依赖时间变分原理（TDVP）算法进行时间演化。我们利用 Clifford 增强 TDVP 研究 AKLT 模型疤痕状态下的弦序动力学，该模型在 Haldane 相内淬灭至反铁磁海森堡哈密顿量后。我们观察到，淬灭后弦序发生衰减，随着双磁振子数量的增加，这种衰减更加明显。这一发现强调了 AKLT 疤痕态中的弦序对对称性保持猝灭的敏感性，即使初始和最终的哈密顿量属于相同的拓扑相。

articles.title: First-Principles Study of Two-Dimensional CeN: Interplay between Structural Stability, Electronic Structure, and Magnetism
articles.title_zh: 二维 CeN 的第一性原理研究：结构稳定性、电子结构和磁性之间的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, the structural stability, and the electronic and magnetic properties of a novel CeN monolayer derived from the (111) surface of bulk rock salt CeN are investigated using first-principles calculations. Dimensional reduction produces substantial changes in the local atomic environment, decreasing the Ce-N coordination from sixfold in the bulk to threefold in the monolayer and shortening the Ce-N bond length, while preserving an essentially planar hexagonal structure. Moreover, the electronic and magnetic properties are significantly modified, which may be useful for practical applications. Both ferromagnetic (FM) and antiferromagnetic (AFM) configurations were investigated and found to be strongly bound, with the FM state slightly lower in energy. The magnetic moments are predominantly localized on the Ce atoms and mainly originated from the Ce 4f states. The electronic structure also exhibits a pronounced dependence on magnetic ordering, highlighting the connection between localized 4f states and the spin-dependent electronic properties of the system. In addition, the calculated elastic properties confirm the mechanical stability of the monolayer, while phonon calculations support its dynamical stability. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further indicate that the two-dimensional structure preserves its integrity under finite-temperature conditions. Overall, these results demonstrate that dimensional reduction significantly modifies the structural, electronic, and magnetic behavior of CeN without compromising the stability of the resulting two-dimensional lattice. The combination of structural robustness, localized Ce 4f magnetism, and spin-dependent electronic properties make the CeN monolayer an interesting system for further exploration in two-dimensional magnetism and spin-dependent applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，利用第一性原理计算研究了源自块状岩盐 CeN（111）表面的新型 CeN 单层的结构稳定性以及电子和磁性。尺寸减小会导致局域原子环境发生显着变化，将 Ce-N 配位从块体中的六倍减少到单层中的三倍，并缩短 Ce-N 键长，同时保留基本平面的六方结构。此外，电子和磁性能得到显着改变，这可能对实际应用有用。研究了铁磁（FM）和反铁磁（AFM）构型，发现它们具有很强的束缚性，FM态的能量略低。磁矩主要集中在 Ce 原子上，并且主要源自 Ce 4f 态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，利用第一性原理计算研究了源自块状岩盐 CeN（111）表面的新型 CeN 单层的结构稳定性以及电子和磁性。尺寸减小会导致局域原子环境发生显着变化，将 Ce-N 配位从块体中的六倍减少到单层中的三倍，并缩短 Ce-N 键长，同时保留基本平面的六方结构。此外，电子和磁性能得到显着改变，这可能对实际应用有用。研究了铁磁（FM）和反铁磁（AFM）构型，发现它们具有很强的束缚性，FM态的能量略低。磁矩主要集中在 Ce 原子上，并且主要源自 Ce 4f 态。电子结构还表现出对磁有序的明显依赖性，突出了局域 4f 态与系统自旋相关电子特性之间的联系。此外，计算的弹性特性证实了单层的机械稳定性，而声子计算则支持其动态稳定性。从头算分子动力学模拟进一步表明，二维结构在有限温度条件下保持其完整性。总的来说，这些结果表明，尺寸减小显着改变了 CeN 的结构、电子和磁性行为，而不会影响所得二维晶格的稳定性。结构鲁棒性、局域 Ce 4f 磁性和自旋相关电子特性的结合使 CeN 单层成为进一步探索二维磁性和自旋相关应用的有趣系统。

articles.title: Reference-Measure Freedom of the Effective Hamiltonian: From Stochastic Thermodynamics to the Macroscopic Limit
articles.title_zh: 有效哈密顿量的参考测量自由度：从随机热力学到宏观极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effective Hamiltonian (EH), also referred to as the potential of mean force or free-energy landscape, is widely used to describe equilibrium properties and slow dynamics in chemical and softmatter systems. However, the conventional EH has been argued to be ill-defined because it does not transform as a scalar under a change of coordinates. Here, we show that this apparent problem originates from an implicit change of the reference measure (gauge) with respect to which the equilibrium probability density is defined. We formulate the equilibrium measure and the Fokker--Planck equation (FPE) intrinsically on the manifold of slow variables and show that an EH is a scalar function defined with respect to a chosen gauge. Different EHs, including the conventional EH and the diffusion-dependent EH recently proposed in a Riemannian formulation, thus provide different gauge representations of the same intrinsic equilibrium measure and stochastic dynamics. We further show that the gauge choice has an operational meaning: different restraint protocols for the slow variables select different reference measures. Finally, when the equilibrium measure obeys a large-deviation principle in a macroscopic limit, differences among EHs associated with subleading gauges become subleading relative to the large-deviation speed. The leading part of the EH is then determined by the gauge-independent large-deviation rate function, and the corresponding deterministic dynamics is likewise gauge independent.
articles.abstract_zh: 有效哈密顿量 (EH)，也称为平均力势或自由能景观，广泛用于描述化学和软物质系统中的平衡特性和慢动力学。然而，传统的 EH 被认为是不明确的，因为它在坐标变化下不会转换为标量。在这里，我们表明，这个明显的问题源于定义平衡概率密度的参考测量（量规）的隐式变化。我们在慢变量流形上本质上制定了平衡测度和福克-普朗克方程 (FPE)，并表明 EH 是相对于所选规范定义的标量函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有效哈密顿量 (EH)，也称为平均力势或自由能景观，广泛用于描述化学和软物质系统中的平衡特性和慢动力学。然而，传统的 EH 被认为是不明确的，因为它在坐标变化下不会转换为标量。在这里，我们表明，这个明显的问题源于定义平衡概率密度的参考测量（量规）的隐式变化。我们在慢变量流形上本质上制定了平衡测度和福克-普朗克方程 (FPE)，并表明 EH 是相对于所选规范定义的标量函数。不同的 EH，包括传统的 EH 和最近在黎曼公式中提出的扩散相关 EH，因此提供了相同内在平衡测量和随机动力学的不同规范表示。我们进一步表明，规范的选择具有操作意义：慢变量的不同约束协议选择不同的参考措施。最后，当平衡测度在宏观极限下遵循大偏差原理时，与次领先轨距相关的EH之间的差异相对于大偏差速度而言变得次领先。然后，EH 的主导部分由与规范无关的大偏差率函数确定，并且相应的确定性动力学同样与规范无关。

articles.title: Interdependent-Network Criticality without a Second Network: Cascading Collapse of the Joule-Coupled Insulator-Metal Transition in VO₂
articles.title_zh: 没有第二个网络的相互依存网络临界性：VO2 中焦耳耦合绝缘体-金属转变的级联崩溃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When driven by a large enough electric field or current, the insulating state of vanadium dioxide (VO₂) typically collapses abruptly into the metallic state (the insulator-metal transition, IMT) following a brief incubation delay. These incubation delays, typically lasting microseconds or less, have been analyzed predominantly through macroscopic electro-thermal modeling, providing little statistical insight into the transition dynamics. Here, we investigate the electrically driven IMT in a two-dimensional VO₂ lattice and demonstrate that the material behaves as a complex, interdependent network despite being a single structural entity. Because metallic domains dissipate significantly more Joule heat than insulating regions, each switching event raises the Joule heating of the network, resulting in network dependency and triggering a cascading chain reaction. Combining time-resolved resistance measurements with a Joule-coupled resistor-network model and interdependent-network theory, we observe an abrupt (first-order) transition preceded by an anomalously long incubation plateau lasting thousands of seconds. During this metastable plateau, an effective branching factor of the switching activity approaches unity at criticality, and the plateau lifetime diverges with exponent ζ=1/2; the order parameter scales with exponent β=1/2. These signatures coincide with those predicted for interdependent networks, indicating that dissipative Joule coupling alone can drive mixed-order catastrophic cascades in a single-network correlated-oxide system.
articles.abstract_zh: 当受到足够大的电场或电流驱动时，二氧化钒 (VO2) 的绝缘态通常会在短暂的孵化延迟后突然塌陷为金属态（绝缘体-金属转变，IMT）。这些孵化延迟通常持续微秒或更短，主要通过宏观电热模型进行分析，几乎无法提供对转变动态的统计洞察。在这里，我们研究了二维 VO2 晶格中的电驱动 IMT，并证明该材料尽管是单一结构实体，但其行为却表现为复杂的、相互依赖的网络。由于金属域比绝缘区域耗散更多的焦耳热，因此每次切换事件都会增加网络的焦耳热，从而导致网络依赖性并触发级联链式反应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当受到足够大的电场或电流驱动时，二氧化钒 (VO2) 的绝缘态通常会在短暂的孵化延迟后突然塌陷为金属态（绝缘体-金属转变，IMT）。这些孵化延迟通常持续微秒或更短，主要通过宏观电热模型进行分析，几乎无法提供对转变动态的统计洞察。在这里，我们研究了二维 VO2 晶格中的电驱动 IMT，并证明该材料尽管是单一结构实体，但其行为却表现为复杂的、相互依赖的网络。由于金属域比绝缘区域耗散更多的焦耳热，因此每次切换事件都会增加网络的焦耳热，从而导致网络依赖性并触发级联链式反应。将时间分辨电阻测量与焦耳耦合电阻网络模型和相互依赖网络理论相结合，我们观察到突然的（一阶）转变，之后是持续数千秒的异常长的孵化平台。在这个亚稳态平台期间，开关活动的有效分支因子在临界点接近一致，并且平台寿命以指数 ze=1/2 发散；阶次参数以指数 β=1/2 缩放。这些特征与对相互依赖的网络的预测一致，表明仅耗散焦耳耦合就可以驱动单网络相关氧化物系统中的混合级灾难性级联。

articles.title: Spectroscopic Evidence for Nontrivial Band Topology in Superconducting FeTe/MnTe Heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 超导 FeTe/MnTe 异质结构中非平凡能带拓扑的光谱证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: FeTe has long been regarded as a nonsuperconducting antiferromagnetic metal with trivial band topology, but recent advances in stoichiometry control have begun to challenge this picture. Here we use higher-order epitaxy on zinc-blende MnTe to stabilize near-stoichiometric FeTe with strongly suppressed interstitial Fe and a superconducting transition onset near 13 K. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals markedly enhanced quasiparticle coherence, well-defined Fe-derived hole bands, and a nearly two-dimensional Dirac-cone-like state near the Fermi level. First-principles calculations identify an inversion between odd- and even-parity bands, yielding nontrivial Z₂ topology and a Dirac surface state consistent with experiment. These results elucidate the intrinsic electronic structure of stoichiometric superconducting FeTe and provide evidence for nontrivial band topology, positioning FeTe/MnTe as a promising platform for exploring topological superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: FeTe 长期以来一直被认为是一种具有平凡能带拓扑的非超导反铁磁金属，但化学计量控制的最新进展开始挑战这一观点。在这里，我们在闪锌矿 MnTe 上使用高阶外延来稳定近化学计量的 FeTe，并强烈抑制间隙 Fe 和在 13 K 附近开始的超导转变。角分辨光电子能谱显示出明显增强的准粒子相干性、明确的 Fe 衍生空穴带以及费米能级附近的近二维狄拉克锥状态。第一原理计算确定了奇数和偶数奇偶校验带之间的反转，产生了非平凡的 Z2 拓扑和与实验一致的狄拉克表面态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: FeTe 长期以来一直被认为是一种具有平凡能带拓扑的非超导反铁磁金属，但化学计量控制的最新进展开始挑战这一观点。在这里，我们在闪锌矿 MnTe 上使用高阶外延来稳定近化学计量的 FeTe，并强烈抑制间隙 Fe 和在 13 K 附近开始的超导转变。角分辨光电子能谱显示出明显增强的准粒子相干性、明确的 Fe 衍生空穴带以及费米能级附近的近二维狄拉克锥状态。第一原理计算确定了奇数和偶数奇偶校验带之间的反转，产生了非平凡的 Z2 拓扑和与实验一致的狄拉克表面态。这些结果阐明了化学计量超导 FeTe 的固有电子结构，并为非平凡能带拓扑提供了证据，使 FeTe/MnTe 成为探索拓扑超导性的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Spin Birefringence and Spin Polarized Transmission across p-wave Altermagnetic Heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 自旋双折射和跨 p 波交变磁异质结构的自旋偏振传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper investigates electron transport properties across N/AM interface or N/AM/N heterojunction. Based on Hamiltonians in the three regions, general wave functions are proposed and combined linear equations are constructed. Reflection and transmission coefficients as well as spin polarizatioin of the altermagnet heterostructure are obtained. When electron incident from normal metal to altermagnet, it is scattered and split into + branch and _ branch transmitting into altermagnet zone with separate refractive angles. Total internal reflection might happen to + branch. Critical angle of total reflection is determined by incident conditions and properties of AM material. In the heterostructure case, spin-up and spin-down electrons transmitted with same propagation directions but different transmission probabilities. Transmission and polarization periodically change with length of the junction. Exchange field and spin-splitting strength have pronounced effect on spin-polarized transmittance while the effect of spin-orbit coupling is quite small. Optimized system can be found by tuning parameters of the AM material. This study will lay the theoretical groundwork for experimental research on spin-selective outputs and spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了 N/AM 界面或 N/AM/N 异质结的电子传输特性。基于三个区域的哈密顿量，提出了一般波函数并构造了组合线性方程。获得了交流磁体异质结构的反射和透射系数以及自旋极化。当电子从普通金属入射到交变磁体时，它被散射并分裂成+分支和_分支，传输到具有不同折射角的交变磁体区域。全内反射可能发生在+分支上。全反射的临界角由入射条件和增材制造材料的特性决定。在异质结构情况下，自旋向上和自旋向下的电子以相同的传播方向传输，但传输概率不同。传输和偏振随着结的长度而周期性地变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了 N/AM 界面或 N/AM/N 异质结的电子传输特性。基于三个区域的哈密顿量，提出了一般波函数并构造了组合线性方程。获得了交流磁体异质结构的反射和透射系数以及自旋极化。当电子从普通金属入射到交变磁体时，它被散射并分裂成+分支和_分支，传输到具有不同折射角的交变磁体区域。全内反射可能发生在+分支上。全反射的临界角由入射条件和增材制造材料的特性决定。在异质结构情况下，自旋向上和自旋向下的电子以相同的传播方向传输，但传输概率不同。传输和偏振随着结的长度而周期性地变化。交换场和自旋分裂强度对自旋偏振透射率有显着影响，而自旋轨道耦合的影响很小。通过调整增材制造材料的参数可以找到优化的系统。该研究将为自旋选择性输出和自旋电子器件的实验研究奠定理论基础。

articles.title: Tunability of the structural and magnetic transition in kagome material: PrIr₃B₂
articles.title_zh: Kagome 材料中结构和磁转变的可调性：PrIr₃B2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39175v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the temperature and pressure tunability of an unusual structural transformation associated with a two-step metal-insulator-metal (MIM) transition in the kagome lattice compound PrIr₃B₂ using synchrotron X-ray powder diffraction. At ambient conditions of temperature and pressure, the monoclinic (C2/m) and the hexagonal (P6/mmm) phases coexist as twinned structure in the crystal. As the temperature (pressure) is decreased (increased), PrIr₃B₂ converts fully to monoclinic structure at T = 280 K (at ambient pressure) and P = 1.2 GPa (at room temperature). Temperature dependence of the monoclinic structure at ambient pressure presents complex evolution of lattice parameters with weak but clearly discernable anomalies at SIsim 250 K and SIsim 110 K, which are correlated with the second MIM transition and the linear to nonlinear temperature-dependent resistivity crossover, respectively. These anomalies are likely due to some charge order state causing a partially gapped Fermi surface. The magnetic phase diagram of PrIr₃B₂ is also investigated from anisotropic measurements. At 10 K, a superzone gap opens near the antiferromagnetic transition, which does not close even in the polarized state. From the tunability of the crystal structure and magnetic and electronic ground state, promising electronic orders are indicated in this kagome metallic magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用同步加速器 X 射线粉末衍射报告了 Kagome 晶格化合物 PrIr₃B2 中与两步金属-绝缘体-金属 (MIM) 转变相关的不寻常结构转变的温度和压力可调性。在环境温度和压力条件下，单斜晶（C2/m）和六方晶（P6/mmm）相以孪晶结构共存于晶体中。随着温度（压力）降低（升高），PrIr₃B2 在 T = 280 K（环境压力）和 P = 1.2 GPa（室温）时完全转变为单斜结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用同步加速器 X 射线粉末衍射报告了 Kagome 晶格化合物 PrIr₃B2 中与两步金属-绝缘体-金属 (MIM) 转变相关的不寻常结构转变的温度和压力可调性。在环境温度和压力条件下，单斜晶（C2/m）和六方晶（P6/mmm）相以孪晶结构共存于晶体中。随着温度（压力）降低（升高），PrIr₃B2 在 T = 280 K（环境压力）和 P = 1.2 GPa（室温）时完全转变为单斜结构。环境压力下单斜晶结构的温度依赖性呈现出晶格参数的复杂演化，在 SIsim 250 K 和 SIsim 110 K 下具有微弱但清晰可辨别的异常，这分别与第二个 MIM 转变和线性到非线性温度相关电阻率交叉相关。这些异常可能是由于某些电荷有序状态导致费米表面部分有间隙造成的。 PrIr₃B2 的磁相图也通过各向异性测量进行了研究。在 10 K 时，超区带隙在反铁磁转变附近打开，即使在极化状态下也不会关闭。从晶体结构以及磁基态和电子基态的可调性来看，这种戈薇金属磁体显示出有前途的电子序。

articles.title: Exact analytic solutions of classical time crystals
articles.title_zh: 经典时间晶体的精确解析解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39201v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present examples of classical time crystals (in a parabolic potential for the position) that admit simple exact analytic solutions. The kinetic energy in these crystals is piecewise parabolic as a function of speed and is minimised at nonzero values of the speed. The solutions are periodic, while the speed acquires definite periodic discontinuities. The solutions are stable along the branches where the action is lower. We also examine the classical time crystal with quartic kinetic energy. We show how the quartic kinetic energy can be emulated by a piecewise parabolic one, leading to accurate and transparent solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了经典时间晶体的例子（在该位置的抛物线势），它允许简单的精确解析解。这些晶体中的动能作为速度的函数呈分段抛物线形，并且在速度的非零值处最小化。解是周期性的，而速度则具有一定的周期性不连续性。沿着作用较低的分支，解是稳定的。我们还研究了具有四次动能的经典时间晶体。我们展示了如何通过分段抛物线来模拟四次动能，从而获得准确且透明的解决方案。

articles.title: Multipartite entanglement hidden in vector-chiral correlations of spin-1/2 chains
articles.title_zh: 隐藏在自旋 1/2 链的矢量手性相关性中的多部分纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39258v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Characterizing entanglement in quantum materials through experimentally accessible observables remains a central challenge. Quantum Fisher information associated with sums of one-site spin operators provides one route by linking entanglement to measurable magnetic response functions. Extending this approach to local composite observables requires new entanglement bounds. Here we establish a rigorous bound for the total nearest-neighbour vector chirality of periodic spin-1/2 chains with an even number of sites. The quantum Fisher information per spin cannot exceed k+1 for any k-producible state, so exceeding this bound certifies entanglement depth of at least k+1. Combining infinite density-matrix renormalization group and thermal pure quantum-state calculations, we demonstrate multipartite entanglement encoded in vector-chiral correlations at zero and finite temperatures in an extended J₁-J₂ XXZ chain. The spin-current coupling between vector chirality and electric polarization offers, in principle, access to this witness through dielectric loss spectroscopy in multiferroic magnets, extending entanglement diagnostics beyond dipolar spin correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过实验上可观察到的现象来表征量子材料中的纠缠仍然是一个核心挑战。与单点自旋算子之和相关的量子费希尔信息通过将纠缠与可测量的磁响应函数联系起来提供了一种途径。将这种方法扩展到局部复合可观测量需要新的纠缠边界。在这里，我们为具有偶数个位点的周期性自旋 1/2 链的总最近邻矢量手性建立了严格的界限。对于任何可产生 k 的状态，每次自旋的量子费希尔信息不能超过 k+1，因此超过此界限证明纠缠深度至少为 k+1。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过实验上可观察到的现象来表征量子材料中的纠缠仍然是一个核心挑战。与单点自旋算子之和相关的量子费希尔信息通过将纠缠与可测量的磁响应函数联系起来提供了一种途径。将这种方法扩展到局部复合可观测量需要新的纠缠边界。在这里，我们为具有偶数个位点的周期性自旋 1/2 链的总最近邻矢量手性建立了严格的界限。对于任何可产生 k 的状态，每次自旋的量子费希尔信息不能超过 k+1，因此超过此界限证明纠缠深度至少为 k+1。结合无限密度矩阵重正化群和热纯量子态计算，我们证明了在扩展的 J₁-J2 XXZ 链中在零和有限温度下以矢量手性关联编码的多部分纠缠。原则上，矢量手性和电极化之间的自旋电流耦合可以通过多铁磁体中的介电损耗光谱来获得这一证据，从而将纠缠诊断扩展到偶极自旋相关性之外。

articles.title: Varying A-site radius and size disorder to tune magnetic ordering in compositionally complex perovskite oxides
articles.title_zh: 改变 A 位半径和尺寸无序来调节成分复杂的钙钛矿氧化物中的磁有序性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A long standing goal of magnetochemists is to be able to control ordering temperatures through compositional engineering. Here we report the synthesis of a perovskite oxide with twelve cations accommodated within a single phase solid solution, AM7O₃, A = Lafᵣₐc₁₅Smfᵣₐc₁₅Gdfᵣₐc₁₅Ndfᵣₐc₁₅Dyfᵣₐc₁₅ (A5), and M7 = Tifᵣₐc₁₇Crfᵣₐc₁₇Mnfᵣₐc₁₇Fefᵣₐc₁₇Cofᵣₐc₁₇Nifᵣₐc₁₇Cufᵣₐc₁₇. Bulk magnetometry measurements for A5M7O₃, as well as for A = La, Gd and Lafᵣₐc₁₂Gdfᵣₐc₁₂, show that all these compounds magnetically order as ferrimagnets between 89 and 115 K. We find that the magnetic properties are influenced by considering a combination of the size disorder parameter alongside the A-site cationic radii and valence electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁化学家的长期目标是能够通过成分工程控制有序温度。在这里，我们报道了在单相固溶体中容纳十二个阳离子的钙钛矿氧化物的合成，AM7O₃，A = Lafᵣₐc₁₅Smfᵣₐc₁₅Gdfᵣₐc₁₅Ndfᵣₐc₁₅Dyfᵣₐc₁₅ (A5)，M7 = Tifᵣₐc₁₇Crfᵣₐc₁₇Mnfᵣₐc₁₇Fefᵣₐc₁₇Cofᵣₐc₁₇Nifᵣₐc₁₇Cufᵣₐc₁₇。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁化学家的长期目标是能够通过成分工程控制有序温度。在这里，我们报道了在单相固溶体中容纳十二个阳离子的钙钛矿氧化物的合成，AM7O₃，A = Lafᵣₐc₁₅Smfᵣₐc₁₅Gdfᵣₐc₁₅Ndfᵣₐc₁₅Dyfᵣₐc₁₅ (A5)，M7 = Tifᵣₐc₁₇Crfᵣₐc₁₇Mnfᵣₐc₁₇Fefᵣₐc₁₇Cofᵣₐc₁₇Nifᵣₐc₁₇Cufᵣₐc₁₇。 A5M7O₃ 以及 A = La、Gd 和 Lafᵣₐc₁当 Gdfᵣₐc₁当 的整体磁力测量表明，所有这些化合物在 89 至 115 K 之间以亚铁磁体的形式进行磁性排序。我们发现，通过考虑尺寸无序参数以及 A 位阳离子半径和价电子的组合，可以影响磁性。

articles.title: Qantum Well Resonant Tunneling Diode Probe of Correlated States in Twisted Bilayer MoS₂
articles.title_zh: 扭曲双层 MoS2 中相关态的量子阱谐振隧道二极管探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré superlattices formed in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) offer a versatile platform for exploring emergent quantum phases arising from strong electronic correlations. In this work, we develop a new experimental platform, the quantum well resonant tunneling diode (QWRTD), to probe the electronic landscape of approx 57^circ twisted bilayer MoS₂ (tMoS₂). By measuring the differential conductance (dI/dVPᵣₒbₑ) as a function of filling factor ν and displacement field D, we observe a robust integer correlated insulating state at ν = 1 that persists across the measured displacement field range. Furthermore, we identify a displacement-field-induced fractional insulating state at ν = 3/4 for D < -75~mV/nm. Temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent measurements characterize this ν = 3/4 state as a potential generalized Wigner crystal. These correlated states are also observed in another device with a similar twist angle (approx 56.5^circ). Our results provide direct evidence of correlated states in near-AB-stacked tMoS₂ and establish QWRTD as a powerful experimental tool for investigating strong correlations and topology in van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 中形成的莫尔超晶格为探索由强电子相关性产生的涌现量子相提供了一个多功能平台。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个新的实验平台，即量子阱谐振隧道二极管 (QWRTD)，以探测约 57^circ 扭曲双层 MoS2 (tMoS2) 的电子图景。通过测量作为填充因子 ν 和位移场 D 函数的微分电导 (dI/dVPᵣₒbₑ)，我们观察到在 ν = 1 时存在稳健的整数相关绝缘状态，该状态在测量的位移场范围内持续存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 中形成的莫尔超晶格为探索由强电子相关性产生的涌现量子相提供了一个多功能平台。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个新的实验平台，即量子阱谐振隧道二极管 (QWRTD)，以探测约 57^circ 扭曲双层 MoS2 (tMoS2) 的电子图景。通过测量作为填充因子 ν 和位移场 D 函数的微分电导 (dI/dVPᵣₒbₑ)，我们观察到在 ν = 1 时存在稳健的整数相关绝缘状态，该状态在测量的位移场范围内持续存在。此外，我们确定了当 D < -75~mV/nm 时，在 ν = 3/4 处存在位移场诱导的分数绝缘态。与温度和磁场相关的测量将这种 ν = 3/4 状态描述为潜在的广义维格纳晶体。这些相关状态也在具有类似扭转角（约 56.5^circ）的另一装置中观察到。我们的结果提供了近 AB 堆叠 tMoS2 中相关态的直接证据，并将 QWRTD 确立为研究范德华异质结构中强相关性和拓扑的强大实验工具。

articles.title: Weyl superconductivity from Feshbach resonance in the three-dimensional repulsive Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 三维排斥哈伯德模型中 Feshbach 共振产生的 Weyl 超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the first experimental realization of the antiferromagnetic phase transition in the three-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model, we present a theoretical study of the model's 3D superconducting phase. By formulating a 3D extension of the Feshbach mechanism, we provide a unified microscopic picture at strong coupling in which pairing is driven by near-resonant bound states of dopants. These long-lived bound states acquire a qualitatively different internal structure in three dimensions compared to their two-dimensional counterparts, giving rise to a distinct superconducting state, namely a time-reversal symmetry breaking dₓ^₂₋y^₂+idz^₂ pairing state. We also provide an estimate of the corresponding critical temperature, and provide evidence that the resulting superconducting phase hosts gapless Weyl points. Our results represent a new milestone for the field of quantum simulation, challenging experiments and large-scale numerics alike to test our predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 受三维费米-哈伯德模型中反铁磁相变首次实验实现的启发，我们对该模型的 3D 超导相进行了理论研究。通过制定 Feshbach 机制的 3D 扩展，我们提供了强耦合下的统一微观图像，其中配对由掺杂剂的近共振束缚态驱动。与二维对应物相比，这些长寿的束缚态在三个维度上获得了本质上不同的内部结构，从而产生了独特的超导态，即打破 dₓ²₋y²+idz² 配对态的时间反转对称性。我们还提供了相应临界温度的估计，并提供了由此产生的超导相具有无间隙韦尔点的证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受三维费米-哈伯德模型中反铁磁相变首次实验实现的启发，我们对该模型的 3D 超导相进行了理论研究。通过制定 Feshbach 机制的 3D 扩展，我们提供了强耦合下的统一微观图像，其中配对由掺杂剂的近共振束缚态驱动。与二维对应物相比，这些长寿的束缚态在三个维度上获得了本质上不同的内部结构，从而产生了独特的超导态，即打破 dₓ²₋y²+idz² 配对态的时间反转对称性。我们还提供了相应临界温度的估计，并提供了由此产生的超导相具有无间隙韦尔点的证据。我们的结果代表了量子模拟领域的一个新里程碑，通过具有挑战性的实验和大规模数值来测试我们的预测。

articles.title: Giant PhotoMagnetoDiode Effect
articles.title_zh: 巨大光磁二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the observation of a photomagnetodiode effect with a giant rectification ratio of 10 at a magnetic field of 0.1 T. The effect consists of a diode-like dependence of the photocurrent on the applied voltage that emerges in an external magnetic field. Such a pronounced nonreciprocity is observed in high-quality VPE-grown GaAs samples at low temperatures at interband photoexcitation. The photoconductivity is invariant upon reversing the polarity of both electric and magnetic fields. Similar behavior with even higher asymmetry ratio is observed in photoluminescence. The findings are well described by the theory of ambipolar drift of carriers in electric and magnetic fields together with fast surface recombination.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了在 0.1 T 磁场下观察到的巨大整流比为 10 的光磁二极管效应。该效应包括光电流对外部磁场中出现的外加电压的类似二极管依赖性。这种明显的非互易性在低温下带间光激发的高质量 VPE 生长的 GaAs 样品中观察到。当电场和磁场的极性反转时，光电导率保持不变。在光致发光中观察到具有更高不对称率的类似行为。电场和磁场中载流子双极漂移以及快速表面复合的理论很好地描述了这些发现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了在 0.1 T 磁场下观察到的巨大整流比为 10 的光磁二极管效应。该效应包括光电流对外部磁场中出现的外加电压的类似二极管依赖性。这种明显的非互易性在低温下带间光激发的高质量 VPE 生长的 GaAs 样品中观察到。当电场和磁场的极性反转时，光电导率保持不变。在光致发光中观察到具有更高不对称率的类似行为。电场和磁场中载流子双极漂移以及快速表面复合的理论很好地描述了这些发现。

articles.title: Active spinners drive passive matter into chiral rotors
articles.title_zh: 主动旋转器将被动物质驱动到手性转子中
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active spinners inject angular momentum into their surroundings without persistent translation, providing a route to chiral active matter distinct from self-propelled particles moving along curved trajectories. Recent studies have shown that spinner fluids can self-organize into rotating clusters with circulating edge currents characteristic of odd-viscous fluids. Whether angular-momentum injection alone can transmit chirality and edge-current dynamics to ordinary passive matter - and thus serve as a generic mechanism for imparting chiral functionality to undriven material components - remains an open question. Here, we show experimentally and numerically that purely rotational magnetic spinners can transfer chirality and edge-current dynamics to passive colloidal matter. At high passive-particle fraction, active spinners assemble into rotating clusters surrounded by passive matter. Remarkably, upon changing composition and spinner attraction, this organization turns inside out: passive colloids form rotating clusters surrounded by a chiral spinner fluid. These passive rotors exhibit edge currents and the same angular-velocity scaling, |Ω|sim R⁻², as their active counterparts. A minimal model shows that spinner-mediated transverse and non-reciprocal interactions are sufficient to reproduce these complementary chiral states and their boundary-driven dynamics. Our results establish angular-momentum injection by active spinners as a route to endow otherwise passive matter with chirality, collective rotation and boundary transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 主动旋转器将角动量注入周围环境，而无需持续平移，从而提供了一条通向手性活性物质的途径，这与沿着弯曲轨迹移动的自驱动粒子不同。最近的研究表明，旋转流体可以自组织成旋转簇，具有奇粘性流体的循环边缘流特征。单独的角动量注入是否可以将手性和边缘电流动力学传递给普通无源物质 - 从而作为向非驱动材料组件赋予手性功能的通用机制 - 仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们通过实验和数值证明，纯旋转磁性旋转器可以将手性和边缘电流动力学传递给被动胶体物质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 主动旋转器将角动量注入周围环境，而无需持续平移，从而提供了一条通向手性活性物质的途径，这与沿着弯曲轨迹移动的自驱动粒子不同。最近的研究表明，旋转流体可以自组织成旋转簇，具有奇粘性流体的循环边缘流特征。单独的角动量注入是否可以将手性和边缘电流动力学传递给普通无源物质 - 从而作为向非驱动材料组件赋予手性功能的通用机制 - 仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们通过实验和数值证明，纯旋转磁性旋转器可以将手性和边缘电流动力学传递给被动胶体物质。在高被动粒子分数下，主动旋转器组装成被被动物质包围的旋转簇。值得注意的是，在改变成分和旋转器吸引力时，这种组织发生了翻天覆地的变化：被动胶体形成被手性旋转器液体包围的旋转簇。这些无源转子表现出边缘电流和与有源转子相同的角速度缩放|Ω|sim R⁻²。最小模型表明，旋转器介导的横向和非互易相互作用足以重现这些互补的手性状态及其边界驱动的动力学。我们的结果建立了主动旋转器的角动量注入作为赋予被动物质手性、集体旋转和边界传输的途径。

articles.title: Emergent Quantum Geometric Phases in Holey Graphene
articles.title_zh: Holey石墨烯中出现的量子几何相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In graphene and other two-dimensional materials, periodic modulations of the electron density can significantly alter the energy spectrum and transport properties. Here, we report magnetotransport measurements in encapsulated monolayer graphene with ultra-high-quality patterned periodic antidot lattices that preserve the intrinsic electronic properties of the material. This lithographically defined platform enables controlled access to commensurability and superlattice phenomena at length scales otherwise difficult to achieve. By systematically tuning the lattice dimensions, we reveal a hierarchy of classical commensurability features arising from cyclotron orbits with comparable radii that follow multiple classical trajectories, resulting in broadened resistance peaks beyond the conventional single-orbit picture. Superimposed on these features, we observe pronounced Brown-Zak oscillations arising from the quantum commensurability between the magnetic flux quantum and the unit cell of the engineered Bravais lattices. We demonstrate that the intrinsic geometric phase of our system is directly measurable and show a precise matching of the magnetic field periodicity to the lithographic periodic patterning, where moiré-like electronic spectra can be geometrically generated in single-layer graphene without the need for twist, lattice mismatch, or multilayer stacking. Our results establish nanopatterned graphene as a clean, tunable, and scalable platform for realizing and exploring moiré physics through on-demand real-space design
articles.abstract_zh: 在石墨烯和其他二维材料中，电子密度的周期性调制可以显着改变能谱和传输特性。在这里，我们报告了封装单层石墨烯中的磁输运测量，该石墨烯具有超高质量图案化周期性反点晶格，可保留材料的固有电子特性。这种光刻定义的平台能够以其他方式难以实现的长度尺度来受控地访问可通约性和超晶格现象。通过系统地调整晶格尺寸，我们揭示了由具有可比较半径的回旋加速器轨道产生的经典可通约性特征的层次结构，这些轨道遵循多个经典轨迹，从而导致超出传统单轨道图的更宽的电阻峰值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在石墨烯和其他二维材料中，电子密度的周期性调制可以显着改变能谱和传输特性。在这里，我们报告了封装单层石墨烯中的磁输运测量，该石墨烯具有超高质量图案化周期性反点晶格，可保留材料的固有电子特性。这种光刻定义的平台能够以其他方式难以实现的长度尺度来受控地访问可通约性和超晶格现象。通过系统地调整晶格尺寸，我们揭示了由具有可比较半径的回旋加速器轨道产生的经典可通约性特征的层次结构，这些轨道遵循多个经典轨迹，从而导致超出传统单轨道图的更宽的电阻峰值。叠加在这些特征上，我们观察到由磁通量量子和工程布拉维晶格的晶胞之间的量子可通约性引起的明显的布朗-扎克振荡。我们证明了我们系统的固有几何相位是可以直接测量的，并且显示出磁场周期性与光刻周期图案的精确匹配，其中可以在单层石墨烯中几何生成莫尔状电子光谱，而不需要扭曲、晶格失配或多层堆叠。我们的研究结果将纳米图案石墨烯建立为一个清洁、可调且可扩展的平台，用于通过按需实空间设计来实现和探索莫尔物理

articles.title: Realization of ZnSe-based Field-Effect Transistors operating at Cryogenic Temperatures as a Platform for Future Spin-Qubit Applications
articles.title_zh: 实现在低温下工作的基于ZnSe的场效应晶体管作为未来自旋量子应用的平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39521v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The wide-bandgap compound semiconductor ZnSe is a promising host material for the realization of electron spin-qubits. Its non-degenerate conduction band and the potential for isotopic nuclear spin purification promise long spin coherence times. Key requirements for such devices include reliable electrostatic control of electrons in ZnSe and low-resistance ohmic contacts that remain functional at cryogenic temperatures. In this work, we utilize a novel Shadow Wall technique for molecular-beam epitaxy combined with in-situ deposition of Al ohmic contacts to realize normally-off ZnSe-based field-effect transistors. The devices exhibit linear output characteristics and effective gate control of the channel from room temperature down to 5 K, confirming low-resistance ohmic contacts to the undoped ZnSe channel. The drain current can be modulated by several orders of magnitude through electrostatic gating, with threshold voltages of approximately 3 V and field-effect mobilities exceeding 100 cm2/Vs over the investigated temperature range. Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson and drift-diffusion simulations reproduce the measured transfer characteristics and provide insight into the role of interface electrostatics in determining the channel formation and threshold voltage. These results demonstrate the potential of gated ZnSe heterostructures for future spin-qubit applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 宽带隙化合物半导体ZnSe是实现电子自旋量子位的有前途的主体材料。其非退化传导带和同位素核自旋纯化的潜力保证了较长的自旋相干时间。此类器件的关键要求包括对ZnSe中的电子进行可靠的静电控制，以及在低温下保持工作的低电阻欧姆触点。在这项工作中，我们利用一种新颖的分子束外延阴影壁技术结合Al欧姆接触的原位沉积来实现常断ZnSe基场效应晶体管。这些器件表现出从室温到5 K的通道的线性输出特性和有效的栅极控制，从而确认与未掺杂的ZnSe通道的低电阻欧姆接触。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宽带隙化合物半导体ZnSe是实现电子自旋量子位的有前途的主体材料。其非退化传导带和同位素核自旋纯化的潜力保证了较长的自旋相干时间。此类器件的关键要求包括对ZnSe中的电子进行可靠的静电控制，以及在低温下保持工作的低电阻欧姆触点。在这项工作中，我们利用一种新颖的分子束外延阴影壁技术结合Al欧姆接触的原位沉积来实现常断ZnSe基场效应晶体管。这些器件表现出从室温到5 K的通道的线性输出特性和有效的栅极控制，从而确认与未掺杂的ZnSe通道的低电阻欧姆接触。漏极电流可以通过静电栅极调制几个数量级，在所研究的温度范围内，阈值电压约为3 V ，场效应迁移率超过100 cm2/Vs。自洽的薛定谔-泊松和漂移-扩散模拟再现了测量的转移特性，并提供了对界面静电在确定沟道形成和阈值电压中的作用的见解。这些结果证明了门控ZnSe异质结构在未来自旋量子位应用中的潜力。

articles.title: Anisotropic wavevector-dependent damping of thickness-quantized magnons
articles.title_zh: 厚度量化磁子的各向异性波矢量相关阻尼
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnon damping is a key factor governing spin-wave transport and nonlinear dynamics of multimode magnon systems. However, many descriptions rely on the assumption of an effective mode-independent parameter, which can mask wavelength-dependent relaxation processes that depend on propagation geometry and mode profile. Here, we employ high-resolution parametric-instability spectroscopy to probe thickness-quantized spin waves with wavelengths down to about a hundred nanometers in micrometer-thick yttrium iron garnet films. The instability threshold exhibits a regular sawtooth dependence on the magnetic field, arising from switching between discrete thickness modes. Comparison with dipole--exchange theory reveals anisotropic wavevector-dependent damping that increases with mode number and depends differently on the in-plane and out-of-plane wavevector components.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁子阻尼是控制多模磁子系统自旋波传输和非线性动力学的关键因素。然而，许多描述依赖于有效模式无关参数的假设，该参数可以掩盖依赖于传播几何形状和模式轮廓的波长相关弛豫过程。在这里，我们使用高分辨率参量不稳定光谱来探测厚度量化自旋波，其波长在微米厚的钇铁石榴石薄膜中低至约100纳米。不稳定阈值表现出对磁场的规则锯齿依赖性，这是由离散厚度模式之间的切换引起的。与偶极子交换理论的比较揭示了各向异性波矢量相关阻尼，其随模数增加而增加，并且不同地依赖于平面内和平面外波矢量分量。

articles.title: An electromechanically coupled multiphase-field model with generalized kinetic relations for ferroelectrics
articles.title_zh: 一种具有铁电体广义动力学关系的机电耦合多相场模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical phase-field models typically use the Allen--Cahn evolution law to model interface motion as a consequence of energy-gradient descent. This implies a linear kinetic relation between the velocity of an interface (e.g., a domain wall in a ferroelectric) and its driving force. When nonlinear kinetic relations are to be modeled, as commonly found in ferroelectric ceramics, an alternative evolution law and hence an alternative model is needed. Here, we propose an electromechanically (stress-driven) coupled multiphase-field framework with a general kinetic formulation, which integrates a prescribed kinetic relation directly into the evolution law. We show that this model correctly evolves domain walls with the assigned nonlinear kinetics, e.g., of mixed exponential-power law type, following the so-called Merz--Stadler law. The multiphase formulation further enables distinct kinetic relations and interfacial energies to be assigned to different order-parameter pairs, which reflects the distinguishable properties of the different types of ferroelectric domain walls. The proposed framework is broadly applicable for simulating kinetic relations in materials with applications beyond ferroelectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典相场模型通常使用Allen-Cahn演化定律来模拟作为能量梯度下降结果的界面运动。这意味着界面（例如，铁电体中的畴壁）的速度与其驱动力之间存在线性动力学关系。当要建模非线性动力学关系时，如铁电陶瓷中常见的那样，需要一种替代的演化规律，因此需要一种替代模型。在这里，我们提出了一种具有一般动力学公式的机电（应力驱动）耦合多相场框架，它将规定的动力学关系直接整合到演化规律中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典相场模型通常使用Allen-Cahn演化定律来模拟作为能量梯度下降结果的界面运动。这意味着界面（例如，铁电体中的畴壁）的速度与其驱动力之间存在线性动力学关系。当要建模非线性动力学关系时，如铁电陶瓷中常见的那样，需要一种替代的演化规律，因此需要一种替代模型。在这里，我们提出了一种具有一般动力学公式的机电（应力驱动）耦合多相场框架，它将规定的动力学关系直接整合到演化规律中。我们证明了这个模型正确地演化了具有分配的非线性动力学的畴壁，例如，按照所谓的Merz-Stadler定律，混合指数幂律类型。多相配方进一步能够将不同的动力学关系和界面能量分配给不同的有序参数对，这反映了不同类型的铁电畴壁的可区分特性。所提出的框架广泛适用于模拟材料与铁电体以外应用的动力学关系。

articles.title: A transferable full-band Monte Carlo framework for complex alloy avalanche photodiodes
articles.title_zh: 用于复杂合金雪崩光电二极管的可转移全频段蒙特卡罗框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a physics-based multiscale full-band Monte Carlo framework for modeling avalanche multiplication and excess noise in complex alloy avalanche photodiodes (APDs), demonstrated on Al₀.₇InAsSb as a representative quaternary system. The framework links atomistic material structure to device-level avalanche statistics: an environment-dependent sp³d⁵s^ast tight-binding calculation resolves the full conduction- and valence-band structure of the random- or digital-alloy configuration -- including Γ, X, and L valley ordering, non-parabolicity, anisotropy, and spin-orbit-induced valence-band splitting -- and supplies the band-structure inputs for stochastic high-field transport. A central element of the framework is a physics-derived treatment of alloy-disorder scattering, in which the quaternary disorder potential is constructed from atomic valence differences, covalent radii, and Thomas--Fermi screening through a composition-weighted decomposition into binary contributions, complemented by composition-interpolated polar-optical, acoustic, intervalley-phonon, impurity, and impact-ionization models. Because every material-dependent input is generated from the atomic composition and configuration by the same well-defined procedure, the framework transfers without structural modification to arbitrary zinc-blende ternary and quaternary alloys. Applied to a SI1micrometer Al₀.₇InAsSb p-i-n APD, the framework reproduces the measured gain and excess-noise characteristics with only the impact-ionization softness parameters calibrated. The approach provides a documented, reproducible route for analyzing and designing complex alloy APDs in which band structure, disorder, and scattering physics jointly determine gain and ionization statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于物理学的多尺度全波段蒙特卡罗框架，用于模拟复杂合金雪崩光电二极管（ APD ）中的雪崩倍增和过量噪声，在铝上进行了演示。InAsSb作为具有代表性的四元系统。该框架将原子材料结构与器件级雪崩统计联系起来：环境相关的sp ³ d钚s ^ ast紧密绑定计算解决了随机或数字合金结构的全传导带和价带结构，包括Γ、X和L谷排序、非抛物线性、各向异性和自旋轨道诱导价带分裂，并为随机高场传输提供带结构输入。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种基于物理学的多尺度全波段蒙特卡罗框架，用于模拟复杂合金雪崩光电二极管（ APD ）中的雪崩倍增和过量噪声，在铝上进行了演示。InAsSb作为具有代表性的四元系统。该框架将原子材料结构与器件级雪崩统计联系起来：环境相关的sp ³ d钚s ^ ast紧密绑定计算解决了随机或数字合金结构的全传导带和价带结构，包括Γ、X和L谷排序、非抛物线性、各向异性和自旋轨道诱导价带分裂，并为随机高场传输提供带结构输入。该框架的核心元素是合金无序散射的物理衍生处理，其中四元无序势由原子价差、共价半径和Thomas构建--通过组合物加权分解成二进制贡献的费米筛选，并辅以组合物插值极光、声学、谷间声子、杂质和冲击电离模型。由于每个材料相关的输入都是通过相同的明确定义的程序从原子组成和配置生成的，因此框架无需结构修改即可转移到任意锌掺杂的三元和四元合金中。适用于SI1微米的铝合金。InAsSb p-i-n APD ，该框架仅在校准冲击电离软度参数的情况下再现测量的增益和过量噪声特性。该方法为分析和设计复杂的合金APD提供了有文献记载的可重现路线，其中波段结构、无序性和散射物理学共同确定增益和电离统计。

articles.title: μSR measurements of 3D Ising ferromagnetism in bulk Fe₃GeTe₂ crystals
articles.title_zh: μSR测量三维Ising铁磁性在块状Fe恤GeTe ₂晶体中
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fe₃GeTe₂ is a quasi-two-dimensional itinerant ferromagnet with a van-der-Waals layered structure that exhibits substantial magnetic anisotropy. In bulk samples, this material becomes magnetically ordered below 220~K, while in thin samples, the gate-tunability of the ferromagnetic moment has attracted significant interest. Alongside high-temperature ferromagnetism, a low-temperature magnetic state occurs whose nature has not been conclusively identified, with some studies suggesting a transition between ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism with temperature. Here we present magnetometry and μSR data that demonstrate that Fe₃GeTe₂ exhibits three-dimenional Ising-like ferromagnetism over the entire temperature range between TC=220~K and 2~K. The feature at 170~K that has previously been proposed to be a transition to antiferromagnetism is instead likely to represent a domain-freezing transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁GeTe ₂是一种准二维流动铁磁体，具有van-der-Waals层状结构，表现出相当大的磁各向异性。在大块样品中，这种材料在220 ~ K以下磁性有序，而在薄样品中，铁磁矩的栅极可调谐性引起了人们的极大兴趣。除了高温铁磁性之外，还会发生低温磁态，其性质尚未最终确定，一些研究表明铁磁性和反铁磁性之间存在随温度变化的过渡。在这里，我们展示了磁强计和μSR数据，证明在TC = 220 ~ K和2 ~ K之间的整个温度范围内， Fe恤GeTe ₂表现出三维Ising样铁磁性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁GeTe ₂是一种准二维流动铁磁体，具有van-der-Waals层状结构，表现出相当大的磁各向异性。在大块样品中，这种材料在220 ~ K以下磁性有序，而在薄样品中，铁磁矩的栅极可调谐性引起了人们的极大兴趣。除了高温铁磁性之外，还会发生低温磁态，其性质尚未最终确定，一些研究表明铁磁性和反铁磁性之间存在随温度变化的过渡。在这里，我们展示了磁强计和μSR数据，证明在TC = 220 ~ K和2 ~ K之间的整个温度范围内， Fe恤GeTe ₂表现出三维Ising样铁磁性。以前提出的170 ~ K处向反铁磁性过渡的特征很可能代表畴冻结过渡。

articles.title: Magnetization relaxation of interacting chains of nanomagnets
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的纳米磁铁链的磁化松弛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the magnetization dynamics crossover from single-particle to collective behavior in a one-dimensional chain of dipolar-coupled nanomagnets with uniaxial anisotropy. Using both an intermediate-to-high damping (IHD) analytical approach based on Langer's theory and time-quantified Monte Carlo (TQMC) simulations, we derive and validate semi-analytical expressions for the relaxation rate and the magnetization relaxation curves. Our main results include: (i) a closed-form expression for the relaxation rate accounting for (weak) dipolar interactions, (ii) a two-exponential semi-analytical formula for the magnetization dynamics m(t) of an interacting chain, and (iii) a systematic comparison with TQMC simulations, showing good agreement for a wide range of parameters. The analysis reveals a field-controlled crossover from uniform (macrospin-like) reversal to edge-nucleation propagation, driven by the spatial inhomogeneity of dipolar stabilization. The derived expressions provide a computationally efficient framework for predicting the relaxation behavior of dipolar-coupled nanomagnetic assemblies.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有单轴各向异性的双极耦合纳米磁体的一维链中从单粒子到集体行为的磁化动力学交叉。使用基于Langer理论的中高阻尼（ IHD ）分析方法和时间量化的蒙特卡罗（ TQMC ）模拟，我们推导并验证了弛豫速率和磁化弛豫曲线的半解析表达式。我们的主要结果包括： （ i ）考虑（弱）偶极子相互作用的弛豫速率的闭式表达式， （ ii ）相互作用链的磁化动力学m （ t ）的双指数半解析公式，以及（ iii ）与TQMC模拟的系统比较，在广泛的参数范围内表现出良好的一致性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有单轴各向异性的双极耦合纳米磁体的一维链中从单粒子到集体行为的磁化动力学交叉。使用基于Langer理论的中高阻尼（ IHD ）分析方法和时间量化的蒙特卡罗（ TQMC ）模拟，我们推导并验证了弛豫速率和磁化弛豫曲线的半解析表达式。我们的主要结果包括： （ i ）考虑（弱）偶极子相互作用的弛豫速率的闭式表达式， （ ii ）相互作用链的磁化动力学m （ t ）的双指数半解析公式，以及（ iii ）与TQMC模拟的系统比较，在广泛的参数范围内表现出良好的一致性。该分析揭示了由双极稳定的空间不均匀性驱动的从均匀（巨自旋样）逆转到边缘成核传播的场控交叉。导出的表达式为预测偶极耦合纳米磁性组件的弛豫行为提供了一个计算效率高的框架。

articles.title: Engineering Grain Boundary Commensurability for Ferroelectric Stabilization in Hafnia-Based Films
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39931v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries fundamentally dictate the macroscopic properties of polycrystalline materials by breaking long-range symmetry. In ferroelectrics, these structural discontinuities are conventionally considered as detrimental features that induce depolarization fields and accumulate defects, thereby suppressing or pinning local polarization. Here, we demonstrate that the commensurability of grain boundaries inherently governs the polar-orthorhombic phase stability in polycrystalline Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) thin films. Using depth-resolved multislice electron ptychography, we map the three-dimensional (3D) phase distribution across diverse boundaries with atomic resolution, revealing that highly commensurate grain boundaries effectively suppress the nonpolar-tetragonal phase by compensating for lattice mismatch while mitigating geometric frustration. Monte Carlo simulations uncover the atomistic and energetic origins of polar-phase stabilization, showing that commensurate grain boundaries favor the polar-orthorhombic phase more strongly than other grain boundaries. Guided by this principle, we epitaxially engineer HZO thin films to promote the preferential formation of commensurate grain boundaries, resulting in an approximately 60% enhancement in the remanent polarization of ferroelectric devices. These findings provide direct 3D experimental and theoretical evidence that establishes grain boundary commensurability as a critical degree of freedom for designing functional interfaces, guiding the construction of novel ceramics and polycrystalline ferroelectrics.

articles.title: Thermal magnon transport in FM/AFM bilayers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39947v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Progress in information processing relies on spintronics, where magnetic states serve as efficient carriers for data storage and transfer. In this work, we theoretically study magnon propagation in a bilayer composed of a ferro-magnet and an antiferromagnet. For this purpose, we probe the spin Seebeck effect by introducing a spatially varying temperature profile. This generates a local magnon excitation and a continuous magnon flux from hot to cold regions which we quantify through the resulting non-equilibrium magnon accumulation. Based on the chirality of these modes, we identify specific constraints for magnon modes traveling either from the ferromagnet into the antiferromagnet or vice versa. A key finding is the observation of a thermally triggered spin current in the antiferromagnet, a phenomenon typically absent in bulk antiferromagnets that obey time-reversal symmetry. These results provide important insights into the design of heterostructures for magnonic chirality-selective spin transport.

articles.title: Strong Dimerization and Field-Induced Reconstruction of the Low-Energy Spectrum in Cu₃(OH)₄(HCO₂)₂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the field-dependent low-energy thermodynamics of the distorted triangular quantum antiferromagnet Cu₃(OH)₄(HCO₂)₂ using a sector-resolved Superblock Diagonalization Method (SBDM) supplemented by a transfer-matrix treatment of weakly coupled layers. The strong exchange hierarchy, dominated by the Cu1--Cu1 intradimer coupling J₂=150,K, separates a high-energy dimer sector from a much softer magnetic manifold formed predominantly by the Cu2 moments. In the 24-site cluster, sixteen Cu1 spins form the strongly bound sector while eight Cu2 spins remain magnetically active; polarization of these eight spins gives S^z=4 compared with S^zᵣₘ ₛₐₜ=12, providing a direct microscopic origin for the one-third magnetization scale. The finite-temperature thermodynamics reveals a non-monotonic field evolution of the low-energy scale: the dominant C/T feature softens with increasing field, reaches a minimum near the field region around 2,T, and subsequently hardens as the low-temperature magnetization approaches Mᵣₘ ₛₐₜ/3. Temperature and field sweeps thus expose a common field-induced spectral reconstruction, while the strongly reduced entropy reflects the restricted number of thermally active degrees of freedom below the dimer excitation scale. Our results identify strong-dimer-induced reduction of the active magnetic Hilbert space, followed by field-driven reorganization of the residual spin sector, as the common microscopic origin of the one-third magnetic response and the non-monotonic low-temperature thermodynamics.

articles.title: Cluster-based Structural Similarity for Dataset Visualization and Data Selection for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are essential components for accelerating simulation-driven materials design. Data-efficient MLIP training relies on data-selection strategies that maximize structural diversity while limiting computationally expensive first-principles calculations. A key challenge in such strategies is evaluating structural similarity, which involves a trade-off between retaining information on individual atomic environments and reducing computational cost. Here, we propose similarity evaluation methods that achieve both representational fidelity and computational efficiency. Our method represents each structure using a small set of characteristic atomic environments identified by k-medoids clustering and computes pairwise similarity through optimal matching between these representatives or their distributions. Molecular benchmarks demonstrate that our method is approximately 50 times faster than the baseline method while also more clearly distinguishing structures with different chemical compositions. Similarity-based data-selection benchmarks demonstrate that our methods improve the data efficiency and stability of force prediction in MLIPs.

articles.title: Entropy-Driven Altermagnetism from Thermal Magnons
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a route to altermagnetism driven by entropy upon heating and demonstrate it in a minimal square-lattice antiferromagnet. An exchange modulation is entropically favored because the resulting momentum-dependent magnon splitting increases the magnon entropy, thereby lowering the free energy and favoring altermagnetism. We derive an instability criterion for this exchange-modulated state, predict its temperature-driven reentrant behavior, and show that its overlap with Néel order defines a finite-temperature altermagnetic phase. Variational spin-wave theory, spin--lattice Monte Carlo, and cluster diagonalization establish the entropy-driven instability and its coexistence with magnetic order. The resulting state supports a transverse spin conductivity. The mechanism provides a route to thermally induced altermagnetism in compensated magnets coupled to sufficiently soft physical modes.

articles.title: Many-body topology in parity-preserving tensor networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planar parity-preserving tensor networks (ppTNs) admit a fermionic formulation in which the Gaussian, efficiently contractible limit is deformed by local interactions. We investigate how many-body methods can be used to analyze such contractions in a minimal two-parameter ppTN. Its contraction is simultaneously an interacting fermionic partition function, a loop gas, a deformed toric-code norm, and a quartic Ising model, allowing the same phase diagram to be approached with complementary tools. At its center lies a `topological island', characterized beyond the Gaussian limit by a boundary-twist mathbb Z₂ indicator that reduces to Chern-number parity and admits a loop-winding interpretation under duality. Fermionic perturbation theory predicts the interacting phase boundaries, tensor-network numerics establish their critical behavior, and the loop and spin descriptions reveal a self-dual line with a c=1 four-state-Potts multicritical fixed point.

articles.title: A latent-space extrapolation grade built into graph atomic cluster expansion foundation potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials cover broad configurational and chemical spaces, but their reliability can vary across the atomic environments encountered during a simulation. Here we introduce the calibrated Mahalanobis (CALM) extrapolation grade γ, a piecewise differentiable per-atom quantity integrated into GRACE foundation models and evaluated alongside energies and forces in a single model pass. We define γ from nearest-cluster Mahalanobis distances in latent feature space, setting γ=1 from the training-distance distribution separately for each element and cluster. Controlled tests show that a normalized random projection of the invariant many-body basis detects structural and chemical extrapolation. On different foundation datasets, OMat24 and SMAX, γ correlates with atomic force errors and separates structures with different error distributions. The CALM grade adds percent-level computational cost, and its spatial gradient guides uncertainty-biased data collection toward configurations with larger absolute force errors.

articles.title: Topological Transverse Transport without a Gap in Critical Topological Flat Bands
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantized Hall transport is traditionally anchored to a bulk spectral gap, which isolates the occupied subspace and exponentially suppresses thermal deviations. Recently discovered critical topological flat bands (CTFBs) challenge this paradigm: an exactly flat band touches a dispersive continuum while retaining a well-defined integer Chern number. However, their finite-temperature transverse transport properties remain entirely unexplored. Here, we develop a low-temperature theory of the intrinsic electrical, thermoelectric, and thermal Hall responses in CTFBs. At fixed particle number, the macroscopic flat-band degeneracy forces a singular Lambert-W drift of the chemical potential, generating an algebraic-logarithmic hierarchy of low-temperature corrections: Tln(1/T) for electrical Hall, T[ln(1/T)]² for thermoelectric Hall, and T[ln(1/T)]³ for thermal Hall conductivity, replacing the activated thermal protection of a gapped Chern insulator. By contrast, externally pinning the chemical potential to the flat-band energy locks the flat band to half occupation at any nonzero temperature, obstructing the recovery of the fully filled topological ground state as T→0⁺. Our results establish that a bulk spectral gap is unnecessary for zero-temperature Hall quantization, but indispensable for its exponential thermal protection.

articles.title: adapol: Adaptive pole-fitting for quantum many-body physics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe adapol, a Python package for fitting Matsubara Green's functions, self-energies, and hybridization functions by a compact sum of simple poles with real pole locations and matrix-valued residues. This pole-fitting step arises in many contexts, including hybridization fitting for quantum impurity solvers based on exact diagonalization, perturbation theory, and tensor networks, the compression of existing pole expansions such as the discrete Lehmann representation, diagrammatic methods based on discrete pole representations, and the analytic continuation of Matsubara Green's functions. adapol uses a modified version of the AAA rational approximation algorithm to estimate pole locations, and non-convex optimization to refine them. This procedure yields accurate and compact fits in a black-box and noise-robust manner. adapol provides a simple, self-contained interface with extensive documentation and examples, as well as an interface to the TRIQS package.

articles.title: Designing Strongly Correlated Quantum Phases of Matter with Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing a material with a desired property amounts to solving an inverse problem: finding the couplings of a microscopic Hamiltonian whose ground state exhibits that property. For strongly correlated quantum systems, solving this problem efficiently remains largely out of reach. To address this challenge, we present a general framework for ab initio inverse design based on Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States, a recent approach in which the ground states of a family of Hamiltonians are encoded in a single variational wave function. Because the ansatz depends explicitly on the couplings, any target property is a differentiable function of them, and the search for the right Hamiltonian reduces to gradient-based optimization in coupling space. We apply this approach to search for nonmagnetic phases of frustrated Heisenberg models on the square lattice with an increasing number of free next-nearest-neighbor couplings, aiming to identify new quantum spin liquid candidates. With a single coupling, the method recovers the known nonmagnetic window of the square J₁-J₂ Heisenberg model, whereas letting the two diagonal couplings vary independently reveals an extended nonmagnetic region connecting the square-lattice and anisotropic-triangular-lattice regimes. In a search space of eight independent couplings within a 2×2 unit cell, which contains several paradigmatic frustrated spin models, the optimization spontaneously converges to the J₁-J₂-δ Heisenberg model, in which the diagonal couplings alternate between two values on neighboring plaquettes, a model recently proposed in the context of altermagnetism. Finite-size scaling up to 16×16 clusters in this optimal model shows that the ground state has no magnetic, dimer, or plaquette order, establishing it as a new quantum spin liquid candidate, distinct from those previously proposed on the square lattice.

articles.title: Long-lived divergence from equilibrium of electrons, nuclear spins and lattice for a solid state ion trap at low temperature
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A fundamental problem in physics as well as engineering is equilibration. For example, the regulation of thermal and quantum fluctuations enables thermal and quantum annealing of complex systems. A key question is how different subsystems, such as electrons, nuclear spins and phonons equilibrate on their own as well as with each other. Level crossings play a special role in the dynamics of coupled degrees of freedom, for it is here that entanglement can be maximized to speed up relaxation.
