Based on repeated isolation (3x) and a SNP difference of ≤10 across the whole genome, 177 isolates were classified as persistent, supplemented by 37 historical persistent isolates. Persistent strains appeared in all facility types. Pangenome-wide analysis revealed a set of 2,232 accessory genes, of which 354 genes were significantly associated with persistent isolates. Persistent isolates were enriched in genes related to genome maintenance, regulatory functions, stress response, and mobile genetic elements, while genes involved in metabolism, nutrient processing, and intracellular trafficking were depleted. Virulence and environmental stress tolerance gene profiles were driven more by ST type rather than persistence classification. The high detection rate in this study demonstrates that genomic flexibility makes it challenging to control persistent strains under highly dynamic and heterogeneous conditions present across food production environments. In summary, our findings underscore the need to integrate genomic, ecological and environmental data to predict and control persistence.

articles.title: A Vision-based Grid-Exploration Path Planning Method for Efficient Water Surface Cleaning under Heterogeneous Debris Distributions
articles.abstract: Conventional coverage path planning (CPP) for unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) is often inefficient in environments with sparse or clustered debris due to extensive traversal of empty areas. This paper proposes a Vision-based Grid-Exploration (VGE) method that integrates perception and planning in a structured framework. The workspace is decomposed into grid cells based on the sensor's field-of-view, followed by boundary-based rotational scanning to localize debris. Intra-cell traversal is then optimized as an Open Traveling Salesman Problem (OTSP) with fixed endpoints. The VGE method was evaluated in a 40 m × 40 m simulated environment across four scenarios: sparse uniform, dense uniform, clustered, and mixed distributions. Compared to traditional and reactive Boustrophedon algorithms, VGE significantly improves efficiency by reducing unnecessary traversal. The most notable gains occur in sparse environments, where path length and mission time are reduced by up to 75.7% and 65.4%, respectively, compared to the traditional approach (799.0 m and 646.7 s). Furthermore, preliminary field experiments in a landscape water channel validated the practical feasibility of the framework on embedded hardware. The results show high fidelity between the planned paths and actual GPS trajectories, demonstrating that the VGE method is a robust and efficient solution for autonomous water surface cleaning in realistic, heterogeneous environments.

articles.title: Electro-Thermal Hotspot Analysis of SiGe p-FinFET devices
articles.abstract: This work analyzes a dopingless SiGe channel p-FinFET using a drift-diffusion model coupled with the phonon hydrodynamic equation (PHE) for electro-thermal simulation. After validating the model against experimental data, we modulate the Ge content (xGe from 0.2 to 0.8). The results show that SiGe FinFETs exhibit a peak operating temperature approximately 15 K lower than their pure silicon counterparts, a benefit attributed to reduced resistive heating from enhanced hole mobility rather than thermal conductivity differences. While a 25% mobility enhancement is achieved at xGe = 0.4, increasing Ge beyond 0.6 introduces a trade-off due to alloy-induced thermal conductivity reduction. This work provides a comprehensive electro-thermal framework for optimizing SiGe FinFETs in thermally constrained high-speed applications.

articles.title: Harmonics of femtosecond and continuous-wave radiation for precision spectroscopy: generation efficiency and spectral line shape
articles.abstract: Precision spectroscopy in the UV and VUV ranges, including the thorium-229 nuclear transition at 148.4 nm, requires narrow-band sources obtained by frequency multiplication of stabilized lasers. Upon harmonic generation, the power drops and the phase noise grows. We analyze both factors for two primary sources: a continuous-wave single-frequency laser and a femtosecond optical frequency comb. In the weak-conversion regime and at equal average input power, the central mode of the Kth harmonic of the comb matches the harmonic power of the continuous-wave laser for K = 2 and noticeably exceeds it for K > 2. Group-velocity mismatch reduces the overall conversion efficiency without affecting the phase-matched central mode. The transformation of the phase noise of an ultrastable laser leads to two K-dependent effects: the linewidth grows linearly, whereas the power fraction in the carrier decreases as a Gaussian function and is governed by the high-frequency noise of the stabilization loop (servo bumps). Phase-noise measurements of a laser stabilized to a Fabry–Pérot cavity show that for a typical rms phase excursion of ~ 100 mrad the carrier loses about half its power at the eighth harmonic, while a non-optimal loop gain leads to carrier collapse as early as the second–third harmonic.

articles.title: Numerical Optimization of Relief-Shelf Retaining Walls for Stabilization of Seismic and Rainfall-Sensitive Hill Slopes under Combined Loading
articles.abstract: Steep urban hill slopes are particularly vulnerable to instability when surcharge, groundwater and seismic actions act simultaneously, yet retaining-wall design is often evaluated using isolated loading conditions. This study develops a numerical framework for assessing and optimizing cantilever retaining-wall configurations for stabilization of a steep slope adjacent to Naini Lake, Uttarakhand, India. A two-dimensional finite-element model was developed in Optum G2 using the Mohr-Coulomb constitutive model and the Strength Reduction Method to evaluate factor of safety, displacement and stress response. Eight loading scenarios incorporating self-weight, building and vehicular surcharge, groundwater, and pseudo-static seismic loading were investigated. The natural slope exhibited a factor of safety of 1.508, which progressively decreased with increasing environmental and structural demands and reached 0.859 under simultaneous groundwater, surcharge and seismic loading. Retaining-wall location strongly influenced stabilization efficiency, with placement near the termination of the critical failure surface producing superior performance. Addition of a shear key provided a further but limited improvement, whereas relief shelves produced greater reductions in deformation and stress. The results demonstrate the importance of failure-surface-informed wall placement and relief-shelf geometry for resilient stabilization of complex hill slopes subjected to coupled hydraulic, structural and seismic demands.

articles.title: Heterogeneous dynamics in yttrium dihydride with deep learning potential
articles.abstract: Our recent study based on ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations [Y. Huang et al. , Sci. Rep. 15 , 18144 (2025)] reveals that hydrogen diffusion in YH 2 at elevated temperatures proceeds through a correlated mechanism. In the current work, we develop a deep-learning interatomic potential for YH 2 trained on AIMD data, enabling large-scale classical molecular dynamics simulations to elucidate the microscopic details of this cooperative mechanism. Our simulations reproduce and extend the AIMD predictions, capturing an order–disorder transition at a characteristic temperature of Tα ∼800 K accompanied by quasi-one-dimensional, string-like hydrogen displacements. A second crossover at Tλ ∼ 950 K denotes the superionic-like transition, which coincides with a discernible peak in the specific heat capacity. We show that above Tα, the hydrogen atoms, which are constrained within the yttrium lattice, exhibit spatially heterogeneous dynamics, manifested as distinct regions of slow- and fast-moving atoms. Further analysis establishes a buildup of dynamic heterogeneity that peaks above Tα and gradually diminishes beyond Tλ. The progression of dynamic heterogeneity in YH 2 shows a remarkable similarity to that of fluorites with a close-packed structure and establishes YH 2 as a Type II superionic-like conductor at high temperatures. Our work opens new avenues for exploring superionic-like transport in metal hydrides, a class of materials in which such behavior has remained largely unexplored.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Diatomic FeH + has almost all it needs to be a carrier of diffuse interstellar bands
articles.abstract: The carriers of the diffuse interstellar bands (DIBs) in the interstellar medium are mostly unidentified, with C 60 + as a notable exception. We here present electronic photodissociation spectra of the diatomic iron hydride cation FeH + , which underline that diatomic molecules can cause absorption bands that resemble DIBs. The spectrum is dominated by a broad absorption centered around 310 nm, which results from allowed transitions into the repulsive section of quintet state potential curves. However, we also find weak absorptions to bound states with band widths in the range of 10–20 Å. Multireference calculations including spin–orbit coupling indicate the presence of a dense manifold of states, which arises from spin–orbit splitting of a group of repulsive septet states connecting to the Fe + ( 6 D) + H ground state asymptote, and bound triplet states connecting to excited state asymptotes. Since we observe the Fe + fragment in the mass spectrum, the molecule undergoes predissociation following excitation to these bound states, most likely via repulsive septet states, but multiple curve crossings involving triplet and quintet states may also lead to dissociation. Predissociation is known to cause substantial line broadening, which is a mechanism that leads to a diffuse absorption band in a diatomic spectrum. Several bands are observed close to known DIBs and have matching widths, but do not show the required match in the position, and their intensity is very weak. Given the complex photophysics of this diatomic molecular ion, further experiments are needed to fully rule out FeH + as a DIB carrier.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Rotation of NH 3 + and H 3 O + ions in superfluid helium droplets
articles.abstract: Infrared spectra of small molecules embedded in helium nanodroplets exhibit well-resolved rotational structure owing to the superfluid nature of the droplets and the weak interactions between the dopant molecules and surrounding helium atoms. In this work, we investigated the ν 3 stretching bands of the light cationic rotors NH 3 + and H 3 O + in helium nanodroplets. The ν 3 band of NH 3 + displays a well-resolved rotational structure, whereas that of H 3 O + is only partially resolved. The rotational constants associated with rotation about the C 3 symmetry axis remain close to their gas-phase values. In contrast, the rotational constants corresponding to tumbling motion are reduced in helium to ∼60% of their free-molecule values. A substantially larger reduction was reported previously for the CH 3 + ion. This difference is attributed to differences in the electronic structures of the ions, which govern their interactions with helium atoms. In addition, the NH 3 + spectrum exhibits anomalies in both line positions and intensities, suggesting that the rotational dynamics of ions in superfluid helium may not be adequately described by the conventional free-molecule rotational Hamiltonian.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Reactivity of ambident nucleophiles in magnetic fields: A combined conceptual DFT and current-DFT study
articles.abstract: The influence of strong external magnetic fields (up to 0.30 B 0 ) on the electronic structure and reactivity of ambident nucleophiles is investigated using the nitrite and thiocyanate anions as prototypical examples. To capture magnetic-field-induced changes in reactivity, current-density-functional theory (current-DFT) calculations are interpreted through conceptual density-functional theory (conceptual DFT) descriptors, namely global hardness and local softness via Fukui functions, focusing on the evolution of the electronic structure and associated properties with increasing field strength in different orientations. By extending our previous adiabatic treatment of molecules to include higher-spin states, in analogy with an earlier study on atoms, and by considering the symmetry properties of relevant quantum-chemical quantities within full magnetic groups using the qsym 2 framework, we uncover substantial magnetic-field-induced modulations of both molecular polarity and the shape of the Fukui function. Despite these modulations, the ambident nucleophilicity of both (NO2)− and SCN − is largely preserved, as is the preference for attack by soft electrophiles at the sulfur end of SCN − . At higher field strengths, however, the Fukui functions become increasingly diffuse, reflecting the growing importance of external magnetic interactions relative to internal electrostatic forces. The resulting redistribution of local reactivity not only predicts reaction pathways with unexpected geometries but also raises the possibility that regioselectivity may become progressively less well-defined in the strong-field regime.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: New features of BDF since 2020
articles.abstract: The Beijing Density Functional (BDF) program package, with a history of over 30 years, is primarily characterized by its inclusion of the full range of relativistic Hamiltonians (one-, two-, quasi-four-, effective-four-, and four-component, as well as quantum electrodynamics) alongside fully symmetry-adapted density functional theory (DFT), time-dependent (TD) DFT, and single/multi-reference wave function theories (WFTs) for electronic structures and response properties of molecular systems. New features of BDF since its last summary [Zhang et al. , J. Chem. Phys. 152 , 064113 (2020)] include approximate treatments of relativistic effects, improved SCF solvers, implicit and explicit solvation models, enhanced TDDFT, new multi-reference WFT for strong correlation, and analytic gradients, Hessians, and nonadiabatic coupling matrix elements for both ground and excited states, as well as extensions to various spectroscopies. These developments have transformed BDF into a comprehensive and efficient electronic structure program well-suited for real-world applications.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Entangled photon pair excitation and time-frequency-filtered multidimensional photon correlation spectroscopy as a probe for dissipative exciton kinetics
articles.abstract: In quantum aggregates, delocalized exciton states across energy manifolds interact with phonon modes, making state-resolved spectroscopic monitoring of dynamics challenging. We propose a scheme that combines photon-entanglement-enhanced narrowband excitation of two-exciton states with time-frequency-filtered two-photon coincidence counting, which allows high-resolution probing of dissipative two-exciton dynamics spread across multiple spectral and temporal windows. We demonstrate that entangled photon pairs can be used to prepare narrowband two-exciton population distributions, circumventing transport in the mediating one-exciton manifold, and the redistributed two-exciton population can be monitored using time-frequency-filtered two-photon coincidence counting. Numerical simulations for a light-harvesting aggregate highlight the ability of this protocol to suppress or amplify specific pathways under a realistic scenario. Combining entangled photonic sources with multidimensional photon correlation techniques enables promising applications in spectroscopy and sensing.

articles.title: Kinetically arrested phase separation leads to tunable domain structures in vapor-deposited glasses
articles.abstract: The characteristic length scale of phase-separated organic thin film blends is a critical structural parameter governing the performance and functionality of organic electronic devices. The arrested morphologies of vapor-deposited organic thin films result from the interplay between thermodynamic driving forces and kinetic constraints during deposition. Here, we aim to isolate the role of kinetic effects in phase separation by varying the deposition rate at a constant substrate temperature for a co-deposited molecular glass blend of N , N ′-bis(3-methylphenyl)- N , N ′-diphenylbenzidine (TPD) and Disperse Orange 37. The dependence of morphology on deposition rate is quantified using power spectral density analysis of atomic force microscopy images. Two distinct deposition rate-dependent length scales at the surface reveal how deposition kinetics directly influence domain size and film topography. Complementary resonant soft x-ray scattering measurements indicate that phase separation extends throughout the film thickness. These observations are consistent with the surface equilibration mechanism previously described for homogeneous vapor-deposited films, in which enhanced surface mobility allows molecules in the growing film to partially equilibrate into distinct surface-templated states during deposition. In the current work, this mechanism allows the multi-component blend to phase separate and coarsen into a structure with multiple length scales before kinetically arresting to an extent that depends on the deposition rate. The demonstration of finely tunable domain size with deposition rate provides strategies to design new organic electronic devices with desired morphologies.

articles.title: Photophysics of heteroatom-doped B,N multiple-resonance emitters: A computational investigation
articles.abstract: Boron/nitrogen multiple-resonance thermally activated delayed fluorescence (B/N MR-TADF) emitters offer high color purity, but accelerating reverse intersystem crossing (RISC) without sacrificing narrowband emission remains challenging. Here, 16 C-, O-, S-, and Se-containing B/N MR-TADF emitters with varied framework symmetries are investigated using density functional theory (DFT), time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT), and the thermal vibration correlation function (TVCF) formalism. We find that the conventional T 1 → S 1 pathway cannot explain the accelerated RISC because the S 1 –T 1 gap remains thermally unfavorable. Instead, a near-resonant high-lying T 2 state provides an intrinsically fast spin-conversion pathway, although its productive contribution is governed by the competition between T 2 → S 1 RISC and T 2 → T 1 internal conversion. Chalcogen embedding and framework symmetry breaking cooperatively tune the T 2 orbital character, enhance S 1 –T 2 spin–orbit coupling (SOC), and yield direct T 2 → S 1 RISC rate constants from 8.65 × 10 7 to 8.77 × 10 9 s −1 for S- and Se-containing emitters with numerically stable T 2 -state vibronic parameters. Spectral simulations further show that the same heavy-atom perturbation can increase S 1 /S 0 relaxation, reorganization energy, and vibronic coupling, thereby broadening emission. The emission bandwidth correlates more closely with S 1 → S 0 reorganization energy than with global structural displacement, identifying vibronic reorganization as the key color-purity descriptor. Thus, S 1 –T 2 energy alignment and SOC govern the intrinsic spin-conversion capability, whereas framework rigidity, symmetry, and reorganization energy determine narrowband emission. Symmetric double locking with localized S or Se embedding, therefore, provides a practical strategy for balancing intrinsic spin-conversion capability and color purity.

articles.title: Beyond the absorption peak: An all-experimental analysis of resonance conditions in doubly resonant sum frequency generation via intensity and phase-resolved spectroscopy
articles.abstract: Doubly resonant infrared-visible sum frequency generation spectra of diverse origins are analyzed using a spectral overlap function determined from in situ measurements. New and previously published datasets are compared through both homodyne (intensity) and internal heterodyne (phase-resolved) spectra across varied visible and infrared excitation conditions. We demonstrate that the conventional damping of excitation spectra for vibrational modes—a long-standing practice in the literature—is not required to reproduce the experimental observations when the spectral overlap function is obtained experimentally. Moreover, we show that the doubly resonant character cannot be inferred from the absorption spectrum alone, as resonance conditions extend well beyond the energy range implied by the absorption peak. Finally, this all-experimental method for data analysis accurately predicts the vibrational-electronic phase extracted from phase-resolved spectra, a critical parameter for robust spectral interpretation and an independent validation of the approach.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Hydrogen-bonded supramolecular assembly of didodecylmelamine and thymine at the air/water interface studied by heterodyne-detected vibrational sum frequency generation
articles.abstract: Langmuir monolayers of didodecylmelamine (2C 12 mela) on thymine aqueous solutions were studied by in situ heterodyne-detected vibrational sum frequency generation (HD-VSFG) spectroscopy. The HD-VSFG spectrum of the monolayer on a 10 mM thymine aqueous solution exhibited a positive band at 1665 cm −1 , a negative band at 1710 cm −1 , and an extremely broad, positive band at the low wavenumber side (2600–2850 cm −1 ) of the CH, NH, and OH stretching region. The three bands were assigned to the 4-carbonyl, 2-carbonyl, and strongly hydrogen-bonded NH stretching modes of thymine. The signs of the bands indicate that thymine molecules were oriented with the oxygen atoms of the 4-carbonyl pointing downward, the oxygen atoms of the 2-carbonyl pointing upward, and the hydrogen atoms of the NH groups of thymine pointing upward along the interface normal, respectively. The spectral data, supported by finite-cluster spectral simulations, favor a polymer-like supramolecular structure over trimeric models. In this model, thymine molecules are bound to neighboring 2C 12 mela molecules in an ∼1:1 arrangement, with their methyl groups pointing downward along the interface normal and their 4-carbonyl groups sharing a common lateral orientation along the supramolecular chain.

articles.title: Anion photoelectron spectroscopy on xenon cluster anions, the simplest solvated electrons
articles.abstract: Xenon clusters had been predicted to form polarizability-bound anions and/or correlation-bound anions, Xe n − , but despite their importance in understanding weak binding by excess electrons and the theoretical studies probing them, only their mass spectrometric observation by Haberland et al. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 63 , 1219 (1989)] had revealed their viability. In this study, xenon atomic and cluster anions, Xe n − ( n = 1–54), were formed, and their anion photoelectron spectra were measured for n = 20–54. Each of these spectra exhibited two photoelectron peaks, i.e., one at an electron binding energy (EBE) around 0.2 eV and another at an EBE around 0.8 eV. The Xe n − cluster anions associated with the lower EBE peaks were attributed to those in which their excess electrons are bound by aggregates of highly polarizable xenon atoms. The smallest stable size for this type of binding interaction had been predicted to be n ∼ 5. This is consistent with the extrapolation of a plot of the observed vertical detachment energy (VDE) values for the lower EBE peaks vs n −1/3 toward VDE = 0. These Xe n − atomic cluster anions are presumably the simplest solvated electrons. The Xe n − cluster anions associated with the higher EBE peaks were attributed to those in which an electronically metastable xenon atomic anion, Xe* − , is physisorbed, i.e., “solvated,” by n − 1 Xe atoms, i.e., Xe* − (Xe) n −1 .

articles.title: Special topic issue on terahertz spectroscopy
articles.abstract: Terahertz (THz) spectroscopy occupies a unique position at the intersection of chemistry, physics, electrical engineering, materials science, and biology. By probing low-energy excitations, collective motions, intermolecular interactions, carrier transport, and light–matter coupling, THz methods provide direct insight into molecular and condensed-phase dynamics that are often inaccessible by other spectroscopic techniques. This Special Topic of The Journal of Chemical Physics brings together recent advances in THz spectroscopy, spanning chiral molecular sensing, biomolecular dynamics, liquids and electrolytes, nanomaterials, semiconductors, photonic structures, and theoretical methodology.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Simulation of two-dimensional electronic and double-quantum coherence spectra of molecular polaritons
articles.abstract: We simulate two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy (2DES) and double-quantum coherence (DQC) signals for a dissipative Tavis–Cummings model using the third-order optical response function formalism. Cavity photon loss, excited state population relaxation, and fast dephasing are included through Lindblad terms, while static energetic disorder is treated using the density matrix equations of motion. The 2DES spectra contain lower polariton (LP) and upper polariton (UP) diagonal peaks together with LP–UP cross peaks, thereby resolving excitation–detection correlations that are absent in pump–probe spectra. Decomposition into ground state bleaching, stimulated emission, and excited state absorption pathways shows that the 2DES are the residual of cancellations among pathways of opposite sign, with the incomplete cancellation originating from the two-level structure of the emitters. The waiting time dependent amplitudes of the 2DES peaks exhibit damped Rabi oscillations. As the bright state coherence and population decay, the diagonal-cross peak contrast is reduced. The remaining long time signal is determined by dark state relaxation and is no longer associated with either polariton branch. DQC spectra provide a complementary view of the same model. The double-quantum frequency axis resolves the structure of the double-excitation manifold, while the T 1 dependence monitors the phase evolution and decay of coherence between the ground and single-excitation states. The DQC signal amplitude decays rapidly and oscillates with a period approximately twice that of the 2DES oscillations.

articles.title: Energy decomposition of dispersion-corrected density functional theory (DFT-D3 and DFT-D4) in terms of symmetry-adapted perturbation theory components
articles.abstract: Symmetry-adapted perturbation theory based on density functional theory [SAPT(DFT)] improves the electrostatic, exchange, and induction components compared to Hartree–Fock-based SAPT. However, the dispersion component of SAPT(DFT) converges slowly with the basis set and is a major computational bottleneck due to the requirement to compute frequency-dependent density susceptibilities. Here, we combine SAPT(DFT) with inexpensive Grimme -D3 and -D4 damped asymptotic dispersion corrections to obtain physically meaningful energy components and accurate interaction energies, even in augmented double- ζ basis sets. However, we find that an “intermolecular” approach to the -D4 correction, rather than a “supermolecular” one, is needed. We also introduce a prescription for obtaining a SAPT partitioning of conventional DFT-D interaction energies, which are quite accurate for a number of functionals and which also avoid the rather costly computation of SAPT(DFT) dispersion. Tests on a set of 4530 van der Waals dimers demonstrate that the latter approach using PBE0-D4 or B3LYP-D4 and the aug-cc-pVDZ basis yields interaction energy mean absolute errors below 0.2 kcal mol −1 vs benchmark values at the coupled-cluster complete-basis-set level [CCSD(T)/CBS], comparable with much more expensive SAPT2+3(CCD)/aug-cc-pVTZ calculations. Meanwhile, replacing dispersion in SAPT(PBE0)/aug-cc-pVDZ with a -D4 correction yields a mean absolute error below 0.3 kcal mol −1 for this test set. Both types of approximations are much faster than SAPT(DFT) or wavefunction-based SAPT computations of similar quality.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: BCH 2 exists
articles.abstract: The elusive boron carbene (BCH 2 ) free radical has been observed spectroscopically for the first time. The reactive species was generated in a free expansion discharge jet with a precursor mixture of trimethylboron (TMB) in high pressure argon. A 11 BCH 2 laser-induced fluorescence spectrum consisting of only two bands (000 and 201) was found in the 318–305 nm region, in accord with our prior ab initio predictions. Experiments utilizing TMB-d 9 and isotopically enriched 10 B TMB precursors confirmed the existence of the boron carbene species, despite the fact that it is predicted to be some 4000 cm −1 less stable than the HBCH global minimum. High resolution studies of the 0–0 bands of 11 BCH 2 , 11 BCD 2 , 10 BCH 2 , and 10 BCD 2 have yielded the rotational constants and molecular structures of boron carbene in the excited C̃ 2 B 2 and ground X̃ 2 A 1 states. In sharp contrast to the other group 13 carbenes (MCH 2 ; M = Al, Ga, In), which have 2 B 1 ground states and metal–carbon single bonds, X̃ 2 A 1 BCH 2 has a boron–carbon double bond with a length of 1.391(1) Å, a consequence of the better orbital match of the boron 2s and 2p orbitals with those of methylene.

articles.title: Thermochemistry of ReN and IrN: Bond dissociation energies of ReN + and IrN + and ionization energies of ReN and IrN
articles.abstract: The bond dissociation energies (BDEs) of ReN + and IrN + have been measured using a newly constructed cryogenically cooled ion photodissociation spectrometer to be D 0 (Re + -N) = 40 615(100) cm −1 [5.036(12) eV] and D 0 (Ir + -N) = 37 825(75) cm −1 [4.690(9) eV]. The ionization energy (IE) of IrN was measured to be IE(IrN) = 75 490(300) cm −1 [9.360(37) eV] using resonant 2-photon ionization (R2PI) spectroscopy. The values of D 0 (Ir + -N) and IE(IrN), along with previous measurements of D 0 (IrN) and IE(Ir), were used to complete the thermochemical cycle D 0 (IrN) + IE(Ir) − IE(IrN) − D 0 (Ir + -N) = 0, obtaining 264 ± 311 cm −1 after propagating errors by quadrature. Because IE(IrN) is by far the least precise value in the cycle, a more precise value is obtained using the other measurements in the thermochemical cycle, giving IE(IrN) = 75 754(83) cm −1 or 9.392(10) eV. The corresponding thermochemical cycle for ReN initially did not agree, prompting a remeasurement that gave IE(ReN) = 68 276(40) cm −1 [8.465(5) eV]. The previous D 0 (ReN) measurement was also reassessed, giving D 0 (ReN) = 45 575(75) cm −1 [5.651(15) eV]. The corresponding cycle for ReN now gives −134 ± 131 cm −1 . Predissociation-based measurements of BDEs necessarily provide upper limits only; there is always the possibility of a barrier to dissociation that could cause the measured values to be too high. The present results demonstrate that for molecules such as ReN and IrN, which have a high density of states at the ground separated atom limit, predissociation-based methods provide a highly accurate measurement of the BDE.

articles.title: Binary kagome superconducting candidates hosting topological electronic states
articles.abstract: Author(s): Xin-Wei Yi, Jing-Yang You, and Gang Su Binary kagome compounds emerge as an unexpectedly rich frontier for topological superconductivity. Through a high-throughput first-principles search spanning three structural families, the authors identify 84 phonon-mediated superconducting candidates with estimated T c above 3K; seven surpass the approximately 9K benchmark for ambient-pressure kagome superconductors. The leading candidate, Ti 3 Si, reaches an estimated T c of 15.2K and hosts nodal-line-derived drumhead surface states, while NbBi ( T c = 4.0K) combines a kagome flat band with Z 2 -derived Dirac-cone surface states near the Fermi level. This map establishes chemically simple, tunable platforms where superconductivity and diverse topological states converge, offering especially compelling targets for synthesis and experimental discovery. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, L091802] Published Mon Sep 28, 2026

articles.title: Spin rephasing helps quantum memories store single-photon states longer for future networks
articles.title_zh: 自旋重相可帮助量子存储器为未来网络存储更长的单光子状态
articles.abstract: We are continuously sending information to each other, transmitting zeros and ones through a giant network of connected computers and devices. Scientists are now trying to extend this familiar concept of the internet to the quantum realm, looking for an efficient way to exchange quantum rather than classical information: qubits instead of bits. The motivation is not just scientific curiosity. Qubits can be a 0, a 1 or any superposition of the two. They can also become entangled, showing a degree of correlation that is out of reach for classical bits.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们不断向彼此发送信息，通过连接的计算机和设备的巨大网络传输0和1。科学家们现在正试图将这种熟悉的互联网概念扩展到量子领域，寻找一种交换量子而不是经典信息的有效方式：量子比特而不是比特。动机不仅仅是科学上的好奇心。量子位可以是0、1或两者的任何叠加。它们也可能纠缠在一起，显示出一定程度的相关性，这是经典比特无法企及的。

articles.title: Optimization and Electrochemical Evaluation of PVA assisted Electrospun Polyindole Nanofibers for Supercapacitors
articles.title_zh: 用于超级电容器的PVA辅助电纺聚吲哚纳米纤维的优化和电化学评价
articles.abstract: Conducting polymer nanostructures exhibit good theoretical capacitance but there1D nanostructuring remains a challenge. In this study, polyindole nanofibers were successfully fabricated by electrospinning method using PVA as carrier polymer. For the investigation of its chemical, structural and morphological properties, XRD, FTIR and FESEM techniques were used. The electrochemical performance was evaluated by CV and GCD assessment in 3 M KOH electrolyte. XRD results confirmed the amorphous nature of polyindole whereas characteristic functional groups and vibrational modes were identified by FTIR. FESEM images revealed non-woven, bead free uniform nanofibers with average diameter ranging between 200–300 nm. Among the three electrodes, P2 exhibited highest specific capacitance of 387 F/g at scan rate of 5 mV/s and 356.7 F/g at 0.5 A/g from CV and GCD profiles respectively. Areal capacitance exhibited by P2 was found to be 1161 mF/ cm⁻² at 5 mV/s. Electrochemical study shows overall pseudocapacitive behavior of all three samples with significant super capacitance retained at higher scan rates and increased current densities, indicating good rate capability. Overall, these findings demonstrate the potential of as such fabricated electrospun polyindole nanofibers as a promising electrode material for supercapacitor applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 导电聚合物纳米结构表现出良好的理论电容，但1D纳米结构仍然是一个挑战。本研究以PVA为载体聚合物，采用静电纺丝法成功制备了聚吲哚纳米纤维。为了研究其化学、结构和形态特性，使用了XRD、FTIR和FESEM技术。在3 M KOH电解质中通过CV和GCD评估电化学性能。XRD结果证实了聚吲哚的非晶态性质，而特征官能团和振动模式通过FTIR识别。FESEM图像显示平均直径在200–300 nm之间的无纺无珠均匀纳米纤维。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 导电聚合物纳米结构表现出良好的理论电容，但1D纳米结构仍然是一个挑战。本研究以PVA为载体聚合物，采用静电纺丝法成功制备了聚吲哚纳米纤维。为了研究其化学、结构和形态特性，使用了XRD、FTIR和FESEM技术。在3 M KOH电解质中通过CV和GCD评估电化学性能。XRD结果证实了聚吲哚的非晶态性质，而特征官能团和振动模式通过FTIR识别。FESEM图像显示平均直径在200–300 nm之间的无纺无珠均匀纳米纤维。在三个电极中， P2在扫描速率为5 mV/s时显示最高比电容为387 F/g ，在0.5 A/g时分别显示最高比电容为356.7 F/g。在5 mV/s下， P2显示的面积电容为1161 mF/cm ”。电化学研究表明，所有三个样品的整体伪电容行为，在更高的扫描速率和增加的电流密度下保留了显着的超级电容，表明良好的速率能力。总体而言，这些发现证明了电纺聚吲哚纳米纤维作为超级电容器应用的有前景的电极材料的潜力。

articles.title: A Probabilistic Dual-Track Framework for Least-Cost Electrification in Sub-Saharan Africa
articles.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲最低成本电气化的概率双轨框架
articles.abstract: Sub-Saharan Africa retains the world's largest electricity access deficit. This study develops a Dual-Track Energy Architecture (DTEA) that routes decentralised renewable supply to dispersed households while concentrating grid investment on industrial and high-load demand, using a lifetime net-present-value model with country-specific discount rates (9–15% WACC), post-connection demand growth (2–7%/yr), and reliability-adjusted supply costs, with parameter uncertainty propagated through a Monte Carlo simulation (M = 20,000 draws per country, 8 correlated parameters) across five countries. Median break-even distances span more than an order of magnitude: 0.0 km in the DRC (P5–P95: 0.0–2.4), 1.1 km in Nigeria (0.0–10.4), 8.1 km in Ghana (2.0–20.2), 8.6 km in Cameroon (1.7–22.1), and 15.3 km in Namibia (5.7–35.1). Reliability adjustment is decisive: a naive tariff-based lifetime model overstates the Nigerian threshold by roughly 25× (27.8 km vs. 1.1 km) and the DRC threshold by more than 10× (11.6 km vs. 0.0 km). Spearman sensitivity analysis shows grid availability and grid cost dominate in weak-grid countries, while line cost and connection density dominate in Namibia, where reliable grids hold. Adding a 1,500 kWh/yr productive-use load extends Namibia's break-even distance from 15.3 km to 45.0 km but leaves the DRC's at 0.0 km, confirming that anchor loads strengthen the case for grid investment only where grid reliability already supports it. Applying the resulting probabilistic zoning to 2,500 settlements samples (CIESIN GHSL/MSPHP, OpenStreetMap grid distances, Meta Relative Wealth Index) under an identical rule in every country, with distance measured against a single voltage class, classifies 33.0% of Namibian settlements as grid-priority versus 98.0% of DRC settlements and 71.4–77.2% of Nigerian and Cameroonian settlements as decentralised-only, and relative wealth declines significantly with distance from the mapped network in each of the five countries tested separately. These results are derived from literature-sourced parameters and are presented as a framework demonstration rather than calibrated country forecasts.
articles.abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲仍然是世界上最大的电力供应缺口。本研究开发了一种双轨能源架构（ DTEA ） ，将分散的可再生能源供应路由到分散的家庭，同时将电网投资集中在工业和高负荷需求上，使用具有国家特定折扣率（ 9-15 ％ WACC ） ，连接后需求增长（ 2-7 ％/年）和可靠性调整供应成本的终身净现值模型，并通过蒙特卡罗模拟传播参数不确定性（ M =每个国家20,000次， 8相关参数）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 撒哈拉以南非洲仍然是世界上最大的电力供应缺口。本研究开发了一种双轨能源架构（ DTEA ） ，将分散的可再生能源供应路由到分散的家庭，同时将电网投资集中在工业和高负荷需求上，使用具有国家特定折扣率（ 9-15 ％ WACC ） ，连接后需求增长（ 2-7 ％/年）和可靠性调整供应成本的终身净现值模型，并通过蒙特卡罗模拟传播参数不确定性（ M =每个国家20,000次， 8相关参数）。盈亏平衡距离中位数跨度超过一个数量级：刚果民主共和国为0.0公里（ P5-P95 ： 0.0-2.4 ） ，尼日利亚为1.1公里（ 0.0-10.4 ） ，加纳为8.1公里（ 2.0-20.2 ） ，喀麦隆为8.6公里（ 1.7-22.1 ） ，纳米比亚为15.3公里（ 5.7-35.1 ）。可靠性调整具有决定性：基于关税的天真终身模型将尼日利亚门槛夸大了大约25倍（ 27.8公里对1.1公里） ，将刚果民主共和国门槛夸大了10倍以上（ 11.6公里对0.0公里）。Spearman敏感性分析显示，电网可用性和电网成本在弱电国家占主导地位，而线路成本和连接密度在可靠电网所在的纳米比亚占主导地位。增加1,500千瓦时/年的生产性使用负荷将纳米比亚的盈亏平衡距离从15.3公里延长至45.0公里，但刚果民主共和国的盈亏平衡距离仍为0.0公里，这证实了锚定负荷仅在电网可靠性已经支持的情况下才会加强电网投资。将由此产生的概率分区应用于每个国家相同规则下的2,500个定居点样本（ CIESIN GHSL/MSPHP、OpenStreetMap网格距离、元相对财富指数） ，以单个电压等级测量距离，将33.0%的纳米比亚定居点归类为网格优先级，将98.0%的刚果民主共和国定居点和71.4-77.2%的尼日利亚和喀麦隆定居点归类为仅分散式，相对财富随距离分别测试五个国家的映射网络。这些结果来自文献来源的参数，并作为框架演示而不是校准的国家预测呈现。

articles.title: Achieving Heisenberg limit under noisy conditions with quantum Zeno dynamics and dynamical decoupling
articles.title_zh: 通过量子Zeno动力学和动力学解耦在噪声条件下达到Heisenberg极限
articles.abstract: Quantum Zeno dynamics (QZD) and dynamical decoupling (DD) are useful tools that enable the effective suppression of noise in quantum systems. We consider the problem of when (i) noise can be suppressed and (ii) Heisenberg limit (HL) can be achieved in quantum metrology, and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for when QZD and DD are useful for achieving these two goals. We further show this condition can hold even when the Hamiltonian-not-in-Lindblad-span (HNLS) condition fails, allowing QZD/DD to recover Heisenberg scaling beyond what is certified by the usual HNLS-based quantum error correction (QEC) criterion. Finally, we demonstrate that the combination of both techniques can allow individually imperfect QZD and DD strategies to saturate HL.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子芝诺动力学（ QZD ）和动态解耦（ DD ）是有效抑制量子系统噪声的有用工具。我们考虑了量子计量中何时可以抑制噪声和何时可以达到海森堡极限（ HL ）的问题，并证明了QZD和DD何时可用于实现这两个目标的必要和充分条件。我们进一步表明，即使在Hamiltonian-not-in-Lindblad-span （ HNLS ）条件失败时，这种情况仍然存在，允许QZD/DD恢复Heisenberg缩放，超出了通常基于HNLS的量子纠错（ QEC ）标准所证明的范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子芝诺动力学（ QZD ）和动态解耦（ DD ）是有效抑制量子系统噪声的有用工具。我们考虑了量子计量中何时可以抑制噪声和何时可以达到海森堡极限（ HL ）的问题，并证明了QZD和DD何时可用于实现这两个目标的必要和充分条件。我们进一步表明，即使在Hamiltonian-not-in-Lindblad-span （ HNLS ）条件失败时，这种情况仍然存在，允许QZD/DD恢复Heisenberg缩放，超出了通常基于HNLS的量子纠错（ QEC ）标准所证明的范围。最后，我们证明，两种技术的结合可以使个别不完美的QZD和DD策略使HL饱和。

articles.title: AI-Assisted Link Quality Prediction for Weather-Aware Outdoor Terahertz Communications: Forecasting, Uncertainty, and Explainability Analysis
articles.title_zh: 用于天气感知室外太赫兹通信的人工智能辅助链路质量预测：预测、不确定性和可解释性分析
articles.abstract: Outdoor terahertz (THz) communication links suffer severe, time-varying degradation from rain and atmospheric attenuation, yet most prior work including our earlier study evaluates this impairment at fixed, discrete rain rates rather than forecasting it as a dynamic process. This paper proposes a real-weather driven THz channel and Link Quality Index (LQI) forecasting framework: a composite, application-relevant metric combining channel, reliability, and hard ware margins, computed by a physics-based simulator (ITU-R P.838-3 rain attenuation, ITU-R P.676 gaseous attenuation, and a modified Friis link bud get) driven by six years of hourly meteorological observations (51,888 records) from Sylhet , Bangladesh. We benchmark seven forecasting models and these are persistence, linear regression, random forest, XGBoost, GRU, LSTM, and a Transformer across four forecast horizons (1, 3, 6, and 12 hours) under a leak-free chronological 70/15/15 split, with hyperparameter sensitivity, multi-seed robust ness, Diebold–Mariano significance testing, Monte Carlo Dropout uncertainty calibration, SHAP explainability, a feature-group ablation, and a degradation conditioned stratified evaluation. Results show forecast skill of 21.5%–31.4% over persistence, well-calibrated but progressively overconfident uncertainty at longer horizons, and substantially higher error during rain and low-LQI conditions. To further validate the framework, we apply the identical pipeline to a second, climatically contrasting site (Rajshahi, Bangladesh) and find that the centralting site (Rajshahi, Bangladesh) and find that the central conclusions, including that aggregate metrics hide severe forecast failures under degraded conditions, hold consistently across both sites.
articles.abstract_zh: 室外太赫兹 (THz) 通信链路因降雨和大气衰减而遭受严重的、随时间变化的退化，但大多数先前的工作，包括我们早期的研究，都是在固定、离散的降雨率下评估这种损害，而不是将其作为动态过程进行预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 室外太赫兹 (THz) 通信链路因降雨和大气衰减而遭受严重的、随时间变化的退化，但大多数先前的工作，包括我们早期的研究，都是在固定、离散的降雨率下评估这种损害，而不是将其作为动态过程进行预测。本文提出了一个真实天气驱动的太赫兹信道和链路质量指数（LQI）预测框架：一个综合的、与应用相关的指标，结合了信道、可靠性和硬件裕度，由基于物理的模拟器（ITU-R P.838-3雨衰、ITU-R P.676气体衰减和修改后的弗里斯链路预算）计算得出，该模拟器由六年来的每小时气象观测（51,888条记录）驱动。孟加拉国锡尔赫特。我们对七个预测模型进行了基准测试，这些模型是持久性、线性回归、随机森林、XGBoost、GRU、LSTM 和 Transformer，在无泄漏时间顺序 70/15/15 分割下跨越四个预测范围（1、3、6 和 12 小时），具有超参数敏感性、多种子鲁棒性、Diebold-Mariano 显着性测试、蒙特卡罗 Dropout 不确定性校准、SHAP 可解释性、特征组消融和降解条件分层评估。结果显示，预测技巧在持久性方面的预测能力为 21.5%–31.4%，在较长的时间范围内经过良好校准但逐渐过度自信的不确定性，并且在降雨和低 LQI 条件下误差显着更高。为了进一步验证该框架，我们将相同的管道应用于第二个气候对比站点（孟加拉国拉杰沙希），并发现中心站点（孟加拉国拉杰沙希）并发现中心结论（包括汇总指标隐藏了退化条件下严重的预测失败）在两个站点中保持一致。

articles.title: Enhancing energy resilience and efficiency in port energy systems: An integrated framework for resilience assessment
articles.title_zh: 增强港口能源系统的能源弹性和效率：弹性评估综合框架
articles.abstract: Maritime ports are increasingly conceptualized as energy hubs, i.e., interfaces between diverse energy infrastructures capable of producing, converting, storing, and consuming energy. However, this transformation merges two critical infrastructures, maritime transportation and energy systems, thereby amplifying exposure to systemic shocks and cross-system disruptions. Strengthening the energy resilience and efficiency of port energy systems is therefore essential. This study defines and validates a comprehensive set of resilience indicators for assessing energy systems in general and port energy systems in particular, making two primary contributions: First, it conceptualizes an Energy Resilience Matrix that organizes 77 resilience indicators across four system layers — Infrastructure, Information, Governance, and Community — and four resilience functions: Plan/Prepare, Absorb, Recover, and Adapt. Second, it incorporates port authority perspectives to evaluate the practical relevance of these indicators for port energy systems. Empirical findings support the strategic utility of both the indicators and the Energy Resilience Matrix as tools for building energy resilience capacity and efficiency. Nevertheless, the research also offers a critical reflection on indicator-based approaches to resilience measurement. Respondents identified challenges in operationalizing certain indicators due to financial and technological constraints. Moreover, an overreliance on quantitative metrics risks producing a technocentric perspective that marginalizes the governance structures and stakeholder communities integral to systemic resilience. These limitations point to the need for future research exploring alternative frameworks better suited to capturing the multidimensional character of energy resilience, alongside the development of financial incentives and robust business cases to ensure the long-term economic viability of resilience interventions.
articles.abstract_zh: 海港越来越多地被概念化为能源中心，即能够生产、转换、储存和消耗能源的不同能源基础设施之间的接口。然而，这种转型融合了海运和能源系统这两个关键基础设施，从而放大了系统性冲击和跨系统破坏的风险。因此，加强港口能源系统的能源弹性和效率至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 海港越来越多地被概念化为能源中心，即能够生产、转换、储存和消耗能源的不同能源基础设施之间的接口。然而，这种转型融合了海运和能源系统这两个关键基础设施，从而放大了系统性冲击和跨系统破坏的风险。因此，加强港口能源系统的能源弹性和效率至关重要。本研究定义并验证了一套全面的弹性指标，用于评估一般能源系统，特别是港口能源系统，做出了两个主要贡献：首先，它概念化了一个能源弹性矩阵，该矩阵组织了四个系统层（基础设施、信息、治理和社区）的 77 个弹性指标以及四个弹性功能：计划/准备、吸收、恢复和适应。其次，它结合了港务局的观点来评估这些指标对港口能源系统的实际相关性。实证结果支持指标和能源弹性矩阵作为建设能源弹性能力和效率的工具的战略效用。尽管如此，该研究也对基于指标的复原力测量方法进行了批判性反思。受访者指出，由于财务和技术限制，在实施某些指标方面存在挑战。此外，过度依赖定量指标可能会产生以技术为中心的观点，从而使治理结构和利益相关者社区边缘化，而这些是系统弹性的组成部分。这些局限性表明，未来的研究需要探索更适合捕捉能源弹性的多维特征的替代框架，同时制定财政激励措施和强有力的商业案例，以确保弹性干预措施的长期经济可行性。

articles.title: Sustainable Valorization of Ceramic Waste for the Fabrication of Ceramic Membranes for As(V) Removal
articles.title_zh: 陶瓷废料的可持续增值，用于制造去除 As(V) 的陶瓷膜
articles.abstract: The valorization of industrial ceramic waste into functional separation materials offers a promising route toward reducing membrane fabrication costs while mitigating solid-waste disposal. This study developed a low-cost ceramic membrane using ceramic dust and wall ceramic sludge as the sole inorganic raw materials, followed by surface functionalization with polyamide 6 (PA6) and Fe2O3 to treat the arsenic-contaminated water. The waste-derived membrane was prepared using a 3:1 sludge-to-dust ratio and sintered at 1100°C for 1.75 h. The resulting membrane exhibited 19.15 MPa flexural strength and a permeability of 103.75 L/m2.h. Surface modification decreased the overall porosity from 39.7% to 35.5% and reduced the median pore diameter from 0.615 to 0.420 µm, confirming pore-coating and partial pore narrowing. SEM-EDX and FTIR analyses verified the incorporation of Fe2O3 and PA6 onto the membrane surface. The modified membrane exhibited a zeta potential of 6.84 and achieved As(V) rejection of 84% with a flux of 394.25 L/m2.h at an initial concentration of 1ppm. The membrane also demonstrated 90.0% flux recovery and only 9.2% irreversible fouling, highlighting its potential for sustainable treatment of arsenic-contaminated water.
articles.abstract_zh: 将工业陶瓷废物转化为功能性分离材料，为降低膜制造成本同时减少固体废物处理提供了一条有前途的途径。本研究以陶瓷粉尘和壁陶瓷污泥为唯一无机原料，开发了一种低成本陶瓷膜，然后用聚酰胺6（PA6）和Fe2O3进行表面功能化处理砷污染水。使用3:1的污泥与灰尘的比例制备废物源膜，并在1100℃下烧结1.75小时。所得膜的弯曲强度为19.15 MPa，渗透率为103.75 L/m2.h。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将工业陶瓷废物转化为功能性分离材料，为降低膜制造成本同时减少固体废物处理提供了一条有前途的途径。本研究以陶瓷粉尘和壁陶瓷污泥为唯一无机原料，开发了一种低成本陶瓷膜，然后用聚酰胺6（PA6）和Fe2O3进行表面功能化处理砷污染水。使用3:1的污泥与灰尘的比例制备废物源膜，并在1100℃下烧结1.75小时。所得膜的弯曲强度为19.15 MPa，渗透率为103.75 L/m2.h。表面改性将总孔隙率从 39.7% 降低至 35.5%，中值孔径从 0.615 µm 降低至 0.420 µm，证实了孔隙涂层和部分孔隙变窄。 SEM-EDX 和 FTIR 分析验证了 Fe2O3 和 PA6 掺入膜表面。改性膜的 zeta 电位为 6.84，初始浓度为 1ppm 时，As(V) 截留率为 84%，通量为 394.25 L/m2.h。该膜还表现出 90.0% 的通量恢复率和仅 9.2% 的不可逆污垢，凸显了其可持续处理砷污染水的潜力。

articles.title: Genome-Wide Identification, Abiotic Stress Responses, and Haplotype Variation of the OsMOT Gene Family in Rice
articles.title_zh: 水稻 OsMOT 基因家族的全基因组鉴定、非生物胁迫反应和单倍型变异
articles.abstract: Background Molybdenum (Mo) is an essential trace element for plants, playing critical roles in nitrogen metabolism, hormone biosynthesis, and stress responses. Molybdate transporters (MOTs) mediate molybdate uptake, translocation, and distribution, and are essential for maintaining cellular molybdenum homeostasis. To date, the functional differentiation, abiotic stress response patterns, and genome-wide allelic variation landscape of the MOT family across global rice (Oryza sativa) germplasm collections remain poorly understood.Results Through homologous sequence alignment and conserved domain verification, we identified four MOT genes in the Oryza sativa genome, clustered into two subfamilies, MOT1 and MOT2. All members harbor a transmembrane domain of the major facilitator superfamily (MFS). Phylogenetic, gene structure, and protein 3D structure prediction analyses revealed segmental duplication as the primary driver of family expansion, with the family evolving under dominant purifying selection. The two subfamilies exhibit pronounced divergence in channel geometry and substrate recognition: MOT1 uses a cooperative hydrogen bond-salt bridge network, while MOT2 forms a hydrogen bond interface with few polar residues. Protein-protein interaction network prediction linked the MOT family to the molybdopterin biosynthesis pathway. Tissue expression profiling and abiotic stress qRT-PCR assays revealed spatiotemporal functional divergence between the two subfamilies: OsMOT1;2 responded rapidly and specifically to salt stress, while OsMOT2;1 responded broadly to multiple abiotic stresses. Haplotype analysis of global rice germplasm whole-genome resequencing data further showed the highest MOT family diversity in the Southeast Asia-South China rice domestication center, with clear indica-japonica differentiation and reduced diversity after transcontinental introduction.Conclusions This study provides insights into the functional differentiation of the rice MOT family from evolutionary, structural, transcriptional, and population genetic perspectives, characterizes the predicted structural features and stress response patterns of the MOT2 subfamily, and uncovers the haplotype distribution and domestication trajectory of MOT genes across global rice germplasms. These findings provide a theoretical basis and candidate genes for improving molybdenum use efficiency and stress tolerance in rice breeding.
articles.abstract_zh: 背景钼（Mo）是植物必需的微量元素，在氮代谢、激素生物合成和胁迫反应中发挥着关键作用。钼酸盐转运蛋白 (MOT) 介导钼酸盐的吸收、易位和分布，对于维持细胞钼稳态至关重要。迄今为止，我们对全球水稻种质资源中 MOT 家族的功能分化、非生物胁迫响应模式和全基因组等位基因变异格局仍知之甚少。结果通过同源序列比对和保守域验证，我们在水稻基因组中鉴定了 4 个 MOT 基因，分为两个亚家族：MOT1 和 MOT2。所有成员都具有主要促进子超家族 (MFS) 的跨膜结构域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景钼（Mo）是植物必需的微量元素，在氮代谢、激素生物合成和胁迫反应中发挥着关键作用。钼酸盐转运蛋白 (MOT) 介导钼酸盐的吸收、易位和分布，对于维持细胞钼稳态至关重要。迄今为止，我们对全球水稻种质资源中 MOT 家族的功能分化、非生物胁迫响应模式和全基因组等位基因变异格局仍知之甚少。结果通过同源序列比对和保守域验证，我们在水稻基因组中鉴定了 4 个 MOT 基因，分为两个亚家族：MOT1 和 MOT2。所有成员都具有主要促进子超家族 (MFS) 的跨膜结构域。系统发育、基因结构和蛋白质 3D 结构预测分析表明，片段重复是家族扩张的主要驱动力，家族在显性纯化选择下进化。这两个亚家族在通道几何结构和底物识别方面表现出明显的差异：MOT1 使用协作的氢键-盐桥网络，而 MOT2 形成具有很少极性残基的氢键界面。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络预测将 MOT 家族与钼蝶呤生物合成途径联系起来。组织表达谱和非生物胁迫 qRT-PCR 检测揭示了两个亚家族之间的时空功能差异：OsMOT1;2 对盐胁迫做出快速且特异性的反应，而 OsMOT2;1 对多种非生物胁迫广泛响应。对全球水稻种质全基因组重测序数据的单倍型分析进一步显示，东南亚-华南水稻驯化中心的MOT家族多样性最高，籼粳分化明显，跨大陆引入后多样性降低。全球水稻种质中 MOT 基因的驯化轨迹。这些研究结果为提高水稻育种中钼利用效率和抗逆性提供了理论依据和候选基因。

articles.title: Explainable artificial intelligence in interface design influences user outcomes and cybersecurity literacy
articles.title_zh: 界面设计中的可解释人工智能会影响用户结果和网络安全素养
articles.abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) exposes information that users can examine when assessing AI-generated recommendations. However, limited evidence is available on whether explanation-supported interaction develops competencies relevant to privacy and cybersecurity literacy. This study examined whether an XAI-enhanced design tool affects creative confidence, perceived learning, reported trust, perceived autonomy, and usability during a UI design task. We conducted a controlled between-groups experiment with 128 participants. Participants were randomly assigned to an XAI condition (n = 64) or a standard AI condition (n = 64). Both groups completed the same UI design task. The XAI tool presented rationales and trade-offs with each suggestion, whereas the standard tool presented suggestions alone. Results show that the XAI condition produced a larger creative-confidence gain (d = 0.68). Post-task perceived learning (d = 1.17) reported trust (d = 0.97), and perceived autonomy (d = 0.42; all p<.05) were also higher. Usability was higher under XAI (d = 1.78). Logged interaction counts were higher in XAI condition (d = 2.66). Across the full sample, these counts correlated with perceived learning, reported trust, usability, and task quality (all r≥.35). Thus, XAI was associated with stronger self-reported outcomes and higher usability during AI-assisted design. The findings support explanations as an interface feature that may promote critical engagement with AI recommendations. However, trust calibration, privacy literacy, dark-pattern recognition, and resistance to deceptive interfaces were not measured directly. The results indicate potential relevance to privacy and cybersecurity literacy, not demonstrated behavioural resilience. Direct transfer should be evaluated using realistic privacy-decision tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 可解释的人工智能 (XAI) 公开了用户在评估人工智能生成的建议时可以检查的信息。然而，关于解释支持的互动是否能培养与隐私和网络安全素养相关的能力，证据有限。本研究检验了 XAI 增强型设计工具是否会影响 UI 设计任务期间的创意信心、感知学习、报告信任、感知自主性和可用性。我们对 128 名参与者进行了一项对照组间实验。参与者被随机分配到 XAI 条件 (n = 64) 或标准 AI 条件 (n = 64)。两个小组完成了相同的 UI 设计任务。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可解释的人工智能 (XAI) 公开了用户在评估人工智能生成的建议时可以检查的信息。然而，关于解释支持的互动是否能培养与隐私和网络安全素养相关的能力，证据有限。本研究检验了 XAI 增强型设计工具是否会影响 UI 设计任务期间的创意信心、感知学习、报告信任、感知自主性和可用性。我们对 128 名参与者进行了一项对照组间实验。参与者被随机分配到 XAI 条件 (n = 64) 或标准 AI 条件 (n = 64)。两个小组完成了相同的 UI 设计任务。 XAI 工具提出了每项建议的理由和权衡，而标准工具则单独提出建议。结果表明，XAI 条件产生了更大的创意信心增益 (d = 0.68)。任务后感知学习 (d = 1.17) 报告的信任 (d = 0.97) 和感知自主性 (d = 0.42；所有 p<.05) 也较高。 XAI 下的可用性更高 (d = 1.78)。 XAI 条件下记录的交互计数较高 (d = 2.66)。在整个样本中，这些计数与感知学习、报告信任、可用性和任务质量相关（所有 r≥.35）。因此，XAI 与人工智能辅助设计期间更强的自我报告结果和更高的可用性相关。研究结果支持解释作为一种界面功能，可以促进对人工智能建议的关键参与。然而，信任校准、隐私素养、暗模式识别和对欺骗性界面的抵抗力并未直接测量。结果表明与隐私和网络安全素养的潜在相关性，而不是表现出的行为弹性。应使用现实的隐私决策任务来评估直接转移。

articles.title: Seasonal Variability of Soil Radon Exhalation Under Climate Forcing: An Example of Humid Subtropical Highland Climate
articles.title_zh: 气候强迫下土壤氡析出的季节变化：湿润亚热带高原气候的一个例子
articles.abstract: Radon (²²²Rn) migrates from soil to the atmosphere by molecular diffusion and pressure-driven advection while decaying with a 3.82-day half-life. Surface exhalation varies seasonally because the two governing soil properties, the effective diffusion coefficient and the radon source strength, both depend on soil moisture and temperature. Existing one-dimensional models are typically solved at steady state or with static properties, and few openly available tools ingest meteorological forcing to resolve the flux as a time-evolving signal. We present a model that solves the full transient diffusion–advection–decay equation in a layered 1-D soil column (0–200 cm) using an implicit Crank–Nicolson scheme. The effective diffusion coefficient follows the Rogers–Nielson moisture relation with a gas-kinetic temperature correction; pore air–water partitioning uses the temperature-dependent Ostwald coefficient; emanation responds to moisture and temperature; and a damped analytical thermal wave plus a leaky-bucket moisture model translate monthly climate inputs into depth- and time-resolved forcing. The solver matches the exact analytical steady state to a root-mean-square error of 0.0003%. Under idealized seasonal forcing representative of a humid subtropical highland (Murree-type) climate, the modelled flux is strongly bimodal: a pre-monsoon June maximum from warm, drying soil, a pronounced July–August monsoon minimum where high saturation collapses diffusivity and traps radon at depth, and an autumn recovery. The annual mean is ~ 245 Bq m⁻² h⁻¹ with a peak-to-peak range near 40%. Sensitivity analysis shows near-linear scaling with radium activity, emanation and bulk density, and nonlinear response to porosity and moisture. A factorial attribution experiment shows the two controls act nearly additively, moisture contributing a larger variance share (≈ 60%) than temperature (≈ 40%); moisture alone reproduces the bimodal shape, temperature alone a single summer maximum. This competition between moisture-enhanced emanation and moisture-suppressed diffusion reconciles the apparent paradox that wetting raises soil-air radon yet can reduce exhalation, providing a reproducible, climate-forced framework for interpreting exhalation time series and generating hypotheses about climate-driven change.
articles.abstract_zh: 氡气 (²²²Rn) 通过分子扩散和压力驱动的平流从土壤迁移到大气中，同时衰变，半衰期为 3.82 天。地表呼气随季节变化，因为有效扩散系数和氡源强度这两个控制土壤特性都取决于土壤湿度和温度。现有的一维模型通常在稳态或静态属性下求解，并且很少有公开可用的工具吸收气象强迫来将通量解析为随时间演化的信号。我们提出了一个模型，该模型使用隐式克兰克-尼科尔森方案求解分层一维土柱（0-200 cm）中的完整瞬态扩散-平流-衰变方程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氡气 (²²²Rn) 通过分子扩散和压力驱动的平流从土壤迁移到大气中，同时衰变，半衰期为 3.82 天。地表呼气随季节变化，因为有效扩散系数和氡源强度这两个控制土壤特性都取决于土壤湿度和温度。现有的一维模型通常在稳态或静态属性下求解，并且很少有公开可用的工具吸收气象强迫来将通量解析为随时间演化的信号。我们提出了一个模型，该模型使用隐式克兰克-尼科尔森方案求解分层一维土柱（0-200 cm）中的完整瞬态扩散-平流-衰变方程。有效扩散系数遵循带有气体动力学温度校正的罗杰斯-尼尔森湿度关系；孔隙空气-水分配使用与温度相关的奥斯特瓦尔德系数；散发对湿度和温度有反应；阻尼分析热波加上漏桶湿度模型将每月的气候输入转化为深度和时间分辨的强迫。求解器将精确的分析稳态与 0.0003% 的均方根误差相匹配。在代表湿润亚热带高原（穆里型）气候的理想化季节性强迫下，模拟的通量具有强烈的双峰性：季风前六月的最大值来自温暖、干燥的土壤，明显的七月至八月季风最小值，其中高饱和度破坏扩散性并在深处捕获氡气，以及秋季恢复。年均值约为 245 Bq m⁻² h⁻1，峰峰值范围接近 40%。灵敏度分析显示，镭活度、散发量和堆积密度呈近线性比例，而孔隙度和湿度呈非线性响应。因子归因实验表明，两个控制几乎相加，湿度贡献的方差份额 (≈ 60%) 比温度 (≈ 40%) 更大；单独的湿度再现双峰形状，单独的温度再现单个夏季最大值。水分增强的散发和水分抑制的扩散之间的竞争调和了明显的悖论，即湿润会增加土壤-空气氡气，但会减少呼气，为解释呼气时间序列和生成有关气候驱动的变化的假设提供了一个可重复的、气候强制的框架。

articles.title: Operator Learning for Exploring Frequency Effects in CO2 Radio-Frequency Discharges under Martian Conditions
articles.title_zh: 探索火星条件下CO2射频放电频率效应的操作员学习
articles.abstract: Carbon dioxide (CO2) conversion under Martian conditions is of growing importance for both future space exploration and sustainable carbon utilization. Here, we develop an operator-learning framework based on the deep operator network (DeepONet) to resolve the frequency-dependent behavior of radio-frequency (RF) CO2 discharges at Martian atmospheric pressure. A high-fidelity and self-consistent fluid model, coupled with a reduced kinetic mechanism involving 26 species and 278 reactions, is employed to construct a high-dimensional dataset that captures the strongly coupled spatiotemporal plasma dynamics. The resulting neural operator provides nearly instantaneous, mesh-independent predictions of 28 key physical quantities over a continuous frequency range from 13.56 to 100 MHz, thereby moving beyond conventional pointwise surrogate modeling toward field-level operator learning for plasma simulation. The results show that increasing the driving frequency enhances electron confinement and bulk plasma density while reducing the sheath thickness and maintenance voltage. At higher frequencies, the discharge undergoes a pronounced transition from high-energy electron heating to a high-density, low-electron-temperature regime, redirecting the dominant energy coupling from electronic excitation toward vibrational ladder-climbing pathways that favor CO2 activation. Benchmarking against the fluid model demonstrates excellent interpolation and extrapolation capability, with low relative errors and a reduction in computational cost by several orders of magnitude. This work establishes a fast and physically informative neural-operator tool for exploring frequency effects in low-temperature plasma systems and provides a promising computational foundation for optimizing Martian in situ resource utilization technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 火星条件下的二氧化碳（ CO2 ）转化对于未来的太空探索和可持续碳利用都越来越重要。在这里，我们开发了一个基于深度运营商网络（ DeepONet ）的运营商学习框架，以解决火星大气压下射频（ RF ）二氧化碳排放的频率依赖性行为。采用高保真和自洽的流体模型，加上涉及26种和278种反应的简化动力学机制，来构建捕获强耦合时空等离子体动力学的高维数据集。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 火星条件下的二氧化碳（ CO2 ）转化对于未来的太空探索和可持续碳利用都越来越重要。在这里，我们开发了一个基于深度运营商网络（ DeepONet ）的运营商学习框架，以解决火星大气压下射频（ RF ）二氧化碳排放的频率依赖性行为。采用高保真和自洽的流体模型，加上涉及26种和278种反应的简化动力学机制，来构建捕获强耦合时空等离子体动力学的高维数据集。由此产生的神经算子在13.56至100 MHz的连续频率范围内为28个关键物理量提供近乎即时的、与网格无关的预测，从而超越传统的逐点代理建模，转向用于等离子体模拟的现场级算子学习。结果表明，增加驱动频率可提高电子约束和体等离子体密度，同时降低护套厚度和维持电压。在更高的频率下，放电经历了从高能电子加热到高密度、低电子温度状态的明显转变，将主导能量耦合从电子激发转向有利于CO2激活的振动爬梯途径。对流体模型进行基准测试显示出出色的插值和外推能力，相对误差低，计算成本降低了几个数量级。这项工作为探索低温等离子系统中的频率效应建立了一个快速且物理信息丰富的神经操作工具，并为优化火星原位资源利用技术提供了有前途的计算基础。

articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29229v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This data article provides the datasets, symbolic derivations, and scripts used to reproduce master diagrams, stationary-phase spectra, windowed first-order coherence functions, and quantum-noise stability maps for strongly chirped dissipative solitons of the cubic-quintic complex Ginzburg-Landau equation in normal and anomalous group-delay dispersion regimes. The repository includes node-regularized normal-dispersion spectra and energies; small-parameter expansions of the branch roots; cavity-map gain-loss update relations; Airy uniformization at the normal-dispersion spectral edge; anomalous-dispersion spectra and coherence calculations; and processed tables for plotting and stability analysis. OriginLab projects are accompanied by open-format .csv/.txt numerical tables to support reuse without proprietary plotting software. Data and code repository: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22690899.

articles.title: Rare quantum state reveals particles with quarter-electron charge

articles.abstract: An electron's charge is normally fixed, like a coin you can't break into pieces. But if electrons are cooled close to absolute zero and trapped in a two-dimensional layer under a powerful magnetic field, they organize into a collective state of "quasiparticles" that seem to hold only a fraction of an electron's charge.
