articles.title: Competing magnetic and spin vestigial orders from continuum field theory
articles.title_zh: 来自连续场理论的相互竞争的磁性和自旋退化秩序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study magnetic systems featuring competing antiferromagnetic and spin-nematic phases, described by dipolar primary and quadrupolar secondary order parameters. While the antiferromagnetic phase breaks time-reversal and spin-rotational symmetries, only spin-rotational symmetry is broken in the nematic phase, which can be understood as a spin-vestigial phase. We develop a classical continuum field theory with independent vector and tensor fields and use mean-field and renormalization group methods to analyze its phases and finite-temperature transitions. We determine the fixed-point structure using an ϵ expansion about the upper critical dimension of six and track the resulting fixed points to lower dimensions using a perturbative fixed-dimension renormalization group approach. The multicritical fixed point governing the meeting of the antiferromagnetic, nematic, and paramagnetic phases occurs at imaginary coupling throughout the dimensions accessible to our analysis, indicating a first-order transition through the triple point. Away from the triple point, a direct paramagnetic-to-antiferromagnetic transition can be continuous when the tensor mass is sufficiently large, without an intervening vestigial phase. We argue that it is governed by the cubic universality class in d=3 and the Ising universality class in d=2 for three-component order parameters. The theory also supports a two-step transition with an intermediate spin-nematic phase. The paramagnetic-to-nematic transition is governed by the four-state Potts universality class in d=2 and is first order in d=3, while the nematic-to-antiferromagnetic transition is generically expected to be continuous and of Ising type in both dimensions. Our results provide a field-theoretical framework for understanding the finite-temperature transitions observed in the candidate Kitaev material Na₂Co₂TeO₆.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有竞争性反铁磁和自旋向列相位的磁性系统，由偶极子初级和四极子次级序参数描述。当反铁磁相打破时间反转和自旋旋转对称性时，只有自旋旋转对称性在向列相中被打破，这可以理解为自旋-研究相。我们开发了一个具有独立向量和张量场的经典连续体场论，并使用均值场和重整化群方法来分析其相位和有限温度跃迁。我们使用围绕六的上临界维度的扩展来确定固定点结构，并使用扰动固定维度重整群方法将所得固定点跟踪到较低维度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究具有竞争性反铁磁和自旋向列相位的磁性系统，由偶极子初级和四极子次级序参数描述。当反铁磁相打破时间反转和自旋旋转对称性时，只有自旋旋转对称性在向列相中被打破，这可以理解为自旋-研究相。我们开发了一个具有独立向量和张量场的经典连续体场论，并使用均值场和重整化群方法来分析其相位和有限温度跃迁。我们使用围绕六的上临界维度的扩展来确定固定点结构，并使用扰动固定维度重整群方法将所得固定点跟踪到较低维度。支配反铁磁相、向列相和顺磁相会议的多临界固定点发生在我们分析可访问的整个维度的虚耦合中，表明通过三重点的一阶过渡。远离三重点，当张量质量足够大时，直接顺磁-反铁磁转变可以是连续的，而无需中间退化相。我们认为，对于三分量阶参数，它受d = 3的三次普遍性类和d = 2的伊辛普遍性类支配。该理论还支持中间自旋向列相的两步过渡。顺磁-向列跃迁由d = 2中的四态Potts普遍性类控制，并且在d = 3中是一阶的，而向列-反铁磁跃迁通常预计是连续的，并且在两个维度上都是Ising类型。我们的结果提供了一个现场理论框架，用于理解在候选基塔耶夫材料Na ₂ Co ₂ TeO中观察到的有限温度跃迁。

articles.title: Stimulation of superconductivity in d-wave superconductors
articles.title_zh: D波超导体中超导电性的刺激
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the stimulation of superconductivity by an external electromagnetic radiation --- the Eliashberg effect --- in a disordered d-wave superconductor. We use the self-consistent Keldysh--Nambu quasiclassical formalism augmented by an inelastic relaxation term to compute the static correction to the pairing amplitude by treating elastic scattering within the Born approximation with the full second-order impurity vertex retained. We find that the clean d-wave superconductor shows no enhancement at any frequency: without a momentum relaxation channel a spatially uniform drive produces no absorption, only pair breaking. Elastic impurity scattering restores absorption and with it activates response in the Eliashberg channel. We find enhancement of the pairing amplitude which is confined to a bounded window in frequency, disorder strength, inelastic scattering rate and gap magnitude. Both edges of the window scale with the gap but are set by the competition between quasiparticle redistribution, heating and pair breaking rather than by a feature of the spectrum. Furthermore, in contrast to the s-wave when the threshold is pinned at 2Δ, the upper edge is not pinned to the maximum gap and crosses it as the system approaches the critical temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了无序d波超导体中外部电磁辐射（ Eliashberg效应）对超导性的刺激。我们使用自洽的Keldysh--Nambu准经典形式主义加上一个非弹性松弛项，通过在保留完全二阶杂质顶点的Born近似中处理弹性散射来计算对配对幅度的静态校正。我们发现干净的d波超导体在任何频率下都没有表现出增强：没有动量弛豫通道，空间均匀的驱动器不会产生吸收，只会断对。弹性杂质散射恢复吸收，并激活Eliashberg通道的响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了无序d波超导体中外部电磁辐射（ Eliashberg效应）对超导性的刺激。我们使用自洽的Keldysh--Nambu准经典形式主义加上一个非弹性松弛项，通过在保留完全二阶杂质顶点的Born近似中处理弹性散射来计算对配对幅度的静态校正。我们发现干净的d波超导体在任何频率下都没有表现出增强：没有动量弛豫通道，空间均匀的驱动器不会产生吸收，只会断对。弹性杂质散射恢复吸收，并激活Eliashberg通道的响应。我们发现配对振幅的增强局限于频率，无序强度，非弹性散射率和间隙幅度的有界窗口。窗口的两个边缘都带有间隙，但由准粒子再分布、加热和成对断裂之间的竞争而不是由光谱的特征来设置。此外，与阈值固定在2Δ时的s波相反，当系统接近临界温度时，上边缘不会固定到最大间隙并穿过它。

articles.title: Interaction induced flattening of optical transition quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 相互作用诱导的光跃迁量子几何平坦化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Riemannian geometry of optical transition dipoles has become a useful picture for understanding linear and nonlinear optical response. Here we argue that the interacting quantum geometry of optical transitions possesses a rich structure and can be naturally delineated into two types: localized and delocalized particle-hole excitations. The former possess uniform quantum geometry with flat (vanishing) Hermitian curvature; the latter possess non-uniform quantum geometry with non-vanishing Hermitian curvature. As a striking example, we find that uniform quantum geometry can be produced by electron-hole interactions: even when composed from extended Bloch states in the particle and hole bands, we find excitons have uniform and flat quantum geometry. By developing a many-body length gauge formulation of nonlinear response, we find this uniform and flat excitonic quantum geometry zeros its third-order circular photoconductivity in non-magnetic materials in stark contrast to its non-interacting counterparts. Similarly, the zero Hermitian curvature of localized optical transitions locks their Hall response to that of the ground state. This demonstrates the rich landscape of many-body optical response controlled by an interacting quantum geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学跃迁偶极子的黎曼几何已经成为理解线性和非线性光学响应的有用图片。在这里，我们认为光跃迁的相互作用量子几何具有丰富的结构，可以自然地划分为两种类型：局部粒子空穴激发和离域粒子空穴激发。前者具有均匀的量子几何，具有平坦（消失）的埃尔米特曲率；后者具有非均匀的量子几何，具有非消失的埃尔米特曲率。作为一个引人注目的例子，我们发现均匀量子几何可以通过电子-空穴相互作用产生：即使由粒子和空穴带中的扩展布洛赫态组成，我们也发现激子具有均匀和平坦的量子几何。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学跃迁偶极子的黎曼几何已经成为理解线性和非线性光学响应的有用图片。在这里，我们认为光跃迁的相互作用量子几何具有丰富的结构，可以自然地划分为两种类型：局部粒子空穴激发和离域粒子空穴激发。前者具有均匀的量子几何，具有平坦（消失）的埃尔米特曲率；后者具有非均匀的量子几何，具有非消失的埃尔米特曲率。作为一个引人注目的例子，我们发现均匀量子几何可以通过电子-空穴相互作用产生：即使由粒子和空穴带中的扩展布洛赫态组成，我们也发现激子具有均匀和平坦的量子几何。通过开发非线性响应的多体长度计公式，我们发现这种均匀和平坦的激子量子几何结构使其在非磁性材料中的三阶圆形光电导率为零，与其非相互作用的对应物形成鲜明对比。类似地，局部光跃迁的零埃尔米特曲率将它们的霍尔响应锁定到基态的霍尔响应。这展示了由相互作用的量子几何控制的多体光学响应的丰富景观。

articles.title: Defect Poisoning of Quantum Spin Ice
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋冰缺陷中毒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The hunt for a material realization of quantum spin ice has motivated more than two decades of experimental effort. The candidate materials inevitably contain crystal imperfections, such as magnetic vacancies, whose effects are often disregarded. Here, we show that experimentally relevant levels of dilution can qualitatively reshape the low-energy behavior, as nearby vacancies generate quantum fluctuations that are absent in the clean system. Already at dilution levels as low as two percent, well below those reported in cerium-based pyrochlores, these vacancy-induced processes connect percolating clusters of spins and dominate over the conventional quantum-spin-ice dynamics. We therefore argue that magnetic vacancies in current experiments can strongly contaminate, and potentially completely obscure, the sought-after signatures of quantum spin ice. We support these conclusions using large-scale, unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations and exact diagonalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 对量子自旋冰物质实现的追求激发了二十多年的实验努力。候选材料不可避免地含有晶体缺陷，例如磁性空位，其影响往往被忽视。在这里，我们表明，实验相关的稀释水平可以定性地重塑低能行为，因为附近的空缺会产生清洁系统中不存在的量子波动。这些空位诱导的过程已经处于低至2%的稀释水平，远低于铈基烧绿石中报道的稀释水平，这些空位诱导的过程连接了渗透的自旋簇，并在传统的量子自旋冰动力学中占主导地位。因此，我们认为，当前实验中的磁空位可能会严重污染并可能完全掩盖量子自旋冰的抢手特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对量子自旋冰物质实现的追求激发了二十多年的实验努力。候选材料不可避免地含有晶体缺陷，例如磁性空位，其影响往往被忽视。在这里，我们表明，实验相关的稀释水平可以定性地重塑低能行为，因为附近的空缺会产生清洁系统中不存在的量子波动。这些空位诱导的过程已经处于低至2%的稀释水平，远低于铈基烧绿石中报道的稀释水平，这些空位诱导的过程连接了渗透的自旋簇，并在传统的量子自旋冰动力学中占主导地位。因此，我们认为，当前实验中的磁空位可能会严重污染并可能完全掩盖量子自旋冰的抢手特征。我们使用大规模、无偏的量子蒙特卡罗模拟和精确对角化来支持这些结论。

articles.title: Large-Area SnS Crystals by Controlled Sn-S Chemical Vapor Deposition: Growth Optimization, Morphology, and Raman Characterization
articles.title_zh: 通过控制Sn-S化学气相沉积的大面积SnS晶体：生长优化，形貌和拉曼表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tin monosulfide (SnS) is a layered IV-VI semiconductor with strong in-plane anisotropy and promising properties for optoelectronic and ferroic applications. However, obtaining large, continuous, and morphologically well-defined SnS crystals remains challenging. Here, we report the growth of large-area SnS crystals using chemical vapor deposition with separate elemental Sn and S precursors. By controlling the precursor temperatures, source positions, substrate temperature, carrier-gas flow, and hydrogen flow, we obtain SnS crystals with lateral dimensions approaching 350 micrometers. The optimized growth occurs with the Sn source at approximately 750 degrees C, the S source at approximately 230 degrees C, and the substrate maintained near 650-680 degrees C, using Ar/H2 flow rates of 120/10 sccm. X-ray diffraction shows a dominant SnS (111) reflection with no detectable secondary crystalline tin-sulfide phase within the measurement sensitivity. Raman spectroscopy reveals six characteristic SnS phonon modes at approximately 39.3, 48.8, 95.2, 165.0, 193.1, and 219.1 cm⁻¹. In particular, the low-frequency modes near 39 and 49 cm⁻¹ are clearly resolved with FWHM values of approximately 2.52 and 2.37 cm⁻¹, respectively. SEM and AFM measurements further show large continuous crystals and a relatively smooth nanoscale surface. Growth on mica produces more regular square and rectangular flakes, with lateral dimensions approaching 300 x 300 micrometers, while crystals grown on SiO2/Si are more frequently fractured or irregular at their edges. These results demonstrate a practical growth window for obtaining large-area SnS crystals suitable for further optical, electrical, and device studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 一硫化锡（ SnS ）是一种层状IV-VI半导体，具有很强的面内各向异性，在光电和铁电应用中具有良好的性能。然而，获得大型、连续且形态明确的SnS晶体仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了使用具有单独元素Sn和S前体的化学气相沉积的大面积SnS晶体的生长。通过控制前驱体温度、源位置、衬底温度、载气流和氢气流，我们获得了横向尺寸接近350微米的SnS晶体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一硫化锡（ SnS ）是一种层状IV-VI半导体，具有很强的面内各向异性，在光电和铁电应用中具有良好的性能。然而，获得大型、连续且形态明确的SnS晶体仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了使用具有单独元素Sn和S前体的化学气相沉积的大面积SnS晶体的生长。通过控制前驱体温度、源位置、衬底温度、载气流和氢气流，我们获得了横向尺寸接近350微米的SnS晶体。使用120/10 sccm的Ar/H2流速，优化生长的Sn源温度约为750 ℃ ， S源温度约为230 ℃ ，衬底温度保持在650-680 ℃附近。X射线衍射显示在测量灵敏度内没有可检测到的二次结晶硫化锡相的主要SnS (111)反射。拉曼光谱揭示了约39.3、48.8、95.2、165.0、193.1和219.1厘米的六种特征SnS声子模态。特别是，接近39和49厘米的低频模式分别以约2.52和2.37厘米的FWHM值清晰地分辨出来。SEM和AFM测量进一步显示出大的连续晶体和相对光滑的纳米尺度表面。云母上的生长产生更规则的方形和矩形薄片，其横向尺寸接近300 x 300微米，而在SiO2/Si上生长的晶体在其边缘更频繁地断裂或不规则。这些结果证明了获得适合进一步光学、电学和器件研究的大面积SnS晶体的实用生长窗口。

articles.title: Altermagnetic Kondo Logic via Floquet Symmetry Conversion
articles.title_zh: 通过Floquet对称转换实现Altermagnetic Kondo逻辑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A common belief in Kondo physics is that a magnetic impurity can act as an efficient probe of key properties of its host bath. In altermagnets, however, this intuition fails in a symmetry-enforced way: the momentum-dependent spin splitting cancels in the local impurity spectrum, making a conventional single-impurity Kondo resonance essentially blind to the altermagnetic form factor. Here, we overcome this constraint by introducing Floquet symmetry conversion. We show that an in-plane AC field converts the hidden altermagnetic spin splitting into a locally detectable spin-dependent hybridization channel, which is further amplified by Kondo correlations into a novel altermagnetic Kondo effect. Remarkably, the Kondo splitting exhibits a nontrivial dependence on the field orientation and inherits the same crystalline form factor as the altermagnetic host, thereby serving as Kondo tomography of altermagnetic spin splitting. This field-controlled response further provides a natural route to symmetry-controlled Kondo logic gates. Our results establish a field-controllable altermagnetic Kondo effect, linking symmetry-resolved impurity spectroscopy to Kondo logic functionality.
articles.abstract_zh: 近藤物理学的一个普遍信念是，磁性杂质可以作为其主浴关键特性的有效探针。然而，在替代磁体中，这种直觉以对称强制的方式失败：动量依赖的自旋分裂抵消了局部杂质光谱，使得传统的单纯近藤共振基本上对替代磁性形状因子视而不见。在这里，我们通过引入Floquet对称转换来克服这一限制。我们表明，平面内交流场将隐藏的变磁自旋分裂转换为局部可检测的自旋依赖杂交通道，该通道通过近藤相关进一步放大为新的变磁近藤效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近藤物理学的一个普遍信念是，磁性杂质可以作为其主浴关键特性的有效探针。然而，在替代磁体中，这种直觉以对称强制的方式失败：动量依赖的自旋分裂抵消了局部杂质光谱，使得传统的单纯近藤共振基本上对替代磁性形状因子视而不见。在这里，我们通过引入Floquet对称转换来克服这一限制。我们表明，平面内交流场将隐藏的变磁自旋分裂转换为局部可检测的自旋依赖杂交通道，该通道通过近藤相关进一步放大为新的变磁近藤效应。值得注意的是， Kondo分裂表现出对场取向的不平凡依赖性，并继承了与替代磁性宿主相同的晶体形状因子，从而起到替代磁性自旋分裂的Kondo断层扫描的作用。这种场控响应进一步为对称控制的Kondo逻辑门提供了自然路径。我们的研究结果建立了可现场控制的近藤变磁效应，将对称分辨杂质光谱与近藤逻辑功能联系起来。

articles.title: Power-law growth of shift current with superlattice period in flat Chern bands
articles.title_zh: 平坦Chern频带中超晶格周期移位电流的幂律增长
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry governs a wide array of physical observables in topological quantum materials. In its ideal limit, quantum geometry yields exact bounds and analytical results for a growing class of observables. However, a comparable framework for the shift current remains elusive because it depends on geometric relations between multiple bands. In this work, we show that the shift current is proportional to the cyclotron shift, the displacement of the cyclotron center induced by Landau-level mixing. This mechanism yields a universal scaling law: the integrated weight and the peak magnitude scale as lⁱ⁺¹⁻ⁿ and l²ⁱ⁺¹⁻ⁿ in the magnetic length or moiré period l, where n is the momentum order of the symmetry-breaking perturbation and Δ E propto l⁻ⁱ is the level spacing. We verify the scaling law in exactly solvable chiral-N Landau levels under a uniform magnetic field and in Schrödinger and Dirac moiré skyrmion crystals, which capture the flat Chern bands of twisted MoTe₂ and twisted bilayer graphene. For a Schrödinger flat band with a distorted skyrmion texture, the integrated weight grows linearly with the moiré period and the resonant peak grows cubically.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何控制着拓扑量子材料中广泛的物理可观测物。在其理想极限中，量子几何为不断增长的可观测类提供了精确的界限和分析结果。然而，移位电流的可比框架仍然难以捉摸，因为它取决于多个频带之间的几何关系。在这项工作中，我们证明了偏移电流与回旋加速器偏移成比例，回旋加速器中心的位移是由Landau级混合引起的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子几何控制着拓扑量子材料中广泛的物理可观测物。在其理想极限中，量子几何为不断增长的可观测类提供了精确的界限和分析结果。然而，移位电流的可比框架仍然难以捉摸，因为它取决于多个频带之间的几何关系。在这项工作中，我们证明了偏移电流与回旋加速器偏移成比例，回旋加速器中心的位移是由Landau级混合引起的。该机制产生了一个通用的缩放定律：在磁长或莫尔周期l中，积分权重和峰值幅度尺度为l "* * * * * * * * ，其中n是对称破坏扰动的动量级， Δ E propto l * * * *是水平间距。我们在均匀磁场下以及在薛定谔和狄拉克莫尔斯卡米翁晶体中验证了精确可解的手性-N兰道水平上的缩放定律，这些晶体捕获了扭曲的MoTe ₂和扭曲的双层石墨烯的平坦Chern带。对于具有扭曲的skyrmion纹理的薛定谔平带，积分重量随着moiré周期线性增长，共振峰立方增长。

articles.title: A Renormalized Ginzburg-Landau Framework for Dimensional Crossover and Fluctuation Specific Heat in High-T_c Superconductors in a Magnetic Field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中高温超导体尺寸交叉和波动比热的重整Ginzburg-Landau框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28705v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of phase transitions and critical phenomena in high-temperature superconductors using a renormalized Ginzburg-Landau framework. Rather than assuming a conventional linear temperature dependence, we treat the quadratic coefficient as a self-consistent, Hartree-renormalized quantity determined by fluctuation-loop corrections. This renormalization regularizes mean-field divergences and yields a finite, dimensionality-dependent specific-heat anomaly near the transition. When an external magnetic field is applied, minimal coupling quantizes order-parameter fluctuations into discrete Landau levels, reducing the effective dimensionality via an effective spectral dimension. In this framework, the intrinsic fluctuation-coupling strength self-consistently determines the temperature width of the critical Ginzburg region, while the cyclotron energy of the quantized fluctuations uniquely establishes both the specific-heat peak position and the upper-critical-field crossover boundary. Comparison with YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ experimental data demonstrates that this approach captures the suppression of the sharp mean-field discontinuity and accurately reproduces the vortex-lattice topological structure under finite magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用重整的Ginzburg-Landau框架对高温超导体的相变和临界现象进行了理论分析。我们不是假设传统的线性温度依赖性，而是将二次系数视为由波动环校正确定的自洽的哈特里重整量。这种重整化使均值场发散正则化，并在过渡附近产生有限的、依赖于维度的比热异常。当施加外部磁场时，最小耦合将阶参数波动量化为离散的Landau水平，通过有效光谱维度降低有效维度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文使用重整的Ginzburg-Landau框架对高温超导体的相变和临界现象进行了理论分析。我们不是假设传统的线性温度依赖性，而是将二次系数视为由波动环校正确定的自洽的哈特里重整量。这种重整化使均值场发散正则化，并在过渡附近产生有限的、依赖于维度的比热异常。当施加外部磁场时，最小耦合将阶参数波动量化为离散的Landau水平，通过有效光谱维度降低有效维度。在此框架下，固有波动耦合强度自洽决定了临界Ginzburg区的温度宽度，而量化波动的回旋加速器能量唯一地建立了比热峰值位置和上临界场交叉边界。与YBa ₂ Cu恤O恤恤δ实验数据的比较表明，这种方法捕获了尖锐平均场不连续性的抑制，并精确地再现了有限磁场下的涡格拓扑结构。

articles.title: Intriguing topological superconductor phases in long-range extended Kitaev models: an interplay between sub-lattices and power-law interaction
articles.title_zh: 在远程扩展Kitaev模型中引人入胜的拓扑超导相位：子晶格和幂律相互作用之间的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The power-law profile of hopping and superconductivity introduces rich critical phenomena that are not possible to explore in the nearest-neighbor models. Having this in mind, we construct the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH)-Kitaev model with mono-, bi-, and tri-partite sub-lattices where superconductivity [hopping] is of power-law Kitaev [SSH] type. The long-range (LR) superconductivity can alone gap out the zero-momentum critical line while LR hopping alters the finite-momentum critical line. There exists open-ended critical line at vanishing superconducting gap on the phase diagram for all versions of the SSH-Kitaev model. Interestingly, LR superconductivity (hopping) promotes massive Dirac (Majorana zero) modes, while in a finite-size system, their emergence in open boundary conditions is caused by the bulk gap of the anti-periodic Hamiltonian in momentum space. This indicates an unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence for power-law models as compared to what is seen in the short-range models. Importantly, the thermodynamic phase boundaries are correctly reproduced by the above unconventional correspondence. Intriguingly, an even (odd) number of sub-lattices yields an integer (half-integer) winding number while the massive Dirac modes continue to survive irrespective of the sub-lattice profile as long as there exists LR pairing only.
articles.abstract_zh: 跳跃和超导的幂律剖面引入了在最近邻模型中无法探索的丰富临界现象。考虑到这一点，我们构造了Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) -Kitaev模型，其中超导[跳跃]是幂律Kitaev [SSH]类型的单、双和三方子格。远程（ LR ）超导可以单独与零动量临界线隔开，而LR跳跃改变了有限动量临界线。在SSH-Kitaev模型的所有版本的相位图上，存在消失超导间隙的开放式临界线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 跳跃和超导的幂律剖面引入了在最近邻模型中无法探索的丰富临界现象。考虑到这一点，我们构造了Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) -Kitaev模型，其中超导[跳跃]是幂律Kitaev [SSH]类型的单、双和三方子格。远程（ LR ）超导可以单独与零动量临界线隔开，而LR跳跃改变了有限动量临界线。在SSH-Kitaev模型的所有版本的相位图上，存在消失超导间隙的开放式临界线。有趣的是， LR超导（跳跃）促进了大规模狄拉克（ Majorana零）模式，而在有限尺寸系统中，它们在开放边界条件下的出现是由动量空间中反周期Hamiltonian的体间隙引起的。这表明与短程模型相比，幂律模型存在非常规的批量边界对应。重要的是，通过上述非常规对应正确地再现了热力学相界。有趣的是，偶数（奇数）子网格产生整数（半整数）绕组数，而大规模狄拉克模式继续存在，而不管子网格轮廓如何，只要存在LR配对。

articles.title: Plane-Wave Photon-Fock Cavity QED-DFT: Chiral-Cavity-Induced Topology in Graphene
articles.title_zh: 平面波光子场腔QED-DFT ：石墨烯中的手性腔诱导拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop an explicit plane-wave (PW) × photon-Fock approach to the quantized, velocity-gauge Pauli--Fierz Hamiltonian for periodic, first-principles calculations: because the quantized vector potential is spatially uniform, the light--matter coupling reduces to an operator-valued shift of the crystal momentum, K→ K+hatmathbf A/c, and the existing plane-wave machinery of ordinary solid-state DFT is reused essentially unchanged. This PW×Fock construction puts first-principles cavity QED of periodic solids on the same footing as the Fock-space coupled-cluster and configuration-interaction methods already developed for molecules, opening hitherto inaccessible systems---materials in a linear or chiral cavity, in particular---to first-principles plane-wave calculations. We illustrate the method with monolayer graphene in linear and chiral cavities, obtaining a polarization-selective Haldane gap together with the corresponding density-of-states, real-space, and circular-dichroism optical signatures. A full Brillouin-zone Berry-curvature calculation confirms the topological character of the chiral-cavity gap directly: the occupied manifold carries a quantized Chern number that steps through a non-monotonic sequence, C=1→3→-1→1→2→-1→1, with two narrow, sign-reversed windows---a property of extended, vacuum-dressed matter with no counterpart in a finite molecular system.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种显式的平面波（ PW ） ×光子-福克方法，用于量化，速度计Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian的周期性第一原理计算：由于量化矢量势在空间上是均匀的，光-物质耦合减少到晶体动量的算子值偏移，→ K K + hatmathbf A/c ，普通固态DFT现有的平面波机械基本上不变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种显式的平面波（ PW ） ×光子-福克方法，用于量化，速度计Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian的周期性第一原理计算：由于量化矢量势在空间上是均匀的，光-物质耦合减少到晶体动量的算子值偏移，→ K K + hatmathbf A/c ，普通固态DFT现有的平面波机械基本上不变。这种PW × Fock结构将周期性固体的第一原理空腔QED置于与已经为分子开发的Fock空间耦合簇和构型相互作用方法相同的基础上，从而将迄今为止无法接近的系统（特别是线性或手性空腔中的材料）开放给第一原理平面波计算。我们说明了在线性和手性腔中使用单层石墨烯的方法，获得偏振选择性Haldane间隙以及相应的状态密度、实空间和圆分色光学特征。完整的布里渊区Berry曲率计算直接证实了手性腔间隙的拓扑特征：占用的歧管携带量化的Chern数，该Chern数步进通过非单调序列， C = 1→ 3→ -1→ 1→ 2→ -1→ 1 ，具有两个狭窄的符号反转窗口---在有限分子系统中没有对应物的扩展的真空敷料物质的特性。

articles.title: Imaging how fluctuations destroy superconductivity in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 成像波动如何破坏二维超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional superconductors are model systems for thermal and quantum fluctuations. Key questions persist: whether existing models quantitatively describe the destruction of superconductivity, and whether an intermediate "anomalous metal state" represents a new phase of matter. We use scanning magnetic susceptibility to directly image the local phase stiffness, a thermodynamic measure of superconducting order, in gate-tunable Josephson junction arrays, a model two-dimensional superconductor. Across a broad range of carrier densities, we find that the superconducting critical temperature and phase stiffness are suppressed more strongly than expected from thermal fluctuations alone. At low carrier densities, we find that anomalous metal transport and large-scale spatial inhomogeneity emerge together. These results indicate that quantum fluctuations suppress superconductivity and that anomalous metal behavior emerges from phase slips in spatially disordered regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维超导体是热和量子波动的模型系统。关键问题仍然存在：现有模型是否定量描述了超导性的破坏，以及中间“异常金属态”是否代表了物质的新阶段。我们使用扫描磁化率直接成像局部相位刚度，这是超导顺序的热力学测量，在栅极可调约瑟夫森结阵列中，模型二维超导体。在广泛的载流子密度范围内，我们发现仅热波动对超导临界温度和相刚度的抑制就比预期的更强。在低载流子密度下，我们发现异常金属运输和大规模空间不均匀性一起出现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维超导体是热和量子波动的模型系统。关键问题仍然存在：现有模型是否定量描述了超导性的破坏，以及中间“异常金属态”是否代表了物质的新阶段。我们使用扫描磁化率直接成像局部相位刚度，这是超导顺序的热力学测量，在栅极可调约瑟夫森结阵列中，模型二维超导体。在广泛的载流子密度范围内，我们发现仅热波动对超导临界温度和相刚度的抑制就比预期的更强。在低载流子密度下，我们发现异常金属运输和大规模空间不均匀性一起出现。这些结果表明，量子波动抑制了超导性，并且异常金属行为从空间无序区域的相位滑移中出现。

articles.title: Magnetostrictive properties in Fe₄₋ₓCoₓN films: Insight from experiments and first-principles calculations
articles.title_zh: 磁致伸缩特性：来自实验和第一原理计算的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ferromagnetic nitride Fe₄N has attracted attention for application in spintronic devices due to its high spin polarization and large magnetostriction. We present a combined experimental and theoretical study on the magnetostriction of Fe₄₋ₓCoₓN films across a wide composition range. The Fe₄₋ₓCoₓN films were grown on SrTiO₃(001) substrates using molecular beam epitaxy, and the magnetostriction constants along the [100] direction (λ₁₀₀) and [111] direction (λ₁₁₁) were precisely evaluated using an optical cantilever method. The experimental results reveal that λ₁₁₁ remains positive in the whole composition range and shows a maximum value of +82 ppm around x = 0.9. The variation in λ₁₁₁ with x is much smaller than that in λ₁₀₀, for which giant tunability and sign reversal are observed. First-principles calculations show reasonable agreement with the experimental λ₁₁₁ for x ge 1.6, but give negative values at lower x, and an exceptionally large negative λ₁₁₁ is obtained at x = 0.8, where the Fermi level coincides with a pronounced minority-spin peak in the density of states. The calculated λ₁₁₁ depends strongly on the smearing parameter, indicating that the rhombohedral magnetostriction is highly sensitive to the treatment of atomic disorder. The saturation magnetostriction constant (λₛ) derived from λ₁₀₀ and λ₁₁₁ is also compared with the λₛ measured for the (001)-oriented polycrystalline Fe₄₋ₓCoₓN films, and a possible scenario for deviation between them is discussed. Our findings clarify the basic features of magnetostriction in the Fe₄₋ₓCoₓN system, providing essential magnetoelastic parameters for designing nitride-based spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 高自旋极化和大磁致伸缩的铁磁性氮化物Fe ”N在自旋电子器件中的应用引起了人们的关注。我们提出了一个综合的实验和理论研究在广泛的成分范围内的磁致伸缩的Fe” Co ”N薄膜。采用分子束外延法在SrTiO钚(001)衬底上生长Fe锘刮刮膜，采用光学悬臂法精确评价沿[100]方向(λ涓刮刮)和[111]方向(λ涓刮刮)的磁致伸缩常数。实验结果表明，在整个组成范围内， λ * * * * *保持正值，并且在x = 0.9左右显示出+82 ppm的最大值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高自旋极化和大磁致伸缩的铁磁性氮化物Fe ”N在自旋电子器件中的应用引起了人们的关注。我们提出了一个综合的实验和理论研究在广泛的成分范围内的磁致伸缩的Fe” Co ”N薄膜。采用分子束外延法在SrTiO钚(001)衬底上生长Fe锘刮刮膜，采用光学悬臂法精确评价沿[100]方向(λ涓刮刮)和[111]方向(λ涓刮刮)的磁致伸缩常数。实验结果表明，在整个组成范围内， λ * * * * *保持正值，并且在x = 0.9左右显示出+82 ppm的最大值。随x的变化幅度远小于观测到的巨大可调性和符号反转的λ ”的变化幅度。第一原理计算表明，对于x ge 1.6 ，第一原理计算与实验λ”的合理一致，但在较低的x处给出负值，并且在x = 0.8处获得异常大的负λ ”，其中费米能级与状态密度中显着的少数自旋峰相吻合。计算的λ * * * * * * *强烈依赖于涂抹参数，表明菱形磁致伸缩对原子紊乱的治疗高度敏感。并与(001)取向多晶薄膜的λ?测得的饱和磁致伸缩常数(λ?)进行了比较，讨论了它们之间偏差的可能场景。我们的研究结果阐明了磁致伸缩的基本特征，为设计氮化物基自旋电子器件提供了必要的磁致弹性参数。

articles.title: Conductance of silicon nanotube junctions in high magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 高磁场中硅纳米管结的电导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate coherent quantum transport through silicon nanotube (SiNT) junctions in high magnetic fields up to 60 T using a tight-binding model combined with the non-equilibrium Green's function formalism, and magnetic field included via Peierls substitution. We consider junctions of metallic nanotubes (6,0)+(6,0) and semiconducting ones (9,9)+(9,9), and examine the effects of the overlap length, inter-tube distance, magnetic-field direction, and field strength on the electronic transmission. In contrast to carbon nanotube junctions, the SiNT systems exhibit irregular transmission oscillations and do not show the emergence of highly conductive gateway states. The transmission is substantially more sensitive to a magnetic field perpendicular to the nanotube axis than to a parallel field, while increasing the field strength progressively modifies the transmission spectrum. Increasing the overlap length results in more frequent transmission oscillations, whereas increasing the inter-tube distance modifies their positions and amplitudes without changing their overall character. Generally, similar trends are observed for both types of junctions, involving metallic and semiconducting nanotubes. However, in the junction of semiconducting nanotubes, one observes peculiar additional field-dependent in-gap transmission features. These results demonstrate that the magnetic-field response of SiNT junctions is strongly governed by their geometry and differs qualitatively from that of pristine carbon nanotube junctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用紧密结合模型结合非平衡格林函数形式来研究高达60 T的高磁场中通过硅纳米管（ SiNT ）结的相干量子传输，并通过Peierls替换包括磁场。我们考虑了金属纳米管(6,0) + (6,0)和半导体纳米管(9,9) + (9,9)的结点，并研究了重叠长度、管间距、磁场方向和场强对电子传输的影响。与碳纳米管结相反， SiNT系统表现出不规则的传输振荡，并且没有显示出高导电性网关状态的出现。透射对垂直于纳米管轴线的磁场比对平行场更敏感，而场强的增加逐渐改变透射光谱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用紧密结合模型结合非平衡格林函数形式来研究高达60 T的高磁场中通过硅纳米管（ SiNT ）结的相干量子传输，并通过Peierls替换包括磁场。我们考虑了金属纳米管(6,0) + (6,0)和半导体纳米管(9,9) + (9,9)的结点，并研究了重叠长度、管间距、磁场方向和场强对电子传输的影响。与碳纳米管结相反， SiNT系统表现出不规则的传输振荡，并且没有显示出高导电性网关状态的出现。透射对垂直于纳米管轴线的磁场比对平行场更敏感，而场强的增加逐渐改变透射光谱。增加重叠长度会导致更频繁的传输振荡，而增加管间距离会在不改变其整体特征的情况下修改其位置和振幅。通常，对于涉及金属和半导体纳米管的两种类型的结，观察到类似的趋势。然而，在半导体纳米管的结中，人们观察到特殊的附加场相关的间隙内传输特征。这些结果表明， SiNT结的磁场响应受到其几何形状的强烈控制，并且与原始碳纳米管结的磁场响应在性质上有所不同。

articles.title: Moiré droplet of ultracold Bose gases in a twisted-bilayer optical lattice
articles.title_zh: 扭曲双层光学晶格中的超冷Bose气体Moiré液滴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the emergence of Moiré droplet in two-dimensional ultracold bosons subjected to a spin-dependent optical lattice, effctively realizing a twisted-bilayer configuration. We show that the droplet formation dramatically enhances the visibility of Moiré pattern in the density profile, even for exceptionally weak lattice potentials. The Moiré pattern can be enhanced similarly by increasing the lattice depth, which, however, also induces droplet diffusion characterized by a spreading density profile. Furthermore, we demonstrate a dynamical generation of Moiré pattern by dragging a small droplet through a moving lattice. At appropriate velocities, the droplet undergoes bifurcation and exhibits pronounced Moiré pattern within periodic time intervals. Our results establish the ultracold droplet as a compelling platform for simulating interacting Moiré physics, particularly the interplay between Moiré lattice and bound-state formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了经受自旋相关光学晶格的二维超冷玻色子中莫尔液滴的出现，有效地实现了双绞双层结构。我们表明，液滴的形成极大地增强了莫尔图案在密度分布中的可见性，即使对于非常弱的晶格电位也是如此。莫尔图案可以通过增加晶格深度来类似地增强，然而，这也诱导了以扩散密度分布为特征的液滴扩散。此外，我们通过拖动小液滴穿过移动的晶格来演示莫尔图案的动态生成。在适当的速度下，液滴经历分叉，并在周期性时间间隔内表现出明显的莫尔图案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了经受自旋相关光学晶格的二维超冷玻色子中莫尔液滴的出现，有效地实现了双绞双层结构。我们表明，液滴的形成极大地增强了莫尔图案在密度分布中的可见性，即使对于非常弱的晶格电位也是如此。莫尔图案可以通过增加晶格深度来类似地增强，然而，这也诱导了以扩散密度分布为特征的液滴扩散。此外，我们通过拖动小液滴穿过移动的晶格来演示莫尔图案的动态生成。在适当的速度下，液滴经历分叉，并在周期性时间间隔内表现出明显的莫尔图案。我们的研究结果确立了超冷液滴作为模拟相互作用的Moiré物理学的引人注目的平台，特别是Moiré晶格与界态形成之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Beyond the Kagome Layer: Interlayer Origin of the Flat Band in FeSn
articles.title_zh: 超越Kagome层： FeSn中扁平带的层间起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome FeSn exhibits an occupied flat band at its terminated surface, whereas bulk FeSn adopts A-type antiferromagnetic order and does not display the same feature. Here, we combine density functional theory with primitive- and doubled-cell analysis and a double-layer tight-binding model to determine how interlayer electronic coupling and magnetic stacking control flat-band formation in FeSn. We identify an occupied Fe-dz^₂-derived flat-band manifold in the ferromagnetic state that is consistent with the experimentally observed surface feature. Brillouin-zone folding reveals that its flat branch originates from the k_z=fracπc sector of the primitive cell, demonstrating that it cannot be understood as an isolated kagome-layer state. Instead, the state depends on coupling between neighboring kagome layers and can be seen as a result of antibonding coupling between nearest neighbor kagome layers. A double-layer tight-binding analysis identifies interlayer Fe-Fe hopping as the dominant microscopic coupling responsible for this behavior, while a contrasting unoccupied flat-band-related manifold is governed primarily by intralayer Fe-Sn hybridization. These results establish interlayer coupling and magnetic stacking as key control parameters for kagome flat bands and highlight how coupling between layers can generate and tune extended correlated-electron states in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: Kagome FeSn 在其终止表面表现出占据的平带，而块状 FeSn 采用 A 型反铁磁顺序，并且没有表现出相同的特征。在这里，我们将密度泛函理论与原胞和双胞分析以及双层紧束缚模型相结合，以确定层间电子耦合和磁堆叠如何控制 FeSn 中的平带形成。我们确定了铁磁态下占据的 Fe-dz² 派生平带流形，这与实验观察到的表面特征一致。布里渊区折叠揭示其扁平分支源自原始细胞的k_z=分形扇区，表明它不能被理解为孤立的戈薇层状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kagome FeSn 在其终止表面表现出占据的平带，而块状 FeSn 采用 A 型反铁磁顺序，并且没有表现出相同的特征。在这里，我们将密度泛函理论与原胞和双胞分析以及双层紧束缚模型相结合，以确定层间电子耦合和磁堆叠如何控制 FeSn 中的平带形成。我们确定了铁磁态下占据的 Fe-dz² 派生平带流形，这与实验观察到的表面特征一致。布里渊区折叠揭示其扁平分支源自原始细胞的k_z=分形扇区，表明它不能被理解为孤立的戈薇层状态。相反，该状态取决于相邻 kagome 层之间的耦合，并且可以视为最近相邻 kagome 层之间反键耦合的结果。双层紧束缚分析确定层间 Fe-Fe 跳跃是造成这种行为的主要微观耦合，而对比未占据的平带相关流形主要由层内 Fe-Sn 杂化控制。这些结果将层间耦合和磁性堆叠确立为 kagome 平带的关键控制参数，并强调了层间耦合如何在量子材料中生成和调整扩展相关电子态。

articles.title: Generative crystallographic phasing through invariant relationships
articles.title_zh: 通过不变关系进行生成晶体相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal structure determination requires the phases of scattered waves -- yet diffraction measures only their intensities. Direct methods exploit phase invariants but become less reliable as diffraction information diminishes. Learned phase prediction has lowered the resolution barrier, yet remains primarily confined to centrosymmetric crystals with binary phases. We introduce PhiGen, a generative reformulation of traditional direct methods that learns origin-independent phase relationships for binary and continuous phasing. Across 210 space groups, including groups absent from training, it recovered high-quality maps for 99.0% of centrosymmetric structures and invariant-consistent phases for 92.8% of non-centrosymmetric structures. From simulated 3 Å zeolite powder data, the network recovered framework maps for 84.2% of held-out structures, versus 1.0% for Superflip. For experimental ZSM-25 and TNU-9, generated phases seeded high-resolution phase extension. These results suggest a route to structure determination from low-resolution, incomplete, and overlapped diffraction data.
articles.abstract_zh: 晶体结构的确定需要散射波的相位，而衍射仅测量它们的强度。直接方法利用了相不变性，但随着衍射信息的减少而变得不太可靠。学习的相位预测降低了分辨率障碍，但仍然主要局限于具有二元相的中心对称晶体。我们引入了 PhiGen，它是传统直接方法的生成式重构，可学习二元和连续定相的与起源无关的相位关系。在 210 个空间组（包括未参加训练的组）中，它恢复了 99.0% 的中心对称结构的高质量图，以及 92.8% 的非中心对称结构的不变一致相位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体结构的确定需要散射波的相位，而衍射仅测量它们的强度。直接方法利用了相不变性，但随着衍射信息的减少而变得不太可靠。学习的相位预测降低了分辨率障碍，但仍然主要局限于具有二元相的中心对称晶体。我们引入了 PhiGen，它是传统直接方法的生成式重构，可学习二元和连续定相的与起源无关的相位关系。在 210 个空间组（包括未参加训练的组）中，它恢复了 99.0% 的中心对称结构的高质量图，以及 92.8% 的非中心对称结构的不变一致相位。根据模拟的 3 Å 沸石粉末数据，网络恢复了 84.2% 保留结构的骨架图，而 Superflip 为 1.0%。对于实验 ZSM-25 和 TNU-9，生成的相位播种了高分辨率相位扩展。这些结果提出了从低分辨率、不完整和重叠的衍射数据确定结构的途径。

articles.title: Exact selection of a toric-code vison crystal in a flux-conditioned Kitaev model
articles.title_zh: 在通量调节的 Kitaev 模型中精确选择复曲面码视觉晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct an exactly solvable extension of the spin-1/2 Kitaev honeycomb model in which conserved Z₂ fluxes determine not only the signs but also the connectivity of nearest-neighbor Majorana hopping. At a tuned loop point, hopping survives only across opposite-flux plaquettes, so every vertex has active degree zero or two and the matter Hamiltonian fragments in each flux sector into independent Majorana rings and isolated zero modes. Exact ring spectra and bond counting then bound the matter energy over all local flux configurations and all four Wilson-loop sectors, and split it exactly into a frustrated triangular-lattice Ising term, whose extensively degenerate ground states are the fully packed loop coverings, and a non-negative Majorana residual. On admissible commensurate tori, the residual selects precisely the three translation-related 2/3-vison crystals, which saturate the bound, and an exact fermion-parity identity shows that for antiferromagnetic coupling their vacua also survive projection, making them rigorous ground states of the spin model. Within a single crystal, a depth-one local unitary then maps the ground space onto that of a sheared square-lattice toric code, giving fourfold topological degeneracy. The model thus realizes exact nonperturbative gauge-matter feedback: the flux fixes where the Majorana fermions may move, and their zero-point energy selects in return a topologically ordered vison crystal with spontaneously broken translation symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了自旋 1/2 Kitaev 蜂窝模型的精确可解扩展，其中守恒 Z2 通量不仅决定了符号，还决定了最近邻马约拉纳跳跃的连通性。在调谐环路点，跳跃仅在相反通量斑块上存在，因此每个顶点的活动度为零或二，并且每个通量扇区中的物质哈密顿碎片形成独立的马约拉纳环和孤立的零模式。然后，精确的环光谱和键计数将物质能量限制在所有局部通量配置和所有四个威尔逊环扇区上，并将其精确地分解为受挫三角晶格伊辛项，其广泛退化的基态是完全堆积的环覆盖和非负马约拉纳残差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了自旋 1/2 Kitaev 蜂窝模型的精确可解扩展，其中守恒 Z2 通量不仅决定了符号，还决定了最近邻马约拉纳跳跃的连通性。在调谐环路点，跳跃仅在相反通量斑块上存在，因此每个顶点的活动度为零或二，并且每个通量扇区中的物质哈密顿碎片形成独立的马约拉纳环和孤立的零模式。然后，精确的环光谱和键计数将物质能量限制在所有局部通量配置和所有四个威尔逊环扇区上，并将其精确地分解为受挫三角晶格伊辛项，其广泛退化的基态是完全堆积的环覆盖和非负马约拉纳残差。在可接受的相称环面上，残差精确地选择了三个与平移相关的 2/3-vison 晶体，这些晶体使边界饱和，并且精确的费米子宇称恒等式表明，对于反铁磁耦合，它们的真空也能在投影中幸存下来，从而使它们成为自旋模型的严格基态。在单晶体内，深度一局部酉将地面空间映射到剪切方格环面码的空间上，从而产生四重拓扑简并性。因此，该模型实现了精确的非微扰规范物质反馈：通量固定了马约拉纳费米子可能移动的位置，而它们的零点能量则选择了具有自发破缺平移对称性的拓扑有序视觉晶体。

articles.title: Geometry-Induced Effective Tight-Binding Hamiltonians for Phononic Systems: Mode Conversion and SSH-Like Physics
articles.title_zh: 声子系统的几何诱导有效紧束缚哈密顿量：模式转换和类 SSH 物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29026v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a framework that maps harmonic vibrational systems onto effective multi-orbital tight-binding Hamiltonians, establishing a direct correspondence between phononic degrees of freedom and graph-based lattice models. Within this mapping, the Cartesian displacement components of each mass become internal orbitals, while elastic interactions generate effective onsite energies and hopping amplitudes determined by the geometry of the system. This representation enables the application of numerical and conceptual tools originally developed for electronic transport to the study of phononic systems. The method is first applied to a monoatomic chain containing an angular bend. For this benchmark system, analytical expressions for the polarization-resolved transmission and reflection probabilities are derived and compared against calculations performed using a recursive scattering-matrix method within the mapped tight-binding representation. Excellent agreement is obtained, validating the mapping and demonstrating its ability to describe geometry-induced mode conversion and the influence of evanescent states. We then investigate zigzag chains, where alternating bond orientations generate effective dimerized Hamiltonians reminiscent of the Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) model. Although the uniform zigzag chain develops a spectral gap, no localized edge states are observed. We show that modified boundary parameters generated by the phononic mapping suppress the edge-state formation expected from the ideal SSH picture. Introducing a geometric domain wall restores localized domain-wall states inside the gap, which give rise to resonant transmission channels across an otherwise insulating frequency window. The resonance energies remain robust against system-size variations and the corresponding transmission approaches unity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个框架，将谐波振动系统映射到有效的多轨道紧束缚哈密顿量上，在声子自由度和基于图的晶格模型之间建立直接对应关系。在这个映射中，每个质量的笛卡尔位移分量变成内部轨道，而弹性相互作用产生有效的现场能量和由系统的几何形状决定的跳跃幅度。这种表示使得最初为电子传输开发的数值和概念工具能够应用于声子系统的研究。该方法首先应用于包含角弯曲的单原子链。对于该基准系统，导出了偏振分辨透射和反射概率的解析表达式，并将其与在映射的紧束缚表示中使用递归散射矩阵方法执行的计算进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个框架，将谐波振动系统映射到有效的多轨道紧束缚哈密顿量上，在声子自由度和基于图的晶格模型之间建立直接对应关系。在这个映射中，每个质量的笛卡尔位移分量变成内部轨道，而弹性相互作用产生有效的现场能量和由系统的几何形状决定的跳跃幅度。这种表示使得最初为电子传输开发的数值和概念工具能够应用于声子系统的研究。该方法首先应用于包含角弯曲的单原子链。对于该基准系统，导出了偏振分辨透射和反射概率的解析表达式，并将其与在映射的紧束缚表示中使用递归散射矩阵方法执行的计算进行比较。获得了极好的一致性，验证了映射并证明了其描述几何引起的模式转换和倏逝态影响的能力。然后我们研究锯齿形链，其中交替的键方向产生有效的二聚哈密顿量，让人想起 Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) 模型。尽管均匀的锯齿链形成了光谱间隙，但没有观察到局部边缘态。我们表明，声子映射生成的修改边界参数抑制了理想 SSH 图片中预期的边缘态形成。引入几何畴壁可以恢复间隙内的局部畴壁状态，从而在原本绝缘的频率窗口上产生谐振传输通道。谐振能量在系统尺寸变化的情况下仍然保持稳健，并且相应的传输接近统一。

articles.title: Frustrated junctions in interfacial networks
articles.title_zh: 界面网络中的受挫连接
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Networks of interfaces in materials and living systems evolve through motion and rearrangement of interfaces and junctions. Local equilibrium at a junction requires interfacial force balance. We show that in three dimensions the classical Herring condition for triple lines is necessary but insufficient: four triple lines meeting at a quadruple node may each satisfy Herring equilibrium, while the four conditions remain mutually incompatible. Such a frustrated node has no admissible local equilibrium geometry. In the semi-isotropic limit, the six interfacial energies must form the edge lengths of a non-degenerate tetrahedron, with constructibility determined by the Cayley-Menger determinant. This hidden compatibility constraint arises from three-dimensional geometry and applies broadly to foams, polycrystals, tissues and other interfacial networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料和生命系统中的界面网络通过界面和连接点的运动和重新排列而演变。连接处的局部平衡需要界面力平衡。我们证明，在三维空间中，三重线的经典赫林条件是必要的，但还不够：在四重节点处相交的四条三重线可能各自满足赫林平衡，而这四个条件仍然相互不相容。这种受挫节点不具有可接受的局部平衡几何形状。在半各向同性极限下，六个界面能必须形成非简并四面体的边长，其可构造性由凯莱-门格行列式决定。这种隐藏的相容性约束源自三维几何形状，广泛应用于泡沫、多晶、组织和其他界面网络。

articles.title: Nonequilibrium Dirac condensate in bosonic Kitaev chain
articles.title_zh: 玻色基塔耶夫链中的非平衡狄拉克凝聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore a nonequilibrium Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) in a bosonic Kitaev chain. Within a mean-field framework, we show that bosonic superfluid order develops once the pairing strength exceeds a critical threshold. The condensate order parameter adopts an alternating phase between even and odd sites, giving rise to a spontaneous sublattice ordering. By mapping the emergent sublattice degrees of freedom onto a pseudospin, the elementary Bogoliubov excitation is described by a non-Hermitian Dirac Hamiltonian, displaying two prominent features: a re-entrant bosonic Andreev bound state localized around boundaries, and a macroscopic degeneracy of exceptional Majorana bosons at the critical point.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们探索玻色基塔耶夫链中的非平衡玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）。在平均场框架内，我们表明一旦配对强度超过临界阈值，玻色超流体秩序就会发展。凝聚有序参数采用偶数位和奇数位之间的交替相位，从而产生自发的亚晶格有序。通过将涌现的亚晶格自由度映射到赝自旋上，基本的博戈留波夫激发由非厄米狄拉克哈密顿量描述，显示出两个显着特征：位于边界周围的重入玻色子安德烈夫束缚态，以及异常马约拉纳玻色子在临界点的宏观简并性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们探索玻色基塔耶夫链中的非平衡玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）。在平均场框架内，我们表明一旦配对强度超过临界阈值，玻色超流体秩序就会发展。凝聚有序参数采用偶数位和奇数位之间的交替相位，从而产生自发的亚晶格有序。通过将涌现的亚晶格自由度映射到赝自旋上，基本的博戈留波夫激发由非厄米狄拉克哈密顿量描述，显示出两个显着特征：位于边界周围的重入玻色子安德烈夫束缚态，以及异常马约拉纳玻色子在临界点的宏观简并性。

articles.title: Light-induced rectified orbital magnetization in electron-hole bilayers
articles.title_zh: 电子空穴双层中的光诱导整流轨道磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circularly polarized light can rectify orbital motion into a static magnetization through the inverse Faraday effect (IFE), but in electron-hole bilayers the electron and hole contributions cancel exactly when their properties are equivalent. We show that electron-hole bilayers in transition-metal dichalcogenide platforms avoid this cancellation through effective-mass asymmetry alone, and that the surviving orbital IFE is sensitive to interlayer coupling. In the weak-coupling regime, a two-component Drude description yields an induced magnetization of order one Bohr magneton per carrier for representative terahertz driving. In the strong-coupling regime, where the carriers bind into interlayer excitons, we treat the relative motion using a hydrogenic model with a Rytova-Keldysh interaction and obtain a reduced but finite response. We give closed-form expressions that allow estimates across a broad parameter range and identify where the response is largest.
articles.abstract_zh: 圆偏振光可以通过反法拉第效应（IFE）将轨道运动纠正为静态磁化，但在电子-空穴双层中，当电子和空穴的性质相等时，它们的贡献恰好抵消。我们表明，过渡金属二硫属化物平台中的电子-空穴双层仅通过有效质量不对称性避免了这种抵消，并且幸存的轨道 IFE 对层间耦合敏感。在弱耦合状态下，二元德鲁德描述产生每个载体一阶玻尔磁子的感应磁化强度，用于代表性太赫兹驱动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 圆偏振光可以通过反法拉第效应（IFE）将轨道运动纠正为静态磁化，但在电子-空穴双层中，当电子和空穴的性质相等时，它们的贡献恰好抵消。我们表明，过渡金属二硫属化物平台中的电子-空穴双层仅通过有效质量不对称性避免了这种抵消，并且幸存的轨道 IFE 对层间耦合敏感。在弱耦合状态下，二元德鲁德描述产生每个载体一阶玻尔磁子的感应磁化强度，用于代表性太赫兹驱动。在强耦合状态下，载流子与层间激子结合，我们使用具有 Rytova-Keldysh 相互作用的氢模型来处理相对运动，并获得减少但有限的响应。我们给出了封闭式表达式，可以在广泛的参数范围内进行估计，并确定响应最大的位置。

articles.title: Superconductivity and Band Topology in Functionalized 2D Hexagonal MBenes
articles.title_zh: 功能化二维六角形 MBene 中的超导性和能带拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, two-dimensional transition-metal borides (MBenes) have attracted substantial interest due to their promising properties for electrocatalytic applications. Here, we explore their potential as novel two-dimensional superconductors and topological materials through first-principles calculations on both pristine and surface-functionalized hexagonal MBenes. We conduct a thorough examination of the structural, electronic, phononic, superconducting, and topological properties of 36 compounds with formulas M₂B₂ and M₂B₂T₂ (M = Sc, Ti, V, Zr, Nb, Hf, Ta, Mo, W; T = F, O, OH). Our analysis identifies 21 superconducting MBenes, including four with critical temperatures (Tc) exceeding 10 K, with Ti₂B₂O₂ exhibiting the highest predicted Tc of 24 K based on the McMillan formalism. For the two most promising compounds, Ti₂B₂O₂ and V₂B₂(OH)₂, we further solve the anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg equations, obtaining zero-temperature superconducting gaps of 6.1 and 3.6 meV and anisotropic Tc values of approximately 32 and 25 K, respectively. Symmetry-indicator-based analysis further reveals nontrivial normal-state band topology in several superconducting MBenes. These results indicate the coexistence of phonon-mediated superconductivity and nontrivial normal-state band topology within this material family, making MBenes promising platforms for future investigations of the possible emergence of topological superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，二维过渡金属硼化物（MBenes）由于其在电催化应用中具有良好的性能而引起了人们的极大兴趣。在这里，我们通过对原始和表面功能化的六方 MBene 进行第一性原理计算，探索它们作为新型二维超导体和拓扑材料的潜力。我们对 36 种分子式为 M2B2 和 M2B2T2（M = Sc、Ti、V、Zr、Nb、Hf、Ta、Mo、W；T = F、O、OH）的化合物的结构、电子、声子、超导和拓扑性质进行了彻底检查。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，二维过渡金属硼化物（MBenes）由于其在电催化应用中具有良好的性能而引起了人们的极大兴趣。在这里，我们通过对原始和表面功能化的六方 MBene 进行第一性原理计算，探索它们作为新型二维超导体和拓扑材料的潜力。我们对 36 种分子式为 M2B2 和 M2B2T2（M = Sc、Ti、V、Zr、Nb、Hf、Ta、Mo、W；T = F、O、OH）的化合物的结构、电子、声子、超导和拓扑性质进行了彻底检查。我们的分析确定了 21 种超导 MBene，其中四种临界温度 (Tc) 超过 10 K，其中 Ti2B2O2 根据 McMillan 形式表现出最高预测 Tc 为 24 K。对于两种最有前途的化合物Ti2B2O2和V2B2(OH)2，我们进一步求解了各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg方程，分别获得了6.1和3.6 meV的零温超导带隙以及约32和25 K的各向异性Tc值。基于对称性指标的分析进一步揭示了几种超导 MBene 中非平凡的常态能带拓扑。这些结果表明声子介导的超导性和非平凡的正常态带拓扑在该材料家族中共存，使得MBenes成为未来研究可能出现的拓扑超导性的有希望的平台。

articles.title: Hidden magnetic order within the pressure induced superconducting dome of UTe2
articles.title_zh: UTe2 压力感应超导圆顶内隐藏的磁序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity typically occurs near magnetic instabilities, and the corresponding spin fluctuations are widely believed to play a crucial role in mediating electron pairing. UTe₂ is a promising candidate for exhibiting multiple spin-triplet superconducting phases when tuning with applied pressure and magnetic fields, but the nature of the magnetism driving these unconventional pairing states is undetermined. Our measurements of UTe₂ under applied pressures and magnetic fields reveal the presence of a magnetic order hidden within the pressure-induced superconducting dome, which vanishes together with the superconductivity once there is sufficiently high pressure to induce the three-dimensional antiferromagnetic phase. Extrapolation of the phase boundary of the hidden magnetic order, which is most likely antiferromagnetic in nature, points to a zero-temperature quantum critical point that coincides with the maximum transition temperature of the pressure-induced superconducting dome, suggesting that it could corresponds to the parent magnetic phase of the critical antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations driving the triplet superconductivity. These findings advance the understanding of the interplay of magnetism and superconductivity in an exemplar candidate triplet superconductor, which is necessary for revealing the microscopic origin of the different unconventional superconducting phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 非常规超导通常发生在磁不稳定性附近，人们普遍认为相应的自旋涨落在介导电子配对方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 UTe2 是在施加压力和磁场调节时表现出多个自旋三重态超导相的有前途的候选者，但驱动这些非常规配对状态的磁性性质尚未确定。我们在施加压力和磁场下对UTe2的测量揭示了隐藏在压力诱导的超导圆顶内的磁序的存在，一旦存在足够高的压力以诱导三维反铁磁相，磁序就会与超导性一起消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非常规超导通常发生在磁不稳定性附近，人们普遍认为相应的自旋涨落在介导电子配对方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 UTe2 是在施加压力和磁场调节时表现出多个自旋三重态超导相的有前途的候选者，但驱动这些非常规配对状态的磁性性质尚未确定。我们在施加压力和磁场下对UTe2的测量揭示了隐藏在压力诱导的超导圆顶内的磁序的存在，一旦存在足够高的压力以诱导三维反铁磁相，磁序就会与超导性一起消失。隐藏磁序的相界（本质上很可能是反铁磁的）的外推指向零温度量子临界点，该临界点与压力诱导超导圆顶的最大转变温度一致，这表明它可能对应于驱动三重态超导性的临界反铁磁自旋涨落的母磁相。这些发现促进了对示例性候选三重态超导体中磁性和超导性相互作用的理解，这对于揭示不同非常规超导相的微观起源是必要的。

articles.title: Antisymmetric breathing in altermagnetic skyrmions
articles.title_zh: 互磁斯格明子中的反对称呼吸
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A skyrmion in an altermagnet with (d) wave symmetry consists of two elliptical sublattice textures with perpendicular long axes. For each sublattice component η=A,B, we define an effective skyrmion radius R_η=sqrta_η b_η, where a_η and b_η are the distances from the skyrmion center to its boundary along y and x, respectively. For the anisotropic exchange parameters studied, the equilibrium radius at zero field is smaller than in a reference with parallel sublattice textures and otherwise identical parameters. A magnetic field perpendicular to the film expands one sublattice skyrmion and contracts the other, generating a radius difference dR=R_A-R_B and a net magnetic moment. The exchange modulation used to represent uniaxial strain also produces a nonzero radius difference at zero field. Because the strong and weak exchange directions are interchanged between the two sublattices, a common directional change of the exchange couplings increases one radius and decreases the other. Unlike the magnetic coupling, this mechanism vanishes when the two sublattice exchange tensors become identical. The radius difference also supports an antisymmetric breathing mode. After a short field pulse, it oscillates in quadrature with the uniform helicity, the common rotation of the wall magnetization within the film plane, at (49.5,GHz) for the reference parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有 (d) 波对称性的交变磁体中的斯格明子由两个具有垂直长轴的椭圆形亚晶格纹理组成。对于每个子晶格分量 η=A,B，我们定义有效斯格明子半径 R_η=sqrta_η b_η，其中 a_η 和 b_η 分别是沿 y 和 x 从斯格明子中心到其边界的距离。对于所研究的各向异性交换参数，零场处的平衡半径小于具有平行亚晶格纹理和其他相同参数的参考中的平衡半径。垂直于薄膜的磁场使一个亚晶格斯格明子膨胀并收缩另一个，产生半径差 dR=R_A-R_B 和净磁矩。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有 (d) 波对称性的交变磁体中的斯格明子由两个具有垂直长轴的椭圆形亚晶格纹理组成。对于每个子晶格分量 η=A,B，我们定义有效斯格明子半径 R_η=sqrta_η b_η，其中 a_η 和 b_η 分别是沿 y 和 x 从斯格明子中心到其边界的距离。对于所研究的各向异性交换参数，零场处的平衡半径小于具有平行亚晶格纹理和其他相同参数的参考中的平衡半径。垂直于薄膜的磁场使一个亚晶格斯格明子膨胀并收缩另一个，产生半径差 dR=R_A-R_B 和净磁矩。用于表示单轴应变的交换调制也在零场产生非零半径差。由于强交换方向和弱交换方向在两个子晶格之间互换，交换耦合的共同方向变化会增加一个半径并减小另一个半径。与磁耦合不同，当两个亚晶格交换张量变得相同时，这种机制就会消失。半径差异还支持反对称呼吸模式。经过短场脉冲后，它以均匀螺旋度正交振荡，即膜平面内壁磁化强度的共同旋转，参考参数为 (49.5,GHz)。

articles.title: Multidimensional dynamical centrality from Green functions in complex networks
articles.title_zh: 复杂网络中格林函数的多维动态中心性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional centrality measures provide compact descriptions of node importance, but they emphasize specific structural relations and do not directly resolve the temporal and spectral organization of dynamical perturbation responses. Building on the Green function of a linearized networked system, we develop a multidimensional framework for dynamical node characterization. From the same response function, we extract three complementary indicators---Influence, Efficiency, and Distortion---that quantify cumulative response strength, temporal rate of response, and spectral concentration, respectively, together with a contribution matrix that resolves these quantities into source--target pathways. As a numerical demonstration, we apply the framework to weighted Kuramoto--Sakaguchi dynamics on heterogeneous Barabási--Albert networks. The three indicators distinguish implanted dynamical node classes through complementary dimensions of the perturbation response, while remaining strongly coupled to conventional topological centralities. These results demonstrate how a common dynamical response can be decomposed into distinct, physically interpretable characteristics rather than represented by a single aggregate descriptor. We finally discuss the scope and limitations of the linear-response assumption and extensions to time-dependent and nonlinear regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的中心性度量提供了节点重要性的紧凑描述，但它们强调特定的结构关系，并且不能直接解决动态扰动响应的时间和频谱组织。基于线性化网络系统的格林函数，我们开发了一个用于动态节点表征的多维框架。从相同的响应函数中，我们提取了三个互补指标——影响力、效率和失真——分别量化累积响应强度、时间响应率和光谱浓度，以及将这些量解析为源-目标路径的贡献矩阵。作为数值演示，我们将该框架应用于异构 Barabási-Albert 网络上的加权 Kuramoto-Sakaguchi 动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的中心性度量提供了节点重要性的紧凑描述，但它们强调特定的结构关系，并且不能直接解决动态扰动响应的时间和频谱组织。基于线性化网络系统的格林函数，我们开发了一个用于动态节点表征的多维框架。从相同的响应函数中，我们提取了三个互补指标——影响力、效率和失真——分别量化累积响应强度、时间响应率和光谱浓度，以及将这些量解析为源-目标路径的贡献矩阵。作为数值演示，我们将该框架应用于异构 Barabási-Albert 网络上的加权 Kuramoto-Sakaguchi 动力学。这三个指标通过扰动响应的互补维度来区分植入的动态节点类别，同时保持与传统拓扑中心性的强耦合。这些结果证明了如何将常见的动态响应分解为不同的、物理上可解释的特征，而不是用单个聚合描述符来表示。最后，我们讨论线性响应假设的范围和局限性以及对时间相关和非线性机制的扩展。

articles.title: Mixed-Valent Magnetism in CeFe₂ from Multi-Impurity DFT+DMFT
articles.title_zh: 多杂质 DFT+DMFT 中 CeFe2 的混价磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29241v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic origin of magnetism in CeFe₂ has remained unresolved for almost forty years, where polarized-neutron diffraction and x-ray magnetic circular dichroism infer markedly different Ce 4f spin and orbital moments, that also are in disagreement with theory. We show here that within a relativistic multi-impurity DFT+DMFT framework, where the Fe 3d states are treated by spin-polarized T-matrix fluctuation exchange and Ce 4f orbitals by a bath-coupled configuration-interaction solver, this long standing problem is resolved. This level of theory is exclusive in reproducing magnetic moments (spin and orbital) for both the Ce and Fe atoms, yielding a total moment in agreement with the measured saturation moment. The theory put forth here is much closer to the atom specific moments reported from XMCD, compared to values from polarized-neutron diffraction. The occupation langle n_frangle=0.85 and charge variance δ n_f²=0.27 establish substantial valence fluctuations, while the spectral function simultaneously recovers significant weight at the Fermi level together with separate incoherent structures. These results identify bath-mediated polarization and configuration mixing as the essential ingredients governing the electronic structure and magnetism of CeFe₂.
articles.abstract_zh: CeFe2 磁性的微观起源近四十年来一直没有得到解决，其中偏振中子衍射和 X 射线磁圆二色性推断出明显不同的 Ce 4f 自旋和轨道矩，这也与理论不一致。我们在此表明，在相对论多杂质 DFT+DMFT 框架内，通过自旋极化 T 矩阵涨落交换处理 Fe 3d 态，通过浴耦合构型相互作用求解器处理 Ce 4f 轨道，这个长期存在的问题得到了解决。这一水平的理论在再现 Ce 和 Fe 原子的磁矩（自旋和轨道）方面是独一无二的，产生与测量的饱和矩一致的总矩。
articles.abstract_zh_full: CeFe2 磁性的微观起源近四十年来一直没有得到解决，其中偏振中子衍射和 X 射线磁圆二色性推断出明显不同的 Ce 4f 自旋和轨道矩，这也与理论不一致。我们在此表明，在相对论多杂质 DFT+DMFT 框架内，通过自旋极化 T 矩阵涨落交换处理 Fe 3d 态，通过浴耦合构型相互作用求解器处理 Ce 4f 轨道，这个长期存在的问题得到了解决。这一水平的理论在再现 Ce 和 Fe 原子的磁矩（自旋和轨道）方面是独一无二的，产生与测量的饱和矩一致的总矩。与偏振中子衍射的值相比，这里提出的理论更接近于 XMCD 报告的原子特定矩。占据 langle n_frangle=0.85 和电荷方差 δ n_f²=0.27 建立了显着的价态波动，而谱函数同时恢复了费米能级上的显着权重以及单独的非相干结构。这些结果表明浴介导的极化和构型混合是控制 CeFe2 电子结构和磁性的基本成分。

articles.title: Superconducting spin valve as a sensitive probe of spin-orbit coupling anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 超导自旋阀作为自旋轨道耦合各向异性敏感探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29244v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) plays a central role in modern condensed matter physics and is crucial for the development of spin-based devices and quantum technologies. In particular, the interplay between Rashba SOC (R-SOC), arising from structural inversion asymmetry, and Dresselhaus SOC (D-SOC), due to bulk inversion asymmetry, significantly influences spin coherence and manipulation in two-dimensional and topological systems. Disentangling these SOC components is essential for spintronics, superconducting spintronics, or topological superconductivity. In this study, we experimentally investigate in-plane low-bias conductance anisotropy in epitaxial Fe/MgO/V/MgO/Fe/Co junctions under varying temperature and magnetic field conditions. By applying a theoretical model that accounts for distinct R-SOC and D-SOC contributions, we interpret the observed anisotropy as a reliable method to disentangle these effects. Comparison between experiment and theory reveals a 5 % contribution of D-SOC to total SOC, attributed to periodic interfacial lattice mismatch defects confirmed by high-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM). Our findings offer a practical approach to isolate interfacial SOC components in superconducting spintronic systems with implications for engineering in spintronic and quantum devices, and provide further evidence of superconducting spin-triplet pairing in Fe/MgO/V-based superconductor/ferromagnet heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋轨道耦合（SOC）在现代凝聚态物理中发挥着核心作用，对于基于自旋的器件和量子技术的发展至关重要。特别是，由结构反演不对称引起的 Rashba SOC (R-SOC) 和由于体反演不对称引起的 Dresselhaus SOC (D-SOC) 之间的相互作用，显着影响二维和拓扑系统中的自旋相干和操纵。解开这些 SOC 组件对于自旋电子学、超导自旋电子学或拓扑超导至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道耦合（SOC）在现代凝聚态物理中发挥着核心作用，对于基于自旋的器件和量子技术的发展至关重要。特别是，由结构反演不对称引起的 Rashba SOC (R-SOC) 和由于体反演不对称引起的 Dresselhaus SOC (D-SOC) 之间的相互作用，显着影响二维和拓扑系统中的自旋相干和操纵。解开这些 SOC 组件对于自旋电子学、超导自旋电子学或拓扑超导至关重要。在本研究中，我们通过实验研究了不同温度和磁场条件下外延 Fe/MgO/V/MgO/Fe/Co 结的面内低偏置电导各向异性。通过应用解释 R-SOC 和 D-SOC 不同贡献的理论模型，我们将观察到的各向异性解释为解决这些影响的可靠方法。实验与理论之间的比较表明，D-SOC 对总 SOC 的贡献为 5%，这归因于高分辨率扫描透射电子显微镜 (STEM) 证实的周期性界面晶格失配缺陷。我们的研究结果提供了一种分离超导自旋电子系统中界面 SOC 组件的实用方法，对自旋电子和量子器件的工程具有重要意义，并为 Fe/MgO/V 基超导体/铁磁体异质结构中的超导自旋三重态配对提供了进一步的证据。

articles.title: Two temperature scales in the Ising model on the 5,4 hyperbolic lattice with free boundaries: susceptibility peak and boundary-induced order
articles.title_zh: 具有自由边界的 5,4 双曲晶格伊辛模型中的两个温标：磁化率峰值和边界诱导序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On the 5,4 hyperbolic lattice, the outermost generation holds 73% of the sites at all system sizes, making macroscopic averages strictly boundary-dependent. We study the ferromagnetic Ising model on this geometry with free boundaries by Monte Carlo simulation, demonstrating that conventional observables cease to identify a single critical scale. Instead, the finite lattices are organized by two distinct temperature scales. The susceptibility maximum identifies the lower transition scale at Tc₂=1.4782(15)J/kB without extrapolation. However, the order-parameter distribution lacks a conventional fixed point at this scale. A distinct pseudocritical scale emerges instead at T*simeq1.67(3) inside the boundary-sensitive intermediate phase, where Binder cumulant curves cross and effective exponents are compatible with mean-field criticality. Between Tc₂ and T*, the interior amplifies boundary fluctuations into induced order. Furthermore, because the volume grows exponentially with depth, finite-size scaling must be formulated in the generation index rather than the total number of sites. The lack of asymptotic power-law convergence in the scaling stretch confirms through an independent observable that T* is a finite-size crossover rather than a thermodynamic fixed point. Finally, by applying a coherent field to the outermost generation alone, we recover the upper thermodynamic transition at Tₚₜ=2.81(1)J/kB, demonstrating that it remains accessible under an appropriate boundary perturbation.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 5,4 双曲晶格上，最外层的一代在所有系统尺寸下占据 73% 的位点，使得宏观平均值严格依赖于边界。我们通过蒙特卡罗模拟研究了这种具有自由边界的几何形状的铁磁伊辛模型，证明传统的可观测量不再识别单一的临界尺度。相反，有限晶格是由两个不同的温标组织的。磁化率最大值确定 Tc2=1.4782(15)J/kB 处的较低转变尺度，无需外推。然而，阶次参数分布在此尺度上缺乏传统的固定点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 5,4 双曲晶格上，最外层的一代在所有系统尺寸下占据 73% 的位点，使得宏观平均值严格依赖于边界。我们通过蒙特卡罗模拟研究了这种具有自由边界的几何形状的铁磁伊辛模型，证明传统的可观测量不再识别单一的临界尺度。相反，有限晶格是由两个不同的温标组织的。磁化率最大值确定 Tc2=1.4782(15)J/kB 处的较低转变尺度，无需外推。然而，阶次参数分布在此尺度上缺乏传统的固定点。相反，在边界敏感中间相内的 T*simeq1.67(3) 处出现了明显的伪临界尺度，其中 Binder 累积量曲线交叉且有效指数与平均场临界性兼容。在 Tc2 和 T* 之间，内部将边界波动放大为诱导有序。此外，由于体积随深度呈指数增长，因此必须在生成索引而不是站点总数中制定有限尺寸缩放。缩放拉伸中缺乏渐近幂律收敛通过独立可观测量证实 T* 是有限尺寸交叉而不是热力学固定点。最后，通过仅对最外层一代应用相干场，我们恢复了 Tₚₜ=2.81(1)J/kB 处的上部热力学转变，证明它在适当的边界扰动下仍然是可接近的。

articles.title: Combining physical models with dynamically acquired experimental information for the optimization of multicomponent NASICON fast ionic conductors in a self-driving laboratory
articles.title_zh: 将物理模型与动态获取的实验信息相结合，以优化自动驾驶实验室中的多组分 NASICON 快离子导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Elemental substitution within existing structural frameworks is a widely applied strategy for developing advanced materials. Yet, optimizing target properties while maintaining phase purity usually demands extensive trial-and-error, which becomes substantially inefficient when navigating a complex design space. Here, we introduce a strategy that simultaneously and dynamically assesses composition-dependent synthetic accessibility and target properties via aggregated cost functions that guide autonomous experimentation in a truly self-driving and self-learning mode. Specifically, we developed a cost-guided autonomous solid-state synthesis (CASS) framework and demonstrate its application in the discovery of Na superionic conductor (NASICON) solid electrolytes. CASS successfully optimizes ionic conductivity and phase purity, leading to the identification of 18 promising compositions in 78 trials conducted in an autonomous laboratory, the A-Lab. Among these, we identified two fast-conducting NASICONs yielding total (bulk) ionic conductivity of 0.7 (3.96) and 0.3 (3.17) mS/cm. The successful deployment of CASS reinforces the potential of coupling self-driving autonomous laboratories with physics-informed generative models to accelerate materials discovery. Moreover, the interpretability of the design factors, informed by outcomes from both successful and failed syntheses, enables model refinement and generation of new chemical insights.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有结构框架内的元素替代是开发先进材料的广泛应用的策略。然而，在保持相纯度的同时优化目标特性通常需要大量的反复试验，这在复杂的设计空间中变得非常低效。在这里，我们引入了一种策略，通过聚合成本函数同时动态地评估依赖于成分的合成可及性和目标特性，以真正的自动驾驶和自学习模式指导自主实验。具体来说，我们开发了一种成本引导的自主固态合成（CASS）框架，并展示了其在发现钠超离子导体（NASICON）固体电解质中的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现有结构框架内的元素替代是开发先进材料的广泛应用的策略。然而，在保持相纯度的同时优化目标特性通常需要大量的反复试验，这在复杂的设计空间中变得非常低效。在这里，我们引入了一种策略，通过聚合成本函数同时动态地评估依赖于成分的合成可及性和目标特性，以真正的自动驾驶和自学习模式指导自主实验。具体来说，我们开发了一种成本引导的自主固态合成（CASS）框架，并展示了其在发现钠超离子导体（NASICON）固体电解质中的应用。 CASS 成功优化了离子电导率和相纯度，在自主实验室 A-Lab 进行的 78 项试验中鉴定出了 18 种有前景的成分。其中，我们确定了两种快速传导的 NASICON，其总（体积）离子电导率分别为 0.7 (3.96) 和 0.3 (3.17) mS/cm。 CASS 的成功部署增强了将自动驾驶实验室与物理生成模型相结合以加速材料发现的潜力。此外，设计因素的可解释性（根据成功和失败的合成结果得出的信息）可以改进模型并产生新的化学见解。

articles.title: Superconductivity in structurally complex σ-Phase Re-X (X = V, Nb, Ta) and a derived medium-entropy alloys
articles.title_zh: 结构复杂的 σ 相 Re-X（X = V、Nb、Ta）和衍生的中熵合金中的超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structurally complex tetragonal sigma (σ)-phase provides a unique platform for investigating the interplay between chemical disorder, electronic structure, and superconductivity, particularly in Re-based alloys where unconventional superconductivity has been widely discussed. Here, we synthesize and investigate the superconducting properties of σ-phase Re-X (X = V, Nb, and Ta) alloys with compositions Re₀.₇₆V₀.₂₄, Re₀.₅₆Nb₀.₄₄, and Re₀.₆₀Ta₀.₄₀. These compositions lie within the narrow stability range of the σ phase, underscoring the critical role of valence electron concentration in phase formation. To examine the influence of enhanced chemical disorder, we further synthesize the structurally complex medium-entropy alloy Re₀.₅₆Nb₀.₁₉Ta₀.₁₉V₀.₀₆, derived from these binary systems. Magnetization, electrical resistivity, and specific-heat measurements establish bulk type-II superconductivity in all compounds. Analysis of the electronic heat capacity is consistent with a fully gapped, weak-coupling BCS superconducting state. In contrast, the normal-state resistivity exhibits an unconventional negative temperature coefficient, and the superconducting transition temperature values obtained from resistivity measurements are higher than those determined from other measurements. Our results demonstrate that both the σ-phase Re-X alloys, spanning 3d, 4d, and 5d transition-metal substitutions, and their medium-entropy counterpart constitute an attractive family of model systems for investigating the effects of structural complexity, chemical disorder, and spin-orbit coupling on superconductivity in Re-based materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构复杂的四方西格玛（σ）相为研究化学无序、电子结构和超导性之间的相互作用提供了一个独特的平台，特别是在非常规超导性已被广泛讨论的铼基合金中。在此，我们合成并研究了成分为 Re0.76V00.24、Re0.56Nb0.44 和 Re0.60Ta00.40 的 σ 相 Re-X（X = V、Nb 和 Ta）合金的超导性能。这些成分位于 σ 相的狭窄稳定范围内，强调了价电子浓度在相形成中的关键作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构复杂的四方西格玛（σ）相为研究化学无序、电子结构和超导性之间的相互作用提供了一个独特的平台，特别是在非常规超导性已被广泛讨论的铼基合金中。在此，我们合成并研究了成分为 Re0.76V00.24、Re0.56Nb0.44 和 Re0.60Ta00.40 的 σ 相 Re-X（X = V、Nb 和 Ta）合金的超导性能。这些成分位于 σ 相的狭窄稳定范围内，强调了价电子浓度在相形成中的关键作用。为了研究增强化学无序的影响，我们进一步合成了源自这些二元系统的结构复杂的中熵合金Re0.56Nb0.19Ta00.19V00.06。磁化强度、电阻率和比热测量可在所有化合物中建立体 II 型超导性。电子热容分析与全能隙、弱耦合 BCS 超导状态一致。相比之下，正常状态电阻率表现出非常规的负温度系数，并且通过电阻率测量获得的超导转变温度值高于通过其他测量确定的值。我们的结果表明，跨越 3d、4d 和 5d 过渡金属取代的 σ 相 Re-X 合金及其中熵对应物构成了一个有吸引力的模型系统家族，用于研究结构复杂性、化学无序和自旋轨道耦合对 Re 基材料超导性的影响。

articles.title: Hamiltonian learning reveals optoelectronic mechanisms across thermodynamic state space in soft semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 哈密顿学习揭示了软半导体热力学态空间的光电机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting optoelectronic response across thermodynamic state space requires coupling finite-temperature nuclear dynamics to electronic structure at scales where direct first-principles calculations are impractical. Machine-learning force fields and Hamiltonian-learning models provide scalable predictions, but integrating them into reliable and interpretable workflows remains challenging. Here, we introduce FLOW-OTTER, a modular, model-agnostic framework that automates molecular dynamics, Hamiltonian prediction, observable extraction, reliability assessment, and Hamiltonian-level interpretation. We demonstrate FLOW-OTTER in halide perovskites, soft semiconductors whose anharmonic fluctuations strongly modulate electronic response. Using FLOW-OTTER, we show that independently learned nuclear and electronic models remain predictive when composed end-to-end, reproducing experimental temperature- and pressure-dependent band-gap trends using models trained only on first-principles targets at zero pressure. By resolving the nonlinear evolution of Pb-s/Br-p antibonding at the valence-band maximum, it identifies the microscopic origin of the asymmetric pressure response. FLOW-OTTER thus establishes Hamiltonian learning as a general route from thermodynamic trajectories to experimentally grounded optoelectronic mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测跨热力学状态空间的光电响应需要将有限温度核动力学与电子结构耦合，而直接第一原理计算是不切实际的。机器学习力场和哈密顿学习模型提供了可扩展的预测，但将它们集成到可靠且可解释的工作流程中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍 FLOW-OTTER，这是一个与模型无关的模块化框架，可自动执行分子动力学、哈密顿量预测、可观测值提取、可靠性评估和哈密顿量级解释。我们展示了卤化物钙钛矿中的 FLOW-OTTER，这是一种软半导体，其非谐波波动强烈调节电子响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测跨热力学状态空间的光电响应需要将有限温度核动力学与电子结构耦合，而直接第一原理计算是不切实际的。机器学习力场和哈密顿学习模型提供了可扩展的预测，但将它们集成到可靠且可解释的工作流程中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍 FLOW-OTTER，这是一个与模型无关的模块化框架，可自动执行分子动力学、哈密顿量预测、可观测值提取、可靠性评估和哈密顿量级解释。我们展示了卤化物钙钛矿中的 FLOW-OTTER，这是一种软半导体，其非谐波波动强烈调节电子响应。使用 FLOW-OTTER，我们表明，独立学习的核模型和电子模型在端到端组合时仍然具有预测性，使用仅在零压力下第一原理目标上训练的模型再现实验温度和压力相关的带隙趋势。通过解决价带最大值处 Pb-s/Br-p 反键的非线性演化，它确定了不对称压力响应的微观起源。因此，FLOW-OTTER 将哈密顿学习确立为从热力学轨迹到实验基础光电机制的一般途径。

articles.title: Thermal quasi-Devil's staircase in an anisotropic triangular-lattice Rydberg array
articles.title_zh: 各向异性三角晶格里德伯阵列中的热准魔鬼阶梯
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Devil's staircase is a sequence of transitions between topological sectors as a control parameter is varied. Such staircases are predicted in frustrated magnets and lattice gauge theories, but observing them is hard: the winding number that labels each sector is topologically protected, so local quantum dynamics alone cannot move the system from one step to the next. Here we propose and analyze an experimentally feasible way to realize a thermal quasi-Devil's staircase in a finite Rydberg-atom array. We study the anisotropic triangular-lattice Ising antiferromagnet using a dimer mapping, a directed-string description, exact thermodynamics, and Monte Carlo simulations. In the defect-free string manifold, the commensurate--incommensurate onset follows from a simple energy--entropy balance, and the exact Ising critical relation reduces to the same condition when triangle-rule defects are rare. On a finite lattice, this onset appears as a quasi-Devil's staircase of winding-sector crossovers, which we resolve through winding distributions, structure factors, and directional correlations. The key point is that thermal fluctuations overcome the topological barriers that block sector changes under purely quantum dynamics, and the staircase exists precisely at the finite sizes and tunable effective temperatures of current Rydberg platforms. This makes the effect directly observable in existing experiments. Our comparison also shows that the finite-size steps are not phase transitions: in the thermodynamic limit only a single phase transition survives, and the system crosses over to a defect-dominated paramagnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔鬼阶梯是随着控制参数变化而在拓扑扇区之间发生的一系列过渡。这种阶梯是在受挫磁铁和晶格规范理论中预测的，但观察它们很困难：标记每个扇区的绕数受到拓扑保护，因此仅局部量子动力学无法将系统从一步移动到下一步。在这里，我们提出并分析了一种在实验上可行的方法，以在有限里德堡原子阵列中实现热准魔鬼楼梯。我们使用二聚体映射、有向弦描述、精确热力学和蒙特卡罗模拟来研究各向异性三角晶格伊辛反铁磁体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 魔鬼阶梯是随着控制参数变化而在拓扑扇区之间发生的一系列过渡。这种阶梯是在受挫磁铁和晶格规范理论中预测的，但观察它们很困难：标记每个扇区的绕数受到拓扑保护，因此仅局部量子动力学无法将系统从一步移动到下一步。在这里，我们提出并分析了一种在实验上可行的方法，以在有限里德堡原子阵列中实现热准魔鬼楼梯。我们使用二聚体映射、有向弦描述、精确热力学和蒙特卡罗模拟来研究各向异性三角晶格伊辛反铁磁体。在无缺陷弦流形中，相称 - 不相称起始来自简单的能量 - 熵平衡，并且当三角规则缺陷很少时，精确的伊辛临界关系会减少到相同的条件。在有限晶格上，这种起始点表现为缠绕扇区交叉的准魔鬼楼梯，我们通过缠绕分布、结构因子和方向相关性来解决。关键在于，热涨落克服了在纯量子动力学下阻碍扇区变化的拓扑障碍，并且阶梯精确地存在于当前里德堡平台的有限尺寸和可调有效温度下。这使得在现有实验中可以直接观察到效果。我们的比较还表明，有限尺寸的步骤不是相变：在热力学极限下，只有单个相变存在，并且系统过渡到缺陷主导的顺磁体。

articles.title: Library of carbon nanotube junctions: data-driven insights into structure-magnetotransport relationships
articles.title_zh: 碳纳米管结库：数据驱动的结构-磁输运关系洞察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic transport in carbon nanotube (CNT) assemblies is controlled by a heterogeneous population of CNT--CNT junctions, yet most microscopic studies consider only a few representative systems. Here, we construct a library of 146 single-walled carbon nanotube (SWCNT)--SWCNT junctions spanning broad structural and electronic diversity and analyse their magnetotransport using an automated workflow combining molecular dynamics, tight-binding theory, Peierls magnetic coupling, and non-equilibrium Green's functions.The resulting transport data are subsequently analysed using machine-learning methods. Two complementary transport descriptors reveal distinct structure--transport hierarchies. The averaged first transmission-step value is governed primarily by the mean chiral angle of the two nanotubes forming a junction, whereas the energy gap of the junction depends predominantly on the metallic or semiconducting character of the constituent CNTs. Temperature generally suppresses the averaged transmission while reducing the extracted gap, whereas a perpendicular magnetic field affects transmission much more strongly than the gap. Signatures of interference-driven transport remain visible even at 300~K. Notably, semiconducting--semiconducting junctions retain the largest gaps but, once shifted into their conducting regime, can exhibit transmission comparable to or exceeding that of metallic junctions. These results establish statistically robust junction-level trends that can inform future network-scale models of CNT assemblies.
articles.abstract_zh: 碳纳米管 (CNT) 组件中的电子传输是由 CNT--CNT 结的异质群体控制的，但大多数微观研究仅考虑少数代表性系统。在这里，我们构建了一个包含 146 个单壁碳纳米管 (SWCNT) - SWCNT 连接的库，涵盖广泛的结构和电子多样性，并使用结合分子动力学、紧束缚理论、佩尔斯磁耦合和非平衡格林函数的自动化工作流程分析它们的磁输运。随后使用机器学习方法分析所得的输运数据。两个互补的传输描述符揭示了不同的结构——传输层次结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碳纳米管 (CNT) 组件中的电子传输是由 CNT--CNT 结的异质群体控制的，但大多数微观研究仅考虑少数代表性系统。在这里，我们构建了一个包含 146 个单壁碳纳米管 (SWCNT) - SWCNT 连接的库，涵盖广泛的结构和电子多样性，并使用结合分子动力学、紧束缚理论、佩尔斯磁耦合和非平衡格林函数的自动化工作流程分析它们的磁输运。随后使用机器学习方法分析所得的输运数据。两个互补的传输描述符揭示了不同的结构——传输层次结构。平均第一传输步长值主要由形成结的两个纳米管的平均手性角决定，而结的能隙主要取决于组成碳纳米管的金属或半导体特性。温度通常会抑制平均传输，同时减少提取的间隙，而垂直磁场对传输的影响比间隙更强烈。即使在 300~K 的温度下，干扰驱动的传输特征仍然可见。值得注意的是，半导体-半导体结保留了最大的间隙，但一旦转变为导电状态，就可以表现出与金属结相当或超过的传输能力。这些结果建立了统计上稳健的结级趋势，可以为未来的 CNT 组件网络规模模型提供信息。

articles.title: Selective strain tuning of nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics in BiFeO_text3
articles.title_zh: BiFeO_text3 中非平衡多铁动力学的选择性应变调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum materials are characterized by intertwined orders, and a fundamental goal in condensed matter physics is to achieve their selective control in such a way that one order parameter can be tuned while leaving others largely unaffected. Although significant progress has been made in thermal equilibrium, realizing such control out of equilibrium remains highly challenging. Here we employed in situ tensile strain to selectively manipulate the photoinduced lattice dynamics associated with ferroelectric and magnetic orders in multiferroic BiFeO₃. By applying MeV ultrafast electron diffraction to freestanding BiFeO₃ membranes under tunable strain, we showed that tensile strain markedly suppresses the ultrafast photoinduced reduction of the ferroelectric displacement. By contrast, the photoinduced dynamics of the antiferrodistortive rotation of the oxygen octahedra, which modulates the magnetic order, remains insensitive to strain. Not only do these findings reveal distinct microscopic pathways underlying nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics, they also establish tunable strain as an effective route for engineering ultrafast phase control in correlated materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料的特点是相互交织的秩序，凝聚态物理的一个基本目标是实现其选择性控制，从而可以调整一个秩序参数，同时使其他秩序参数基本上不受影响。尽管在热平衡方面已经取得了重大进展，但实现这种不平衡控制仍然极具挑战性。在这里，我们采用原位拉伸应变来选择性地操纵与多铁性 BiFeO₃ 中的铁电和磁序相关的光致晶格动力学。通过在可调应变下对独立式 BiFeO₃ 膜应用 MeV 超快电子衍射，我们发现拉伸应变显着抑制了铁电位移的超快光致减少。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料的特点是相互交织的秩序，凝聚态物理的一个基本目标是实现其选择性控制，从而可以调整一个秩序参数，同时使其他秩序参数基本上不受影响。尽管在热平衡方面已经取得了重大进展，但实现这种不平衡控制仍然极具挑战性。在这里，我们采用原位拉伸应变来选择性地操纵与多铁性 BiFeO₃ 中的铁电和磁序相关的光致晶格动力学。通过在可调应变下对独立式 BiFeO₃ 膜应用 MeV 超快电子衍射，我们发现拉伸应变显着抑制了铁电位移的超快光致减少。相比之下，调节磁序的氧八面体反铁畸变旋转的光致动力学仍然对应变不敏感。这些发现不仅揭示了非平衡多铁动力学背后的独特微观途径，而且还确立了可调谐应变作为相关材料中工程超快相位控制的有效途径。

articles.title: The giant component of complex hypergraphs: automated generating function calculations
articles.title_zh: 复杂超图的重要组成部分：自动生成函数计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29558v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Complex hypergraphs (chygraphs) contain graphs, hypergraphs, multiplex and interacting networks as special cases, and the percolation threshold of all of them follows from one symbolic calculation: the spectrum of a tensor A built from four matrices of first moments. That calculation stops at the threshold. Here I show that A is the Jacobian, at its trivial fixed point, of a non-linear self-consistency map whose non-trivial fixed point is the giant component fraction, so threshold and order parameter are two orders of one object on one index set. Carrying the expansion one order further gives the critical amplitude B in S=BΛ+O(Λ²) in closed form, and exposes a hierarchy: first moments fix the threshold, second moments the amplitude, and only the generating functions themselves the order parameter away from it. Dropping the assumption that a complex's participation in different layers is independent generalises the tensor again, replacing unconditional first moments by inclusion-biased second moments: distributions with identical marginals have different thresholds and different order parameters. Six constructions from the literature are then solved by substitution, among them AND- against OR-logic hypergraph percolation, which share a chygraph and differ in one generating function, and SIR epidemics with two levels of mixing, whose household reproduction number falls out of the tensor. A reported failure of mean-field theory on strongly clustered graphs is shown to be a failure of applying it to the wrong object: mapped onto the treelike backbone rather than the clustered graph, the same calculation reproduces the exact threshold, order parameter and critical exponents. Everything is implemented in one class, in which a chygraph is specified once by its generating functions and then returns all three, and validated against Monte Carlo simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 复杂超图（chygraph）包含图、超图、多重网络和交互网络作为特殊情况，所有这些的渗流阈值都来自一个符号计算：由四个一阶矩矩阵构建的张量 A 的谱。该计算在阈值处停止。在这里，我证明 A 是非线性自洽图在其平凡不动点处的雅可比行列式，其非平凡不动点是巨大的分量分数，因此阈值和阶参数是一个索引集上一个对象的两个阶。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复杂超图（chygraph）包含图、超图、多重网络和交互网络作为特殊情况，所有这些的渗流阈值都来自一个符号计算：由四个一阶矩矩阵构建的张量 A 的谱。该计算在阈值处停止。在这里，我证明 A 是非线性自洽图在其平凡不动点处的雅可比行列式，其非平凡不动点是巨大的分量分数，因此阈值和阶参数是一个索引集上一个对象的两个阶。将展开式进一步进行一阶，以闭合形式给出 S=BΛ+O(Λ²) 中的临界振幅 B，并暴露出层次结构：一阶矩固定阈值，二阶矩固定振幅，只有生成函数本身是远离阈值的阶次参数。放弃复合体在不同层中的参与是独立的假设，再次概括张量，用包含偏向的二阶矩代替无条件的一阶矩：具有相同边际的分布具有不同的阈值和不同的阶参数。然后通过替换解决文献中的六种结构，其中AND-反对OR-逻辑超图渗透，它们共享一个chygraph并且在一个生成函数上不同，以及具有两级混合的SIR流行病，其家庭再生数落在张量之外。据报道，平均场理论在强聚类图上的失败被证明是将其应用到错误的对象上的失败：映射到树状主干而不是聚类图上，相同的计算重现了精确的阈值、顺序参数和临界指数。一切都在一个类中实现，其中 chygraph 由其生成函数指定一次，然后返回所有三个，并根据蒙特卡洛模拟进行验证。

articles.title: Symmetry-protected intraband exciton-phonon scattering and its breakdown by mass asymmetry
articles.title_zh: 对称保护的带内激子-声子散射及其质量不对称的破坏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coupling of excitons to lattice vibrations is typically treated via phenomenological models that artificially separate long-range Fröhlich and short-range Holstein interactions. Recent analytical work has established that, in the delocalized limit, Fröhlich scattering is suppressed by electron--hole interference. Here we present a model-space Bethe--Salpeter framework to evaluate exciton--phonon coupling across the extended-to-localized crossover. We establish a fundamental distinction between the emphinclusive exciton--phonon coupling weight, obtainable via an exact completeness sum rule without summation over excited states, and the emphexclusive intraband (internal-state-preserving) scattering amplitude that governs low-energy decoherence. We prove an exact symmetry theorem: for an inversion-symmetric relative-coordinate Hamiltonian with equal electron and hole masses, the intraband Fröhlich vertex vanishes identically, protecting the exciton from low-energy polar phonon scattering. When mass asymmetry is introduced, the finite-momentum relative wavefunction acquires a complex phase twist that breaks this protection. By analyzing the long-wavelength limit, we derive a controlled small-q activation law showing that the intraband vertex scales as F₀₀(q) propto Δ q² langle r² rangle, where Δ parameterizes the mass asymmetry. Finally, we compute the second-order polaron self-energy shift and demonstrate that mass asymmetry dramatically enhances phonon dressing, confirming that the symmetry theorem directly governs the many-body energy renormalization of the exciton. These results provide a rigorous conceptual framework for understanding the competition between long-range and local exciton--phonon coupling in polar semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 激子与晶格振动的耦合通常通过唯象模型来处理，该模型人为地分离长程 Fröhlich 和短程 Holstein 相互作用。最近的分析工作表明，在离域极限中，弗罗利希散射受到电子-空穴干涉的抑制。在这里，我们提出了一个模型空间 Bethe-Salpeter 框架来评估扩展到局部交叉的激子-声子耦合。
