In particular, SAGE achieves up to an 8-fold improvement on the Andrews-Curtis problem, an open real-world long-horizon task. Code is available at: https://github.com/Susan571/SAGE-NeurIPS2026.

articles.title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29166v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physical AI aims to build embodied agents that perceive the world, understand and reason about it, and decide how to act. Yet the field has focused primarily on the last component: the action model that maps observations to low-level controls. The prevailing training recipe can erode the perceptual and reasoning capabilities needed for robust behavior, leaving even strong action models vulnerable to scene perturbations and long-horizon tasks. We introduce HarnessPAI, a model- and embodiment-agnostic Harness framework for Physical AI that treats code as the executable and evolvable interface that organizes the underlying action primitive. The framework separates two timescales: within a rollout, it executes open-loop at the program level, with a fixed program guiding and checking execution; across rollouts, it evolves closed-loop, using execution feedback to revise the program and distill failures into reusable skills. Across desktop robot arms, household robots, a robot vacuum, and a legged walking agent, HarnessPAI improves on both pure action models and code-as-policy baselines without retraining the underlying model: a 61.6-point gain over π₀.₅ on LIBERO-PRO and a 27.2-point gain over WorldDreamer on RoboCasa atomic tasks. Once a program is selected, rollout execution requires no online high-level LLM deliberation. Beyond execution, the converged program is also a cheap and reliable expert-data collector, and fine-tuning π₀.₅ on collected expert data lifts success rate on LIBERO-PRO by 38.8 points. Our results suggest that the frontier of Physical AI depends not only on stronger action models, but also on executable harnesses that integrate perception, task understanding and reasoning, and action execution into a unified, verifiable, and feedback-driven system. Website: https://darwin-agent.github.io/HarnessPAI

articles.title: Reasoning Instructions Can Break Answer Decoding in Vision--Language Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29278v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) instructions can distort multiple-choice VLM evaluation when a scorer appends a reasoning cue but reads answer-label logits before the model generates any rationale. We call this CoT-prefix scoring. On ScienceQA, Qwen2.5-VL-7B drops from 80.76% to 45.48%, and across five option-content permutations 93.54% of CoT-prefix predictions select the first slot. Condition-matched linear probes recover 78.94% from the same hidden states, while free generation restores 75.24%, showing that the answer often survives the prefix and the immediate readout fails. Vocabulary and layer diagnostics explain the mismatch: probability mass moves toward continuation tokens, while answer information remains linearly accessible in late layers. The effect recurs with varying severity across datasets and models, though not universally. These results show that CoT-prefix scoring can confound model knowledge with an evaluation-interface mismatch and should be avoided unless the requested and scored output events are aligned.

articles.title: DocuTeam: Mixed-Initiative Multi-Agent Discussions around Evolving Documents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.29309v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In open-ended problem solving, collaborators often rely on discussion to surface concerns, challenge perspectives, and refine shared work as it evolves. While AI agents are increasingly used as discussion partners, existing multi-agent systems place a heavy burden on users to initiate and carefully orchestrate the discussions. We present DocuTeam, a mixed-initiative multi-agent discussion system in which both users and agents can initiate and steer conversations. Agents monitor document changes to proactively start and redirect discussions as the work evolves, while users can flexibly shape the conversation or adopt agent ideas. In a within-subjects study (N=20), participants using DocuTeam produced outcomes rated significantly more novel, relevant, and specific than with a baseline without any increase in cognitive load. Rather than using agents for one-off idea sourcing, participants engaged in an iterative refinement loop in which document changes prompted agent reactions, which led users to revisit and further develop their work.

articles.title: Controlled Interferometric Test of Quantum Coherence under Equal PathDistinguishability: Discrete Energy Exchange versus Continuous Dispersion
articles.abstract: The relation between interference visibility and path distinguishability is a core pillar of quantum complementarity and decoherence theory. In standard quantum mechanics, all coherence decay in interferometric systems is attributed exclusively to path information leakage, which establishes a one-to-one relation between environmental distinguishability and fringe visibility. However, a fundamental question remains experimentally untested: whether discrete quantized energy exchange between light and matter can degrade quantum coherence independently of path distinguishability. In this work, we propose a high-precision cavity-QED experiment based on a Mach–Zehnder interferometer to decouple interaction modality from path information. A single trapped Rb atom inside an optical cavity is placed in one interferometer arm, enabling fully switchable light–matter interaction regimes: resonant discrete energy exchange and far-detuned continuous dispersive interaction. To eliminate systematic artifacts, we employ environmental state tomography to rigorously equalize the path distinguishability in both operational regimes. Furthermore, we systematically compensate all linear dynamical differences between resonant and dispersive cavity responses, including group delay, spectral distortion, and temporal mode mismatch. With all standard decoherence and dynamical contributions precisely calibrated, standard quantum mechanics predicts identical interference visibility for resonant and dispersive interactions. In contrast, a physically motivated alternative conjecture suggests that discrete energy exchange can induce intrinsic coherence suppression even at fixed path distinguishability. The two scenarios yield experimentally distinguishable visibility differences. Our scheme utilizes mature single-atom cavity quantum optics techniques without low-temperature superconducting devices, providing a robust and accessible platform to resolve this long-standing open question in quantum interferometry. The complete optical layout, timing sequence, tomography calibration, statistical criteria, and error suppression strategies are presented. This experiment offers a decisive experimental benchmark for the fundamental relationship between light–matter interaction type and quantum coherence.

articles.title: Construction of a CeO 2 /ZnO/NH 2 -MIL-101(Fe) Ternary Heterojunction for Efficient Visible-Light-Driven Photocatalytic Reduction of U(Ⅵ): Enhanced Charge Separation and Uranium Immobilization Mechanism
articles.abstract: The remediation of radioactive effluent is significantly impacted by the development of highly efficient visible-light photocatalysts for the reduction of soluble radionuclide. This study successfully synthesized and evaluated NH2-MIL-101(Fe) (MIL) and a series of CeO2/ZnO-modified NH2-MIL-101(Fe) ternary heterojunctions (A-C) for the photocatalytic reduction of aqueous U(Ⅵ). After 60 min of visible-light irradiation, the optimized 5%CeO2/10%ZnO/MIL (composite B) exhibited the highest photocatalytic activity among the prepared photocatalysts, achieving 92.9% and 95.1% under air and N2 atmospheres, respectively. These experiments were carried out under the optimal conditions of 75 mg catalyst dosage, 20 mg L− 1 initial U(Ⅵ), pH 5, and 1% (v/v) formic acid. In addition, the effects of oxides loading, catalyst dosage, initial U(Ⅵ) concentration, solution pH, reaction atmosphere, sacrificial reagents, and catalyst recyclability were systematically investigated. Moreover, the successful construction of the CeO2/ZnO/MIL heterojunctions was confirmed by comprehensive characterization using PXRD, FT-IR, XPS, UV-vis diffuse reflectance spectroscopy, N2 adsorption-desorption, photoluminescence spectroscopy, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. Although the conventional binary heterojunctions possess a single semiconductor interface, the CeO2/ZnO/MIL ternary architecture is composed of multiple coupled interfaces and the synergistic functions of the three components, which create more efficient interfacial pathways for directional charge migration. This cooperative interfacial effect promotes the electron transit and spatial charge separation, and suppresses the electron-hole recombination, hence enhancing the availability of reduction-active electrons toward U(Ⅵ). The characterization also revealed substantially enhanced visible-light harvesting, efficient interfacial charge separation, accelerated electron transport, and suppressed electron-hole recombination. Furthermore, the dominant reactive species responsible for U(Ⅵ) reduction were photogenerated electrons, superoxide radicals, and slightly reducing CO2•− intermediates of formic acid, as demonstrated by radical trapping experiments. Meanwhile, the optimized composite (B) also demonstrated exceptional structural stability and maintained approximately 78% of its initial activity after five consecutive cycles. Thus, the CeO2/ZnO/MIL heterojunction is a promising visible-light photocatalyst for radionuclide remediation and offers a viable approach to the reduction of U(Ⅵ) and other redox-active radionuclides in an aqueous environment.

articles.title: High-resolution in situ structure of an archaeal A1Ao ATP synthase reveals a universal stress protein rotary brake
articles.abstract: Rotary ATPases interconvert ATP chemical energy with transmembrane ion gradients and occur as F₁Fₒ, A₁Aₒ and V₁Vₒ enzymes. Canonical F-type ATP synthases are commonly framed as Complex V of respiratory or photosynthetic electron-transfer chains, whereas archaeal A₁Aₒ ATP synthases operate downstream of more diverse ion-gradient-generating pathways. However, high-resolution native structures of intact archaeal A₁Aₒ enzymes have remained unavailable. Here, we report a high-resolution in situ structure of the A₁Aₒ ATP synthase from Methanosaeta concilii, determined in native membrane by cryogenic electron tomography (cryoET) and subtomogram averaging at resolutions reaching 3.6 Å. ATPγS-treated samples captured three canonical rotary states, whereas ATPγS-free lysed samples exclusively adopted a fourth state, State 0, defined by binding of a universal stress protein (USP). In this inhibited conformation, a USP homodimer binds at the base of the A₁ domain, near the open A/B catalytic interface and peripheral stalk, and sterically occludes hydrolysis direction rotation. The structures further reveal archaeal membrane-sector adaptations, including an extended Aₒ rotor-base architecture, putative Na⁺-binding c₁₁ ring, accessory transmembrane elements, intraluminal lipid-like density and dense non-lattice-like membrane distribution. Together, these native-state structures define archaeal A₁Aₒ architecture, uncover a USP-mediated rotary brake, and suggest a stress-responsive mechanism for limiting futile ATP hydrolysis when ion-gradient-driven ATP synthesis is compromised.

articles.title: Development of a Hybrid Wire–Powder DED-Arc Plasma System for Fabrication of WC Reinforced Low Carbon Steel Metal Matrix Composites
articles.abstract: The fabrication of metal matrix composites (MMCs) is of considerable interest owing to their excellent mechanical properties and wear resistance. However, their production using conventional manufacturing routes is often associated with high processing complexity and limited design flexibility. Additive manufacturing (AM), particularly Directed Energy Deposition (DED), offers an attractive alternative by enabling near-net-shape fabrication together with enhanced control over material deposition and microstructural development. This work presents the development and process optimisation of a hybrid wire–powder Plasma Arc Directed Energy Deposition (DED) system for the fabrication of WC-reinforced Steel MMCs. The system integrates an auxiliary powder feeding unit into a conventional wire-fed plasma DED process, enabling the simultaneous deposition of a G3Si1 steel wire matrix and tungsten carbide (WC) powder reinforcement. A multi-stage experimental approach was adopted to establish stable deposition conditions by optimising the deposition parameters, powder feed rate, carrier gas flow rate, and nozzle diameter. Using the optimised parameters, multilayer wall structures were produced under different cooling conditions. Optical microscopy, image analysis, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX), and mechanical characterisation were employed to investigate the influence of processing conditions on microstructural evolution and phase formation. The results showed that thermal management significantly affected deposit integrity, with slower cooling reducing cracking and porosity. Partial dissolution of the WC particles promoted the diffusion of W and C into the steel matrix, producing compositionally graded particle–matrix interfaces comprising Fe–W–C reaction layers, carbide-rich eutectic-like regions and a tungsten-alloyed steel matrix. Furthermore, the combined influence of cooling rate and alloying modified the transformation behaviour of the steel matrix, with rapid cooling favouring a predominantly martensitic microstructure. In contrast, slower cooling promoted a greater bainitic fraction. The results demonstrate that hybrid wire–powder Plasma Arc DED provides a viable route for manufacturing WC-reinforced steel MMCs with controlled reinforcement incorporation and tailored microstructures. The findings provide new insights into the relationships among process optimisation, phase evolution, and microstructural development, advancing plasma DED for the fabrication of high-performance steel-based MMCs.

articles.title: MoSI: A Sensor-Fused Margin of Stability at Interfaces for Modular Robots
articles.abstract: Lattice-based modular robots form adaptive structures from repeated units for self-reconfiguration and programmable matter. As these structures grow, loads are transferred through changing interfaces, making stability assessment difficult. Geometric support-polygon and center-of-mass checks are efficient but may overlook localized interface loading, whereas full mechanical-equilibrium solvers require more detailed models and greater computational effort. We introduce a sensor-fused Margin of Stability at Interfaces (MoSI) that combines an edge-weighted, scale-normalized geometric margin with force-sensitive resistor differentials and inertial measurement unit tilt. The geometric margin is computed for the complete configuration, while local sensing differentiates the monitored interfaces. Three variants provide progressively different fusion behaviors, ranging from smooth continuous correction to fuzzy-weighted and sign-adjusted responses. Hardware cantilever experiments over 10 repeated trials show that the fused margins approach or cross the zero-margin threshold at the observed critical four-block condition, while the geometry-only margin remains positive. A hardware-correlated Webots simulation model reproduces the decreasing sensor-fused margin trend and identifies the same lowest-margin condition, with root mean square error =0.018 and mean absolute error =0.013 over four paired growth stages. Scalability-oriented simulations of a V-bridge, J-pillar, branch overhang, and progressively loaded tower-supported plate further demonstrate consistent responses to localized overload, lever-arm growth, asymmetric support loss, and rotational deformation without configuration-specific retuning. The interface scores are compatible with hierarchical box-based evaluation and event-driven distributed minimum aggregation. Overall, the proposed sensor-fused margin of stability at interfaces provides an interpretable stability score that reduces the overconfidence of geometry-only assessment without requiring a full mechanical-equilibrium model. Categories: (2), (5), and (6)

articles.title: Construction of a Four-Strain Synthetic Bacillus Consortium and Evaluation of Its Biocontrol Efficacy Against Tomato Fusarium Wilt Caused by Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici
articles.abstract: Tomato Fusarium wilt, caused by Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici (FORL), is a major soil-borne constraint on protected tomato production worldwide. Because single biocontrol strains often show inconsistent field performance, this study aimed to construct and optimize a synthetic bacterial consortium combining endophytic and soil-derived biocontrol bacteria and to evaluate its efficacy against tomato Fusarium wilt. Using dilution plating, 582 bacterial strains were obtained from 42 rhizosphere soil samples and 195 endophytic strains from six healthy tomato plants. Initial screening by plate confrontation yielded 78 soil-derived and 46 endophytic biocontrol candidates; after a second round of screening, 45 strains with inhibition rates exceeding 35% were retained. Of these, two soil strains (SF-89, KD-54) and two endophytic strains (F-86, F-29) showed the strongest in vitro inhibition of FORL (45.9-48.7%) and were identified by morphological, physiological/biochemical and 16S rRNA gene sequence analysis as Bacillus siamensis, B. subtilis, B. velezensis and B. methylotrophicus, respectively. The four strains were compatible in co-culture. A quantitative mixture-design analysis identified F-29 (B. methylotrophicus) as the principal (dominant) strain of the consortium, and Box-Behnken response-surface optimization determined an optimal strain ratio of SF-89:F-86:KD-54:F-29 = 2:2:2:5.5, giving a predicted sterile-filtrate inhibition rate of 48.02% (validated at 48.8-49.4%; n = 3); inhibitory activity remained stable after 10⁷-fold dilution of the fermentation broth. An optimal fermentation medium (10.721 g/L yeast extract powder, 12.382 g/L beef extract, 7.696 g/L MgCl2) and culture conditions were subsequently established. Application of the consortium fermentation broth promoted tomato seed germination and seedling growth, increased leaf chlorophyll content and nitrate reductase activity, and induced earlier and stronger activity of the defense enzymes superoxide dismutase, peroxidase, catalase and phenylalanine ammonia-lyase following pathogen challenge. In a pot trial, the consortium gave a relative protective efficacy of 52.87% and a relative curative efficacy of 60.0% against tomato Fusarium wilt. These results indicate that the four-strain Bacillus consortium constructed here, combining endophytic and rhizosphere-derived isolates, is a promising candidate biocontrol resource for tomato Fusarium wilt, warranting further mechanistic and field-scale evaluation.

articles.title: Study on Multiphase Pyrolysis Kinetics and Fire Early Warning Characteristics of Cable Sheaths and Insulating Layers
articles.abstract: This study overcomes a limitation of single-material thermal analysis—which cannot resolve the interdependent, multi-phase degradation of multilayered cables under fire—by integrating STA–FTIR with two model-free kinetic methods (KAS and FWO). This enables mechanistic insight into how graded filler concentrations—low (PVC), medium (ZR-YJLV), and high (N-BV)—govern pyrolytic failure and volatile emissions across outer sheaths and inner XLPE insulation. Kinetic analysis shows filler loading controls apparent activation energy during primary decomposition: Eₐ decreases from 208.53 kJ/mol (PVC) to 114.0 7kJ/mol (ZR-YJLV) and 91.53 kJ/mol (N-BV), confirming a progressive inert dilution effect where dense mineral fillers disrupt polymer continuity and impair thermal homogeneity. N-BV exhibits an increase to 160.96 kJ/mol in the final stage due to endothermic sintering of metal oxides into a refractory ceramic phase. FTIR gas profiling reveals a concentration-dependent suppression: medium–high fillers rely on H₂O vapor for gas-phase dilution; ultra-high fillers form a low-permeability ceramic char barrier that impedes volatile diffusion, reducing CH₄ emissions by over two orders of magnitude. By Integrating these hierarchical inhibition mechanisms and the intrinsic vulnerability of XLPE, established a two-tier early-warning paradigm: Tier I (270–310°C; HCl and CO) signals sheath degradation; Tier II (450°C; CH₄, C₂H₄, C₂H₂) marks XLPE breakdown. This framework provides a defensible basis for fire monitoring in urban utility tunnels.

articles.title: Safe Aggregation in Modular Sustainability Assessment: A Method for Interface-Aware Pareto Screening
articles.abstract: Modular sustainability assessment requires deciding which properties of intermediate flows must remain explicit when process models are reused, screened, or connected. We propose a method for determining when such information can be aggregated without altering downstream environmental conclusions. Conditional life-cycle inventories are mapped to partially ordered sufficient-burden relations on typed process interfaces. The central result is a factorization criterion: a coarse interface preserves composition exactly when every intended downstream continuation is insensitive to the distinctions removed. For a declared upstream technology library and downstream continuation family, this yields a reachable observational quotient that is the coarsest exact interface preserving all relevant distinctions. The resulting interface defines where local Pareto pruning is valid before full system composition. In a constructed five-technology benchmark, nominal-product screening eliminates the unique system-level Pareto optimum, whereas interface-aware screening preserves it while still removing a genuinely redundant alternative and an irrelevant interface variable. Controlled Monte Carlo stress tests over 160,000 randomly generated modular systems show that the risk of false nominal pruning increases with downstream state sensitivity, continuation diversity, and technology-library size; exact interface-aware screening preserves the complete system frontier in all simulated cases. The method provides an auditable basis for process aggregation, reusable foreground-model design, and early technology screening in industrial ecology.

articles.title: Implementation Of Metasurface with Slotted Ground Structure Utilizing a Monopole Patch Resonating in Millimeter-Wave Frequency Band
articles.abstract: This manuscript reports the design, analysis and realization of a metasurface-based antenna structure featuring a slotted metallic ground (SMG) integrated with an isosceles triangular monopole (ITM) patch radiator and tapered a feed line targeting for millimetre-wave (mm Wave) operation. To manipulate the current distribution across the radiating patch and SMG, a nonuniform unit-cell metasurface is introduced which effectively enhance the bandwidth in the range of 3.5 – 40 GHz. Additionally, the metasurface suppresses the backward radiation and enhances the radiated power in the forward direction, as a result, an acceptable level of front to back ratio is achieved. The dimensions of the printed prototype are 25×20 mm2 and it provides the broad operating impedance bandwidth in the range 3.5 – 40 GHz with the magnitude of the reflection coefficient |S₁₁| consistently under −10 dB.. The proposed antenna accomplishes the peak measured gain with a radiation efficiency of 10 dBi and 96 percentage respectively, exhibits a unidirectional radiation pattern and is employed for point-to point communication.

articles.title: Translating International Gender Norms into Domestic Trade Policy: The GTAGA Experience in Latin American Countries
articles.abstract: International norms on gender and trade have advanced rapidly, yet how states internalise and translate them into domestic policy remains underexplored. Moving beyond unidirectional top-down models, this study identifies distinct patterns of domestic implementation of the Global Trade and Gender Arrangement (GTAGA) across eight Latin American signatories: Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Costa Rica, Ecuador, and Mexico. Adopting a comparative multi-case design anchored in foreign policy analysis and bidirectional norm diffusion theory, we show that state responses vary systematically based on pre-existing institutional capacity. High-capacity states act as active "norm shapers," exporting domestic innovations to multilateral arenas, while states with consolidating capacity leverage the GTAGA as an external catalyst for domestic reform. Conversely, political volatility in low-resilience contexts highlights the vulnerability of gender agendas. The findings contribute to debates on Global South normative agency, policy implementation, and the structural tensions between feminist trade ambitions and market-oriented trade governance.

articles.title: The border of the source region biases connective field estimates: simulation, human V1 to V2 and V3, and a correction
articles.abstract: Connective field modelling estimates, for a target location in one visual area, the position and size of a Gaussian pooling region on the cortical surface of a source area. The model is fitted inside a source region of interest, so a pooling region centred near the border of that region extends onto cortex the fit cannot see. The limitation has been named in the literature and judged minimal, without a measurement against a known pooling region. We implement the estimator to a published parameterisation and measure the effect in a simulation in which the true pooling kernel is known and extends beyond the region the estimator is given. Two biases act over different ranges. Size shrinks by 0.5 to 1.0 mm within the first millimetre or two of the border, with little dependence on the true size. Position is displaced towards the border by 0.2 to 0.5 times the true size, at a distance of 0.5 to 1 times the true size, and the displacement vanishes for a field centred on the border. Fit quality declines at the border, and estimates accumulate at the size floor when the true size is small or the source region carries spatially correlated noise. Applying the same estimator to the V1 to V2 projection in 19 subjects of a public human retinotopy dataset, and using the retinotopic maps as an independent prediction of where each connective field centre should lie, size near the border is 1.46 mm smaller than far from it after eccentricity control, 41% of the far-from-border size, and the fraction of fits on the size floor rises from 0.12 to 0.46. The size effect holds when near-border and far-border targets are matched on the target’s own distance to the border, and it follows the border of the fitted region rather than the anatomy: cutting the source region back by 3 mm, which places an artificial border 3 mm inside V1, deepens the deficit at those locations by 0.96 mm (−1.43 to −0.53) in the same targets and hemispheres. Giving the estimator 6 mm of cortex beyond the border, with centres still restricted to V1, removes the bias in simulation; in the V1 to V3 projection, where the effect itself is only a trend (−0.93 mm, −1.57 to +0.02), it removes the accumulation at the size floor, which survives correction for multiple testing, and halves the size contrast, which does not. The remedy costs no data but is unavailable between neighbouring areas, V1 to V2 among them, where the extension reaches the targets themselves. The human effects are larger than truncation alone reproduces: taking the same bands in the simulation as in the data, 0 to 2 mm against 10 mm and beyond, the largest near-minus-far difference in floor fraction anywhere in the sweep is 0.10, against 0.36 in the data. The position effect has the predicted direction and the predicted extremum, and its magnitude is not resolved by these data. Excluding targets whose predicted centre lies within 2 mm of the border costs 28.5% of targets in this dataset and substantially reduces the size effect.

articles.title: vIR-OLO: an open-source YOLO-based interface for functional- group detection and localization in infrared spectra
articles.abstract: Accurate identification of functional groups from infrared (IR) spectra is a fundamental task in molecular characterization. Recent data-driven approaches have demonstrated strong performance in functional group recognition; however, most methods formulate the problem as a classification task and do not explicitly identify the spectral regions responsible for their predictions. This limits their utility for annotation workflows, model verification, and human-guided interpretation. Here, we introduce vIR-OLO , an open-source framework that reformulates functional group identification in IR spectroscopy as an object detection problem using the YOLO architecture. Rather than predicting only the presence of functional groups, vIR-OLO localizes characteristic spectral features through bounding-box annotations directly on IR spectra. We developed and benchmarked three pretrained models based on alternative functional group sets containing 10, 12, and 13 classes, respectively. Across all configurations, the models achieved strong incidence-based detection performance (micro-averaged F1 scores exceeding 0.84) while maintaining accurate localization of matched spectral regions (mean Intersection over Union greater than 0.80). vIR-OLO is available at https://github.com/ChemAI-Lab/vIR-OLO, and the pre-trained models are available at https://huggingface.co/ChemAI-Lab. Scientific Contribution Statement: vIR-OLO is the first opensource YOLO-based framework that reframes functional-group identification in IR spectra as an object-detection task. vIR-OLO not only predicts functional group presence but explicitly localizes characteristic spectral regions through editable bounding-box annotations directly on the spectra. By benchmarking three pretrained models across different prior approaches, vIR-OLO and its GUI framework advance the field by providing an easily deployable, human-in-the-loop tool that enables reproducible evaluation and community-driven model development.

articles.title: SAHAB: A Compact Balloon-Borne Radiation Detection Platform for Solar X-Ray and Gamma-Ray Physics Development
articles.abstract: We present SAHAB (Saudi Arabia High-Altitude Balloon), the first iteration of a balloon-borne radiation detection platform developed jointly by King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals (KFUPM), the Space Sciences Laboratory, and the University of California Merced. The program pursues two goals: developing cost-effective instrumentation for solar hard X-ray and gamma-ray spectroscopy, and building research capacity in experimental solar physics within Saudi Arabia. This first flight of the SAHAB payload will be hosted aboard BOOP (Balloon Observation and Operations Platform), a NASA-operated balloon platform. The science payload comprises one NaI(Tl) scintillation detector, one Geiger counter, one environmental sensor, and an imaging camera, all controlled by a Raspberry Pi 3B. In this article we also present the mechanical design and structural analysis of the chassis and payload. This paper describes the design of the first SAHAB iteration and establishes the operational framework for future standalone flights incorporating dedicated telemetry, LaBr3:Ce scintillators, and CdTe/SDD solid-state detectors optimized for solar flare observations.

articles.title: Carbon-Convergent Co-utilization of Ethanol and CO2 Enables 3-Hydroxypropionate Biosynthesis in Komagataella phaffii
articles.abstract: Carbon dioxide offers an abundant feedstock for sustainable manufacturing, yet its highly oxidized state creates a fundamental mismatch with the reducing power for multicarbon biosynthesis. Here we address this limitation through redox-complementary carbon convergence, a hybrid synthesis strategy that combines a chemically reduced carbon intermediate with biological inorganic-carbon incorporation. We identify ethanol as a nexus molecule that supplies a conserved C2 backbone together with reducing equivalents. Then engineerd Komagataella phaffii couples this ethanol-derived C2 unit with an inorganic C1 unit, establishing a “2 + 1=3” route to 3-hydroxypropionate (3-HP). Coordinated engineering of ethanol assimilation, acetate activation, carboxylation, cofactor supply, and energy metabolism generated strain LT-28, which produced 127.04 g/L 3-HP, the highest reported titer for de novo microbial production. 13C tracing verified the joint contribution of ethanol-derived C2 carbon and inorganic C1 carbon to the product skeleton. Moreover, LT-28 directly converted an unpurified ethanol-rich stream generated by thermocatalytic CO2 reduction into 3-HP, demonstrating compatibility between the chemical and biological modules. This work establishes redox-complementary carbon convergence as a general design principle for selecting nexus molecules and constructing hybrid platforms that transform CO2 into reduced multicarbon products.

articles.title: DJAMILAR: Gravity as Geometric Filtration — A Common Geometric Origin of Gravitation, Quantum-Classical Behaviour and Dark-Sector Phenomenology
articles.abstract: DJAMILAR investigates the hypothesis that microscopic apertures in the structure of spacetime, the Djamilars, provide a common physical origin for gravitational response, the quantum–classical transition and part of the phenomenology attributed to dark components. We construct an effective framework for this programme, separate inherited structures from Djamilar-specific identifications, and derive relations that can be tested independently. The geometric loading               Cd = π nd rd2 is mapped to a covariant scalar–aether–memory representative built on aether–scalar–tensor theory, whose scalar equation is written directly for the aperture radius. An induced-gravity interface relates the Einstein coefficient to a renormalized stress-trace moment. On the tracking branch, under its preferred-frame premise, the local conversion obeys the exact identity CtrIR = 1/(1 + α1tr/8); post-Newtonian coefficients of the screened branch require a complete constrained finite-source reduction. A completely positive Gaussian generator attached to the aperture state gives exact decoherence, momentum-diffusion and heating relations. For galaxies and the Solar System, an interpolation-independent monotonicity theorem supplies a conditional no-overlap test, and a higher-spatial-derivative candidate defines a convex static problem with a unique weak solution and an isolated crossover scaling as M−1/2; dynamics and lensing must follow from the same metric solution. In homogeneous cosmology the declared temporal sector yields energy, pressure and exact on-shell conservation, with a conditional relation between a dust-like contribution and aperture drift. Direct variation shows that the minimal compact Euler/three-form sector does not sequester vacuum energy. The microscopic aperture dynamics, the screened post-Newtonian theory, cosmological perturbations and radiative vacuum protection are identified as the constructions that remain.

articles.title: 25 Pb s-1 extreme-multiplexed fiber-optic communications enabled by orbital angular momentum physics
articles.abstract: Massive space-division multiplexing could enable multi-petabit fibre transmission, but its up-scaling is met with two major constraints, namely inter-modal coupling inside the fibre and multi-dimensional spatio-modal alignment at the fibre–transceiver interfaces. We show that by exploiting the natural physical properties of orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) modes in ring-core fibres, both constraints can be significantly relieved to construct block-diagonal end-to-end channel matrix. In the fibre, the OAM modes are partitioned into 4-fold near-degenerate spin-orbital mode groups by joint exploitation of their ring-confined modal field distribution, enlarged inter-group wave propagation-constant separation and azimuthal selection rules to suppress inter-group coupling, resulting in block-diagonal fiber transfer matrix with 4×4 sub-blocks. At the interfaces, the rotational invariance and high overlap between OAM modes allows cross-order transferable wavefront distortion correction, which is utilized to develop rapid adaptive optical alignment that suppresses inter-group crosstalk arising in the massive parallel mode launch and detection process. Leveraging the resulting block-diagonal end-to-end channel matrix, we realize a 10-km 19-core OAM fibre transmission system with only fixed-size 4×4 MIMO equalization modules and fully automated interface. The system supports 266 spatial channels each carrying 1,240 wavelength channels across the S, C and L bands, achieving the extreme multiplexing of 329,840 optical data streams with 25.24 Pb s⁻¹ aggregate capacity, reaching a spectral efficiency of 1935.6 bit s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹ and a spectral-efficiency density of 3.94 × 10⁻² bit s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹ µm⁻². To our knowledge, this is the first single-fibre system exceeding 100 usable SDM channels with low and constant MIMO complexity and no manual interface adjustment.

articles.title: Interlaminar Shear Degradation and Cohesive Zone Modelling of Thermally Aged CFRP Laminates
articles.abstract: This study investigates interlaminar shear degradation induced by thermal aging in T700/epoxy CFRP laminates and links the measured response to equivalent cohesive zone parameters. Short beam shear tests, fracture surface characterization, Bayesian parameter inversion and evolution modelling with temperature and time were combined. Laminates were aged at 150, 180 and 200°C for 24 ~ 1000 h. The interface penalty stiffness, tangential nominal strength and mode II critical fracture energy were identified using tree structured Parzen estimator optimization. The interlaminar shear strength increased slightly after short and intermediate exposure at 150°C, but generally decreased at 180 and 200°C; the strength retention after aging at 200°C for 1000 h was 91.4%. Fracture morphology evolved from mixed matrix and interface failure toward delamination dominated by the interface. Sensitivity analysis showed that tangential nominal strength mainly controlled peak load, interface penalty stiffness governed the response before the peak, and mode II fracture energy regulated damage growth after the peak and energy dissipation. Temperature dependent evolution models calibrated with 24 ~ 500 h data predicted the 1000 h conditions with a mean absolute percentage error of 1.45% for the equivalent interface parameters and an average normalized root mean square error of 7.01% for the load displacement responses. The framework provides a quantitative route for mapping thermal aging history to interlaminar shear response and equivalent interface degradation in CFRP laminates.

articles.title: Effect of reagent ro-vibrational excitation on the electronic ground state dynamics of He + LiH + → LiHe + + H reaction
articles.abstract: The effects of ro-vibrational excitation of reagent LiH + on the He + LiH + ( v = 0–4, j = 0 and v = 0, j = 1) → LiHe + ( v ′, j ′) + H reaction are investigated by employing a time-dependent wave packet propagation approach and quasi-classical trajectory method. A recently developed electronic ground state potential energy surface [Rawat et al. , J. Chem. Phys. 161 , 124308 (2024)] of the LiHeH + system is employed for this purpose. Energy resolved total and state-to-state reaction probabilities, integral reaction cross sections, product diatom rotational and vibrational distributions at some selected collision energies, and state-specific rate constants are calculated to elucidate the mechanistic details of the reaction. Reagent vibrational excitations show an intriguing effect on the dynamics, whereas the effect of reagent rotation is mild. Statistical distribution of product vibration suggests an indirect mechanism through the formation of metastable collision complexes on the underlying surface during the course of the reaction.

articles.title: More is not always better: Dissociative photoionization limits the EUV absorbing photoacid generator pentafluorophenyl triflate in photolithography
articles.abstract: Pentafluorophenyl triflate has been explored as a highly absorbing neutral photoacid generator (PAG) candidate for next-generation chemically amplified resists used in extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography. Although increased fluorination enhances EUV absorption, this study demonstrates that such an approach does not necessarily improve photoacid generation efficiency. Using photoelectron–photoion coincidence spectroscopy at the 92 eV photon energy of the EUV scanners in combination with quantum-chemical calculations, the dissociative photoionization of pentafluorophenyl triflate was systematically investigated. The photoionization mass spectrum reveals extensive fragmentation, with the parent ion contributing only 3.1% of the total signal and CF 3 + representing the dominant product ion. Computed appearance energies align well with experimental trends and support a sequential fragmentation pathway involving loss of SO 2 , CF 3 , and CO. Crucially, none of the major dissociation channels yield precursors capable of forming triflic acid, the strong photoacid required for efficient deprotection reactions in chemically amplified resists. Combined with previous dissociative electron attachment studies indicating similarly unfavorable fragmentation, the results demonstrate that despite its high EUV absorption cross section, pentafluorophenyl triflate is unsuitable as a PAG for EUV lithography. The findings highlight the importance of understanding fundamental photoionization and electron-interaction mechanisms to guide the rational design of next-generation high-performance EUV photoresists.

articles.title: Aerosol hygroscopicity and photodegradation in the polluted Indo-Gangetic Plain compared with the clean Himalayas examined using a quartz crystal microbalance
articles.abstract: Reducing climate uncertainty requires a better understanding of the influence of aerosols on clouds and precipitation, particularly their hygroscopicity under subsaturated conditions, which affects their water uptake, associated optical properties, and radiative impacts. To investigate this, PM2.5 aerosol samples were analyzed from two contrasting locations: Leh, a high-altitude clean desert plateau in the Himalayas, and Delhi, a heavily polluted urban megacity in the Indo-Gangetic Plain (IGP). A quartz crystal microbalance was used to evaluate hygroscopic growth, including mass loss induced by ultraviolet irradiation. The findings show that Himalayan aerosols have a distinct deliquescence phase transition and high hygroscopicity. In contrast, IGP aerosols have delayed or absent deliquescence and low hygroscopicity. These differences highlight the significant role of chemical composition, particularly the organic fraction, in aerosol behavior. Furthermore, the greater photolytic mass loss observed in Himalayan aerosols suggests the presence of more photolabile components. These results underscore the importance of relative humidity history, chemical composition, and photochemistry in aerosol properties, which are crucial for developing accurate atmospheric models.

articles.title: Optical Tamm states-induced tunable triple-band spin-dependent near-perfect absorption in a magnetic Weyl semimetal-Fibonacci heterostructure
articles.abstract: Magnetic Weyl semimetals (mWSMs) enable spin-resolved optical responses at zero magnetic field via their intrinsic topological magneto-optical effects, making them an ideal material platform for spin-selective absorption. However, most existing mWSM-based absorption structures rely on periodic photonic crystal, whose single resonance channel is insufficient to support multichannel parallel spin information processing. Here we construct a heterostructure composed of a Fibonacci quasi-periodic photonic crystal and an mWSM thin film, and systematically investigate its spin-dependent absorption characteristics by using the 4×4 transfer matrix method. Results show that the self-similar fractal energy bands of the quasi-periodic structure satisfy the optical Tamm states phase matching condition in three reflection bandgaps simultaneously, inducing triple-band near-perfect absorption with prominent spin splitting in each band. Furthermore, Weyl node separation, Fermi level and dielectric layer thickness act as independent tuning parameters to adjust the resonance frequency and absorption intensity of the three absorption bands respectively. This study breaks the channel number limitation of periodic configurations and provides a feasible approach for designing integrated multichannel spin photonic devices.

articles.title: Brazilian SARS-CoV-2 Variants: Computational Approaches To Structural Insights Into RBD Mutations And Their Interactions With ACE2
articles.abstract: Mutations in the SARS-CoV-2 Spike Receptor-Binding Domain (RBD) may influence viral infectivity and transmissibility by modulating interactions with the human Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme 2 (ACE2) receptor. This study examined the impact of RBD point mutations by integrating Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, Normal Mode Analysis (NMA), and Machine Learning (ML). From the Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID), SARS-CoV-2 lineages circulating in Brazil between January 2023 and May 2024 were identified, and the prevalent RBD mutations, along with those reported in the literature, were selected for analysis. Mutant models were prepared using CHARMM-GUI and simulated for 50 ns with Nanoscale Molecular Dynamics (NAMD). Trajectories were analyzed in Visual Molecular Dynamics (VMD) through Root Mean Square Deviation, hydrogen bonds, residue-residue distances, and intermolecular contact persistence. NMA based on the Elastic Network Model, evaluated Root Mean Square Fluctuations and collective motions, while ML identified patterns across mutants. The analyses suggested mutation-specific differences in conformational dynamics and interactions. While some mutations increased structural flexibility, others maintained behaviors comparable to the wild type, with most preserving coordinated global motions. Observed differences were associated with compensatory structural adjustments, redistribution of contacts, and modulation of local flexibility. These findings suggest that, initially, RBD mutations may fine-tune the balance between rigidity and flexibility, enabling conformational adaptations that are potentially relevant to receptor engagement and membrane fusion. The results support the hypothesis that structural plasticity and transient conformational states are important for the Spike protein function while preserving global motion of the RBD-ACE2 complex.

articles.title: Combining a Geomagnetic Precursor with Dynamic Time Warping for Solar-Cycle Peak and Trajectory Forecasting
articles.title_zh: 将地磁前驱体与动态时间扭曲相结合，用于太阳周期峰值和轨迹预测
articles.abstract: Forecasting the solar cycle is particularly difficult near its onset, when only limited information about the new cycle is available. We combine two complementary sources of information. A geomagnetic aa-index precursor provides an early estimate of cycle amplitude, while a historical analog model identifies past solar cycles that most closely resemble the developing cycle and uses them to forecast subsequent sunspot evolution. Cycle similarity is quantified using dynamic time warping (DTW), which allows cycles of different lengths to be compared through flexible alignment along the time axis. The geomagnetic and analog peak estimates are then combined so that the estimate with lower historical uncertainty receives greater influence. The resulting forecast trajectory is adjusted to join the latest observation while keeping sunspot numbers non-negative. We tested the method by reconstructing forecasts for Solar Cycles 21–24 at six stages of each cycle, using only information available up to each stage. In 20 of the 24 cases, the cycle maximum had not yet been observed. For peak amplitude, the combined estimate has a mean absolute error (MAE) of 16.1 smoothed sunspots, compared with 18.6 for an equal-weight combination and 25.1 for the geomagnetic precursor alone. Matching the developing cycle against complete historical cycles reduces the mean trajectory error from 26.1 to 20.2 smoothed sunspots, compared with first resampling historical cycles to the length of the observed record. Further tests show that this improvement is mainly associated with preserving the original lengths of the historical cycles during matching, rather than with the choice between approximate and exact DTW calculations. The trajectory adjustment also prevents artificial flat zero-valued tails during the declining phase.  The resulting empirical uncertainty bands are narrower than those from the earlier DTW method, although their coverage varies considerably between cycles , particularly for Solar Cycle 22. They are therefore interpreted as empirical measures of forecast uncertainty rather than as calibrated prediction intervals. The forecasting procedure has been specified for Solar Cycle 26, allowing the method to be tested on a new solar cycle without changing the rules after the outcome is known.

articles.title: Confinement-loss prediction in photonic crystal fiber SPR sensors: kernel surrogates versus generative data augmentation
articles.title_zh: 光子晶体光纤SPR传感器中的约束损耗预测：内核代理与生成式数据增强
articles.abstract: Designing photonic crystal fiber (PCF) based surface plasmon resonance (SPR) sensors requires repeated full-vectorial finite element simulation, which makes iterative geometric optimisation prohibitively slow. Machine-learned surrogates are the standard remedy, and the prevailing strategy is to grow the scarce simulation set with a generative adversarial network before fitting a deep network. We show that this strategy is counterproductive for the kernel models that suit this data regime. On a 432-sample full-vectorial finite element dataset, a Bayesian-optimised support vector regressor reaches a mean squared error of 0.121 on the held-out geometry, against 0.314 for the published GAN-augmented deep network, a 61% reduction achieved without synthetic data. Adding the same synthetic samples degrades both kernel models: the support vector regressor rises to 0.197 and Gaussian process regression collapses entirely. We trace the collapse to its cause, exhibiting generated sample pairs that sit 0.011 apart in scaled feature space yet differ by 0.168 in log-scaled loss, driving the covariance matrix towards singularity. Shapley attribution identifies the outer cladding holes as the dominant control on confinement loss, and a Monte Carlo study identifies the lattice pitch as the dominant source of resonance instability under fabrication error, at 98.8% of the variance in peak position. Timing measurements show the generative route to be the most expensive stage of the pipeline while reducing accuracy. The resulting surrogate is interpretable, trains in under a minute, and needs 70% less simulation data than comparable neural approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 设计基于光子晶体光纤（ PCF ）的表面等离子体共振（ SPR ）传感器需要重复的全矢量有限元模拟，这使得迭代几何优化极其缓慢。机器学习代理是标准补救措施，流行的策略是在拟合深度网络之前，使用生成对抗网络来扩展稀缺的模拟集。我们表明，这种策略对于适合这种数据体制的内核模型是适得其反的。在432个样本的全向量有限元数据集上，贝叶斯优化的支持向量回归器在保持几何上达到0.121的均方误差，而已发表的GAN增强深度网络的均方误差为0.314 ，在没有合成数据的情况下减少了61%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 设计基于光子晶体光纤（ PCF ）的表面等离子体共振（ SPR ）传感器需要重复的全矢量有限元模拟，这使得迭代几何优化极其缓慢。机器学习代理是标准补救措施，流行的策略是在拟合深度网络之前，使用生成对抗网络来扩展稀缺的模拟集。我们表明，这种策略对于适合这种数据体制的内核模型是适得其反的。在432个样本的全向量有限元数据集上，贝叶斯优化的支持向量回归器在保持几何上达到0.121的均方误差，而已发表的GAN增强深度网络的均方误差为0.314 ，在没有合成数据的情况下减少了61%。添加相同的合成样本会降低两个内核模型的质量：支持向量回归量上升到0.197 ，高斯过程回归完全崩溃。我们将崩溃追溯到其原因，显示生成的样本对在缩放特征空间中相距0.011 ，但在对数缩放损失方面相差0.168 ，从而将协方差矩阵推向奇点。Shapley归因将外包层孔识别为约束损失的主要控制，蒙特卡罗研究将晶格间距识别为制造误差下共振不稳定性的主要来源，峰值位置方差的98.8%。计时测量显示，生成路线是管道中最昂贵的阶段，同时降低了准确性。由此产生的替代品是可解释的，训练时间不到一分钟，与同类神经方法相比，所需的模拟数据减少了70%。

articles.title: Preserved Alcohol Cue Salience Despite Olfactory Dysfunction Is Associated with Multimodal Alterations in Olfactory–Reward Networks
articles.title_zh: 尽管嗅觉功能障碍，但保留的酒精提示显著性与嗅觉奖励网络的多峰改变相关
articles.abstract: Chronic alcohol consumption is associated with olfactory dysfunction, but the neurobiological mechanisms linking impaired olfactory function with alcohol cue responsiveness remain unclear. Ninety-eight alcohol consumers underwent objective olfactory assessment, a behavioral odor-cue task, structural MRI, fixel-based diffusion MRI, and proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS), and were classified as having normal olfactory function (threshold–discrimination score ≥ 16; n = 54) or olfactory dysfunction (score < 16; n = 44). Greater alcohol consumption was associated with poorer olfactory function (r = − 0.28, p < 0.01). Despite olfactory dysfunction, familiarity with alcohol beverage odors was preserved, while alcohol cue-induced craving was greater at the highest alcohol concentration (42.8%; β = 0.67, p = 0.04). Compared to participants with normal olfactory function, those with olfactory dysfunction showed lower cognitive performance (Cohen's d = − 0.58, pFDR = 0.02), smaller thalamic and amygdala volumes (d = − 0.70 and − 0.67, pFDR = 0.01), reduced superior thalamic radiation fibre cross-section (d = − 1.30, pFDR < 0.001), and lower prefrontal glutamate concentration (d = − 0.78, pFDR = 0.01). The neurometabolite (MRS) composite was associated with alcohol consumption (β = 0.52, p < 0.01) and significantly mediated the association between olfactory dysfunction and alcohol consumption. Chronic alcohol consumption is thus associated with impaired olfactory function and coordinated neurometabolic, gray matter, and white matter alterations within an olfactory–reward network. Preserved familiarity and craving responses to alcohol-related odors despite impaired olfactory function suggest selective maintenance of alcohol cue salience and highlight olfactory dysfunction as a potential behavioral marker of alcohol-related brain dysfunction.
articles.abstract_zh: 慢性饮酒与嗅觉功能障碍有关，但嗅觉功能受损与酒精提示反应相关的神经生物学机制尚不清楚。98名酒精消费者接受了客观的嗅觉评估、行为气味提示任务、结构MRI、基于固定点的扩散MRI和质子磁共振波谱（ MRS ） ，并被归类为具有正常嗅觉功能（阈值鉴别评分≥ 16 ； n = 54 ）或嗅觉功能障碍（评分< 16 ； n = 44 ）。饮酒越多，嗅觉功能越差（ r = -0.28 ， p < 0.01 ）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 慢性饮酒与嗅觉功能障碍有关，但嗅觉功能受损与酒精提示反应相关的神经生物学机制尚不清楚。98名酒精消费者接受了客观的嗅觉评估、行为气味提示任务、结构MRI、基于固定点的扩散MRI和质子磁共振波谱（ MRS ） ，并被归类为具有正常嗅觉功能（阈值鉴别评分≥ 16 ； n = 54 ）或嗅觉功能障碍（评分< 16 ； n = 44 ）。饮酒越多，嗅觉功能越差（ r = -0.28 ， p < 0.01 ）。尽管存在嗅觉功能障碍，但对酒精饮料气味的熟悉程度得以保留，而酒精线索诱导的渴望在酒精浓度最高时更大（ 42.8 ％ ； β = 0.67 ， p = 0.04 ）。与嗅觉功能正常的参与者相比，嗅觉功能障碍的参与者表现出较低的认知表现（ Cohen's d = − 0.58 ， pFDR = 0.02 ） ，较小的丘脑和杏仁核体积（ d = − 0.70和− 0.67 ， pFDR = 0.01 ） ，较低的丘脑辐射纤维横截面（ d = − 1.30 ， pFDR < 0.001 ）和较低的前额谷氨酸浓度（ d = − 0.78 ， pFDR = 0.01 ）。神经代谢物（ MRS ）复合物与酒精消耗（ β = 0.52 ， p < 0.01 ）相关，并显著介导嗅觉功能障碍与酒精消耗之间的关联。因此，慢性饮酒与嗅觉功能受损以及嗅觉奖励网络中协调的神经代谢、灰质和白质的改变有关。尽管嗅觉功能受损，但对酒精相关气味仍保持熟悉和渴望的反应，这表明选择性地维持酒精线索的突出性，并突出嗅觉功能障碍是酒精相关脑功能障碍的潜在行为标志物。

articles.title: An evaluation method for anti-relaxation coatings in alkali-metal vapor cells based on cumulative relaxation damage factor
articles.title_zh: 基于累积松弛损伤因子的碱金属蒸气池抗松弛涂层评价方法
articles.abstract: Alkali‑metal vapor cells are critical for quantum precision measurement devices such as atomic gyroscopes, magnetometers and clocks. The anti‑relaxation coating on cell walls determines atomic spin polarization lifetime and measurement sensitivity. Conventional evaluations depend on short‑term relaxation tests and fail to characterize long‑term coating stability and microscopic degradation. This work proposes a novel evaluation method based on a cumulative relaxation damage factor. From long‑range kinetic perspectives, alkali‑metal surface dynamics are decomposed into three elementary processes quantified by adsorption energy, charge transfer and diffusion barrier. Drawing on Lusser’s reliability law, we construct this unified factor to interpret relaxation mechanisms and assess coating performance. A first‑principles computational framework with periodic slab models is established for alkali‑metal and organic/inorganic interfaces, validated using experimental interaction parameters of four typical coatings. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed cumulative relaxation damage factor effectively distinguishes the anti-relaxation performance of different coatings and exhibits general applicability across various alkali-metal species. This study converts cumulative long‑range kinetic relaxation into microscopic coating design rules, offering a theoretical tool for wall‑collision relaxation analysis, coating screening and quantum sensing instruments optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 碱金属蒸汽电池对于原子陀螺仪、磁力计和时钟等量子精密测量设备至关重要。细胞壁上的抗弛豫涂层决定了原子自旋极化寿命和测量灵敏度。常规评估依赖于短期弛豫试验，未能表征长期涂层稳定性和微观降解。本文提出了一种基于累积松弛损伤因子的评估方法。从远程动力学的角度来看，碱金属表面动力学被分解成三个基本过程，通过吸附能、电荷转移和扩散屏障来量化。根据Lusser的可靠性定律，我们构建了这个统一的因素来解释松弛机制和评估涂层性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碱金属蒸汽电池对于原子陀螺仪、磁力计和时钟等量子精密测量设备至关重要。细胞壁上的抗弛豫涂层决定了原子自旋极化寿命和测量灵敏度。常规评估依赖于短期弛豫试验，未能表征长期涂层稳定性和微观降解。本文提出了一种基于累积松弛损伤因子的评估方法。从远程动力学的角度来看，碱金属表面动力学被分解成三个基本过程，通过吸附能、电荷转移和扩散屏障来量化。根据Lusser的可靠性定律，我们构建了这个统一的因素来解释松弛机制和评估涂层性能。针对碱金属和有机/无机界面建立了具有周期板坯模型的第一原理计算框架，并使用四种典型涂层的实验相互作用参数进行了验证。仿真结果表明，提出的累积弛豫损伤因子有效地区分了不同涂层的抗弛豫性能，对各种碱金属物种具有普遍适用性。本研究将累积远程动力学松弛转化为微观涂层设计规则，为壁面碰撞松弛分析、涂层筛选和量子传感仪器优化提供了理论工具。

articles.title: Dynamic protonation of nickel, manganese & cobalt (NMC) and its effect on simultaneous estimation and chelation potential of polyphenolic ligand(s)
articles.title_zh: 镍、锰和钴（ NMC ）的动态质子化及其对多酚配体的同时估计和螯合电位的影响
articles.abstract: Quantitative simultaneous estimation and chelation of transition-metal cations such as Ni, Co, and Mn (NCM) associated with Li-ion cathodes is challenging because of their overlapping physicochemical properties. Lithium-ion recycling is currently performed by conventional pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical processes, which are costlier, energy-intensive, and low-resolution techniques. A systematic approach was adopted for simultaneous estimation and high-throughput chelation of NCM by polyphenolic natural ligands using Plackett-Burman screening design, followed by physicochemical analysis by FTIR, SEM-EDX, & ICP-OES and validation using density functional theory (DFT). The simultaneous estimation of Ni, Co, & Mn and their equimolar mixture (NCM) was fitted and analyzed based on Pearson’s r and adjusted R2 value. PB design analysis of the simultaneous chelation study conferred curcumin with the highest standardized effect and expected half-normal probability values of 9.22 and 1.6, respectively. The single-point energy (Eh) derived from density functional theory (DFT) was used to compute the binding energy (ΔE) between the chelating ligand & NCM in protonated and deprotonated states, providing quantitative relative intermolecular stability along with the corresponding HOMO-LUMO energy gap (ΔEgap). FTIR profile confirms the role of keto and enol functional groups of curcumin in simultaneous chelation of NCM; further SEM-EDX of the co-coordination complex and ICP-OES elemental analysis of NCM confirm the significance of protonation on transitional NCM chelation by polyphenolic natural ligands.
articles.abstract_zh: 与锂离子阴极相关的过渡金属阳离子（如Ni ， Co和Mn （ NCM ） ）的定量同时估计和螯合具有挑战性，因为它们具有重叠的物理化学性质。锂离子回收目前通过传统的高温冶金和湿法冶金工艺进行，这些工艺成本更高、能源密集型和低分辨率技术。采用Plackett-Burman筛选设计，采用系统方法通过多酚天然配体同时估计和高通量螯合NCM ，然后通过FTIR、SEM-EDX和ICP-OES进行物理化学分析，并使用密度泛函理论（ DFT ）进行验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 与锂离子阴极相关的过渡金属阳离子（如Ni ， Co和Mn （ NCM ） ）的定量同时估计和螯合具有挑战性，因为它们具有重叠的物理化学性质。锂离子回收目前通过传统的高温冶金和湿法冶金工艺进行，这些工艺成本更高、能源密集型和低分辨率技术。采用Plackett-Burman筛选设计，采用系统方法通过多酚天然配体同时估计和高通量螯合NCM ，然后通过FTIR、SEM-EDX和ICP-OES进行物理化学分析，并使用密度泛函理论（ DFT ）进行验证。根据Pearson's r和调整后的R2值对Ni、Co和Mn及其等摩尔混合物（ NCM ）的同时估计进行拟合和分析。同步螯合研究的PB设计分析赋予姜黄素最高的标准化效果和预期半正常概率值分别为9.22和1.6。密度泛函理论（ DFT ）衍生的单点能量（ Eh ）用于计算质子化和去质子化状态下螯合配体与NCM之间的结合能（ ΔE ） ，提供定量的相对分子间稳定性以及相应的HOMO-LUMO能隙（ ΔEgap ）。FTIR图谱证实了姜黄素的酮基和烯醇官能团在NCM的同时螯合中的作用； NCM的共配络合物和ICP-OES元素分析的进一步SEM-EDX证实了质子化对多酚天然配体过渡NCM螯合的意义。

articles.title: Synthesis, Characterisation and Biological Evaluation of Some 5- Trifluoromethylisoxazole Derivatives
articles.title_zh: 一些5-三氟甲基异恶唑衍生物的合成、表征和生物学评价
articles.abstract: A series of 4-(aryldiazenyl)-5-trifluoromethyl substituted isoxazole derivatives (3a-n and 3aa-an) was synthesized to explore their biological potential. All compounds were characterized by analyzing their FT-IR, ¹H/¹³C/¹⁹F NMR spectroscopic, and mass spectrometric data. The DFT calculations further supported the structural assignment of the hydrazono form (3), among the possible tautomeric structures. The results of in vitro antimicrobial evaluation revealed that among all, seven candidates have shown good potential out of which compound 3ak emerged as the most potent antimicrobial agent, exhibiting remarkable antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) and Bacillus subtilis (B. subtilis) with MIC value of 80 µg/mL, comparable to Ciprofloxacin (MIC = 62.5 µg/mL); and significantly higher antifungal potential against Candida albicans (C. albicans) with MIC value of 320 µg/mL than Amphotericin B (MIC = 1280 µg/ mL). Antioxidant screening revealed that 3j, 3l, 3aa, 3ae, 3ah–ak and 3al–an displayed strong antioxidant potential with EC₅₀ values of 62.5–125 µg/mL, in comparison to ascorbic acid (EC₅₀ = 132.7 µg/mL). In addition, 3g, 3n, 3f, 3m, 3af, 3ag, 3am, and 3an displayed excellent and 3b, 3e, 3aa, 3ae, and 3h demonstrated significant DNA protective effects against UV-induced damage at 60 µg/mL concentration. Hence, the results of the present study demonstrated that the synthesized 5-trifluoromethyl substituted isoxazoles have significant antioxidant potential along with good DNA protective potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 合成了一系列4- (芳基二苯基) -5-三氟甲基取代的异恶唑衍生物(3a-n和3aa-an) ，以探索其生物学潜力。所有化合物均通过分析其FT-IR、¹ H/¹ ³ C/¹ ”F NMR光谱和质谱数据进行表征。在可能的互变异构结构中， DFT计算进一步支持了肼形式（ 3 ）的结构分配。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 合成了一系列4- (芳基二苯基) -5-三氟甲基取代的异恶唑衍生物(3a-n和3aa-an) ，以探索其生物学潜力。所有化合物均通过分析其FT-IR、¹ H/¹ ³ C/¹ ”F NMR光谱和质谱数据进行表征。在可能的互变异构结构中， DFT计算进一步支持了肼形式（ 3 ）的结构分配。体外抗菌评价结果表明，在所有候选药物中，有7种显示出良好的潜力，其中化合物3ak成为最有效的抗菌剂，对金黄色葡萄球菌（金黄色葡萄球菌）和枯草芽孢杆菌（枯草芽孢杆菌）表现出显着的抗菌活性， MIC值为80 µg/mL ，与环丙沙星（ MIC = 62.5 µg/mL ）相当；对白色念珠菌（ C.与两性霉素B （ MIC = 1280 µg/mL ）相比， MIC值为320 µg/mL。抗氧化剂筛选显示， 3j、3l、3aa、3ae、3ah-ak和3al-an显示出较强的抗氧化剂潜力， EC值为62.5-125 µg/mL ，与抗坏血酸（ EC = 132.7 µg/mL ）相比。此外，在60 µg/mL浓度下， 3g、3n、3f、3m、3af、3ag、3am和3an显示出优异的DNA保护作用， 3b、3e、3aa、3ae和3h显示出对紫外线诱导的损伤的显著DNA保护作用。因此，本研究的结果表明，合成的5-三氟甲基取代的异恶唑具有显著的抗氧化潜力以及良好的DNA保护潜力。

articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 24 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03469-z Vortex motion and heating prevent direct-current measurements from reaching the intrinsic depairing limit of type-II superconductors. Picosecond pulses bypass these effects and reveal a sharp threshold in NbN but gradual pair breaking in YBa2Cu3O7.

articles.title: An information-theoretic proof of the Planckian bound for thermalization
articles.title_zh: 普朗克热化界限的信息论证明
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 24 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03397-y Studies of many-body physics have indicated that thermalization processes are bounded by a timescale determined by Planck’s constant. Such a bound has now been proved to apply in general using techniques from quantum information theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 对多体物理学的研究表明，热化过程受普朗克常数确定的时间尺度的限制。现在已经证明，这种界限通常使用量子信息理论的技术来应用。

articles.abstract: Nature Photonics, Published online: 24 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02022-x Multiphoton scattering process is extracted from the resonance fluorescence of a single 87Rb atom. Tripartite entanglement between the photons is verified by a violation of Svetlichny’s inequality. A quantum secret sharing protocol is demonstrated as an application example.

Sau, and Mohammad Hafezi Voltage-tunable semiconductor-superconductor qubits and optical connectivity address different bottlenecks to scaling up superconducting quantum computing. Here, the authors show theoretically that these approaches can be combined in one device: semiconductor optical transitions in a hybrid junction directly access its microwave-active Andreev bound states. This light–Andreev interaction enables optical spectroscopy and control of the bound states, while providing a mechanism for coherent microwave-to-optical photon transduction. [Phys. Rev. articles.title: Easy-plane anisotropy of magnetic fluctuations in UTe2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.26869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The large directional anisotropy of superconducting UTe2 along the lattice a, b, c directions in magnetic susceptibility, upper critical fields, and Knight shift suggests spin-triplet Cooper pairing. If spin fluctuations bind the Cooper pair, one needs to determine their anisotropy in spin space to characterize the superconducting state. Here we use polarised and unpolarised inelastic neutron scattering (INS) experiments to show that antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin fluctuations at the Y point are highly isotropic within the ac-plane but have no observable magnitude along the b-axis. Our results rule out the assumed Ising anisotropy and constrain the possible pairing channels. AFM exchange is no longer pair forming in the triplet channel and the d vector along b is strongly favoured. We capture the experimental observations within a microscopic framework that encompasses the dual nature of 5f electrons. We include itinerant and localized 5f-moments in a tight-binding model fitted to quantum oscillations data. In congruence with INS, the exchange between localized moments generically consists of a strong FM intra-dimer interaction, maxima close to the Y and T points, mediated by 5p_y and 6d₃z^₂₋ᵣ^₂ orbitals respectively, and magnetically decoupled ab-planes. We find that anisotropy and dimerization of the moments can lead to gapped excitations that, in combination with Landau damping, can produce the observed overdamped response at the Y point. We suggest that enhancement of the response and its observed near-O(2)-symmetry could both be driven by proximity to a quantum critical point where the dimer excitation gap closes and gives place to incommensurate helical order. Analysis of the linearized gap equation for a nearest-neighbour pairing interaction favours the B1u triplet with a dominant d-vector component along b, although the possibility of spin singlet pairing cannot be ruled out.

articles.title: Fermion bag study of the two-dimensional Majorana-Hubbard model at finite hopping
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.26881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The two-dimensional Majorana-Hubbard model on the π-flux lattice involves the most local interaction possible for a lattice with one relativistic Majorana fermion per site. It is predicted to host a Majorana semimetal, dimerized phases, and quantum-critical points with an emergent U(1) symmetry. Nonperturbative lattice calculations for this model remain a major open challenge, thus far limited to zero hopping. We present quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the model at finite hopping using Hamiltonian fermion bags, which are based on a continuous-time expansion with Boltzmann weights that are Pfaffians of a matrix with dimension set by the expansion order, and which give the sign of the weight. Sign problem severity is related to the location of zero modes in the free hopping matrix, and for couplings glesssim 0.7 and β=L/4 it is fully removed for lattices up to at least 256 sites. The interaction strength g>0 enhances the U(1)-charged dimerization doublet and suppresses the neutral channel, as the renormalization group predicts. Increasing the interactions also restores U(1) symmetry in the component of the dimerization correlator that is even under bond orientation exchange, but not its odd component. There is a persistent anisotropy in the odd component with the symmetry of a lattice nematic. The data is consistent with a gapless semimetal throughout the sign-problem-minimal window.

articles.title: Control of filament network rigidity by the condensation of crowding molecules
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.26983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how liquid-liquid phase separation impacts the mechanics of filament networks 6 is a fundamental physical problem at the heart of biological cellular processes and soft material 7 design. While a few theoretical mechanisms have been proposed, a clear demonstration of the direct 8 coupling of phase separation to the overall network stiffness is missing. We report experiments 9 that reveal a universal mechanism by which the condensation of macromolecular crowders induces 10 a rigidity transition in a model filament network. We reconstituted stiff sterically interacting helical 11 filaments and polymeric crowders. Initially, the macromolecules were uniformly dissolved and the 12 filaments formed bundles that assembled a rigid entangled network. Once the crowders condensed 13 into droplets, the network structure lost its rigidity and its mechanical response weakened by an 14 order-of-magnitude. The subsequent dissolution of the condensates was accompanied by the re15 establishment of rigidity. Our results show that crowder phase separation modulates the mechanics 16 of filament networks by tuning the osmotic pressure holding the network together. This principle 17 may serve as a paradigm for devising dynamically tunable filamentous materials.

articles.title: Electronic Effects of a Twisted Graphene Catenoid Bridge
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.26988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between non-trivial background geometries and quantum dynamics has emerged as a powerful tool to tailor the electronic properties of 2D materials. In this work, we investigate the effective quantum dynamics of massless Dirac fermions confined to a twisted graphene structure called a catenoid bridge, which connects two single-layer sheets. By adopting a continuum approach, where the electron dynamics is governed by a purely covariant curved Dirac equation, we obtain the effective Hamiltonian containing both curvature and twist interactions. We found that the torsion modifies the electronic states by producing a geometric phase on the wave function. In addition, the twist also deforms the surface geometry, which leads to a new geometric term in the effective Hamiltonian. This twist potential enhances the barrier around the catenoid throat, which increases the suppression of the inter-layer transmission coefficient. Like the spin-curvature interaction, the spin-twist term has a chiral dependence which is invariant under a combined parity and spin flip transformation. As a result, the electronic states can be restricted to the upper or lower layer. These findings provide valuable insights into how mechanical deformations can be harnessed to control quantum transport in graphene-based wormhole architectures.

articles.title: Spectroscopic signatures of persistent exciton condensation in a bulk magnetic topological insulator
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.27079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exciton condensates are long-sought correlated quantum states arising from macroscopic coherence of bound electron-hole pairs. Although equilibrium and transient excitonic states have been reported in several material platforms, direct evidence for a light-induced exciton condensate state has been challenging to achieve as an intrinsic property of a bulk quantum material. Here, we use time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to investigate long-lived photoexcited carriers in the intrinsic magnetic topological insulator MnBi₂Te₄ with the chemical potential tuned to the topological surface state by Sb substitution. Following optical excitation, we observe the delayed emergence of a transient state whose formation coincides with depopulation of the bulk conduction band and whose lifetime extends to the microsecond timescale. The quasiparticle dispersion exhibits a pronounced flattening and develops a Mexican-hat-like profile. These spectral signatures are consistent with the formation of a metastable excitonic condensate state. Our results establish magnetic topological insulators as a promising platform for investigating long-lived photoinduced many-body states and their interplay with topology and magnetism.

articles.title: Resonantly Enhanced Phonon Transport by Magnon Pumping in a Ferromagnetic/Piezoelectric Bilayer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.27101v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the first experimental observation of resonantly enhanced propagating phonon transport induced by magnon pumping in a ferromagnetic/piezoelectric bilayer. Surface acoustic waves (SAWs) generated in a 128cⁱrc Y-cut LiNbO₃ delay-line device resonantly excite magnetization dynamics in an adjacent Co film through magnetoelastic coupling. The enhancement of the transmitted acoustic signal occurs exclusively when the SAW frequency satisfies the ferromagnetic resonance condition predicted by the Kittel dispersion, providing a direct experimental fingerprint of resonant magnon-phonon coupling. A systematic comparison between the Co/LiNbO₃ bilayer and the bare LiNbO₃ substrate demonstrates that the observed transmission enhancement originates solely from the dynamic interaction between propagating phonons and coherent magnetization precession. Furthermore, measurements performed at different SAW harmonics reveal that only the harmonic satisfying the FMR condition produces a measurable enhancement, confirming the frequency-selective nature of the phenomenon. These findings establish an efficient mechanism for transferring energy from magnons to propagating phonons and provide a new strategy for actively controlling coherent acoustic transport in hybrid spintronic, straintronic, and quantum phononic platforms.

articles.title: Detecting a large magneto-optical shift in Py/NiO bilayers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.27106v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here, magneto-optical magnetometry measurements on Py/NiO bilayers reveal a pronounced magnetic-field-induced wavelength shift, demonstrating strong magneto-optical coupling in this antiferromagnetic system. A systematic and monotonic spectral shift of up to ~ 400 nm is observed as the applied magnetic field increases, saturating at higher fields. Quantitative analysis shows that the associated magneto-optical energy variation is on the order of 107 eV, comparable to the magnon energy scale in NiO. Owing to the large NiO thickness, the observed effect originates from magnons intrinsic to the antiferromagnetic NiO layer rather than from spin currents injected by the Py underlayer. These results provide direct experimental evidence for magnetic-field control of antiferromagnetic magnon energies via magneto-optical interactions, establishing Py/NiO bilayers as a promising platform for optically probing and manipulating antiferromagnetic spin dynamics.

articles.title: Towards Extended Active Learning for Modelling Ferroelectric Switching: the Need for 'Gold Standards'
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.27108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For the purpose of modelling ferroelectric switching in wurtzite-structured materials, four cost-effective density-functional theory (DFT) methods (PBE, PBEsol, r2SCAN, and r2SCAN-rVV10) are considered and compared to various ab initio approaches based on the random-phase approximation (RPA), including RPA with singles corrections (RPAR+S), as well as second-order Møller-Plesset perturbation theory (MP2). The purpose is to determine whether an ab initio approach could act as a 'gold standard' for estimating the reliability of DFT, thus determining an optimal DFT method for use in exhaustive tasks such as the training of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIP) for large-scale simulations of materials of arbitrary composition and structure such as Al1-xScxN and Zn1-xMgxO, using AlN, Al0.5Sc0.5N, ZnO, and Zn0.5Mg0.5O as model materials. Applications of active learning (AL) are now common, in which results from MLIP simulations are used to enhance the DFT training data set, but future extended active learning (EAL) methods will also need to systematically assess the DFT methodology against a gold standard. Herein, the variability of the ab initio results is found to exceed that required for a robust gold standard, but the DFT and ab initio approaches appear to converge on RPAR+S and r2SCAN-rVV10 as optimal method choices to initiate EAL. The electron correlation energy is found to be dominated by covalent binding effects associated with the high-electron-density anions involved, but the van der Waals dispersion force is seen to be too significant to ignore in ferroelectric modelling.

articles.title: Exact Equivariance from Ordinary Neural Networks for Lattice Many-Body Dynamics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.27132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale simulations of correlated electron systems require repeated evaluations of the electronic forces and transition energies driving collective dynamics. Machine-learning surrogates alleviate this bottleneck, but incorporating symmetry often involves carefully designed descriptors or specialized network architectures. We show that ordinary multilayer perceptrons equipped with finite-group averaging provide exactly equivariant surrogates directly from microscopic configurations. The construction separates symmetry enforcement from the internal network architecture and applies to both discrete and continuous lattice degrees of freedom. In the Falicov--Kimball model, it predicts directional hopping free-energy differences; in the Holstein model, its invariant limit generates conservative lattice forces. Benchmarks against exact diagonalization establish microscopic accuracy and agreement of dynamical correlations, while large-scale simulations recover multiscale charge ordering and charge-density-wave coarsening. These results demonstrate an accessible, reusable route to symmetry-preserving many-body dynamics for systems with finite lattice point groups.

articles.title: Electric-field switchable interlayer magnetic order and anomalous valley Hall effect in Janus VSSe bilayers with different interfaces
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.27212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric-field control of magnetic order and valley polarization holds great promise for spintronic and valleytronic applications. However, achieving such electrical modulation remains a fundamental challenge in two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnets. Herein, via first-principles calculations, we verify that electrically tunable interlayer magnetic order and valley polarization can be realized in Janus VSSe bilayers with different interfaces. Although the magnitudes of dipole moments within each constituent Janus monolayer are identical, the vertical built-in electrostatic potential difference Δφ across the bilayer depends strongly on the orientations of these dipoles, which originates from the distinct interfacial configurations. As a consequence, the VSSe bilayers with different interfaces possess distinct interlayer magnetic couplings and show dramatically varied responses to external electric fields.
